jobs.title: Restaurant Zone Manager
jobs.description:
Your Role at Raising Cane’s:

The Restaurant Zone Manager is responsible for supporting the Restaurant Leader in day-to-day operations of the restaurant and upholding Raising Cane’s standards and culture in management responsibilities of one restaurant zone’s operations.

The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. It also includes both inside and outside work in varied temperatures, working with and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, commercial cleaning products that require the use of personal protective equipment and physical activities necessary to complete the responsibilities of the job.

Your Impact and Responsibilities:

• Purpose of the position:Ensures operations meet Raising Cane’s standards in one restaurant zone during a shift
• General to the role:Enforces Raising Cane’s policies and standardsManages assigned zone according to Raising Cane’s operations and safety standardsUses required tools, forms and logs to support shift execution, document results and take corrective action when neededDirects crewmembers during a shiftProvides exemplary customer serviceSupports execution of reward and recognition program for the crewmembers in the restaurantAuthorizes employee functions requiring manager approval (e.g. discounts, promotions, etc.)Ensures cleanliness of the restaurant and ensures the facility is in good working orderCompletes other duties as assigned

Requirements for Success:

• Detail-oriented, organized and able to manage multiple priorities that may be constantly changing
• Self-driven, flexible, and highly energetic with strong written and verbal communication skills
• Able to work effectively and efficiently both independently and collaboratively
• Able to recognize problems, set goals, execute and convert plans into action to solve problems
• Able to work a variety of shifts including days, evenings and weekends and travel as needed for work-related functions and training
• Must complete all required Raising Cane’s company training programs
• 1+ years of restaurant or retail management experience, or Raising Cane’s advanced crew experience
• Must be 18 years of age or older
• High school diploma or equivalent preferred

jobs.title: Regional Fire & Life Safety Principal
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The ideal candidate will be responsible for launching and growing the fire protection engineering division in the Mid-Atlantic, ideally in the Washington DC metro area. This role requires a blend of technical expertise in fire protection engineering, business acumen, and strong leadership skills to build a team, establish key operational processes, and drive business growth. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully leading engineering teams, managing startup environments, and contributing to strategic growth in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & Market Development

• Define and execute the Mid-Atlantic market entry and growth strategy for SLS, establishing SOCOTEC as a trusted partner within the local construction, development, and infrastructure ecosystem. Success requires deep understanding of local procurement dynamics and the ability to identify and pursue the right decision-makers across private and public sectors.
• Develop and execute a market-specific growth plan for the SLS Service Line, aligned with the Region's and SOCOTEC's national strategy
• Drive market penetration and revenue growth by identifying and securing new client opportunities within the Service Line and related offerings
• Build and sustain senior client relationships with key clients, owners, developers, contractors, engineers, and industry stakeholders in the local area
• Drive cross-selling of SOCOTEC's integrated service offerings, partnering with other Business Unit General Managers in the Region to maximize lifetime client value
• Establish and nurture long-term client partnerships to anticipate needs and proactively address challenges
• Serve as the primary point of contact for major clients within the local area for the Service Line
• Represent SOCOTEC as a visible market leader through industry involvement, thought leadership, and active participation in local professional organizations

Operational & Financial Management

• This role requires disciplined operational leadership combined with strong financial acumen. The Business Unit Manager will establish scalable processes that support growth while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and compliance within their Service Line.
• Oversee fire protection engineering projects from inception to completion, ensuring adherence to budgets, timelines, and quality standards. Provide technical expertise and leadership during the design, analysis, and implementation phases.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest fire protection technologies, codes, and regulations. Provide guidance and support to the team in areas such as fire suppression systems, life safety systems, fire alarm systems, and building code compliance.
• Ensure all projects comply with local, state, and federal fire protection codes and safety regulations. Serve as a subject matter expert to ensure the highest standards of safety and fire prevention are upheld.
• Full P&L ownership for the Service Line within the local area: manage budgeting, forecasting, utilization management, margin optimization, and cash flow
• Establish and optimize operational processes, quality management systems, and safety protocols specific to the Service Line
• Implement KPIs and performance metrics to drive accountability, continuous improvement, and alignment with utilization and billable hour targets
• Actively manage project execution, resource allocation, billing, and collections for the Service Line
• Support teams with contract tracking, budget monitoring, and collection efforts

Team Leadership & Culture

• Build and lead a high-performing team of engineers, designers, and administrative support within the Service Line, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional excellence. This leader must attract talent capable of scaling with the business while maintaining SOCOTEC's values and performance standards.
• Recruit, develop, and mentor a high-performing technical, commercial, and operational team within the Service Line
• Set clear goals, prioritize objectives, and ensure alignment with overall Regional and business targets
• Ensure objectives and key results are clearly defined, communicated, and monitored for all staff in the Business Unit
• Attract and retain top technical, operational, and business talent capable of scaling with the business
• Build future leaders and support succession planning within the Business Unit
• Promote a hands-on, high-accountability leadership culture
• Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, safety, and professional excellence

• Bachelor's degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field. Master's degree is a plus.
• Professional Engineer (PE) license in Fire Protection Engineering or the ability to obtain one within a reasonable time frame.
• Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in fire protection engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role.
• Strong understanding of fire protection systems design, building codes, and safety regulations (NFPA, IBC, UBC, etc.).
• Experience in managing or starting up a business unit, particularly in a technical or engineering-based environment.
• Proven track record in business development, client relationship management, and project acquisition.
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
• Ability to think strategically, problem-solve, and thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

For more information, please visit www.socotec.us

Job Type: Full-Time

Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Tactical Buyer
jobs.description:
The Tactical Buyer is responsible for managing the purchasing process from requisition through order fulfillment, ensuring timely procurement of materials and services at competitive prices. This role involves obtaining and evaluating vendor quotations, creating and processing purchase orders (POs), coordinating with internal departments, and maintaining strong supplier relationships. The position monitors order confirmations, pricing, quantities, and delivery schedules while proactively resolving supplier and invoice discrepancies within SAP.

Your accountabilities

• Obtain, evaluate and negotiate vendor quotations for pricing, quantities and delivery schedules.
• Manages the full cycle PO process.
• Communicate with all departments on status of PO’s.
• Communicates orders to vendors/suppliers.
• Contact suppliers to ensure they are meeting delivery schedules and minimize the risk of missed deliveries.
• Respond to supplier inquiries about clarifying orders, changes in requests, delivery requirements and cancellations.
• Resolve problems with suppliers to speed up deliveries and to minimize the risk of supply shortages.
• Review requisition orders to ensure accuracy and correct line item specifications.
• Solve invoice issues in SAP (missed quantities, price differences,..).
• Ensure audit compliance and order accuracy.

• 3+ years of experience in a purchasing role
• 1+ yrs of steel purchasing experience preferred
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in purchasing, inventory, or supply chain management
• Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills
• Analytical and mathematical capabilities to compare prices and quantities and consider vendor contract terms
• Ability to evaluate market conditions and various suppliers
• Keen eye for detail
• Willingness to make quick and thoughtful decisions on behalf of the business
• Effective relationship building skills

What do we offer you?

• PTO, days paid sick leave, 11 US paid holidays
• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
• Company paid Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
• Company Paid Life Insurance
• Company Paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment
• 401K with employer match, currently 4%
• Partial Tuition Reimbursement after 12 months
• Gross Salary
• Tobacco Free Campus

jobs.title: Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Pricing Analyst with International SOS Government Medical Services, you'll turn labor, staffing, and financial data into cost models that support pricing decisions for federal proposals.

Working with the Senior Pricing Analyst and FP&A Director, you'll evaluate proposal costs, contract profitability, and pricing assumptions while collaborating with proposal, operations, and finance teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain pricing models and templates for federal proposals, validating labor, materials, overhead, and other costs while documenting assumptions and supporting data.
• Analyze staffing requirements, compensation by locality, prevailing wage rates, and contract-specific requirements to develop accurate labor pricing inputs.
• Evaluate proposal and contract profitability, summarizing cost trade-offs, financial performance, and expected margins for management review.
• Support pricing approaches for FFP, CPFF, T&M, and IDIQ proposals, following established procedures and FAR, DFARS, and company compliance guidance. Identify and escalate pricing or compliance issues for review.
• Research labor rates, material costs, and available competitor information to update pricing assumptions and support proposal decisions.
• Review pricing models for accuracy, formula integrity, and consistency with proposal requirements; assist with peer reviews and additional financial analyses.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in pricing, cost analysis, or program finance within U.S. Government contracting.
• Experience supporting federal pricing proposals.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar analytical tools, including building cost models, analyzing financial data, and validating calculations.
• Understanding of government contract cost elements, profitability drivers, and the financial impact of pricing assumptions.
• Ability to follow pricing compliance requirements, maintain supporting documentation, and identify issues requiring additional review.
• Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills, with excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple pricing assignments, explain financial assumptions, and meet proposal deadlines.

jobs.title: Industrial Site Technician - Middletown, OH
jobs.description:
JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• This is a safety sensitive position.
• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer V
jobs.description:
CRB is seeking an experienced Senior Lead Electrical Engineer with a strong background in building and industrial power systems to lead electrical design efforts on complex projects. In this role, you will be responsible for the design and implementation of low‑ and medium‑voltage electrical systems, mentoring engineering teams, and partnering with clients, project managers, and construction teams from concept through construction.

This role is ideal for a licensed electrical engineer with hands‑on experience in power distribution, lighting, and special systems who enjoys technical leadership, solving complex field challenges, and delivering high‑quality, constructible designs in regulated environments.

Responsibilities

Lead Electrical Design & Project Delivery

• Lead electrical design for complex projects across all phases, including programming, design development, construction documentation, and construction support
• Design and coordinate low‑ and medium‑voltage power distribution systems, including switchgear, panelboards, transformers, feeders, grounding, and protective devices
• Perform advanced power system calculations, including load studies, short‑circuit analysis, voltage drop, and arc flash evaluations
• Develop electrical construction drawings and specifications that are fully code‑compliant and construction‑ready
• Identify and resolve complex existing conditions through site visits and field surveys

Team Leadership & Collaboration

• Direct and coordinate the work of electrical engineers and designers at various experience levels
• Collaborate with project managers on scope definition, scheduling, staffing, and electrical discipline budgets
• Work closely with architectural, mechanical, structural, process, and construction teams to ensure integrated design solutions
• Coordinate with contractors, vendors, utilities, and equipment manufacturers to support design and installation of electrical systems

Construction & Quality Support

• Provide technical leadership during construction, including RFI responses, submittal reviews, site observations, and punch list development
• Perform detailed quality reviews of electrical documents, calculations, and designs to ensure technical accuracy and overall project quality

Mentorship & Growth

• Mentor and develop junior and mid‑level electrical engineers and designers
• Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the electrical team

Required Qualifications

• ABET‑accredited Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering
• 15+ years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in a consulting or design firm environment
• Active Professional Engineer (PE) license
• Proven experience designing and leading projects involving building or industrial power systems and voltage‑based electrical infrastructure

Preferred Experience

• Experience in GMP manufacturing environments, including life sciences or food & beverage facilities
• Strong working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and applicable building codes
• Hands‑on experience with:Low‑ and medium‑voltage systemsPower distribution, lighting, and special systemsShort‑circuit, coordination, load flow, and arc flash studies
• Strong troubleshooting skills for electrical power and system performance issues
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams

jobs.title: AVP, Dams Engineering Practice Leader
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Dams and Hydropower Senior Project Manager in our West Region Water Business Line. The Senior Project Manager will lead major projects and help grow our business in Northern California and Pacific Northwest. This senior level position will ideally be based in Northern California, but we are open to other locations in California, Oregon, or Washington for the right candidate.

With a proud history spanning over 85 years and thousands of successful projects, our expertise in dam and reservoir engineering is unmatched. From feasibility studies to design, construction, and maintenance, we cover every aspect of the process, ensuring the longevity and safety of critical water infrastructure. As part of our team, you'll contribute to our legacy, bringing innovative solutions to life and making a meaningful impact on global water resources.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

• Serve as a program manager, project manager, or technical lead, directing teams on major dams and hydropower projects and programs. Lead multi-disciplinary teams to the successful completion of the project, focusing on client communication and delivery.
• Lead the pursuit of major dam and hydropower projects in Northern California and the Pacific Northwest, leading major proposals,and engaging with clients.
• Support senior leaders in the development of business strategies for dams and hydropower in these regions based on market trends and identify and pursue opportunities within the business line and adjacent sectors.
• Lead client-facing activities to develop business with existing clients and win work with new clients, build strong relationships with clients, teaming partners, industry groups, and stakeholders related to the market sector.
• Develop strategies and capture plans for major pursuits, aligning with AECOM’s business development strategies and technical capabilities. Coordinate project opportunities with the Dams & Hydropower Division Manager and Growth Lead, and senior project managers within the Water Business Line.
• Maintain regular interaction with clients to ensure satisfaction with AECOM services and engage with project delivery personnel to proactively address client feedback on team performance.
• Coordinate with AECOM's Technical Practice Leads and Division Managers to match team skills with market trends and drive strategic technical leadership hires.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree + 10 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's (MS) or Doctorate (PhD) in Engineering. Civil, Structural, Geotechnical, or a related field is preferred.
• Extensive and proven knowledge of dams and hydropower markets, trends, and clients.
• 15+ years dams and hydropower industry technical and leadership experience.
• 5 years of experience leading projects, client accounts, or business development initiatives.
• Strong reputation in the industry through participation in USSD, ASDSO, or related industry organizations.
• Ability to broad scan other water related end markets and to assist in strategy development.
• Agile response to fast paced, complex work environment and organizational change.
• Proven ability to deliver projects and foster collaboration across geographies, disciplines, and business lines.

• Relocation is available for this role.
• Sponsorship is not available now or in the future for this position.
• Occasional project/client related travel may be required.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Grounds & Facilities Supervisor
jobs.description:
Purpose : Responsible for leading and coordinating a team of approximately 10–15 housekeeping staff, including a Team Leader, to ensure housekeeping activities are performed safely, effectively, and in accordance with site procedures and applicable requirements. The role supports housekeeping across a diverse manufacturing environment, including chemical process unit operations, warehouses, classified cleanroom manufacturing areas, weigh booths, common areas, restrooms, locker rooms, and exterior areas. Ensures appropriate staffing, work coordination, quality standards, safety practices, and cleanliness expectations are consistently maintained to support safe and compliant manufacturing operations.

• Operating under the general guidance of the Section Manager, the duties of this position include but are not limited to: planning, organizing, staffing, training, directing and controlling the housekeeping activities.

• More specific duties include the developing and issuing of goals, policies, procedures and programs to produce results in accordance with the corporate objectives as well as the objectives of individual customer divisions and departments. The Supervisor must understand and work successfully with customers who often have urgent and conflicting demands. The Supervisor must also determine requirements for new and replacement tools, provide training and job instruction, know safety rules and regulations

• This position requires the individual to seek out and stay current with new techniques, equipment and materials associated with the housekeeping field. The Supervisor must provide expert technical support for green, yellow and red radioactive environments, Bio level 1, 2 and 3 environments as well as hazardous waste disposal guidelines. The individual needs to be knowledgeable in entrance and exit procedures for controlled environments, cross contamination control procedures, microbial control

• This position requires the individual to assure that all regulatory requirements are met and maintained to include FDA, GMP, OSHA, INRC, ALAC and ISO requirements, to allow research and manufacturing of pharmaceutical, chemical and products to market. The supervisor can also be called on to be a subject matter expert for housekeeping services when working with the FDA of other regulatory agencies.

• Frequently, in addition to his/her more typical responsibilities, the incumbent will act in other assigned roles such as; team leader or work on special inter divisional project teams and/or task forces, provide temporary support for departmental projects, and be a temporary backup for his/her manager.

•Ensures compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal regulatory requirements which include but are not limited to: OSHA's Process Safety Management (PSM) standard (29 CFR 1910.119) and EPA's Risk Management Planning (RMP) rule (40 CFR 68), Mechanical Integrity programs, PCI, DOT, EPA etc.

•Creates a safety culture by setting direction to reduce or eliminate operations-related injuries or accidents, damage/loss of product or equipment, and unnecessary costs by ensuring that all equipment and facilities are maintained consistent with the safety, security, hygiene and standards set by AbbVie.

jobs.title: Clinical Instructor - Master of Science in Nursing – Family Nurse Practitioner. - Faculty
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT AS A WALDEN FACULTY MEMBER

Faculty members educate Walden University students by effectively and proficiently using online technology and resources so that knowledge, information, feedback, and critique are imparted to and shared with students in thoughtful, carefully formulated, well written, and timely communications. Faculty are required to grade assignments, participate in discussions, respond to student emails, use technology designed to enhance the learning experience for students.  This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of the student, the faculty member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the faculty member is involved.

TRAINING

All new faculty members receive specific training from Walden University in the techniques of online teaching; use of an electronic learning platform; specifics of the policies, procedures, and degree programs of the School or College in which they are going to teach; socialization into the Walden University culture; assessment of academic integrity of student work; and research supervision of theses and dissertations. Teaching and mentorship assignments are contingent upon successful completion of required training. During the first term of teaching, faculty members may be assigned a faculty peer mentor (senior colleague) as an extension of their new instructor training. Peer mentors will continue to support instruction and provide peer reviews of the classroom on a regular basis.

COURSE/ TEACHING AVAILABILITY

Faculty members are assigned courses, which are taught using Canvas, and are responsible for interacting with students within Canvas. Discussion Boards for classrooms are open 24 hrs/day, 7 days/wk. Faculty members are expected to be in the classroom a minimum of 4 days/wk and responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hrs. The university suggests regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or regular online chats; office hours and synchronous student meetings may be required based on program or college policy.

TOOLS/ TECHNICAL SKILLS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Incumbents will be evaluated, in part, based on performance of each essential function. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

LICENSING/ CERTIFICATION

Faculty Members must be appropriately credentialed, work currently Clinical Instructor - MSN FNP, possess an earned degree from an accredited institution or recognized by a country's ministry of education in the discipline being taught, and may be expected to be licensed or license-eligible in order to teach in specific programs. Faculty Members must maintain their licenses and any appropriate certifications in order to continue to teach at Walden University. Faculty Members are also expected to maintain currency with research by reviewing articles, journals, and presentations. If participating in research, the Faculty Member may publish and acknowledge Walden University.

All FNP Faculty are required to obtain RN and APRN licensure in the state of Minnesota and provide evidence of current Advanced Practice certification before being hired as a Nurse Practitioner Faculty at Walden University.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

• Earned Master's
• A record of professional scholarly contributions to their field of specialization.
• A minimum of one year experience of teaching in higher education.
• Current clinical experience in MSN-FNP practice.
• Teaching experience, 1-2 years online teaching experience required.
• Commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.
• Excellent oral and written communication, leadership, team, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
• Board Certified FNP

TRAVEL

Contributing faculty members may have the opportunity to travel to university events and residencies. When traveling to these events, the faculty member will be expected to fully participate in the event. For core faculty, there will be required travel throughout the year.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment but may involve exposure to moderate noise levels. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for 6–8 hours daily and includes physical demands associated with a traditional office setting (e.g., walking, standing, communicating, and other physical functions as necessary).

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS

Faculty members are expected to have a personal computer with virus protection and Internet access. Walden University provides a Walden e-mail account and access to the learning platform, password-protected faculty sections of the website, university and college listservs, and other faculty communications tools.

Software Requirements include current Web browser (Internet Explorer ver. 9.0 or higher or Firefox ver. 19 or higher); Microsoft Office suite; Adobe Reader; Adobe Flash Player; Apple QuickTime; Windows Media Player; antivirus software (e.g., McAfee or Norton) installed, running, and kept current by promptly installing the upgrades and patches made available by the software manufacturer. Software versions are subject to change

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Additional information

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

• Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
• Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

jobs.title: Production Workers - All Shifts
jobs.description:
Hours

1st Shift:  Monday - Friday 5:30am to 2pm, $17.50 per hour

2nd Shift:  Monday - Thursday 3:30pm to 2am, $20.50 ($17.50 per hour plus $3.00 shift differential)

3rd Shift: Friday, Saturday, Sunday 6am to 6pm, $20.00 ($17.50 per hour Plus $2.50 shift Differential)

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The role of the Production Worker is to perform necessary functions in order to efficiently, safely, and correctly prepare and process raw material to prepare it for cooking or cut & package finished product in preparation for shipment to customer.

The duties and responsibilities of this position shall consist of, but not be limited to, the following:

General:

• Follow daily production schedule and achieve specified goals.
• Ensure product conforms to specifications.
• Prevent and minimize rework and/or inedible.
• May require working on taping machines, shrink wrap machines, pallet jacks, trash and recycling compactors.
• Perform standard operating procedures of production and inspection functions as directed.
• Successfully complete all necessary technical training and skills verification as directed.
• Successfully complete all necessary soft skills training as directed.
• Return from breaks in a timely manner; notify lead/foreman/supervisor before leaving the department.
• Accurately complete all necessary paperwork as directed.
• Attend all department and company scheduled meetings.
• Works scheduled shift as assigned.
• Maintain a safe, clean and organized work area.
• Immediately report all accidents and deficiencies to the lead/foreman/supervisor.
• Ensure safety devices are installed and working properly.
• Suggest improvements; continuously improve the quality of all support activities.
• Perform all required duties within OSHA and company safety standards.
• Follows set company and OSHA safety rules, regulations, and guidelines at all times.
• Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) training, along with company pre-requisite programs, Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), and Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures (SSOP’s).
• Performs other duties and responsibilities as necessary.
• Ensure products are correctly labeled and identified for proper disposition.
• Keep record of products used to follow FIFO (first in – first out)

RAW:

• Add ingredients to batch and verify against formulations in Blending system.
• Move meat into machine(s) and/or combos and/or v-mags using appropriate tools and techniques
• Load meat racks, push meat trucks from one area to another, visually monitoring meat for quality.
• Maintain accurate records, washing and sanitizing carts, racks, and trucks.

Ready to Eat:

• Count and place packages in appropriate caddies, maintaining accurate records, washing and sanitizing carts, racks, and trucks.
• Handling finished product, placing it continuously in trays or assembly lines to be shipped to our customers.
• Making pallets by stacking boxes onto pallets, preparing the pallet with cardboard wrapping, manually shrink wrapping, and pulling/pushing pallets with manual pallet jack.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Required Education: None

Required Experience: None

Preferred: Knowledge of warehouse and assembly line experience is a plus.

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE and ABILITIES:

• Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Must be able to perform repetitive functions.
• Must adhere to all company policies and regulatory guidelines.
• Must be able to accept direction from Department Leads and supervisors
• Must be able to communicate with co-workers and supervisor.
• Must be able to work in a team oriented environment.
• Must be able to perform duties with minimal supervision.
• Excellent attendance and dependability
• Attention to detail
• Fast-paced environment
• Work well with others
• Great communication skills

The salary for this role is $17.50. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear.  The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms.  The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

jobs.title: Devops Engineer
jobs.description:
Engineer, Chennai

Our Technology teams are focused on supporting and modernizing enterprise applications through automation, DevOps best practices, and continuous improvement. The DevOps team manages these platforms while adopting modern engineering practices including GitHub Actions, Infrastructure Automation, Cloud technologies, and AI-assisted development tools.

As a Junior DevOps Engineer, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to support application deployments, CI/CD pipelines, operational excellence, and platform reliability. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience across DevOps, Linux administration, security, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled engineering practices while contributing to critical business platforms.

Responsibilities

• Support CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for application build, test, deployment, and release activities.
• Assist in managing and supporting applications hosted in on-premise and hybrid environments.

• Assist with automation initiatives to improve deployment efficiency, operational stability, and repeatability.

• Hands-on with GitHub Actions or other CICD tools.
• Experience in container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
• Basic Linux/Unix knowledge including commands, file systems, process management, and shell scripting.
• Understanding of DevOps principles, software delivery lifecycle, and release management concepts.
• Exposure to Oracle databases or relational database concepts and SQL fundamentals.
• Basic understanding of security best practices, including access controls, password management, and secure software delivery.
• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively within Agile/Scrum teams.

• Experience using AI-enabled developer tools such as GitHub Copilot.

Crown Innovations is seeking a customer focused and technically capable Junior IT Operations & Support Specialist to provide day-to-day technology support for approximately 275 employees across the organization.

This position serves as the primary internal point of contact for common end user technology issues involving computers, mobile devices, printers, Microsoft and Apple environments, network connectivity, user access, business applications, office telecommunications, and endpoint systems.

The Junior IT Operations & Support Specialist will manage and monitor Crown’s internal help desk and ticketing process, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, support Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Intune, assist with device deployment and configuration, and maintain accurate IT asset and device records.

This role will work closely with Crown leadership and the company’s third-party IT service provider. The selected individual will independently resolve routine and intermediate support issues while appropriately escalating infrastructure, network, cybersecurity, or other advanced technical matters to Crown’s external IT provider and authorized leadership.

This position requires more than technical aptitude. The successful candidate must be professional, responsive, approachable, and capable of communicating effectively with employees and leadership at all levels of the organization. Strong customer service, judgment, follow-though, and the ability to explain technical issues in clear, practical terms are essential.

This role provides an excellent opportunity for an early career IT professional to build broad experience across endpoint management, Microsoft 365, user support, IT operations, telecommunications, and technology projects while working closely with experienced internal and external technical resources.

Key Responsibilities

Help Desk & User Support

• Serve as the primary internal point of contact for employee technology support.
• Manage and maintain the company’s IT help desk and ticketing system.
• Receive, prioritize, document, troubleshoot, and resolve technical support requests.
• Provide timely in person, remote, and telephone based technical assistance.
• Troubleshoot common hardware, software, application, account, access, and connectivity issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify opportunities to improve IT support processes.
• Escalate infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and other advanced technical issues to the appropriate external provider or authorized internal resources.
• Maintain professional and responsive communication with employees throughout the support process.

Hardware & Endpoint Management

• Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and mobile devices.
• Support both Windows and Apple devices.
• Assist with device provisioning, configuration, updates, replacements, and lifecycle management.
• Manage and support endpoint devices through Microsoft Intune.
• Maintain accurate records of company issued computers, mobile devices, peripherals, and other IT assets.
• Support related IT onboarding, employee transfers, and offboarding activities.
• Prepare and configure equipment for new employees and ensure devices are properly recovered during separations.

Microsoft 365 & Business Applications

• Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft 365 and related Microsoft applications.
• Troubleshoot Microsoft accounts, applications, configurations, licensing, and access issues.
• Assist with user and device administration within authorized Microsoft environments.
• Support employees using Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, SharePoint, and other commonly used Microsoft applications.
• Assist with employee access to approved business applications and systems.

Network & Connectivity Support

• Troubleshoot Wi Fi and Ethernet connectivity issues.
• Troubleshoot shared folder and network drive access.
• Map and maintain network drives as appropriate.
• Perform basic network troubleshooting and diagnostics.
• Identify, document, and communicate recurring connectivity issues.
• Coordinate with the company’s third-party IT provider on network infrastructure matters requiring escalation.

Printers, Conference Rooms & Peripherals

• Install and configure printers and printer drivers.
• Troubleshoot local and network printer issues.
• Support scanners, monitors, docking stations, conference room technology, and other office peripherals.
• Assist with setup and troubleshooting of meeting room and audiovisual equipment.

Telecommunications

• Manage office phone assignments and user configurations.
• Assist with employee phone setup, changes, and troubleshooting.
• Coordinate phone migrations and telecommunications changes.
• Maintain accurate telephone and device assignment records.
• Work with telecommunications vendors and the company’s third-party IT provider as required.

Third Party IT Provider Coordination

• Serve as an internal liaison between employees, management, and Crown’s third party IT provider.
• Open, monitor, document, and follow up on escalated service requests.
• Provide external technical resources with relevant troubleshooting information and documentation.
• Assist with implementation of technology projects involving the external IT provider.
• Monitor escalated issues to help ensure they are appropriately assigned and resolved within expected timeframes.
• Communicate status updates to affected employees and leadership as appropriate.

Documentation & IT Operations

• Develop and maintain documentation for common troubleshooting procedures and internal IT processes.
• Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, devices, telecommunications assignments, and other IT assets.
• Assist with development and maintenance of IT policies, procedures, and user guidance.
• Provide basic employee technology training and support materials as needed.
• Participate in technology projects, upgrades, migrations, and deployments.
• Identify opportunities to improve IT support efficiency, documentation, and employee technology experience.
• Maintain awareness of current Microsoft, Apple, endpoint management, and workplace technology developments.
• Perform other related IT and operational duties as assigned.

Minimum Required Qualifications

• Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant professional experience.
• Minimum of two years of professional IT help desk, desktop support, systems support, or related end user support experience.
• Hands on experience supporting Windows computers and Microsoft 365 applications.
• Working knowledge of macOS and Apple devices.
• Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, printers, peripherals, user access, and connectivity issues.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Suite or other endpoint management platforms.
• Basic understanding of networking concepts including Wi Fi, Ethernet, TCP/IP, DNS, and shared network resources.
• Experience configuring and deploying computers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
• Strong customer service orientation and ability to support employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to communicate professionally with employees, managers, executives, vendors, and technical service providers.
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to independently manage multiple support requests and appropriately prioritize issues.
• Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive company information appropriately.
• Ability to work fully onsite at Crown Innovations Headquarters in Arlington, Virginia.

Preferred Qualifications

• CompTIA A+ certification.
• Additional CompTIA, Microsoft, Apple, or other relevant IT certifications.
• Experience administering or supporting Microsoft Intune.
• Experience supporting Microsoft 365 in a professional business environment.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID or Active Directory user administration.
• Experience supporting approximately 200 or more users.
• Experience working with an IT help desk or ticketing platform.
• Experience supporting both Windows and macOS environments.
• Experience managing IT assets and device inventories.
• Experience coordinating with a Managed Service Provider or third-party IT provider.
• Experience supporting office telecommunications or VoIP systems.
• Government contracting or professional services experience.

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is fully onsite at Crown Innovations Headquarters in Arlington, Virginia.

The Junior IT Operations & Support Specialist will provide direct technology support to employees and leadership throughout the headquarters office while also supporting employees across Crown’s broader organization.

The position requires frequent interaction with employees, executive leadership, external vendors, and Crown’s third-party IT provider.

Occasional after-hours support may be required for technology deployments, outages, upgrades, or other business critical needs.

Compensation

Junior IT Operations & Support Specialist: $60,000 to $75,000 annually

Compensation is determined based on experience, education, technical skills, certifications, internal equity, and business needs.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on job related factors.

Benefits

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• 401(k) with Company Match

• Company Paid Life Insurance

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration, NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and supporting nationally significant programs.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful, mission driven work.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Lead, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Mechanical Engineering Lead with experience on Hyperscale Data Center projects to act as Data Center Mechanical Engineer Lead. The job incumbent will be responsible for designing and overseeing the construction of mechanical systems for hyperscale data centers, including HVAC, piping and fire suppression systems.  This position is based in Arlington, VA, however, is open to other AECOM office locations and remote work under certain circumstances.

The Mechanical Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and safety of our data center infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in mechanical engineering and experience working with high-density data centers.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

JOB SUMMARY:

• Act as the primary point of contact for clients, responding to their inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, regularly communicating with them to understand their needs and expectations
• Coordinating with multiple disciplines and acting as lead mechanical engineer to ensure that projects are delivered within budget and on schedule while managing the mechanical team including HVAC, fire protection, plumbing
• Develop detailed specifications for mechanical equipment, including pumps, fans, and air handling units.
• Writing reports for internal and external purposes based on findings
• Ensures discipline plans that are created to meet overall project team requirements for project scope and schedule
• Stays current on codes and technologies appropriate to the mechanical, plumbing and fire protection systems related to hyperscale data centers
• Analyze and evaluate mechanical system performance, identifying areas for improvement and making recommendations for upgrades
• Provide technical support during the construction phase, responding to RFIs and addressing any issues that arise
• Attend job site visits, project meetings, and commissioning activities as needed
• Ensure compliance with industry standards, codes, and regulations
• Evaluate and recommend new technologies and equipment to enhance system performance and reduce operational costs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical and mechanical engineers, to ensure seamless integration of the chiller systems with other data center infrastructure
• Analyze energy usage, identifying opportunities for optimization and cost savings.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering plus ten (10) years of relevant experience in mechanical design and/or mechanical engineering, with a focus on data center infrastructure, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Professional Engineer License (P.E.) is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering plus twelve (12) years of relevant experience in mechanical design and/or mechanical engineering, with a focus on data center infrastructure, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Extensive experience in mechanical engineering for data centers or other critical facilities.
• Strong knowledge of HVAC, piping, and fire suppression systems design and construction.
• Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
• Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients
• Ability to think creatively and identify opportunities to enhance the client experience.
• Experience working with computer-aided design (CAD) and building information modeling (BIM) software
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
• Experience with data center design and construction, including design criteria and industry standards

• We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States. Permanent residency sponsorship is available for current H1-B visa holders in the United States.
• Relocation is not available for this position

jobs.title: Architect IV
jobs.description:
The Senior Architect candidate can successfully execute specific scope areas across applicable phases of a project, including design, documentation and construction administration as part of a multi-disciplinary team.  This position encourages creativity in problem solving to promote technical and design excellence while ensuring building code and regulatory compliance.  The Senior Architect has the ability to coordinate with internal and external parties, manage multiple complex tasks, establish priorities and direct the work of others.  The candidate will serve as the Architectural point of contact for clients, other disciplines, estimating and construction personnel.

The Senior Architect candidate has the ability to develop CRB’s Architectural presence in Food and Beverage market and is differentiated by a focused area of food and beverage. The candidate has distinguished themselves through industry presentations and involvement, thought leadership and a deep understanding of food and beverage specific regulations, design standard and trends.

Core Responsibilities

• Work independently on projects with ability to execute all phases of design, including programming, planning, concept development, detailed design and construction administration.
• Generate complex code analyses, life safety and egress plans, floor plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules and specifications for large projects of advanced complexity with no oversight.
• Develop and generate studies, presentations and reports, and present to internal or external audiences.
• Research and apply International Building Code and other regulatory requirements as part of project delivery process.
• Work closely with Engineering and Construction personnel to develop and ensure coordinated and constructible designs.
• Participate and contribute during drawing reviews, coordination meetings and quality checks.
• Assist PM in resource planning, budget and scope definition, schedule adherence and overall quality of deliverables.
• Conduct quality checking of documents for complex projects (e.g. technical verification of design calculations, documentation, design approaches) and drive overall project quality.
• Identify and resolve complex code, construction or design related challenges
• Develop advanced Architectural design and/or technical training presentations.
• Provide mentorship to Architectural staff.
• Act as Architect of Record for project assignments, may include corporate licensure responsibilities.

Must Have Qualifications

• Accredited Professional Degree in Architecture (B.Arch, M.Arch, and/or D.Arch) or Canadian / International equivalent
• Architectural license in good standing within home state, with ability for reciprocal licensure through NCARB
• Extensive knowledge and application of International Building Codes, OSHA Regulations and ADA Standards
• History of successful, cross-discipline project coordination and execution on a variety of project types preferably in the Food and Beverage industry
• Ability to develop (or guide development of) complete set of Construction Documents and Specifications for complex projects.
• Proficiency in Revit and Microsoft Office suite
• Relevant AEC (Architectural, Engineering or Construction) firm experience
• 15 years of professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Entrepreneurial, client focused leadership skills, preferably within the Food & Beverage industries
• Flexibility for moderate travel in support of project-based or training activities
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Ability to mentor Architectural staff
• LEED Accreditation, WELL Certification or similar sustainability credentials
• Expertise in food & nutrition and/or consumer products and international clients/projects.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Strategic Partnerships Manager to help originate, structure, and scale the partnerships that extend Nexthink's reach with other software companies (ISVs). This will be an individual contributor, partner-facing role: you'll be on the road at large conferences, representing Nexthink at joint announcements, press briefings, and events. You'll work cross-functionally with Legal, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to structure, launch, and scale partnerships. We are looking for people with the ambition, judgment, and interpersonal skill to own ambiguous, cross-functional problems – and the comfort to hold your own in a room with partner executives.

Key Responsibilities:

• Analyze the Nexthink Ecosystem and help Identify strategic partnership opportunities.
• Assist in defining key milestones, deliverables, and success metrics for each ISV partner.
• Partner with Legal on contracting and deal structuring, with Engineering on technical integration scope, and with Marketing on joint go-to-market and launch plans.
• Work on joint announcements, press briefings, and co-marketing moments tied to partner launches.
• Build relationships across the wider software ecosystem – from business development counterparts to technical and marketing teams.
• Collaborate on business reviews to track partnership health, progress against goals, and expansion opportunities, and build the business case for new and expanded alliances.
• Travel to major partner conferences and industry events regularly to build and maintain partner relationships in person.

• 3-5 years of experience in partnership business development, strategy consulting, investment banking, or corporate development.

• Comfortable with PR and launch work: joint announcements, press briefings, and event presence.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills – able to hold a confident conversation with partner executives and present externally.
• Ambitious and hands-on – comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems from first analysis through to launch.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:

This position is responsible for proactively engaging HVAC contractors, identifying sales opportunities, preparing and following up on quotes, and helping customers find complete solutions for their projects. The successful candidate will take ownership of their customer relationships, consistently pursue new opportunities, and work toward achieving individual and branch sales goals.

The ideal candidate is a motivated sales professional who understands that success comes from consistent customer contact, product knowledge, follow-through, and a commitment to growing profitable business.

Qualifications

• Previous inside sales, account management, customer service, or wholesale distribution experience preferred.
• HVAC industry experience or knowledge of HVAC parts, equipment, and supplies is strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to build customer relationships and identify opportunities to grow sales.
• Strong communication, negotiation, organization, and problem-solving skills.
• Comfortable making outbound calls, following up on quotes, and initiating customer conversations.
• Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize opportunities, and meet established deadlines.
• Proficiency with computers, order entry systems, email, and sales tracking tools.
• Self-motivated, dependable, and accountable for individual performance.
• Ability to work effectively with branch management and other team members to achieve shared goals.

Sales Growth and Account Development

• Proactively contact existing customers to identify additional sales opportunities and increase account penetration.
• Develop relationships with new HVAC contractors and prospective customers to generate new business.
• Re-engage inactive or underperforming accounts and identify opportunities to regain their business.
• Grow sales of HVAC equipment, replacement parts, accessories, and complementary products.
• Identify opportunities to sell complete systems and solutions rather than individual products when appropriate.
• Maintain regular communication with assigned customers to understand their business needs, upcoming projects, and purchasing patterns.
• Establish and work toward individual sales goals that support branch and company growth objectives.

Quotes, Orders, and Customer Follow-Up

• Prepare accurate and competitive quotes based on customer requirements.
• Follow up on outstanding equipment and sales quotes within two business days, with continued follow-up as appropriate.
• Proactively pursue open quotes and identify obstacles preventing customers from placing orders.
• Process customer orders accurately and communicate product availability, lead times, and order status.
• Coordinate with purchasing, warehouse personnel, manufacturers, and other branches to help meet customer needs.
• Maintain accurate customer information, quote records, and sales activity within company systems.

Customer Relationships and Service

• Develop strong working relationships with HVAC contractors, service technicians, owners, and purchasing contacts.
• Provide product recommendations and assist customers in identifying solutions for their applications.
• Respond promptly to customer inquiries, resolve issues professionally, and follow through on commitments.
• Communicate product promotions, new offerings, and relevant sales opportunities to customers.
• Maintain a high level of product knowledge and continue developing expertise in HVAC parts, equipment, and applications.

Sales Performance and Accountability

• Monitor individual sales performance and progress toward established goals.
• Maintain consistent outbound sales activity, including customer calls, quote follow-ups, and account development.
• Review sales opportunities with branch management and identify ways to improve results.
• Focus on profitable sales while following company pricing, discounting, and credit policies.
• Participate in branch sales meetings, product training, and company sales initiatives.
• Work collaboratively with counter sales and branch personnel to provide consistent service and maximize sales opportunities.

jobs.title: Sales Trainee
jobs.description:
TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

jobs.title: Jr. Security Evaluator - Fault Injection
jobs.description:
One of the most powerful techniques to test a product's security is fault injection. Such attacks aim at modifying the circuit’s behaviour in order to access protected assets. Many types of fault injection attacks have been developed during the past decades, posing a critical threat for modern secured products. Fault Injection Security Evaluators use a wide range of attack methods to evaluate the security of a product.

The position

Fault injection attacks are performed in several steps, using various methods. Your daily activities involve (but are not limited to) cooperation with code and/or hardware reviewers to understand the product and its vulnerabilities, hands-on experiments in our lab, result analysis and reporting. As a Fault Injection Security Evaluator, you will be trained in these activities by an experienced colleague. Once fully trained, you will become an independent Evaluator. As attacks and products are constantly evolving, you will keep learning with the team.

Understanding the product

A fault injection test is usually one task of a larger evaluation project. These projects start with an implementation review (hardware and/or code) to identify potential vulnerabilities. This review is done by code and/or hardware reviewers who then create a test plan based on the identified vulnerabilities.

Your task starts by building an understanding of the product: its architecture, the vulnerability you are assessing, the target operation you need to attack, etc. Typically, this information is also part of the test plan and you will discuss this during the project with the rest of the team. Understanding the architecture of a microcontroller/smart card, crypto algorithms such as DES, AES, RSA, ECC etc., or payment protocols will be helpful to understand the product. This will be the first part of your training if you have no experience in this area.

Fault injection experiments

Once you have understood the product, you will prepare product samples for testing. This step can involve various preparation techniques like mechanical or chemical removal of packaging, chip thinning, the preparation of test circuit boards, etc. Skills like understanding and/or designing electronic circuits or experience with lab equipment like oscilloscopes will be helpful but they – as well as any skills needed to prepare the samples – will also be part of the training and are not mandatory.

Once the sample is prepared, you will need to write a test script (typically in JavaScript) which performs the attack on one of the various fault injection set-ups present at Brightsight. The techniques you will encounter include voltage manipulation (VM), body bias injection (BBI), electro-magnetic fault injection (EMFI) and light manipulation (LM) using various laser set-ups. During the second part of your training, you will learn how to prepare your sample and how to use all of our fault injection set-ups.

Analysis of the experiments results

As part of the experiments, you will assess the impact of the manipulation attempts performed e.g. by analyzing the response to a target command. You will need to determine whether the product you are attacking has activated countermeasures or whether you have successfully injected a fault. This is an iterative process, based on the results of several experiments for each of which you will actively choose the various parameters needed to thoroughly test the product. During this phase, you will discuss your results with the team and the code or hardware reviewer to understand better any unexpected activity you may observe.

Writing a report

As a final step, you will write a technical report to describe the experiments that you have performed as well as the results you have achieved. An important part of the report is your well supported conclusion with regard to the security of the product. The report must be understandable for internal and external entities, so it is important that you can determine what is important or not and have good writing skills in English.

Other activities

Besides the above-mentioned activities, fault injection security Evaluators are involved in the development of (hardware or software) tools and R&D of new attacks.

Job requirements

• We are looking for people with a BSc or MSc degree in a technical field (Electronics, Physics, Electrical Engineering) with the potential ability to understand and perform the above-mentioned daily activities of Fault Injection Security Evaluators.
• It is important that you like to work in a lab, with oscilloscopes, function generators, and other electronic equipment.
• Having an analytic mind and being a good team player will be a plus.
• Experience in circuit development and knowledge of fault injection attacks are helpful but not mandatory. Brightsight provides a full training program from basics to expert level. Therefore, your motivation, potential and attitude to analyse the products are most important.
• This job also requires that you communicate knowledge convincingly, both orally and in writing, to internal and external entities.

The field of security evaluation is very broad, constantly on the move, and very exciting. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

Why Join Brightsight?

• Work on international projects in the field of security evaluation and certification.
• Collaborate with highly skilled technical experts and Lead Evaluators.
• Be part of a global Project Management team.
• Develop your career in a growing and specialized industry.
