jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer at Nexthink, you will be responsible for the security of our internal environment. You won't just be monitoring logs; you will be architecting the security fabric that enables our rapid growth.

Working in close partnership with IT, business teams and, partnering with our Cloud and Application Security teams, you will secure the identity, devices, and applications used by "Nexthinkers" worldwide. You will own the security of a complex SaaS ecosystem, and lead detection and response for the corporate environment.

What You Will Do

Identity-Centric Security Architecture

• Contribute to the design and support the implementation of passwordless authentication and Zero Trust principles.
• Manage secure provisioning and lifecycle management, ensuring least-privilege access across all business systems.
• Partner with HR and IT to streamline onboarding/offboarding workflows, ensuring timely access revocation and auditability.

Endpoint & Infrastructure Security

• Define and enforce security baselines for our diverse fleet of endpoints (Windows, macOS) and mobile devices via MDM (Intune/Jamf).
• Manage and tune EDR/XDR solutions to ensure high-fidelity detection on workstations and servers (Windows, Linux, macOS).
• Secure the corporate Azure footprint, ensuring proper configuration of subscriptions, networking, and resources distinct from our production product environment.
• Proactively identify and mitigate security risks in our corporate environment, conducting regular security assessments and vulnerability scans.
• Coordinate vulnerability management and patch management
• Collaborate with IT to automate endpoint compliance checks and remediation workflows.

Security Engineering

• Support the development and maintenance of Infrastructure-as-Code.
• Ensure hardening and compliance of endpoints and servers.

SaaS Security & Integration

• Assess and secure third-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Salesforce apps, browser extensions, productivity tools) to prevent data leakage and over-privileged access.
• Collaborate with Legal and Compliance to vet new vendors and tools.
• Configure and maintain CASB and DLP policies to safeguard sensitive corporate data without hindering productivity.

Detection, Response & Automation

• Lead incident response activities for corporate security events (phishing, malware, lost devices).
• Develop automation scripts (Python/PowerShell) and workflows (SOAR) to automate manual security tasks, evidence collection, and response actions.
• Proactively hunt for threats within the corporate network and identity providers.
• Develop incident response playbooks including technology specific procedures and forensics collection

Audits and Compliance

• Design and implement security controls to safeguard corporate resources, including endpoints, data storage, networking, computing and identity and access management.
• Support and automate evidence collection for audits.

Culture & Collaboration

• Act as the primary security liaison to the IT Department and business teams, helping them build security into their operations (DevSecOps for IT).
• Design and deliver technical security training and awareness campaigns for engineering and business teams.

• 5-8 years of hands-on experience in Corporate Security, IT Security Engineering, or a SOC role in a cloud-first environment.
• Endpoint Mastery: Experience hardening operating systems (macOS/Windows) and managing security via MDM/UEM tools.
• Vulnerability management: Proven experience in helping IT and business teams patching systems and infrastructures.
• Coding Skills: Proficiency in Python and Terraform for automating APIs and security workflows.
• Security Ops: Proven experience with EDR tools and SIEM log analysis.
• Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical stakeholders.
• Proven ability to influence and drive security best practices across non-security teams.
• Experience with security awareness training platforms and phishing simulation tools.

Bonus Points

• Identity Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of Okta and Microsoft Entra ID (Authentication policy, Conditional Access, SSO, SCIM, OIDC/SAML).
• Experience implementing FIDO2/WebAuthn (Passwordless).
• Proficient in PowerShell.
• Familiarity with compliance standards (ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2, FedRAMP)
• Experience securing Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS) specifically for internal/corporate workloads.

Why Join Nexthink Security?

• Impact: You will report directly into the CISO organization and have a tangible impact on the daily lives of employees and the safety of the company.
• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge security projects, with visibility and support from executive leadership.
• Technology: We use top-tier security stacks. You won’t be fighting with legacy on-premise hardware; we are cloud-native.
• Culture: We value "Security as an Enabler," not a blocker. You will work in a supportive, highly technical environment in our Madrid hub

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Collections Advisor
jobs.description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

We're looking for an experienced individual to fill the role of Senior Collections Advisor. This position requires an important balance of both credit and conduct risk as we focus on delivering the right outcomes for our customers based on their individual circumstances, always.

You will be working alongside as part of small but rapidly expanding team in our Milton Keynes office, this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our Milton Keynes office with flexibility on the other 2. There will also be a requirement to attend our central London office once a month (fully expensed).

The ideal candidate will have excellent attention to detail and be comfortable following documented procedures consistently ensuring that all customers are treated fairly and receive the appropriate outcomes. Tasks also include updating account details, maintaining accurate records, and escalating cases to senior staff if necessary. There will also be a requirement to identify and support customers who may shows signs of vulnerability.

Who you are

 - An experienced Customer facing advisor confident at dealing with customers in arrears with credit products

 - Have a good understanding of FCA regulation including CONC7 and DPA requirements

 - Have an awareness of the broad range of debt solutions i.e. Payment Arrangements, DMPs, IVAs, Trust Deeds, DROs, Breathing Space etc.

 - Understands Customer Vulnerability and how to identity and manage

 - Comfortable working with statements and ledgers to interpret transactions to help resolve customer queries

 - Familiar with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Teams)

 - Have a very strong attention to detail and a high regard for consistency

 - A strong team player who will help as required to deliver tasks within the team SLAs

 - Familiar with KPIs and targets and quality assurance requirements

What you'll be doing

 - Handling multiple live customer chats

 - Receiving and making telephony calls from Customer requiring assistance with their loans

 - Supporting our omni channels i.e. live web chat, email, SMS and phone (inbound and outbound) including dialler software.

 - Assessing customer affordability using our industry leading Open Banking software

 - Agreeing and setting affordable payment plans with customers

 - Processing on our systems when customers advise they are pursing alternative debt solutions

 - Setting promises to pay received through digital channels

 - Dealing with third party partners i.e. Field suppliers, debt collection agencies, insolvency portfolio managers

 - Thinking analytically and giving suggestions and ideas as part of continuous improvement

What we offer

 - Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

 - Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

 - 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

 - 2 paid volunteering days per year

 - One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

 - Employee loan

jobs.title: Patient Support Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Montu, our Patient Support team plays an important role in the patient journey, helping people access their prescribed medication and ensuring they feel listened to, informed and supported throughout their treatment.

We are looking for a friendly, proactive and compassionate Patient Support Coordinator to join our Pharmacy Support team at Winnersh Triangle.

This is an opportunity to make a genuine difference to patients, many of whom are living with complex and often debilitating health conditions.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, has the confidence to manage challenging conversations and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

For someone who thrives in a busy, people-focused environment and wants to be part of a growing healthcare organisation where the work really matters, this could be a fantastic opportunity.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, the role focuses on supporting patients with prescription queries, medication availability, deliveries and any challenges that may arise throughout their treatment journey.

This is a predominantly telephone-based position, with live chat and email enquiries also forming part of the day-to-day responsibilities.

Working closely with our Pharmacy, Clinical and wider Patient Support teams, the priority is to resolve enquiries efficiently, provide accurate information and ensure patients receive the support they need.

Some conversations are straight forward, while others require patience, empathy and the confidence to support patients who may be frustrated, worried or experiencing difficulties accessing their medication.

It is a fast-paced environment where no two days are quite the same. Strong communication, attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential, alongside the ability to balance a busy workload without losing sight of the person behind each inquiry.

Ultimately, this role is about much more than answering calls. It is about taking ownership, building trust and helping patients feel supported throughout their treatment.

What will you be doing?

 - Acting as a friendly and professional first point of contact for patients, primarily over the telephone, alongside live chat and email enquiries.

 - Supporting patients with questions relating to prescriptions, medication availability, deliveries and potential delays.

 - Taking ownership of patient enquiries, finding solutions and keeping patients informed throughout the process.

 - Working closely with Pharmacy Dispensers and the wider Pharmacy team to resolve prescription, stock and dispensing queries.

 - Liaising with Clinical teams and healthcare professionals to ensure patient enquiries are directed appropriately.

 - Providing clear information about prescription processes and escalating clinical questions to qualified healthcare professionals.

 - Recognising when patients require additional support and escalating complex or sensitive concerns to the appropriate teams, including Clinical Governance.

 - Maintaining accurate patient records in line with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.

 - Managing a busy workload while maintaining a high standard of service and attention to detail.

 - Working collaboratively with colleagues across the business to ensure enquiries are handled efficiently.

 - Contributing ideas and feedback to help improve processes and the overall patient experience.

What you will need?

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people and understands the importance of delivering excellent customer service, particularly when supporting individuals who may be dealing with difficult or sensitive situations.

Strong communication skills are essential, alongside the ability to listen, show empathy and remain calm when conversations become challenging.

This role would suit someone who is naturally proactive, enjoys problem-solving and takes pride in seeing an enquiry through to resolution.

 - A minimum of two years of experience in a customer service or patient-facing environment.

 - Experience managing a high volume of telephone enquiries, including challenging or sensitive conversations.

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a compassionate and professional approach.

 - Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

 - Confidence using multiple IT systems and learning new processes quickly.

 - Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling patient information and maintaining accurate records.

 - A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to take ownership of enquiries.

 - An understanding of the importance of following policies, procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs), particularly within a regulated environment.

 - A positive, collaborative approach to teamwork and a willingness to support colleagues across different departments.

 - Confidence working towards service standards and performance targets without compromising the patient experience.

 - The ability to work five days per week from our Winnersh Triangle office, including one Saturday per month.

Desirable experience

 - Previous experience within healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated environment.

 - Experience supporting patients or customers with complex, sensitive or time-critical enquiries.

 - A background in a busy contact centre or high-volume customer service environment.

 - Previous healthcare or pharmacy experience would be beneficial, but it is not essential. What matters most is a positive attitude, strong communication skills and a genuine desire to help people.

Location and working hours

 - This is a full-time, office-based position at our Winnersh Triangle office in Berkshire.

 - Working hours: 8:30am to 5:30pm, including a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

 - Working pattern: Five days per week, on a rota that includes one Saturday per month.

 - Location: Fully office-based at Winnersh Triangle, including during and following training.

What we offer:

 - Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

 - Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

 - Private Healthcare Scheme 

 - Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

 - Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

 - Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

jobs.title: Advisory Solutions Architect, MSP (New Product Intro)
jobs.description:
Help shape how Rubrik partners with leading service providers to deliver cyber resilience at scale. The New Product Introduction (NPI) & Service Creation Solution Architect is a new function in the MSP Solution Architecture Team. You will design, package and enable new managed service offerings built on Rubrik's data protection, cyber resilience and recovery portfolio, and turn them into repeatable programs that MSPs, MSSPs and cloud providers can adopt at scale.

You own the technical service blueprint from concept through launch. You also support strategic presales into large global MSPs and work hand in hand with Sales, Product and Engineering, Marketing and Competitive Intelligence teams. The role reports to the Global Director, MSP Solution Architects, is highly partner-facing, and requires significant travel.

Why You'll Love This Role:

• Build something new: This is a founding role in a new function. You will create the offerings, programs and playbooks from the ground up, then see them launched, adopted and sold by real partners.

• Make a visible difference: The services you design help service providers protect and recover their customers' data when ransomware and cyber attacks strike.

• Influence and autonomy: You will work directly with senior leaders across Sales, Product, Engineering and Marketing and with executives at leading service providers, with the freedom to take your own ideas from concept to launch.

• Build with AI every day: Work in an environment where building with Claude and Claude Code is encouraged and expected, and shape how the team uses AI to move faster.

Key Responsibilities:

Service Creation & Partner Workshops

• Define and prioritize new service offerings (managed backup, DRaaS, cyber recovery, SaaS backup, ransomware readiness) with Product Management and translate roadmaps into service blueprints and scalable reference architectures covering SLAs, tiers, security, compliance and sovereignty.

• Own and run a repeatable partner service co-creation workshop program, from joint scoping through launch, owning post-workshop outcomes so each partner moves to a defined, launched and sold service, and tracking partner satisfaction and conversion to launched services.

• Build and maintain a service adoption tracker with analytics on partner adoption, workshop-to-launch conversion and service results, and use it to continuously improve the program with new templates, feedback surveys and facilitation tooling, in partnership with Sales and Product leadership.

• Enhance existing partner planning tools with standard sizing guidelines, configuration patterns and partner business-case templates (financial, ROI/TCO, pricing) that turn a design into a priced service.

Presales & Partner Engagement

• Support strategic opportunities that depend on new services: discovery, requirements capture (RPO/RTO, sovereignty, compliance) and high-level solution design.

• Lead hands-on workshops and demos to validate architectures against partner and customer environments.

• Maintain a trusted cadence with strategic MSP partners, track commitments to closure, and keep engagement activity visible to leadership.

Enablement, Content & Product-to-Field Bridge

• Create delivery playbooks, runbooks, service descriptions, onboarding methodologies, training assets and webinars so partner delivery is high-quality and repeatable.

• Represent MSP readiness in NPI launches and own roadmap visibility for partners and the SA team, ensuring partners and the field are ready to sell and operate new capabilities at launch, and continuously improve the Claude skill that turns the product roadmap into tailored feature adoption recommendations for MSP partner account teams, refining it every release cycle based on partner feedback and adoption results.

• Own the MSP content strategy and thought leadership (blogs, webinars, newsletter, partner portal, video) and run recurring programs on a dependable cadence with clear KPIs.

AI-Enabled Building

• AI is central to this role. You must be a builder with excellent hands-on Claude, Claude Code and Cowork experience, and a track record of turning your work into repeatable assets: skills, automations and tools that others on the team use.

• Build and maintain a library of Claude skills and rapid prototypes for MSP work, such as partner prep, partner collateral, roadmap summaries, and sizing and pricing calculators, connected to enterprise systems and run on a schedule.

• Make AI output trustworthy and scalable: use grounding and review gates so content is safe for partners, follow AI governance and data-handling rules, and teach the team through live builds.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Analytics
jobs.description:
MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more.

Senior Staff Product Manager, Analytics

MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more.

Location: Los Angeles | Hybrid (3 days per week in office).

Role Overview

This role owns the vision, strategy, and business outcomes for how MediaAlpha turns its analytics and data science into products. Our Analytics team builds the models, signals, and optimization behind the MediaAlpha Marketplace.

You'll set the long-term direction for a family of intelligence products for advertisers, publishers, and agents, spanning bidding, predictive signals, performance guarantees, and partner-facing reporting and forecasting. You'll define how proven analytics work becomes a product, and you'll be fully accountable for the outcomes those products produce.

The core challenge: build a repeatable path from research to revenue. Analytics owns its models and roadmap. You'll own the moment proven work becomes a product, and everything after: whether it should be a product at all, who it's for, how it's packaged and priced, and how account teams take it to market. You'll balance one-off requests from large partners against the discipline of standard products, consistent rules, and claims we've actually measured, and you'll make sure every product strengthens our marketplace.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll partner closely with analytics and data science, engineering, product marketing, finance, legal and privacy, and our advertiser, publisher, and agent account management teams. You'll also mentor other product managers across the organization, raising the bar for data-product thinking, commercial judgment, and product craft.

Responsibilities

• Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for MediaAlpha's analytics products, translating analytics capabilities, partner needs, marketplace dynamics, and business goals into a clear long-term direction and prioritized roadmap.

• Be accountable for business outcomes by defining and measuring per-partner impact, including revenue from analytics products, marketplace margin, partner retention and growth.

• Own the path from research to launch: define what "ready" means for an analytics capability, accept handoffs from Analytics, and decide whether each one becomes a product.

• Define the partner problem each product solves and which advertisers, publishers, or agents it fits, and own its packaging, naming, and positioning within a single product family.

• Partner with finance and business leaders on pricing and commercial terms, including how products are offered across different marketplace and deal structures.

• Design pilots with account managers, including partner selection, goals, and success criteria set up front.

• Translate analytics work into product terms and partner needs into clear requests for Analytics, helping data scientists think about who a product is for and what it's worth to them.

• Ensure product requirements give engineering clear context for building analytics into the Exchange, partner dashboards, reports, and tools.

• Build launch kits and playbooks and train account managers to sell with them.

• Leverage advanced AI tools to accelerate strategy development, requirement definition, and rapid prototyping across the product lifecycle.

• Mentor other product managers and elevate product craft, strategic thinking, and execution standards across the team.

• Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade-offs to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

Requirements

• 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years at the Staff level or above.

• Proven ownership of product vision, strategy, and measurable business outcomes for data, analytics, or machine learning-powered products, ideally sold to enterprise customers.

• Strong data-product instincts: you're fluent in experimentation and lift measurement (A/B tests, holdouts, incrementality), understand what a model can and can't do, and can reason about auction and marketplace economics with data scientists and engineers.

• Strong commercial judgment: you can size an opportunity, frame a pricing decision, and focus on strengthening the platform.

• Experience designing cross-team operating models, with clear handoffs, decision rights, and exception processes that hold up at scale.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain a model in one sentence to a partner and defend the strategy behind it to an executive.

• Positive, can-do attitude and willingness to work in a fast-moving environment, rolling up your sleeves to get things done.

Nice to Have

We value strong, general PM craft over specific domain familiarity. However, let us know if you have experience in any of these areas/fields:

• Ad-tech, performance marketing, or programmatic advertising, especially in marketplaces or exchanges.

• Real-time bidding (RTB), bid optimization, or managed and automated bidding products.

• Predictive modeling, forecasting, or decision-science products sold to external customers.

• Track record of taking models, signals, or data science research from prototype to commercial product, including packaging, pricing, and launch.

• Performance guarantees or outcome-based pricing.

• Publisher or supply-side yield optimization.

• Lead generation, call marketplaces, or click-based performance products.

• Insurance, personal finance, or Medicare verticals.

• AI assistants or conversational commerce as a customer acquisition channel.

• A background in data science, analytics, or economics before moving into product.

Compensation & Benefits

We are excited to offer a competitive base pay range of $180,000 - $210,000 per year for this position, based on experience and qualifications. But that's not all - as a valued member of our team, you will also have access to an array of top-notch benefits, including:

• Annual bonus program and participation in our Restricted Stock Unit program

• 100% Employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for you, your dependents, and spouse or registered domestic partner

• 100% employer-paid long-term disability and life insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions to help you plan for your future

• Open Paid Time Off policy with a birthday day off, 13 holidays, and 5 Recharge days

• Professional development reimbursement

• Cell Phone, Wellness, and Internet expense reimbursement, along with a subscription to the Calm App

• 100% fully paid parental leave for team members up to 22 weeks for the primary caregiver and 12 weeks for the secondary caregiver

• Dog-friendly offices (LA and AZ) along with a $300 pet adoption reimbursement

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

MediaAlpha is committed to fostering, cultivating, and maintaining a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our philosophy and actions are built on the premise that as an employer and citizens of our communities, we can create opportunities for lasting change.

Fair Chance

MediaAlpha will consider qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with state and local "Fair Chance" laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans in our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at peopleops@mediaalpha.com or (213) 316-6256.

Position Title: Systems Analyst

Department: Information Technology / Engineering

Reports To: IT Manager / IT Director

Position Summary

The Systems Analyst is responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting engineering software applications, software licensing, and manufacturing CNC/DNC systems. This position provides technical support for both engineering and manufacturing operations, performs routine and advanced IT troubleshooting, and assists with network administration and infrastructure support.

The Systems Analyst works closely with engineering, manufacturing, IT, and networking teams to ensure systems operate efficiently, reliably, and securely while minimizing downtime and supporting overall business operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Engineering Software and Licensing Management

· Manage, maintain, and support engineering software applications and related systems.

· Administer software licenses, renewals, installations, updates, and user access.

· Coordinate with software vendors to resolve technical issues and licensing concerns.

· Monitor software utilization and ensure compliance with licensing agreements.

· Assist engineering personnel with software-related troubleshooting and technical support.

Manufacturing CNC/DNC Systems

· Manage, maintain, and support manufacturing CNC/DNC systems and associated infrastructure.

· Ensure reliable communication and data transfer between engineering systems and manufacturing equipment.

· Troubleshoot CNC/DNC connectivity, communication, and software-related issues.

· Maintain a strong working knowledge of serial communications, including serial ports, serial data transmission, communication protocols, and port configurations.

· Apply a thorough understanding of serial communication to troubleshoot and resolve CNC/DNC connectivity and data transfer issues.

· Assist with system updates, configurations, backups, and ongoing maintenance.

· Work with manufacturing personnel to resolve technical issues and minimize production interruptions.

· Support continuous improvement and reliability of manufacturing technology systems.

IT Support and Systems Administration

· Perform basic and advanced IT-related tasks, troubleshooting, and technical support.

· Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system, and application issues.

· Assist with system installations, configurations, upgrades, and maintenance.

· Provide technical assistance to employees across various departments.

· Identify recurring technical issues and recommend solutions to improve system performance and reliability.

· Assist with maintaining IT documentation, system configurations, and procedures.

Network and Infrastructure Support

· Work closely with network administration and infrastructure teams to support company-wide IT operations.

· Assist with network connectivity troubleshooting and issue resolution.

· Support network-related installations, configurations, and maintenance activities as assigned.

· Assist with identifying and resolving network and communication issues affecting engineering and manufacturing systems.

· Coordinate with internal IT teams and outside service providers when necessary.

General Responsibilities

· Maintain accurate documentation of systems, software, configurations, and troubleshooting activities.

· Follow established IT security policies, procedures, and best practices.

· Support IT projects, system upgrades, and technology improvements.

· Maintain effective communication with engineering, manufacturing, and IT personnel.

· Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

· Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Networking, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

· Experience in IT support, systems administration, or technical troubleshooting.

· Familiarity with engineering software applications and software license management.

· Knowledge of CNC/DNC systems and manufacturing environments.

· Strong knowledge of serial communications, including serial ports, serial data transmission, communication protocols, and troubleshooting serial communication issues.

· Understanding of computer networking, connectivity, and basic network infrastructure.

· Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

· Strong communication and customer service skills.

· Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, manufacturing, and IT teams.

Technical Skills

· Windows operating systems and general computer administration.

· Engineering software installation, configuration, and licensing.

· CNC/DNC systems and manufacturing communication technologies.

· Serial communications, including serial ports, serial data, and communication configurations.

· Hardware and software troubleshooting.

· Basic networking concepts, connectivity, and infrastructure.

· System maintenance, upgrades, and documentation.

· General IT support and systems administration.

Key Performance Expectations

· Maintain reliable operation of engineering software and licensing systems.

· Ensure CNC/DNC systems remain functional and available to support manufacturing operations.

· Respond to and resolve IT-related issues in a timely manner.

· Minimize system downtime and manufacturing disruptions.

· Provide effective support to engineering, manufacturing, and company personnel.

· Collaborate with IT and networking teams to maintain reliable infrastructure.

Work Environment: This position supports both office and manufacturing environments and may require occasional interaction with production equipment, manufacturing personnel, and IT infrastructure.

Position Summary:

This is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of a growing SaaS business. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, you’ll lead the people and processes behind a reliable, scalable global close—bringing hands-on ownership to close execution, reconciliations, consolidation, and financial reporting while developing a team that can deliver with confidence. You’ll be the technical accounting leader for complex questions across U.S. GAAP and IFRS, turning sound judgment into clear, consistent policy and practical guidance for partners across the Company. You’ll strengthen controls and audit readiness, resolve issues at their root, and make the close faster and more dependable through thoughtful standardization, systems improvements, and automation. This role is for a leader who can move comfortably between the detail and the bigger picture: setting clear expectations, coaching people, communicating confidently with stakeholders, and taking ownership until the work is done.

Position Scope:

Financial Close Leadership

• Plan, schedule, and manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close calendar across all entities, setting clear deadlines and dependencies for each team member.

• Lead the close process from cutoff through final reporting, identifying bottlenecks and escalating risks to the Assistant Controller before they affect deadlines.

• Coordinate intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and consolidation entries, and confirm that intercompany balances reconcile between entities.

• Prepare and review journal entries, including accruals, deferrals, and adjusting entries, and verify that supporting documentation is complete.

Account Reconciliation Review

• Review and approve balance sheet reconciliations for all general ledger accounts.

• Assess reconciling items for aging, root cause, and appropriateness, and require resolution or documented justification for items that remain open beyond policy thresholds.

• Confirm that reconciliations are performed timely, are complete, and include evidence of preparer and reviewer sign-off.

• Monitor subledger-to-GL tie-outs.

GAAP and IFRS Compliance

• Ensure that accounting policies are applied consistently across entities and that differences between U.S. GAAP and IFRS, or between local GAAP and group policy, are identified, documented, and reconciled.

• Maintain accounting policy documentation and technical memos for significant or unusual transactions, including the accounting for leases (ASC 842 / IFRS 16), business combinations, stock-based compensation, and income taxes.

• Support preparation of statutory financial statements and local filings for international subsidiaries in coordination with local teams or external advisors.

Internal Controls and Audit

• Design, document, and test key controls over the close and reconciliation processes.

• Serve as support point of contact for external auditors during interim reviews and the annual audit, providing timely PBC responses and resolving audit inquiries.

• Identify control gaps and segregation-of-duties conflicts and recommend remediation to the Assistant Controller.

Process Improvement and Systems

• Identify opportunities to automate reconciliations, close tasks, and reporting using the ERP, consolidation software, and reconciliation tools including AI.

• Lead or support system implementations and upgrades that affect the close, such as M&A integrations.

• Standardize processes across subsidiaries to reduce close duration and improve data quality.

Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop team members through regular one-on-ones and timely, specific feedback; recognize individual strengths and support career growth through meaningful development and stretch opportunities.

• Lead by example and foster an inclusive, collaborative team environment through open, transparent communication; share organizational updates, act on feedback, remove obstacles, and provide the resources and support people need to succeed.

• Partner with Recruiting to attract talent and retain high performers through recognition and opportunities for advancement.

jobs.title: Manager, Enterprise Portfolio Management
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Enterprise Portfolio Manager is responsible for running the operating cadence that turns enterprise strategy into coordinated execution across value streams. This includes driving alignment on priorities being brought through F&G’s quarterly planning cycle and running recurring governance forums — including monthly dependency and roadmap reviews — that keep the portfolio priorities aligned to capacity and cross functional dependencies. The manager ensures business cases for new Enterprise Initiatives are well-formed, while coaching teams on business case quality, validating capacity across value streams, and enforcing governance and readiness criteria so initiatives are prepared for execution. This role requires strong facilitation skills, a results-oriented mindset, and comfort operating at the intersection of strategy and delivery.

• Alignment Capture demand of enterprise initiatives through monthly roadmap reviews. Coach business partners and value stream leads on business case quality, ensuring requests carry clear business outcomes and are ready for sequencing. Partner with the Portfolio Analyst to maintain the portfolio pipeline and dashboards that provide transparency across requests and adherence to standards.

• Quarterly Planning Cadence Drive readiness of portfolio priorities being brought to quarterly Program Increment, including roadmap alignment, dependency mapping, and capacity validation across value streams. Run the monthly Portfolio Dependency Review and Portfolio Roadmap Review, surfacing cross-stream conflicts and capacity constraints before they block commitments. Coordinate, lead, or support other recurring governance forums to review progress and adjust portfolio plans.

Track trends in demand and forecast capacity impact, escalating unresolved conflicts or risks to portfolio leadership. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Proven ability to effectively partner with cross functional leadership and teams. Strong creative and analytical skills and demonstrated ability for detailed work. jobs.title: Supervisor, Talent Attraction
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Scout Motors is seeking a Talent Attraction Supervisor to lead the day-to-day work of the talent attraction team and help deliver strong candidate pipelines for priority hiring needs. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition Enablement & Programs, this role will translate recruiting priorities into clear work plans, coordinate sourcing and recruiting activity, and ensure the team delivers with consistency, quality, and pace.

The Talent Attraction Supervisor will provide hands-on coaching and direction to talent attraction professionals, monitor workload and pipeline health, remove day-to-day barriers, and partner with Talent Acquisition Business Partners and other TA colleagues to meet business demand. Success requires practical people leadership, strong recruiting judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to balance immediate delivery with continuous improvement.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Talent Attraction Delivery

• Translate hiring priorities into clear sourcing and recruiting plans, daily work assignments, milestones, and service expectations for the team.

• Oversee candidate identification, outreach, screening, pipeline development, and related recruiting activity across assigned searches.

• Monitor workload, capacity, pipeline health, and progress; rebalance work and adjust tactics as priorities or market conditions change.

• Remove day-to-day barriers, resolve execution issues, and escalate material risks with relevant facts and recommended actions.

• Ensure the team delivers timely, high-quality work while maintaining clear ownership and consistent follow-through.

Team Supervision & Coaching

• Provide day-to-day direction, coaching, and support to talent attraction professionals, reinforcing clear expectations and accountability.

• Conduct regular check-ins, share timely feedback, and support individual development and performance.

• Review work quality, provide guidance on complex searches, and help team members strengthen sourcing, candidate engagement, and recruiting practices.

• Create an inclusive, collaborative team environment grounded in trust, learning, and shared ownership.

• Promote consistent practices, knowledge sharing, and flexible support across the broader Talent Acquisition organization.

Talent Acquisition Partnership

• Partner with the Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition Enablement & Programs to align team activity with talent priorities, programs, and operating expectations.

• Work closely with Talent Acquisition Business Partners to clarify search needs, candidate profiles, timelines, and delivery requirements.

• Coordinate effectively with recruiting colleagues and specialist partners, ensuring clear ownership, smooth handoffs, and timely communication.

• Provide practical insight on pipeline conditions, sourcing challenges, delivery risks, and options for keeping searches on track.

• Build trusted relationships through responsiveness, transparency, and consistent follow-through.

Recruiting Operations, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

• Track and communicate meaningful measures such as team workload, pipeline strength, outreach activity, funnel conversion, aging, and candidate progress.

• Use data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize team activity, evaluate the effectiveness of sourcing and recruiting tactics, and recommend adjustments.

• Ensure accurate, timely use of Scout's applicant tracking system and related recruiting tools, including clear documentation and recordkeeping.

• Reinforce standard workflows, tools, and operating practices while identifying practical opportunities to simplify work and improve consistency.

• Share recurring talent-market themes and delivery insights that can strengthen Talent Acquisition planning and execution.

Selection Quality, Candidate Experience & Compliance

• Coach the team to apply structured, fair, and job-relevant sourcing, screening, and selection practices.

• Ensure candidates receive clear, respectful, and timely communication throughout the recruiting process.

• Reinforce authentic representation of Scout's culture and employee value proposition in every candidate interaction.

• Maintain recruiting practices that align with applicable laws, company policies, confidentiality expectations, recordkeeping requirements, and Scout's commitment to inclusion and respect.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires four days per week in the office to support close partnership with Talent Acquisition, HR, and business stakeholders.

• Travel: Domestic travel may be required periodically to support recruiting events, hiring initiatives, and other business needs. Valid driver's license required

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• 4+ years of progressive experience in talent acquisition, sourcing, recruiting coordination, or recruiting operations, including experience providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, or work direction to others.

• Demonstrated ability to translate hiring priorities into actionable sourcing plans, team assignments, milestones, and follow-through routines.

• Strong sourcing and recruiting judgment, with experience building candidate pipelines, assessing pipeline quality, and adjusting tactics based on talent-market conditions.

• Ability to manage multiple searches and priorities, monitor workload and capacity, rebalance work, and keep delivery moving in a fast-paced environment.

• Effective coaching, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build trust across Talent Acquisition, HR, and hiring teams.

• Experience using applicant tracking systems, recruiting metrics, and operational insight to monitor progress, identify bottlenecks, and improve recruiting outcomes.

• Sound judgment, discretion, adaptability, accountability, and a commitment to fair, inclusive, and respectful candidate and employee experiences

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $110,000.00 - $135,000.00

Internal leveling code: M9

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Cyber Detection Analyst
jobs.description:
The Detection Health and Performance team helps customers maintain effective detection as attacker behavior evolves, by investigating suspicious traffic and identifying missed attacks, reducing false positives, building and evaluating detection logic and improving customers' detection health during onboarding and throughout customer's life cycle. 

In this role, you’ll combine data analysis, technical troubleshooting, and customer-focused communication to understand technical and detection gaps, and share helpful threat insights and recommendations. As part of the role you will work in collaboration with Technical Account Managers, Solutions Engineers, Operations, Research and Engineering teams, helping to maintaining strong security outcomes while protecting legitimate users.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Investigate suspicious traffic and identify potential attacks, false positives, and missed detections..

• Design and test new detection logics for customers. .

• Validate product integration and assess whether detection behavior is working as expected..

• Recommend safe detection actions, monitor their impact, and adjust them as traffic and attacker behavior evolve..

• Work with R&D, Solution Engineers, and TAM teams to resolve complex customer and product issues..

• Translate investigation findings into clear internal updates and customer-facing communication and recommendations..

• Document investigations and share knowledge with the team. .

• Improve recurring workflows through better queries, dashboards, and automation..




WHO YOU ARE

• +5 years experience as a cyber security or detection analyst / fraud analyst / data or business analyst in a SaaS company.

• Experienced working with large datasets using SQL (Snowflake / BigQuery) and other analysis and visualization tools (Tableau), log analysis tools (ElasticSearch).

• Must be domiciled within the Eastern Time Zone (ET) to support alignment with team and business operating hours.

• Curious, analytical mindset, able to drill down into an investigation and also understand the bigger picture. .

• Motivated to get to the bottom of a problem, understand not only what happened but why it happened, and help resolve it. .

• Interested in cybersecurity, fraud prevention, threat analysis, or how automated attacks operate..

• A clear communicator who can explain technical findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences..

• Collaborative, independent and self-directed, and comfortable learning new tools and concepts..

• Customer facing experience - a big plus..

• Experience working with Cursor and other AI tools to automate workflow is a plus..

About HUMAN Security



HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.



HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.



HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.



If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

jobs.title: Materials Sourcing Lead
jobs.description:
About Formlabs:

A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.

Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.

That’s what we do.

At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.

Your Impact:

Our Manufacturing team makes 3D printing materials at scale, and Materials is one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important parts of our product portfolio. Our powders for our SLS printers are produced by a network of contract manufacturers, and we’re increasingly looking at ways to make the supply chain more agile.

We’re looking for a commercially minded Materials Sourcing Lead to own our powder supply base. You’ll manage contract manufacturer relationships, negotiate the agreements that govern them, and keep cost, capacity, and risk in balance as the business grows. You’ll also help shape our long-term strategy, including where vertical integration can improve our cost position, supply security, or control over quality.

This is a role for someone who has managed suppliers and contracts at a strategic level and wants to influence how a fast-growing materials business is built.

The Job:

Contract Manufacturer Management

• Own relationships with powder contract manufacturers and key suppliers, serving as the primary commercial point of contact.

• Run quarterly business reviews with scorecards for quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and responsiveness, and hold partners accountable to their commitments.

• Manage volume allocation across contract manufacturers to balance cost, capacity, and supply risk.

• Partner with Quality to resolve supplier quality issues and make sure corrective actions are delivered.

• Own supplier qualification and onboarding for new contract manufacturers, and maintain the Approved Supplier List.

Commercial Strategy & Negotiation

• Lead negotiations for supply agreements, including pricing, volume commitments, capacity reservations, lead times, payment terms, and continuity provisions.

• Build and maintain total-cost and should-cost models to understand cost drivers and support negotiations.

• Drive annual cost reduction targets and report savings and commercial performance to leadership.

• Manage pricebooks and execute price change workflows in partnership with Finance.

Vertical Integration & Network Strategy

• Evaluate make-versus-buy opportunities across the powder value chain, building business cases that weigh cost, capital investment, risk, and strategic control.

• Support execution of vertical integration initiatives, coordinating with Finance, Manufacturing, and R&D, and managing the transition with existing partners.

• Develop a multi-year sourcing strategy for powder that supports growth, new product launches, and supply resilience.

Supply Risk & Continuity

• Maintain a live supply risk tracker covering capacity constraints, concentration risk, partner financial health, and geopolitical exposure.

• Surface emerging risks proactively and lead mitigation planning, including dual-sourcing, capacity agreements, and inventory strategy.

• Monitor market conditions for polymer feedstocks and translate them into commercial recommendations.

New Materials & NPI

• Identify and source new powder materials and partners that expand our product portfolio.

• Support NPI by setting cost targets, securing supply, and ensuring contract manufacturer readiness ahead of launch.

Cost Visibility & Operations

• Build and maintain dashboards tracking current and forward-looking powder COGS.

• Lead process improvement projects that make sourcing and supplier management more scalable.

You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, or supplier management, ideally in manufacturing, chemicals, or materials.

• Proven track record managing contract manufacturers or strategic suppliers, including leading complex negotiations with measurable results.

• Experience building business cases and financial models for sourcing, make-versus-buy, or investment decisions.

• Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel/Sheets required; SQL, Python, or Tableau a plus.

• Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with supplier engineers and our R&D team on materials and processes.

• Confident communicator and negotiator with external partners and senior leadership.

Bonus Points

• MBA or graduate degree in business or engineering.

• Experience with polymers, plastics, or powder materials (e.g., nylon, TPU, polypropylene).

• Experience supporting vertical integration, M&A, or new-site projects.

• Background in procurement or operations consulting.

• ERP experience (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Unlimited 3D printing with any Formlabs material on any Formlabs printer

• An equity program that will let you build wealth through RSUs

• Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) that includes a totally free employee-only plan, effective starting on your first day on the job

• 401K matching with no vesting or tenure requirement

• Generous parental leave (fully paid up to 16 weeks)

• Flexible time off so you can take time when you need it

• Six-week fully paid sabbatical after hitting tenure milestones (with the option to take an additional six weeks after that)

• Free on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Free on-site lunch, snacks, beverages, treats, beer kegs, and employee-favorite local coffee and espresso

• Self-driven professional development opportunities like conferences, trade shows, and hackathons

• One-of-a-kind activities and events like monthly socials, the annual weekend summer camp, a can’t-miss company hackathon, and lots of other social opportunities

You don’t need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The annual base pay range for this role is:

$120,000—$170,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented, systems-minded Senior Product Designer to own the experience of Coder Agents. With Coder Agents, developers hand off work to AI coding agents running on their company's own infrastructure. The goal is to make powerful, complex agent workflows feel simple and intuitive, and enjoyable to use. You'll partner closely with the Agents PM and engineering team to take the product from early and capable to mature and loved, and to shape how developers will work with agents day to day. You'll lead end-to-end design across discovery, ideation and delivery, and help turn a powerful, complex product into an intuitive, low-friction experience.

What you’ll do here

 - Own end-to-end design for Coder Agents, from research and discovery to shipped UI

 - Design the core user flows: delegating a task, steering an agent while it works and reviewing its output

 - Design the admin setup experience (models, templates and integrations) so platform teams can roll Agents out with confidence

 - Explore designs for developers, less technical users (PMs, designers, business users) and non-human identities.

 - create a vision for the Agents experience and help steer the team

 - Fit Agents into how developers work, and help decide where Agents shows up beyond the web UI (IDE, App integrations, Desktop, Mobile)

 - Shape information architecture as Agents grows: chat types, projects, sharing and multi-panel layouts

 - Think in systems: build consistent interaction patterns for agent states, long-running tasks, errors and trust signals that hold up as the product grows

 - Facilitate ideation and story-mapping workshops with PM and Engineering

 - Prototype quickly, test with real users, and use what you learn to improve the experience

 - Evolve Coder's design system as Agents adds new patterns

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years of end-to-end product design for complex software, with a portfolio that shows both systems thinking and strong visual and interaction craft

 - Excellent UI and interaction craft, with a portfolio that shows polish and attention to detail

 - Able to take ambiguous, fast-moving problems and turn them into clear flows and shippable decisions

 - Proactive and independent, with strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset

 - A systems thinker who turns complex problems into simple, scalable solutions

 - A deep interest in how developers think, work, and adopt agentic tools

 - Comfortable with using AI tools in your own design process.

Bonus tacos if you have

 - Worked on AI or agent products before (chat interfaces, copilots, autonomous or long-running task UIs)

 - Designed developer tools, IDEs, CLIs or platform and admin consoles

 - Experience designing for enterprise or regulated environments (permissions, governance, auditability)

 - Experience with accessibility/WCAG standards




ABOUT CODER

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow.  Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders. 




AI USE DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.  

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.




OUR USE OF AI IN HIRING

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

 - Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Madison Reed is looking for a performance marketer who wants to own a number, not run a channel. This person owns paid acquisition across our owned and operated business, with particular focus on driving Hair Color Bar growth and acquisition efficiency, and is accountable for the forecast, the budget and the results behind it.

The work runs through two sets of hands that are not your own: an external performance media agency and one internal direct report. Your job is to set the direction, hold both accountable, and know the numbers well enough to challenge what comes back. You will still get into the platforms when the situation calls for it, but the seat is measured on whether acquisition grew and what it cost, not on campaign volume.

We are looking for someone commercially minded and proactive. This role does not wait for direction or stop at reporting what happened. It anticipates where performance is heading, brings the recommendation before it is asked for, and connects what is happening in paid media to what is happening in the business.

This role reports to the SVP, Growth Marketing, is full time and remote. While remote, this role may travel less than 5% of the time.

The base salary range for this position is between $140,000 and $145,000. At Madison Reed, we aim to pay competitively. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Responsibilities

Own acquisition and the number behind it

• Own new customer acquisition targets, budget and performance across our owned and operated channels (Hair Color Bar and Direct-to-Consumer/E-commerce), with primary focus on Hair Color Bar growth, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV) and media mix effectiveness.

• Build and execute the paid acquisition plan in partnership with the SVP, Growth Marketing and the Business Owners (GMs), with particular emphasis on four-wall growth.

• Partner with DTC, Amazon and Wholesale teams on strategies that drive new-to-brand growth for their businesses.

• Translate business objectives into channel plans and measurable growth initiatives rather than waiting for them to arrive as briefs.

Lead the agency relationship

• Own the day-to-day relationship with our external performance media agency: set the strategic direction, the objectives, the KPIs and the testing priorities, and hold them accountable for execution.

• Challenge agency recommendations rather than approving them. Evaluate what comes back against our own numbers and push when the case is thin.

• Run a consistent performance cadence with the agency so problems surface early and in a meeting, not in a month-end report.

• Work with the agency to improve media efficiency, acquisition cost, conversion and incremental growth across paid search, paid social, shopping and other performance channels.

Forecast, budget and financial accountability

• Own acquisition forecasting and budget management: media spend, new customer volume, CAC, ROAS and channel-level performance.

• Build monthly and quarterly forecasts, and flag risks, opportunities and gaps to plan before they land.

• Manage budget pacing and recommend investment shifts across channels, products and campaigns based on performance and business priority.

• Partner with Finance to align acquisition investment to revenue targets, and own monthly media budget reconciliation and reporting with Finance and Accounting.

• Turn performance and financial trends into forward-looking recommendations that inform where the next dollar goes.

Media mix and four-wall growth

• Manage media budget allocation across channels, products and campaigns, weighting intentionally toward four-wall growth channels (geo-targeted paid media, Direct Mail, Audio and similar) against DTC efficiency targets.

• Build the strategies that drive Hair Color Bar traffic through geo-targeting, local marketing and audience segmentation.

• Provide direction across paid and non-paid acquisition drivers including Paid Social, Paid Search and Shopping, Affiliate, Yelp, TV, Audio, Direct Mail, SEO, Referral and exploratory test channels.

• Evaluate emerging platforms and partners to diversify the mix and find incremental growth.

Lead one person, partner with many

• Lead, develop and mentor one direct report, setting clear priorities and accountability alongside real development.

• Build the cross-functional relationships the work depends on: Digital and Engineering on landing pages and marketing technology, Data Strategy on analytics, attribution, incrementality and in-store visit measurement, Creative and Brand on advertising and messaging, Finance on forecasting and budget, and CRM and Brand on how acquisition and retention meet.

Bring the next thing, not just the last number

jobs.title: Senior Construction Manager
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are seeking an experienced Senior Construction Manager to work alongside our key client's large scale, ground-up commercial real estate construction project. The role will be responsible for all aspects of project delivery, from inception through to commissioning.

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 8 years construction field experience and the ability to be highly effective in a client facing role. Under direction of the client, the Construction Manager will be responsible for coordinating with the general contractor and architect/engineer services provider for all construction related activities on the project, including but not limited to:

• Site layout/design (inclusive of roads, infrastructure, site utilities, etc.).
• Constructability reviews of designs, identifying risk to project cost and schedule, preparing reports.
• Lead Turner & Townsend site project team, under the direction of the client
• Ability to work well within a team and liaise with external vendors, architects, engineers, suppliers, & General Contractor.
• In-depth knowledge of construction management in commercial building applications including applicable building codes and standards, as well as amendments by authorities having jurisdiction.
• Strong working knowledge of safety in design and health and safety regulations as they apply to commercial building construction sites.

Design Phase Services

• Support development of Minimum Functionality Case, plus enhancement identification.
• Support and contribute to Value Engineering efforts (selection, coordination, comment follow-up and verification).
• Assist in identifying long-lead items procurement items, providing input/feedback/research related to construction market conditions.
• Assist with preparation of request for proposal for general contractor and commissioning agent procurements.
• Assist in establishing the success criteria for the project construction, including schedule, cost, technical and quality performance parameters.
• Review design and construction drawings against project requirements and for constructability issues and concerns, with follow-up and verification with GC and A/E.
• Participate in risk identification and mitigation planning for cost and schedule risks.
• Assist in developing baseline schedule and provide regular progress update on all activities.
• Participate in Criticality Assessment (workshop to identify critical aspects of design and construction that may require owner witness/hold points and oversight of inspection, testing and acceptance).

Design and Construct

• Participate in Interface with local authorities having jurisdiction, developers, on issues regarding site development, e.g., utility tie-ins, permitting, etc.
• Participate in review of Product Data Submittals in coordination with technical reviewers.
• Coordinate with Commissioning Agent during development of Commissioning Plan and execution of Plan.
• Review project submittals and RFI.

Construction Phase Services including Commissioning and Handover to Operations

• Reviews the general contractors and key subcontractors project schedule for alignment with contract requirements.
• Provide oversight of general contractor during construction phase activities, including regular site visits and review construction work.
• Attend daily construction status meetings and Owner, Architect, Contractor meetings as scheduled.
• Review and report on the overall construction effort and progress.
• Evaluate of the project schedule with relation to actual field production.
• Coordination with Cost and Scheduling representatives for project reporting and dashboard updates.
• Coordination with Document Controller to ensure project documentation is loaded into client system of record.
• Supports observation and issue tracking/resolution and punch-list, coordination with A/E.
• Support In-Process and Final Inspection and Test activity conducted by GC and Commissioning Agent.

• A minimum of 8 years’ project management experience.
• Degree in Construction management or Equivalent and OSHA certified.
• Proficient – expert experience level using Microsoft tools (MS Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
• Ability to lead, coordinate & organize multiple stakeholders including general contractor and deliver project/program status reports as required.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• The tenacity and drive to inject value and create solutions.
• Develops good working relationships with project team.
• Ability to work on site.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life.
