jobs.title: Advanced Practitioner (NP/PA)
jobs.description:
Deliver comprehensive patient care within an established outpatient and urgent care setting supporting personnel within an established international healthcare program. This role practices within a collaborative clinical environment where advanced assessment skills, care coordination, and clinical decision-making contribute to continuity of care and effective patient outcomes across a diverse patient population.

The Advanced Practitioner works alongside physicians, nursing staff, and multidisciplinary healthcare teams to support day-to-day clinic operations, urgent patient evaluation, and ongoing primary care services within an integrated healthcare program.

Job Location: Iraq

Assignment Details: This is a full-time, fixed-term role of up to 12 months. Separate shorter term opportunities are also available. Housing, meals, and project-related airfare are company-paid.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide primary, urgent, and episodic patient care across a wide range of acute and chronic health concerns
• Perform patient evaluations, directed physical examinations, health maintenance counseling, and patient education
• Support emergency assessment, stabilization, and coordination of care for patients requiring higher levels of treatment
• Collaborate with physicians, advanced practice providers, and clinical support staff to ensure coordinated healthcare delivery
• Manage uncomplicated chronic conditions through ongoing monitoring and follow-up care
• Participate in clinical readiness activities, emergency response exercises, and multidisciplinary care coordination
• Maintain accurate clinical documentation and compliance with established healthcare protocols and training requirements
• Coordinate with medical evacuation resources when patient needs exceed on-site clinical capabilities

Requirements

• Graduate of an accredited Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant program
• Current unrestricted U.S. NP or PA licensure, certification, or registration in a U.S. state, territory, commonwealth, or the District of Columbia
• NCCPA certification required for Physician Assistants; AANP or ANCC certification required for Nurse Practitioners
• Current BLS and ACLS certification (or equivalent) required
• 5+ years of recent clinical experience, including at least 6 months within the last 12 months
• U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident with a valid passport.
• Ability to obtain and maintain MRPT security clearance and meet role-related medical and physical readiness requirements

Preferred

• Experience in international, military, or multidisciplinary healthcare environments.
• Experience supporting urgent care, emergency response, or multidisciplinary clinical operations

jobs.title: ICU Registered Nurse (RN)
jobs.description:
You'll provide specialized critical care for patients with life-threatening illnesses and injuries while working alongside physicians and an interdisciplinary healthcare team in a structured international intensive care environment. Your expertise in patient assessment, advanced monitoring, and rapid clinical decision-making will help ensure safe, evidence-based care for U.S. government and contractor personnel stationed in Iraq.

Location: Iraq

Assignment Details: This is a full-time, fixed-term role of up to 12 months. Separate shorter term opportunities are also available. Housing, meals, and project-related airfare are company-paid.

Key Responsibilities

• Assess, monitor, and provide comprehensive nursing care for critically ill patients while recognizing, responding to, and helping manage unexpected or emergent changes in patient condition.
• Administer medications, intravenous therapies, and other physician-prescribed treatments while maintaining safe medication administration practices.
• Collaborate with physicians and interdisciplinary healthcare professionals to develop and implement individualized, evidence-based plans of care.
• Operate and monitor advanced critical care equipment, including ventilators, cardiac monitors, infusion pumps, and other ICU technologies that support complex patient care.
• Document patient assessments, treatments, and clinical progress accurately within the electronic medical record while maintaining complete and current documentation.
• Educate and support patients and their families throughout treatment and recovery while advocating for patient rights, respecting individual beliefs, and promoting patient-centered care.

If you thrive in a collaborative ICU environment where sound clinical judgment and teamwork are essential, you'll find your expertise well suited to this role.

Requirements

• Graduate of an ACEN- or CCNE-accredited nursing program with an Associate, Bachelor, Master of Science in Nursing, or Doctor of Nursing Practice degree.
• Current, full, active, and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license from any U.S. state, territory, commonwealth, or the District of Columbia.
• 3+ years of ICU or critical care experience, including 6 months of direct patient care within the last year.
• Current BLS and ACLS certification.
• U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident Card holder required; ability to obtain and maintain an MRPT U.S. Government security clearance; valid U.S. passport with at least 18 months remaining before expiration and maintained throughout the assignment.
• Ability to meet program physical readiness requirements, communicate effectively in English, and perform duties involving prolonged standing, sitting, bending, stooping, and occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.

Preferred

• CCRN certification preferred; extensive ICU experience may be considered in place of certification.
• ATLS certification.
• Experience providing healthcare services within military or government-supported healthcare environments.
• Experience using Electronic Medical Records (EMR).

jobs.title: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
jobs.description:
You'll provide comprehensive anesthesia care across the full perioperative continuum, helping patients safely prepare for, undergo, and recover from surgical procedures within a structured international healthcare environment. jobs.title: Grocery Merchandiser -  Fort Wayne, IN
jobs.description:
What We Do

C.A. Fortune is a national consumer-centric integrated commerce agency built to help brands win at retail. We deliver sales strategy, in-store execution, full-service marketing, and digital commerce through a single, fully integrated partner. Our capabilities span the full shelf: from getting brands on it, to getting them off it.

We’re passionate, energetic, and deeply motivated by one thing: helping brands win over customers and consumers. We bring together sales experts, marketers, e-commerce specialists, data analysts, and creatives. Different backgrounds, one mission.

Who We Are

C.A. Fortune is built on the belief that great people build great brands. We're a national consumer-centric integrated commerce agency. We show up every day to help brands of all sizes grow, compete, and lead. From emerging challengers to established market leaders, we bring the sales horsepower, marketing firepower, and integrated thinking to move the needle at retail.

The best brands are built by the best people. Come build with us.

Overview of the Role

• The Grocery Merchandiser will properly manage their assigned territory by completing store visits, surveys, and tasks. They will have the ability to take pictures and complete reporting requirements with the technology provided. This position will require merchandising, and the ability to repeatedly bend and lift up to 50 pounds.

• Location: Fort Wayne, IN (within a 40-60 mile radius)

• This position is part time, 20 - 26 hours a week

• Compensation: $17 - $20 hourly, based on experience, qualifications, and skills

• You will be responsible for selling, merchandising, gaining/maintaining distribution within a variety of accounts.

• Ensure our clients' products are well stocked and order if product is not in stock or low.

• This position requires consistent use of mobile apps for reporting, photo uploads, task completion, and communication.

• This position requires you to switch between tasks such as stocking, reporting, and communicating with store teams throughout the day

• You must be able to lift, bend/stoop for extended periods of time.

• This is a position where you work independently, follow directions, and have excellent communication skills.

Perks

• Paid drive time at .70 a mile

• Monthly phone stipend

• Steady and consistent scheduled working hours with available route flexibility

• PTO and sick days

• 1 paid volunteer day per year

• 401k with company match

• Weekly pay

What You’ll Do at C.A. Fortune

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, retail environment with minimal supervision.

• Reliable transportation

• Ability to drive to stores in assigned territory to complete retail tasks & audits at local grocery retailer.

Come As You Are

C.A. is committed to making our company more inclusive. Diversity fuels our innovation and better connects us to our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. That said, we encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of qualifications, especially if this role aligns with your career trajectory.

• Educate patients on treatment plans, health conditions, medications, and self-care strategies to support continuity of care and patient understanding.

Preferred

jobs.title: Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer - OLAP Knowledge
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Job Title: Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer

Locations: Sofia (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager, Product Development

A quick snapshot…

We’re looking for a full-stack senior engineer to build, enhance, and maintain our Price Optimization and Management solutions. The team develops and evolves a family of enterprise pricing products across both monolithic and microservices architectures. You will work across application and service boundaries to drive technical decisions and deliver reliable, production-ready solutions.

What you’ll do

• Contribute to the team’s end-to-end ownership of applications, from development through production operation and continuous improvement

• Design and implement Java services, REST endpoints, business rules, and data-access code for our pricing workflows.

• Build modern, intuitive, and accessible user experiences with React and TypeScript, integrating seamlessly with backend services and APIs.

• Design and evolve data solutions across SQL and NoSQL databases, covering data modeling, schema evolution, data-access patterns, performance, and scalability.

• Participate in technical design and planning by analyzing requirements, assessing complexity, breaking down work, defining technical stories, and contributing to estimates.

• Build quality in from the start through automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

• Troubleshoot production incidents, identify root causes, and drive sustainable fixes and preventative improvements.

• Collaborate with engineers across application, data, and deployment boundaries to deliver cohesive solutions

Are you the person we’re looking for?

A proven track record…

• 5+ years of experience developing large-scale, complex applications using Java and modern JavaScript technologies, preferably React and TypeScript

• Strong Java backend development experience, with a solid understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, SOLID principles, and microservices architecture.

• Experience working with large relational or NoSQL data stores.

• Awareness of algorithmic complexity, Java data structures, and their performance implications.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

• Ability to independently drive well-scoped work to completion while collaborating effectively across application and team boundaries.

• A proactive mindset and an interest in learning and contributing across the full technology stack.

• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar, as part of professional software engineering workflows.

Nice to have

Our technology landscape

• Data and messaging: Microsoft SQL Server, Kafka, Cassandra, Databricks, Redis, TiDB

• Cloud and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Azure

Did we pique your interest?

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

jobs.title: Program Director, Mozambique
jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

• Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

• Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

• Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

• Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

• Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

• Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

• Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

• Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

Role overview

The Program Director leads the portfolio of programs for the GiveDirectly (GD) Mozambique country office and right hand person to the Country Director. They own how GiveDirectly Mozambique's cash transfer programs are designed, run and improved, and are accountable for delivery, performance and quality. They have a mandate to deliver cash to recipients and take programs to step-change scale without compromising on quality or safety.

At the core of the role is leading and coaching the Programs team: building managers' capacity and a team culture rooted in GiveDirectly values. The Program Director also works closely with other GiveDirectly teams (including Product, Safeguarding, Internal Audit, Operations and External Relations) to deliver programs that are effective, scaleable and recipient-centered.

Reports to: Country Director

Level: Director

Location: Maputo, Mozambique, with regular travel to field sites in Nampula, Sofala and other provinces.

Direct reports: LLS Senior Manager; Emergency Cash Program Manager; Social Protection Program Manager; Call Centre Manager

What you'll do

Program leadership and delivery

• Lead delivery of a rapidly growing portfolio - flagship large lump sum programs, government-led social protection and emergency cash, including technology enabled models.

• Lead thinking on how to scale programs and delivery systems in step with the country office's growth ambitions and government poverty reduction priorities.

• Set and hold high standards for recipient experience, delivery quality, KPIs and M&E, using data to guide decision making and allow adaptive programming.

• Adapt plans to new activities, refining assumptions and making adjustments to keep planning accurate and delivery smooth.

• Act as a thought partner to Programs staff, helping them clear bottlenecks to execution.

Team leadership and development

• Coach Programs staff, building their capacity to own decisions, lead teams and develop their skills and hold them accountable to high standards.

• Build a culture of excellence on the Programs team, rooted in GD values.

• Plan teams for scale, including hiring and onboarding of large teams, strengthening management and supervision systems, and building pathways for professional growth.

• Support the Country Director to plan and cost organograms, identify gaps and justify new positions.

Product and program design

• Work with GiveDirectly's global Product team to test, refine and implement new program designs, adapting them to the Mozambique context.

• Oversee the build and functional requirements of tech for new programs, including validating indicators and system logic capture the right data, route recipients through the right recipient experience, and manage risks appropriately.

• Track effectiveness, recipient experience and operational delivery across programs, and share feedback to strengthen product design.

• Develop and adopt tech-enabled and remote delivery models that improve efficiency, mitigate risk and protect quality.

• Coordinate with other global functions, including Programs, Tech, Research and Finance.

Risk, security, safeguarding and audit

• Identify, mitigate and track risks to programs, including fraud, safeguarding, security, reputational and delivery risks.

• Dotted line management of the Internal Audit team to coordinate with programs, and support them to strengthen risk management and systems, including digital and automated checks.

• Work closely with the Safeguarding team to prevent abuse and ensure recipient safety is a priority throughout the program cycle.

• Share responsibility for security management, working with district security focal points, the global security team and Operations to mitigate security risks.

• Support the Country Director to uphold donor and government compliance requirements.

External engagement and partnerships

• Support government engagement and partnership building with mobile network operators, to create an enabling environment for large-scale cash programming.

• Build effective partnerships with implementing partners, including government agencies such as INAS and INGD, as well as sub-awardees and consultants.

• Support the Country Director on donor relationships including through high-quality reporting, communication and input to proposals.

Operations and financial management

• Work with the Operations team (logistics, procurement, HR) on planning and on improving operational efficiency.

• Work with the Country Director and others to develop country annual plans, set annual targets, and develop country budgets.

• Be accountable for project budget vs. actuals (B2As), support review of country B2As, and drive cost efficiency.

What you'll bring

• Strong alignment with GiveDirectly's values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through and fostering inclusivity.

• 7+ years of experience

• 3+ years leading rapidly scaling relevant programs. This may include managing large scale field operations in the social sector or otherwise relevant experience in consulting, financial inclusion, telecommunications, or last mile social enterprise

• A track record of taking programs or delivery systems to scale.

• Experience coaching managers and building strong team cultures, including hiring and growing teams.

• Sound judgement on risk, ideally with experience mitigating security, fraud or safeguarding risks.

• Highly accountable: you turn ambitious goals into concrete plans and take ownership of delivering them.

• Able to cut through complexity: you distill messy problems to what matters and turn them into simple decisions, memos and designs.

• An analytical, iterative problem solver who uses data to diagnose issues, track performance and make decisions.

• Clear, compelling communicator, in writing and in person, with internal teams, government, partners and donors.

• Able to work collaboratively and negotiate to find solutions that work for stakeholders with different interests.

• Willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done where needed. Comfortable operating leanly / cost effectively.

• Professional fluency in English; Portuguese strongly preferred.

• Must be based in Maputo and able to travel regularly to field sites, including in northern Mozambique.

Nice to have - we don't expect candidates to bring all of these:

• Deep experience living or working in Mozambique

• Aptitude and curiosity to figure out how technology and AI can bring about step changes in scaling cash delivery responsibly and ethically. Working with product or tech teams to iterate on program designs.

• Experience managing security, fraud and safeguarding risks.

• Experience with social protection, humanitarian or cash transfer programs.

• Experience working with governments line ministries, regulators, and/or mobile network operators.

We strongly encourage applications from candidates with personal or professional experience in the low-income communities we serve.

Base Salary: USD 100,280

Bonus Target: 15%

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

jobs.title: VP, People Business Partner
jobs.location: NY, US, CA, US, IL, US - Remote
jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

The Role

We are looking for a VP, People Business Partner, Americas to serve as a senior strategic partner to DEPT®’s craft leadership across Creative, Media, Technology, Delivery, and Strategy.

This is a high-impact leadership role that combines senior-level People Business Partnership with ownership of strategic, region-wide people initiatives. The successful candidate will partner closely with craft leaders to strengthen organizational effectiveness, talent development, performance management, succession, and workforce planning while also leading a team of People Business Partners.

A significant component of the role will be translating people data into actionable insights. The VP will develop and implement scalable craft dashboards and people frameworks that give leaders greater visibility into team shape, staffing mix, hiring and exits, employee sentiment, performance, and talent movement.

This role is ideal for a seasoned People leader who is equally comfortable advising senior executives, coaching leaders through complex people decisions, building scalable frameworks, and personally driving strategic projects from concept through implementation.

What You'll Do

Strategic People Business Partnership

• Serve as a trusted senior People advisor to craft leaders across Creative, Technology, Delivery, and Strategy.

• Partner with senior leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, talent strategy, talent management, employee relations, and leadership effectiveness.

• Coach leaders through complex employee relations matters and other sensitive people issues, balancing employee experience with business needs.

• Provide guidance and challenge to leaders on performance management, talent assessment, succession, and organizational effectiveness.

• Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and become a credible, commercially minded thought partner to the business.

• Partner closely with Finance and other functional leaders to connect people strategy, organizational decisions, and financial planning.

Performance, Talent & Career Frameworks

• Lead the design and rollout of scalable people frameworks across the Americas.

• Own and evolve performance management and calibration processes, ensuring consistent and effective application across teams.

• Coach craft leaders through calibration and performance processes, particularly where leaders have limited experience with these disciplines.

• Help establish consistent standards for talent assessment, promotion, development, and succession across disciplines.

• Identify opportunities to improve the employee experience and create greater clarity around career growth and development.

People Analytics & Organizational Insights

• Implement scalable people dashboards across the Americas.

• Own reporting around team shape, staffing mix, hiring, attrition/exits, employee satisfaction, talent movement, and other key people metrics.

• Turn people data into actionable insights and recommendations for craft leadership.

• Help leaders understand and effectively use people information to inform organizational and talent decisions.

Strategic Projects

• Own a portfolio of high-priority strategic People initiatives across the Americas.

• Balance long-term program development with hands-on execution and delivery.

• Build frameworks, processes, and tools that can scale across multiple crafts and markets.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives from strategy and design through implementation and adoption.

• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve People processes across the organization.

• Ensure strategic initiatives are aligned with broader DEPT® People priorities and business objectives.

Launcher - Asia
jobs.description:
About Us

At Quartermaster AI, we leverage cutting-edge AI and robotics technology to enhance maritime domain awareness. Our mission is to become the eyes, ears, and brain of the ocean by enabling every vessel to collaboratively sense, compute, and communicate. Quartermaster is a venture-backed Maritime Domain Awareness company providing near real-time insights to government and commercial partners via our SmartMast™ product. SmartMast™ is a COTS sensor system consisting of a camera, a software defined radio, and a proprietary onboard AI component installed on vessels worldwide and managed by Quartermaster.

About the Role

As a Launcher for Asia, you will carry out Quartermaster's market entry across one of the world's busiest and most strategically important maritime regions. Reporting to the Head of Launch, Asia, you will turn regional strategy into results on the ground: obtaining regulatory approval for deployment, securing vessels, and getting SmartMast™ hardware deployed. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that sits between our regional leadership, local partners, and Field Operations. Success in this role is measured in markets opened, and SmartMast™ units installed, activated, and reporting across Asia's waters.

What you'll own

Regulatory & Compliance Support

 - Government & Regulatory Liaison: Support the Head of Launch in building relationships with national maritime authorities, coast guards, and port authorities, and manage day-to-day working contacts with them.

 - Compliance Execution: Prepare and track the filings, permits, and approvals each launch requires, working with Legal and Compliance on customs, trade, spectrum and equipment type-approval, data handling, and maritime safety requirements.

 - Regulatory Monitoring: Track policy changes across the region's regulatory regimes pertinent to operation of SmartMast™.

Market Entry Execution

 - Playbook Execution: Carry out market entry playbooks in assigned markets, adapting them to local conditions and reporting what works and what does not.

 - Import & Logistics: Manage the import, customs, and logistics steps that bring SmartMast™ hardware into target markets, including warehousing and staging ahead of deployment.

 - Vendor Management: Source, vet, and manage local installers, fabricators, and port-side vendors to Quartermaster's quality and safety standards.

Maritime Stakeholder Engagement

 - Vessel Sourcing: Identify and engage commercial fleet operators, fishing fleets, independent vessel owners, and port authorities suitable for SmartMast™ deployment, and build a pipeline of vessels.

 - Agreement Support: Prepare and negotiate partnership and space-use agreements (the right to mount and operate our hardware on a vessel), closing deals within the terms set by the Head of Launch.

 - Partner Onboarding: Move signed partners to installation, coordinating with Field Operations so vessels are ready and deployments run without delay.

 - Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for fleets, ports, and vendors in assigned markets, keeping partners engaged after installation.

Reporting & Coordination

 - Launch Tracking: Maintain accurate records of pipeline, agreements, installs, and activations, and report progress to the Head of Launch.

 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with product, engineering, legal, and marketing teams to resolve issues that block launches in assigned markets.

 - Market Intelligence: Gather local insight on regional dynamics, technical requirements, and localized risks to inform regional strategy.

What you need

 - Experience: 5+ years in operations, market entry, business development, or government relations roles, ideally within maritime, logistics, defense, or other highly regulated sectors.

 - Regional Expertise: Working knowledge of the political, regulatory, and commercial landscape across Asia's ports and maritime economies.

 - Stakeholder Skills: Experience working with government agencies, port authorities, or fleet operators, and building trust with local partners.

 - Commercial Skills: Track record of sourcing and closing B2B agreements, vendor contracts, or fleet partnerships.

 - Execution Focus: A bias for action. Comfortable managing several launch workstreams at once, in the field and at a desk.

 - Travel: Willingness to travel frequently across the region, including to ports and vessels.

 - Language Skills: Fluency in English is required. Professional proficiency in Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Tagalog, or Vietnamese is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Human Biology faculty (part-time)
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Opportunity at a Glance

We are interested in developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily Industry Professionals to share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate students in a variety of fields.   Commitment is on a course-by-course basis.

Human Biology with Lab (BIOS150)

In this introductory course students study the biological principles governing the normal state of the human body with an emphasis on the structure and function of major organ systems. Through virtual labs, case studies, discussions, and other learning activities, students explore core concepts in biochemistry, biology, genetics, anatomy and physiology to gain an understanding of how human body systems normally work together to maintain homeostasis and respond to disease. The course will also cover topics such as human development, fluid dynamics, reproduction, nutrition, and the body's defenses against illness.

Topics include:

• Demonstrate how anatomical root words give rise to anatomical and medical terminology.
• Describe the basic structure and function of human cells including cell transportation and cell division.
• Explain the roles of the four common biological macromolecules.
• Explain the basic structure, function and organization of tissues within the organ systems in the normal state.
• Recall how various factors including nutrition, environment, and exercise influence the state of the human body.
• Describe common disease states and disorders and their effects on normal function.
• Describe the process of reproduction including the flow of genetic information and basic genetic calculations.

Responsibilities

• Develops and provides students with an approved Covista/Chamberlain University syllabus that follows an established template, which includes the terminal course objectives.

• Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and update all course materials.

• Conduct the course using our student focused coaching model, focused on proactive outreach using phone, email communication, and use of other communication technologies
• Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students.

• Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning.

• Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories.

• Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives.

• Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams and provide timely feedback to students.

• Performs/Completes other duties as assigned.
• Complies with all policies and standards

• Master's Degree is required for all faculty positions (with 18 graduate hours in the subject being taught for undergraduate teaching - Human Biology, Biology, Anatomy & Physiology or Microbiology). Required
• Ability to provide unofficial and official transcripts for all earned degrees from a regionally accredited institution. (or a NACES approved US course-by-course equivalency evaluation for degrees earned and conferred outside of the US) Required
• A minimum of 1-year online teaching experience. Preferred
• Ability to recognize signs of disengagement or academic struggle and intervene early
• Passion for student success and care for students
• Faculty must have requisite subject matter expertise and outstanding communication skills.
• Faculty must also have excellent motivational and instructional skills in a diverse and non-traditional environment.
• Must be able to work in a collegial manner and facilitate the efforts of diverse groups.
• Additional requirements driven by state licensing or accreditation considerations may apply. Required

Working alongside physicians, nurses, and multidisciplinary emergency response teams, this Critical Care Paramedic role combines high-acuity patient care with rapid clinical assessment, advanced intervention, and collaborative care coordination across emergency response and inter-facility transport operations.

This position offers the opportunity to manage complex medical and trauma cases while practicing at an advanced clinical level in a highly collaborative operational setting.

Location: Iraq

• Operate and interpret specialized critical care equipment including ventilators, infusion pumps, cardiac monitors, and 12-lead ECGs to support patient treatment and transport decisions.
• Collaborate closely with physicians, nurses, and healthcare teams to support continuity of care across emergency, inpatient, and outpatient clinical environments.
• Support operational readiness through accurate documentation, equipment management, supply oversight, and participation in ongoing training and clinical competency activities.

Requirements

• Current unrestricted Paramedic license.
• Current CCP-C or FP-C certification required.
• Current BLS, ACLS, and advanced trauma certification (PHTLS, ITLS, TCCC, or equivalent).

• U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident with a valid passport
• Ability to obtain and maintain MRPT security clearance and meet pre-deployment physical requirements.

As a member of an Agile delivery team, the analyst participates in solution design, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement efforts while providing ongoing production support to ensure reliable and compliant master data processes across the enterprise.

• Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and supporting documentation

• Ensure solutions meet business requirements and quality standards prior to deployment

• Provide production support by investigating and resolving data-related issues, interface failures, workflow exceptions, and integration errors

• Analyze root causes of data quality issues and recommend process improvements

• Partner with business users, data stewards, and technical teams to improve master data management processes

• Maintain functional documentation and support knowledge-sharing activities across teams

Here’s what you need:

• 1+ year supporting SAP S/4HANA Material Master and Customer Master data processes

• Experience gathering business requirements and developing functional specifications

• Experience designing and supporting SAP RICEFW objects

• Strong understanding of master data governance and data quality management practices

• Experience developing and executing test strategies, test plans, and test cases

• Experience leading System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities

• Experience working within Agile delivery teams and methodologies

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation or transformation programs

jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Autotechnicus EV

Wil jij werken aan één van de meest innovatieve elektrische automerken ter wereld? Ben jij een ervaren autotechnicus die energie krijgt van complexe diagnoses, geavanceerde voertuigtechniek en elektrische voertuigen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Wat breng je mee?

• Relevante werkervaring als automonteur, autotechnicus, diagnosetechnicus of technisch specialist.

• Werken aan geavanceerde elektrische voertuigen en de nieuwste voertuigtechnologie.

jobs.title: Senior All-Source Intelligence Analyst (5838)
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a motivated Senior All-Source Intelligence Analyst to provide thoughtful, relevant, reliable and predictive intelligence analysis and production. The intelligence production requirements will span the breadth of Southeast Asia and South Asia Countries.

The Senior All-Source Intelligence Analyst will deliver accurate, clear, and consistent products in coordination with SOCPAC JISE leadership and other Senior Intelligence Analysts. To be successful in this role, candidate must be a self-starter and be able to work with diverse stakeholders at all levels. Should have excellent organizational and communications skills.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• The Senior All-source Intelligence Analyst will implement the four priorities of analytical methodologies: Threats to U.S interests: Anti-western threats associated with violent extremist networks Host Nation threats Socio-political environment

• The Senior All-source Intelligence Analyst will: Provide Steady-State, Crisis, and Predictive Intelligence coverage of South Asia/Southeast Asia, facilitating both CONOP development and support for USPACOM, USSOCOM, SOCPAC and interagency planning to develop a full range of Special Operations options. Assist in defining analytical and collection requirements, training (virtual or physical) of PACOM Augmentation Teams, Components, Task Forces, support to PACOM Assessments, national Intelligence Community level discussions and working groups, Link Analysis, Source Directed Requirements and provide predictive analysis to the Commander and Staff. Maintain steady-state coverage of South Asia/Southeast Asia to support SOCPAC’s efforts to provide strategic-level analysis in niche areas to USPACOM and the Intelligence Community efforts. Use information derived from all intelligence disciplines to determine changes in enemy capabilities, vulnerabilities, and probable courses of action. Research, analyze and develop complex analytical products which provide a robust understanding of the dynamic environment in given operationally focused areas. Research and develop critical factors analysis and deliver into intelligence products. Participate in committees and working groups concerned with developing or revising OPLANs, CONPLANs, intelligence architecture and theater and national intelligence. Conduct research and analysis on a wide variety of topics relating to Contingency Operations in the USPACOM Area of Operations (AOR) utilizing several intelligence software tools to include RMT TAC, FADE/MIST, Palantir, CIDNE, etc. Provide intelligence analysis and production relative to an assigned area(s) in political, economic, social, cultural, physical, geographic, technical, or military conditions for one or more foreign countries. Maintain liaison with personnel in assigned and related fields, such as those in other intelligence agencies and allied foreign governments, to discuss mutual intelligence problems and production efforts. Participates in interagency and international meetings and conferences. Deliver technical insight into intelligence matters relevant to the command. Provide intelligence support for OPLAN, CONPLAN and crisis development. Provide intelligence expertise and support to COMSOCPAC, SOCPAC Staff, and Component Commands through the various intelligence products, briefings, and forums to include INTSUMs, CUB, Daily Read book, O&I, Information Papers, and Current Threat Briefs. Work in tandem with the Joint Intelligence Control Element (JISE), USPACOM JIOC and USSOCOM to de-conflict intelligence collection, production, and federation of intelligence support. Provide operational and regional analysis, Geopolitical Analysis, HUMINT/SIGINT/OSINT analysis, collection management, and Find Fix Track Target Engage Assess (F2T2EA) targeting cycle.

• CONUS and OCONUS travel may be required.

• Deployments of no more than 90 days may be required throughout the theater or CONUS.

Required Skills & Experience

• Clearance Required: TS/SCI

• Bachelor’s (BA/BS) degree in any field.

• Ten (10) years of experience conducting intelligence analysis, with at least two (2) years supporting SOF.

• Five (5) years of experience at the operational level conducting regional analysis, Geopolitical Analysis, HUMINT/SIGINT/OSINT analysis, collection management, and Find Fix Track Target Engage Assess (F2T2EA) targeting cycle.

• Five (5) years of experience with developing analytical briefings within USPACOM/INDO-PAC AOR Intelligence Enterprise, the U.S. Intelligence Community, and the Interagency.

• Three (3) years of experience with identity studies (e.g., anthropology, sociology, political science, etc.) or development economics.

• Five (5) years intelligence experience with analysis, reporting and briefing in a DoD setting.

• Four (4) years of experience using theater and national level intelligence automated information, intelligence, and communication systems, tools, databases, and programs.

Desired Skills & Experience

• 3 or more years supporting SOF

• 4 or more years' experience at the GO/FO GCC, Operational, or Interagency level

jobs.title: Full-Stack Staff Software Engineer - Tech Lead
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Job Title: Full-Stack Staff Software Engineer

Locations: Sofia (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager, Product Development

A quick snapshot

We’re looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer / Tech Lead to provide technical leadership for our Price Optimization and Management solutions team in Sofia. The team develops and evolves a family of enterprise pricing products across both monolithic and microservices architectures. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction of our products, translate product strategy into actionable engineering plans, and help the team deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what will give you an edge…

• Own the technical design and the evolution of product functional areas and services, making pragmatic decisions that balance customer value, delivery cost, maintainability, security, performance, and risk.

• Translate product strategy and roadmap priorities into clear technical approaches, actionable increments, dependencies, estimates, and delivery plans for the team.

• Lead design discussions across application, service, data, and deployment boundaries, build consensus, and document important architectural decisions and trade-offs.

• Remain hands-on by designing and implementing critical Java services, REST APIs, business logic, data-access components, and selected React and TypeScript features.

• Design and evolve SQL and NoSQL data solutions, covering data modeling, schema evolution, data-access patterns, performance, scalability, and safe migrations.

• Guide the team toward simple, consistent, and secure designs, reinforcing engineering practices through reviews, examples, and constructive technical challenge.

• Mentor Senior Software Engineers and other team members through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

• Drive engineering quality through automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, observability, production readiness, and continuous improvement.

• Lead the technical investigation of complex production incidents, identify root causes through systematic debugging, and drive sustainable corrective and preventative improvements.

• Collaborate proactively with Product, QA, Cloud Operations, Security, Architecture, and adjacent engineering teams to resolve dependencies and deliver cohesive outcomes.

• Identify technical risks, blockers, and unhealthy patterns early, communicate them clearly, and propose practical alternatives before delivery is at risk.

Are you the person we’re looking for?

A proven track record…

• 7+ years of related software engineering experience, including cloud technologies and technical leadership within a complex product environment.

• Deep Java backend expertise and strong hands-on experience with object-oriented design, design patterns, SOLID principles, APIs, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.

• Full-stack breadth, with practical experience in modern front-end engineering, preferably React and TypeScript, and the ability to guide decisions across the application stack.

• Deep understanding of automated testing, systematic debugging, production diagnostics, observability, and secure software-engineering practices.

• Experience owning the design and operation of a functional area or service, including monitoring, production readiness, performance, scalability, and operational risk.

• Experience with large relational and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, schema evolution, migrations, and performance optimization.

• Strong analytical judgement and the ability to find answers when they are not obvious, resolve underlying issues rather than symptoms, and make sound decisions amid ambiguity.

• Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, build consensus, facilitate healthy technical debate, and challenge decisions constructively.

• Ability to break down roadmap goals into actionable work, coordinate dependencies and priorities, and help the team deliver predictable outcomes.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, QA, Operations, Security, and senior stakeholders.

• A coaching mindset and proven ability to mentor Senior Software Engineers and help raise engineering standards across a team.

• Hands-on experience integrating AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar, into professional software-engineering workflows with appropriate review and judgement.

Nice to have

• Experience with data-intensive business domains.

• Experience modernizing a mature monolithic product while introducing or evolving cloud-native microservices.

• Experience with event-driven architectures, large-scale data processing, or analytical data technologies such as Databricks, SQL Server Analysis Services, OLAP, MDX, or DAX.

• Experience leading improvements in architecture, observability, security, CI/CD, testing, or developer productivity.

Our technology landscape

• Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot, Dropwizard, JDBI, Hibernate, Liquibase

• Frontend: React, TypeScript

• Data and messaging: Microsoft SQL Server, Kafka, Cassandra, Databricks, Redis, TiDB

• Analytics: OLAP, MDX, DAX, SQL Server Analysis Services

• Cloud and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Azure

• Delivery: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins

• Testing: Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, JUnit

Did we pique your interest?

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

jobs.title: Senior Exposure Management Engineer - Mid-Atlantic region (Remote)
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Senior Exposure Management Engineer to support GuidePoint Security's Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management practice. The Senior Exposure Management Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong asset management, integration, and risk-based vulnerability management skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive exposure management programs that will align the delivery of business objectives and priorities.

About the Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management Practice

The Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management Practice is responsible for helping clients see everything they own and fix what matters most. We build unified, real-time asset inventories and risk-based exposure programs — with the Axonius Asset Cloud at the center — that turn fragmented data from hundreds of security and IT tools into a single, trusted asset model and a prioritized, business-aware remediation backlog.

Our team of exposure management engineers, Axonius platform specialists, and automation developers focuses on cyber asset attack surface management (CAASM), risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM), and exposure prioritization. We partner with client security, IT, infrastructure, and cloud teams to eliminate blind spots, de-duplicate findings across tools, assign asset ownership, and drive measurable risk reduction.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Exposure Management Platform Operations

• Operate and maintain security platforms including vulnerability management, RBVM, CAASM, and CNAPP tools

• Monitor security findings and support prioritization and remediation workflows

• Assist in platform tuning, configuration optimization, and integration with client environments

• Support onboarding of new assets, applications, and cloud environments into security platforms

Exposure Management Operations

• Review exposure findings and assist with prioritization and remediation tracking

• Help manage remediation workflows with client engineering teams

• Generate operational dashboards and reporting for security leadership

• Assist in maintaining asset inventory coverage and scanning accuracy

Traditional Vulnerability Management

• Deploy, configure, and maintain vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable Nessus/Tenable.sc, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM) across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

• Design scan sites, asset groups, scan templates, and schedules that deliver complete coverage while minimizing operational impact on production systems.

• Configure and manage authenticated (credentialed) scanning, scan engines, and agent deployments; troubleshoot credential failures and coverage gaps.

• Execute and validate network, host, and web application vulnerability scans; verify findings and reduce false positives.

• Manage the full vulnerability lifecycle — discovery, validation, assignment, remediation, re-scan verification, and closure.

• Coordinate patch and configuration remediation with IT and system owners, and track risk acceptances, exceptions, and compensating controls.

• Perform configuration and compliance scanning against benchmarks such as CIS and DISA STIG.

• Maintain vulnerability management policies, SLAs, and standard operating procedures aligned to frameworks such as NIST, PCI DSS, and CIS Controls.

• Produce recurring vulnerability metrics and reports, including open/aging vulnerabilities, mean time to remediate, and scan coverage.

Risk-Based Vulnerability Management Configuration

• Configure risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM) so that vulnerabilities are prioritized by real-world risk — business impact, exposure, and exploitability — rather than by CVSS score alone.

• Ingest and consolidate vulnerability findings from multiple scanners (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) into RBVM platforms such as Axonius, Nucleus, Brinqa, Armor Code, Cogent, Zafran and configure de-duplication so a single vulnerability reported by different tools is represented once.

• Build and maintain asset criticality ratings and business-context tags so prioritization reflects the importance of each asset to the business.

• Configure enrichment of findings with threat intelligence and exploitability signals (e.g., known-exploited, active-in-the-wild) to surface the vulnerabilities attackers are most likely to use.

• Design saved queries and dynamic asset/vulnerability views that isolate high-risk, exposed, mission-critical findings and filter out low-risk noise and items already within SLA.

• Configure risk scoring, severity mapping, and prioritization logic that combine CVSS, exposure (internet-facing vs. isolated), exploit status, asset criticality, and existing mitigating controls.

• Build automation workflows and dashboards to automate remediation workflows — create and route tickets to the correct owner in ServiceNow/Jira, notify teams, and track SLA and patch-window adherence.

• Configure escalation (“fire alarm”) logic and SLA-based rules for critical and zero-day vulnerabilities that require faster-than-standard remediation.

• Build dashboards and reporting that show remediation progress, SLA compliance, risk reduction over time, and coverage — tailored for both operational teams and security leadership.

• Continuously tune prioritization models and reduce alert fatigue so client teams focus effort on the findings that actually reduce risk.

CNAPP & Cloud Security Support

• Assist with the operation and optimization of CNAPP platforms (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)

• Support cloud posture monitoring and exposure analysis

• Assist with investigation of cloud misconfigurations, identity exposures, and attack paths

• Work with senior engineers to onboard new cloud environments

Automation & Integrations

• Develop scripts and automation to improve security workflows

• Build integrations between security tools and ticketing systems

• Automate reporting, vulnerability triage, and remediation tracking

• Use APIs and automation frameworks to reduce manual operational effort

• Use the Axonius Query Language, REST API, and Enforcement Center to automate asset queries, enrichment, ticketing, and remediation actions.

Client Engagement

• Participate in regular operational cadence meetings with clients

• Provide updates on platform findings and remediation progress

• Assist senior engineers in troubleshooting security platform issues

• Contribute to documentation and operational playbooks

Required Experience:

• 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering

• Exposure management or risk-based vulnerability management experience

• Experience building and maintaining unified asset inventories from disparate security and IT data sources.

• Experience configuring asset criticality, ownership, and business context to drive risk-based prioritization.

• Familiarity with vulnerability management, exposure management, or CNAPP platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, Axonius, or similar tools

• Hands-on experience running enterprise vulnerability scanning programs, including authenticated scanning, scan scheduling, false-positive validation, and remediation tracking.

• Scripting experience (Python, PowerShell, or similar)

• Experience working with APIs or automating workflows

• Understanding of security fundamentals: vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identity and access control, security monitoring

• Strong communication skills and ability to work with engineering teams

• Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience:

• Experience with CNAPP platforms such as: Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca, Lacework

• Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP

• Familiarity with container security and Kubernetes

• Experience integrating security tools with ticketing platforms (Jira, ServiceNow)

• Direct engineering experience with RBVM integrations, correlation tuning, and the Enforcement Center.

• Experience with cyber asset management (CAASM), asset discovery, and network enumeration tooling.

• Experience in Linux environments and API-based data retrieval from security/infrastructure tools (EDR, IdP, NGFW, cloud providers).

• Experience using AI-assisted tools (LLMs, copilots, or agent frameworks) to accelerate scripting, analysis, and security operations workflows

Travel Requirements:

• Up to 10% travel

Physical Requirements:

• Sedentary work

• Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

• Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)

• Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)

• Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

• 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program

• Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance

• Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment

• Pet Benefit Option

jobs.title: Senior Director, US Market Access
jobs.description:
At Kailera, we are bold, authentic and committed to our mission of developing therapies that give people the power to transform their lives and elevate their overall health. Rooted in an entrepreneurial spirit and a team-oriented culture, we are working together to advance Kailera’s mission to advance novel therapies for obesity and related conditions.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes collaboration, integrity, and excellence. As we expand, we seek the most talented individuals with diverse backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, and experiences to join our team.

What You’ll Do:

The Senior Director, US Market Access at Kailera Therapeutics reports to the VP of Value and Access, and will lead pricing, contracting, and reimbursement strategy across commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and employer channels. This person will be a key leader responsible for developing and executing the US market access strategy that ensures broad, sustainable patient access for Kailera’s portfolio, including injectable and oral ributpatide.  This role will partner closely with clinical, medical, marketing, and finance teams to align access strategy with clinical and commercial objectives, driving a successful US launch and sustained growth. This role will be critical in establishing Kailera’s presence as a leader in the obesity space.

Required location: Waltham, MA (hub-based, onsite 3-4 days per week)

Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute the US market access strategy for Kailera’s portfolio, including ribupatide injectable and oral spanning commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, employer, and self-pay channels

• Build and lead market access launch efforts individually with agility while preparing to grow the US Market Access with direct reports over time. Partner with Market Access team foster a culture of innovation, accountability, flexibility, and collaboration

• Lead pricing, contracting, and gross-to-net strategy with PBMs, health plans, and employers, balancing broad access, net price, and long-term commercial success, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and Compliance

• Shape employer and benefit consultant engagement and evaluate emerging access channels, including direct-to-patient and self-pay models, as the obesity coverage landscape evolves

• Collaborate with clinical development, regulatory, medical affairs, HEOR/RWE, marketing, and finance teams to ensure access strategies align with corporate objectives and market dynamics, including input to launch planning and forecasting

• Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including national and regional payers, PBMs, integrated delivery networks, employers, benefit consultants, and key opinion leaders (KOLs)

• Use payer research, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to inform access strategy, pricing, and contracting decisions

• Partner with Policy and Government Affairs to track and assess federal and state policy developments (e.g., Medicare and Medicaid coverage, the IRA, CAA, etc..). Ensure payer and contracting activities comply with applicable laws and regulations

Required Qualifications:

• 12+ years in Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology Market Access. Expertise in US market access, pricing, and contracting, including in-depth knowledge of the US payer environment: coverage, reimbursement, formulary management, rebating, and gross-to-net across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. At least 5 years of people leadership experience

• Has led at least one major US launch within Market Access, from pre-launch strategy through market uptake, including working through the problems that come up after launch. Has built and run an integrated market access launch plan in partnership with brand across functions

• Recent, hands-on experience with payer and PBM engagement, including PIE & value proposition discussions, contract negotiations, and trade decisions. Significant experience developing and implementing US contracting strategies with PBMs and health plans

• Demonstrated ability to develop and implement innovative US access strategies. Proven success translating strategy into actionable plans and delivering successful product launches

• Strong skills in collaborating with marketing, development, regulatory, medical affairs, HEOR/RWE, finance, legal, and trade teams to ensure seamless product development and commercialization, and to maintain strategic alignment and achieve performance objectives

• Experience building, leading, and mentoring high-performing teams, including in a hybrid environment. Ability to foster a culture of innovation, accountability, agility, and collaboration, ensuring the team is positioned for rapid growth and successful commercialization

• Expertise in using complex clinical data, payer research, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to inform access strategy, contracting, and pricing models

• Capable of navigating the complexities of a fast-growing biotech environment while maintaining focus on US launch readiness and long-term value creation. Ability to adapt to change and manage competing demands effectively

Preferred Qualifications:

• Launch experience in obesity, diabetes or related cardiometabolic areas. Experience with incretins (GLP-1 or GLP-1/GIP) is a strong plus

• Proven experience building and leading market access functions within a new organization, company, or product, including establishing foundational strategies and structures in a startup or high-growth environment

• Experience developing and executing access strategies for consumer-driven brands, including self-pay and direct-to-patient models

• Working knowledge of Medicare Part D and Medicaid dynamics and the evolving policy environment affecting obesity therapies, including the Inflation Reduction Act

Education:

A bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in business, life sciences, pharmacy, health policy, or a related field is required

Salary Range

$229,000—$280,000 USD

For Full Time Roles: This range represents the company’s good-faith estimate of the salary at the time of posting. Actual pay may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, and internal equity. We also offer comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a year-end shutdown. Apply today and start a career where you'll see the difference you make every week.

jobs.title: Flight Paramedic - Resource
jobs.description:
Who Are We:

Life Link III is a premier, nationally recognized air medical transport company, known for our clinical excellence, superior aviation program and reliable response in providing care to critically ill or injured patients. As a Critical Care Flight Paramedic at Life Link III, you’ll join an elite team of flight nurses and pilots, delivering advanced life-saving care with top-of-the-line equipment in air medical transport. Experience a high level of autonomy as you assess and stabilize critically ill or injured patients, performing advanced procedures and ensuring their safe journey to specialized medical facilities. This fast-paced, rewarding role demands expert critical care knowledge, mastery of complex interventions, and exceptional communication—where every mission makes a difference.

Your Impact:

• Prior critical care experience that involved a comprehensive understanding of advanced life support techniques, pharmacological therapies, invasive procedures, and emergency interventions

• Prior exposure to high-acuity, multi-system trauma, including shock, severe head injuries, and complex cardiac emergencies, is essential

• Must maintain a flight crew weight of 230 lbs or less, fully dressed in flight required gear

• Valid driver’s license

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous flight experience preferred
