jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
The Field Technician position is responsible for the pick-up and delivery of water, soil and air samples to and from the laboratory. As a field technician you will also be responsible for maintaining the quality, hold time, and turnaround time for all recieved and delievered samples and materials assigned to the lab.

This is an exciting fast paced field position that will request the abillity to drive repeatedly throughout your scheduled day.

• Prepare and deliever bottle orders to clients following the standard operating procedure of the lab.
• Receive and stock all sample control supplies, prepare and ship sample kits and perform sampling events as needed.
• Dispose of samples and hazardous waste according to guidelines and carry out any other duties assigned by the department manager.
• Assists with routine and non-routine sampling, monitoring, and data collection activities in support of environmental monitoring programs and client service requests
• Perform on-site sampling events as needed
• Pick up and deliver samples, bottle orders and report to the laboratory for sign-in and analysis.
• Count the number of samples when receiving them from clients to make sure that the Chain of Custody and samples match. Verify that samples are not broken or damaged.
• Receive and sign the Chain of Custody.
• Ensure that client signs, dates, and records time on the Chain of Custody when releasing samples.
• Unload samples and inspect for damage or violated hold times to maintain sample integrity
• Transport samples on ice from client site to the lab, or from our lab to a sub- contracted laboratory
• Interact with Project Managers and clients appropriately and professionally.
• Follow directions or use maps to locate client offices/sites as specified in the courier request form.
• Communicate effectively with the courier coordinator about the courier schedule.
• Record in the courier log book the time that courier arrives to the site and time leaving from the site for all the pick-ups and deliveries
• Maintain records for the vehicle maintenance and driving miles; turn it in at the end of each month.
• Restock supplies when received so supplies are available to employees when needed.
• Prepare outgoing shipments of bottle kits and coolers for pick-up
• Perform duties in accordance with Section 14 of the Transportation and Fleet Safety of the Corporate Safety Manual.
• Comply with the Company’s driver policies.
• Dispose of samples according to guidelines on a monthly basis to remain in compliance with Environmental Protection Agency and Environmental Health & Safety requirements.
• Maintain delivery truck to keep in proper working order.
• Label samples after log in on an as needed basis.
• Perform all duties as outlined in the Standard Operating Procedure for Couriers

Education: High school diploma or equivalent

Experience: None required.

• Valid driver's license required without recent incident. Will drive a company vehicle as needed.
• Ability to lift 50 pounds- samples arrive in coolers packed in ice.

Ability and/or Skills:

• Reading maps and following directions
• Computer skills preferred- logging in samples
• Ability to prioritize
• Dependability
• Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English.
• Authorization to work in US indefinitely without sponsorship.

Position is located, onsite, in Merrillville, IN.

Position will be looking to offer a starting rate of $17.75/hr.

Position is full-time, Tuesday- Saturday 7 AM - 3 PM, Rotating Sundays and Holidays.

jobs.title: Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Power Business Unit (PWR) is looking for a Staff Product Engineer to join our team to drive the product development of state-of-the-art power management products. This is a unique and exciting opportunity to work with a cross-functional team to bring a product to volume production starting from product conception to production release. The job scope includes but is not limited to, development of the test plan to ensure datasheet specifications are met. Own the qualification plan and the execution to comply with various JEDEC/AEC quality standards. Own product quality assessment through reliability tests. Collaborate with multi-functional teams such as Design, Test, Applications and Failure Analysis teams during first silicon debug and to root cause field failures. Creation and maintenance of

product BOM. Monitor production data to address yield and quality deficiencies using statistical analysis.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Temperature/Voltage/Process characterization and production limit setting.

• Qualification Hardware schematics design and executions

· Full PE product lifecycle ownership from concept to end of life with a focus on ensuring the delivery of the highest quality products to our end customers

· Definition of ATE test, qualification and manufacturing plans

· Product release into manufacturing with adherence to stringent tier 1-customer requirements

· Datasheet and automotive compliance reports

· Real time customer support for design, product and quality related issues

· New product introduction and yield ownership

· Product BOM release and maintenance

· Excursion management for both suppliers and customers

· Use commercially available yield tools for yield improvement and monitoring, generate weekly reports and review with PE teams

· KPI achievement in product related deliverables including NPI execution and velocity, product cost (Gross margin improvements), product quality performance and failure analysis cycle times

· PAT, SYL, SBL, SPC limit and disposition optimizations to protect quality without excessive waste

• 8+ years’ experience in product engineering. A strong analog circuit background is a must. Familiarity with power management IC testing would be a plus

• Familiarity with ATE tester platforms (eg. Teradyne J750, iFlex, Advantest 93K)

• Knowledge of analog and mix-signal circuitry and the common building blocks, device physics, test methodology and DFT knowledge

• Experience with common lab test equipment (DC power supply, oscilloscope, multi-meters etc). Bench characterization experience is a plus

• Familiarity with JEDEC/AEC qualification standards and stress test conditions. Experience with qual hardware/software development would be preferred

• Experience in yield management tools such as PDF Exensio, JMP. Apply statistical analysis to isolate the issue and make data-driven decisions

• Ability to managing supplier excursions and customer escalations through problem solving

• Knowledge of Semiconductor Failure Analysis is preferable

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• A good team player. Effective in fast paced, dynamic work environment

EDUCATION

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. The Signal Integrity/Power Integrity (SIPI) team is a centralized SIPI resource within Waymo. • Review and direct vendor design and simulation workflows where applicable

• Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering with 3+ years relevant working experience

• Be able to perform SI and PI simulation softwares such as Ansys HFSS, SIwave, PowerSI, ADS, HSPICE. Familiar with working with IBIS AMI models

• Understand PI fundamentals. Be able to perform power-noise-aware SI analysis

• Familiar with lab equipment such as VNA and TDR, demonstrated experience with simulation-to-measurement correlation and solving real-world SIPI problems.

• Excellent communication skills with experience to collaborate with internal and external teams

jobs.title: Staff Applied Scientist
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to lead the design and build of an evaluation framework for an enterprise planner-based agent. You will work directly with the client's engineering team to benchmark their agent across planner models, executor LLMs and inference optimization levers. Every proposed change, whether a model upgrade, a harness change or a routing strategy, becomes a controlled, statistically sound experiment with a measurable dollar outcome.

This is a research-heavy, customer-facing role with a significant build component. You will own both the experimental method and the tooling that makes it repeatable: a scenario-driven user simulator, isolated experiment execution, statistical comparison, and automated insights in a locally hosted dashboard the client can adopt as their own. The work runs in three overlapping streams (evaluation pipeline, grading and statistics, dashboard and experiment campaign) and ends in a recommendation the client can act on.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Agents are only as good as the evidence behind them. Today, most teams pick a model or switch on a cost lever on instinct. Here, you replace instinct with data: you build the system that tells the client which planner model, which executor and which levers to roll out, how much quality each change costs or saves, and what it is worth in dollars at production volume. You also show how well the planner carries over from data analytics to tasks. This is a research role with real build accountability, and your work becomes the client's own decision-making tool. It demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You'll Do

Evaluation Pipeline & Simulation

• Design the end-to-end evaluation workflow for a planner-executor agent: scenarios, user simulation, configuration, execution, grading, comparison and insights

• Define the scenario schema, grading spec and validators with the client's team, who own scenario creation, so their data plugs directly into the framework (each scenario has a goal, persona, starting state and expected end state)

• Build an LLM-based user simulator with a hidden goal and a stop rule that holds realistic multi-turn conversations, and check its realism against individual production logs

• Build isolated, parallel experiment execution: config files, one run per config and scenario, and a harness adapter that routes all model traffic through the client's existing LLM gateway

• Package optimization levers as plug-ins and implement a shortlist of 3 to 4 for v1, such as cascade-on-failure, cache-aware model switching and prompt caching

• Tag every model call at the gateway and send traces to a trace store, so tokens, cache usage, latency and cost are attributed to each request

Grading, Statistics & Insights

• Grade each run against the expected end state as the primary signal, with optional LLM judges for answer and plan quality

• Compute the core metrics: verified success, cost per success, p95 latency, and failures traced to pipeline stage

• Compare experiments on the same scenarios with paired methods: confidence intervals, win/loss/tie per scenario, and a non-inferiority test that a cost lever does not drop quality past an agreed margin. Say clearly when a result is inconclusive

• Convert differences into projected dollar savings at production volume using real deployment costs, not just list token prices, and plot the cost-versus-quality frontier

• Build an automated insight engine where a statistics layer computes every number and an LLM only writes them up, so each ranked finding links back to its evidence

Dashboard, Experiments & Readout

• Build the locally hosted dashboard (Launch, Live, Results, Compare, Insights and Traces views), API-first with one-command local deployment so it can be integrated into the client's platform later

• Run the staged campaign: production baseline, model screen, lever screen, then confirm the best combination

• Analyze generalization by scenario category, optionally alongside a small data-analytics anchor set

• Deliver a final recommendation with confidence intervals and dollar impact, plus the runbook and integration guide that support go/no-go decisions

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

• Partner with the client's engineers and leadership to agree on scenarios, margins and success criteria, and explain findings to both scientists and business stakeholders

• Write clear technical reports and leadership summaries that translate results into business impact

• Set the experimental standards for the pod and mentor other engineers on rigorous agent evaluation, including AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code

What You'll Bring

• Experience with LLM and agent evaluation methods, such as programmatic state-based verifiers, LLM-as-judge or agent-as-judge, trajectory-level scoring and user simulation

• Experience building or evaluating planner-executor or other multi-step, tool-using agent architectures in production, not just prototypes

• A strong background in experimental design and statistical inference, including paired designs, non-inferiority testing and power analysis, and the judgment to call a result inconclusive

• Experience with multi-objective optimization or cost-aware ML, including Pareto frontier analysis and converting results into projected dollar savings

• Familiarity with LLM routing, model cascades or model selection, and an understanding of LLM inference internals and cost levers (prompt and plan caching, context compaction, reasoning budgets, cache-aware model switching)

• Experience with observability and tracing for LLM systems, including attributing tokens, cache usage, latency and cost per request

• The ability to build production-quality research tooling: Python services, containerized and sandboxed execution, and data pipelines

• Prior customer-facing or consulting experience where you scoped and delivered research engagements

• The ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences and translate them into business impact, and to go a level deeper when someone pushes on your answer instead of staying abstract

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

• Publications or open-source contributions in LLM evaluation, agents or efficient inference

• Experience building internal dashboards or web UIs that a client team can adopt as their own

• Hands-on use of an LLM gateway or tracing stack, such as LangFuse or LangSmith, to attribute cost and latency at the request level

• Experience in a regulated or high-stakes enterprise domain where evaluation rigor carries real consequences

• A point of view on cost-quality tradeoffs gained from running them in production rather than reading about them

jobs.title: Senior Manager Revenue Accouting
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You’ll own the technical accounting behind how Mews recognises revenue across SaaS, fintech and financial services, and set the standard the wider finance team works to. This role exists because our revenue streams are getting more varied, and every new product, pricing model or payment flow needs a clear, controlled accounting answer before it goes live. You’ll make those calls across all Mews entities and geographies, with the autonomy to shape how it’s done.

Part 1: You’ll lead revenue accounting close, reconciliations and technical conclusions, and manage two revenue accounting team members. You’ll work day to day with Product, Payments, Engineering, Billing and Finance Systems.

Part 2: Each revenue stream brings its own recognition questions under US GAAP and IFRS. The problem this role solves is keeping those answers consistent, documented and audit-ready as the business grows, and keeping the close accurate while it does.

What you would do

• Own the application of ASC 606 and IFRS 15 across the organisation, including principal-versus-agent, multiple-element arrangements and variable consideration, and set the revenue recognition policies that follow from it.

• Lead month-end and quarter-end revenue close, including reconciliations of revenue, receivables, deferred revenue and contract balances, and review adjustments within delegated authority.

• Evaluate new products, pricing changes and commercial arrangements before launch, so the accounting is designed in from the start rather than fixed afterwards.

• Build and strengthen revenue controls and SOX readiness, from source and billing systems through to the general ledger, and lead audit requests and remediation.

• Lead, coach and develop two revenue accounting team members, and drive close automation with BlackLine and controlled, AI-enabled validation of revenue data with proper review and audit trails.

AI Fluency Level 4: This is an AI Fluency Level 4 role, which means you’d build AI-powered systems rather than only using AI in your own work. In practice, that could mean designing an AI-enabled validation layer that checks revenue data against contracts and billing records, with the review steps and audit trail a controlled close needs. For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates” on Confluence.

What you would bring

• 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including substantial revenue accounting and at least 2 years of people management.

• Advanced knowledge of ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including principal-versus-agent assessments, multiple-element arrangements and variable consideration.

• Experience with SaaS, fintech, financial services, payment or transaction-based revenue models, ideally across multiple entities or markets.

• Hands-on experience with revenue close, reconciliations, technical memoranda and audit-ready support, plus a strong grasp of internal controls, SOX readiness and remediation.

• AI Fluency Level 4: you have built AI-powered tools or systems that others use, not just used AI in your own workflow.

Nice to have

• CPA, ACCA, ACA or an equivalent accountancy qualification.

• Familiarity with BlackLine or similar reconciliation systems, and Jira or comparable issue-tracking tools.

To be eligible for this position, you must be based in one of the following US states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Massachusetts, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

• Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)

• Participation in our company share program

• Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

• High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

• We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.

jobs.description:
MIDA SA TEED

Osakonnajuhatajana oled juht, kes toetab ja julgustab kogu oma meeskonda. Edendades kaasavat kultuuri, mis edendab koostööd ja ettevõtlikkust, lood keskkonna, kus kõik saavad areneda. Tegutsedes kooskõlas meie väärtustega, aitad kaasa nii enda kui ka ettevõtte edule.

Sinu ülesanded:

• Juhid oma meeskonda silmapaistva kliendikogemuse pakkumiseks, tagades suurepärased tegevus- ja visuaalsed standardid, reklaamides ja müües samal ajal aktiivselt meie tooteid.
• Võtad vastutuse oma poe ja osakonna tugevate külgede eest, analüüsid müügitulemusi, tuvastad kaubandusvõimalusi, sead eesmärke ja koostad plaane tulemuste, kasumi ja laoseisu optimeerimiseks.
• Haldad meeskonna planeerimist, ajakava koostamist ning tagad sujuvad avamis- ja sulgemisrutiinid.
• Värbad, kaasake ja arendad oma meeskonda, edendades samal ajal kaasavat ja koostööl põhinevat kultuuri, mis edendab kasvu ja innovatsiooni.
• Konkurentsieelise säilitamiseks oled kursis moesuundade, klientide eelistuste ja konkurentidega.
• Esindad ennast ja brändi positiivselt kogu kliendisuhtluse ajal.

KELLEGA SA KOOSTÖÖD TEED

Meie kauplused on meie ettevõtte süda, kus kliendid kogevad meie kaubamärki omal nahal. Dünaamilise kaupluse meeskonna osana aitavad kõik rollid – alates müüginõustajatest, osakonnajuhatajatest, poe juhatajatest ja dekoraatoritest kuni kassahalduriteni – inspireeriva ja külalislahke keskkonna loomisele. Samuti saad luua ühenduse laiema piirkonna meeskonnaga, tehes kauplustes koostööd, et jagada teadmisi ja saavutada koos edu. Koos oma meeskonnaga mängid olulist rolli, et aidata klientidel end enesekindlalt tunda ja väljendada oma individuaalsust uusimate trendide ja ajatute stiilidega. Luues oma kauplustes klientidega sisukaid sidemeid, muudame moe kõigile kättesaadavaks ja jätkusuutlikuks.

KES SA OLED​

Otsime inimesi, kellel on…​

• Jaemüügi juhtimise ja tegevuse kogemus.
• Teadmised müügi planeerimisest, analüüsist ja järeltegevusest, kasutades kliendikeskseid tööriistu ja aruandlust.

Ja inimesi, kes on…​

• Tugevad ja enesekindlad juhid, kes inspireerivad, juhendavad ja arendavad oma meeskondi, näidates samal ajal ettevõtte väärtusi ja kultuuri.
• Edukad koostööl põhinevas dünaamilises keskkonnas ja lahendustele keskendunud mõtteviisiga.
• Motiveeritud looma suurepäraseid kliendikogemusi, reklaamides ja müües samal ajal oma tooteid.
• Tugeva huviga moesuundade, kommertslikkuse ja konkurentide teadmiste vastu, et suurendada müüki.
• Tõhusad suhtlejad, loomingulised ja uudishimulikud.
• Paindlikud, analüütilised ja saavutustele orienteeritud, võimelised haldama statistikat ja töötama numbritega.

KES ME OLEME

H&M Group on ülemaailmne ettevõte, mis koosneb tugevatest moebrändidest ja ettevõtmistest. Meie eesmärk on tõestada, et erakordse disaini, taskukohaste hindade ja jätkusuutlike lahenduste vahel pole kompromisse. Tahame vabastada moe paljude jaoks ja meie kliendid on iga meie otsuse keskmes.​

Meid ühendavad tuhanded kirglikud ja andekad kolleegid, keda omakorda ühendab meie ühine kultuur ja väärtused. Üheskoos tahame kasutada oma jõudu, ulatust ja teadmisi, et viia moetööstust kaasavama ja jätkusuutlikuma tuleviku poole. ​

MIKS SULLE MEELDIB SIIN TÖÖTADA ​

H&M Groupis oleme uhked, et oleme elujõuline ja külalislahke ettevõte. Pakume oma töötajatele atraktiivseid hüvesid koos ulatuslike arenguvõimalustega kogu maailmas. ​

• 25% töötajate soodustus kõigilt meie H&M Groupi kaubamärkidelt nii kauplustes kui ka veebis (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ja ARKET).​
• Mitmed lisasooduskupongid terve aasta vältel
• Paindlik töögraafik
• Tasustatud soovitusprogramm

LIITU MEIEGA

Meie ainulaadsus tuleneb paljude asjade kombinatsioonist – meie kaasavast ja koostöökultuurist, tugevatest väärtustest ja kasvuvõimalustest. Kuid ennekõike on meie inimesed need, kes teevad meist need, kes me oleme.​

Kandideeri, saates oma CV esimesel võimalusel, kuid mitte hiljem kui 22.10.2026. Andmepoliitika tõttu võtame taotlusi vastu ainult karjäärilehe kaudu.

Brutotöötasu 1560Eur / kuus

Astu koos meiega oma karjääris järgmine samm. Teekond algab siit.​

jobs.title: Web Experimentation Manager
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

Growing Rippling across products and markets means building a website that turns demand into qualified pipeline. That’s where you come in.

This is a chance to play a central role in Rippling’s growth, alongside some of the best people in marketing, design, and analytics. There’s a lot of opportunity ahead, and you’ll have the room to think big, bring your ideas to life, and help shape how we grow.

As a Web Experimentation Manager, you’ll help shape our website & conversion rate optimization (CRO) strategy and own the experimentation projects that bring it to life. You’ll identify our biggest growth opportunities, develop ideas, and drive experiments from analysis through launch and rollout. Your primary focus will be the US, while supporting website growth across international markets.

You’ll strengthen the foundations of our CRO program and raise the bar across analytics, experimentation, and execution. That means owning complex projects independently, building systems the team can scale, and helping other CRO team members deliver better work.

Your impact will extend beyond individual tests. You’ll go deep on lead quality, downstream conversion, and pipeline, then apply what we learn to improve the website and guide decisions across marketing.

You’ll partner closely with Design, Web, Paid, and Analytics to bring this work to life. We’re looking for someone who can spot an opportunity, work through the hard problems, and turn it into measurable business growth.

Note: Preference for candidates based in San Francisco or open to relocation to San Francisco for a hybrid in-office model.

What you will do

• Own experiments from start to finish: Identify and prioritize opportunities, develop hypotheses, run A/B tests, analyze results, and roll out wins across landing pages and web flows.
• Go deep in the data: Use GA4, Salesforce, spreadsheets, and AI analytics to investigate funnel performance, validate findings, and recommend what to do next.
• Improve pages and journeys: Partner with Design and Web to improve layouts, forms, and mobile experiences. Write and test clear copy that speaks to our audience.
• Own quality and performance: QA your experiments, validate tracking, and monitor results after launch. Make sure tests work as intended and end with a clear decision.
• Drive projects forward: Align stakeholders, manage dependencies, and keep commitments. Flag risks early and find a path forward when something is blocked.
• Find solutions beyond the page: Follow the problem wherever it leads, from traffic and messaging to forms and lead routing. Work with the right teams to get it solved.
• Build systems that scale: Improve how we prioritize, build, QA, and report on experiments. Create reusable tools and document learnings so the team can move faster.
• Support the team: Share ideas, give feedback, and support other CRO team members on experiments and analysis.
• Turn experiments into pipeline growth: Go deep on lead quality, downstream conversion, and pipeline impact. Use what we learn to improve the website and guide decisions across marketing.
• Support international growth: Drive website growth primarily in the US, while identifying and supporting CRO opportunities across international markets.
• Raise the CRO bar: Strengthen how we analyze opportunities, design experiments, and execute. Build systems that help the team move faster, deliver better work, and scale what works.

What you will need

• CRO experience: Hands-on experience owning website experiments and optimization projects, with clear examples of results and learnings. You understand test design, measurement, and how to interpret results.
• Analytical depth: You can go deep in GA4, Salesforce, spreadsheets, and AI analytics tools to build reports, run complex queries, and check that the data is right.
• Ownership and initiative: You can take a project from start to finish, make recommendations, and solve problems independently. You know when to bring in others.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management: You write clearly, explain the business impact of your work, and work across teams to get decisions made and projects delivered.
• High execution bar: You move quickly, catch issues before launch, and stay accountable for quality, timelines, and results.
• Design taste and UX judgment: You know what makes a page clear, persuasive, and easy to use, and can give useful direction and feedback to designers.
• Creativity and resourcefulness: You generate ideas based on data and user behavior, and find practical ways to test them.
• Strong copywriting: You can write clear, punchy headlines and page copy, and explain why the message will resonate with the audience.

Bonus points

• SQL proficiency.
• STEM education.
• Experience in B2B SaaS.
• Hands-on experience with a CMS such as Contentful and an experimentation platform such as Optimizely, Statsig, or VWO.
• Exposure to Core Web Vitals and website performance.
• Experience with UX research, session replay, or design tools such as Figma.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

jobs.title: Security Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.

Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.  is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at more than 95 authorized treatment centers. The Iovance TIL platform spans registrational trials and next-generation programs in additional solid tumors, including gene-edited and IL-12 tethered TIL therapies, next-generation IL-2, and precision immuno-oncology approaches. As the first and only company to take TIL therapy from concept to a broadly accessible commercial treatment, Iovance operates as an end-to-end cell therapy company, anchored by fully owned, centralized U.S.-based manufacturing that is scaled to serve thousands of cancer patients worldwide each year. For more information, please visit www.iovance.com.

Amtagvi® and its accompanying design marks, Proleukin®, Iovance®, and IovanceCares™ are trademarks and registered trademarks of Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. or its subsidiaries. All other trademarks and registered trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Information on Iovance’s broad, industry-leading patent portfolio is available on the Intellectual Property page on www.iovance.com.

Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Security Engineer with strong technical depth across endpoint, cloud, identity, and email security. This role designs, deploys, and operates Iovance’s core security platforms, including CrowdStrike Falcon EDR and Next-Gen SIEM, privileged access management, Mimecast, AWS security services, and GitHub security. The right candidate builds policy, writes detections and automation, troubleshoots across the stack, and documents their work to the standard expected in a validated, audit-ready environment.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

Endpoint Detection, SIEM & Response (CrowdStrike)

• Administer and tune CrowdStrike Falcon prevention policies, host groups, device control, and sensor updates across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with careful exclusion management for GxP and manufacturing systems.

• Onboard and normalize log sources (Okta, AWS, Mimecast, GitHub, PAM, servers) into Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, and build detections, dashboards, and Falcon Fusion SOAR workflows.

• Investigate alerts, conduct threat hunting, and drive containment and remediation.

Privileged Access Management

• Operate the enterprise PAM platform, including vaulting, credential rotation, session recording, and just-in-time access for servers, cloud accounts, databases, and service accounts.

• Integrate PAM with Okta and Active Directory, and support privileged access reviews and segregation-of-duties controls.

Email Security (Mimecast)

• Administer Mimecast targeted threat protection, DLP, archiving, and continuity policies, and maintain SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

• Investigate phishing, impersonation, and business email compromise attempts.

Cloud & DevSecOps Security (AWS, Microsoft 365 & GitHub)

• Secure AWS workloads including EC2, ECS, ELB/ALB, S3, and VPC networking, using AWS WAF, IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and CloudTrail.

• Identify and remediate misconfigurations, enforce least privilege, and review infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation).

• Harden and monitor Microsoft 365, including Entra ID Conditional Access, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams sharing controls, Microsoft Purview DLP and sensitivity labels, and Microsoft Secure Score recommendations.

• Administer GitHub Advanced Security (code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot), branch protection, and organization policies, and secure GitHub Actions pipelines using OIDC federation to AWS.

Governance, Compliance & Operations

• Author technical documentation, standards, and runbooks suitable for GxP, SOX, and HIPAA audits, and provide audit evidence.

• Participate in change control, vulnerability and patch management, incident response, and on-call rotation.

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments and structured notes for independent advisors, asset managers, and bank issuers, empowering them to engage and transact on a massive scale. We believe that the combination of industry-leading technology and human interaction throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience delivers superior operational efficiency and a world-class client experience. CAIS provides advisors with a broad selection of alternative investment strategies, including private equity, private credit, real estate, infrastructure, hedge funds, and structured notes. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets.

Role Overview

We are looking to hire a Technical Product Manager to lead product for Salesforce at CAIS and to work directly in the system alongside our Salesforce team. Salesforce is where our Sales, operations, and client service teams manage firms, advisors, trades, and cases, so this role directly shapes how our teams work each day. The role also provides product support for our Data team, in an advisory capacity.

You will build a single, prioritized roadmap with Sales leaders for Funds and Capital Markets and with our operations and client service teams, so that work is planned and understood cross functionally. You will configure Salesforce yourself, write clear requirements for the engineers and administrators who build with you, and work to improve Sales adoption and data quality across the system.

AI is central to how we work and what we build. We expect this person to use AI tools every day to drive product outcomes, from research and requirements to prioritization and measuring results, and to define how Salesforce evolves with AI at CAIS.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Salesforce roadmap as the team’s product lead. Partner with Sales and our operations and client service teams to build one cohesive plan, and keep it current as priorities change.

• Run intake and prioritization. Replace request-by-request work with a clear process for how requests are received, ranked, and scheduled, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.

• Configure Salesforce directly: build and maintain flows, custom objects, fields, and permissions, and write clear requirements for work your teammates build.

• Drive Sales adoption. Understand how Sales teams actually use Salesforce, remove friction, support training, and measure usage.

• Own data quality: duplicate prevention, firm, team, and contact structure, and third-party enrichment, with one trusted source for each key data point shared between the CAIS platform and Salesforce.

• Own the integrations between the CAIS platform and Salesforce, such as trade and client data syncs, so Sales and Finance see accurate and timely information.

• Define how Salesforce evolves with AI, including AI assistants that work inside the CRM, automated record updates and activity logging, and evidence-based recommendations on what to build.

• Use AI tools in your daily work to move faster and make better decisions, including discovery, drafting requirements, analyzing data, and keeping stakeholders informed, and help your team do the same.

• Provide advisory oversight of the Data team's roadmap and work tracking board, partnering with the Data team's leader on planning.

• Represent Salesforce priorities in cross-functional planning, translating technical trade-offs into business-impact language for non-technical stakeholders.

Skills & Experience Required

• Demonstrated product management experience, including ownership of a CRM or another internal business system, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment.

• Hands-on Salesforce experience: you have configured flows, custom objects, fields, and permission sets yourself, at Salesforce Administrator level or higher.

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools to drive product outcomes, with concrete examples of how it changed what you shipped or how fast you shipped it.

• Experience improving CRM data quality and user adoption, including duplicate management and clear rules for who owns which data.

• Experience leading day-to-day product delivery with engineers and administrators, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination.

• Strong stakeholder management skills: able to balance competing requests from Sales, operations, and executives, say no with a clear rationale, and explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

Highly Advantageous Skills

• Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Platform App Builder.

• Experience with Salesforce integrations, including APIs and event-based data syncs with other systems.

• Experience connecting AI assistants to CRM data, including controlled write-back to Salesforce records.

• Working knowledge of SQL and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.

• Experience in wealth management, asset management, or financial services sales.

CAIS is consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work, and our culture is at the heart of our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where employees can be their most authentic selves and feel inspired and supported to bring their voice forward to drive community, growth, and innovation. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at our careers page.

CAIS’ compensation package includes a market competitive salary, a performance bonus, and exceptional benefits. If you are located in New York, New York, the base salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific office location.

CAIS offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental and vision insurance, an employer matched retirement plan, wellness programs, and generous PTO and parental leave. Additionally, CAIS offers a flexible, hybrid in-office model; for most roles, we do require a minimum of 3 days in our New York City office per week.

jobs.title: Аналітик (регулярна та регуляторна звітність)
jobs.description:
У команду Київстар шукаємо аналітика/-иню, який/-а відповідатиме за підготовку регулярної звітності, аналітичних матеріалів для керівництва та взаємодію з українськими й європейськими телеком-регуляторами. Нам потрібна людина, яка любить цифри, вміє бачити за ними закономірності та перетворювати дані на зрозумілі висновки 😉
Що треба робити?
Готувати та оновлювати регулярні звіти й дашборди для внутрішніх замовників
Створювати презентації для керівництва, візуалізувати дані та формулювати ключові висновки
Формувати та подавати звітність для українського регулятора НКЕК і європейських регуляторних органів
Опрацьовувати ad hoc запити від бізнесу: збирати дані, проводити аналіз і презентувати результати
Перевіряти повноту та коректність статистичних даних, знаходити розбіжності й координувати їх виправлення з власниками даних
Взаємодіяти з командами IT, фінансів, комерційним та юридичним підрозділами, підтримувати документацію щодо методології розрахунків і джерел даних
Ви — наш метч, якщо...
Маєте вищу освіту за напрямами економіки, статистики, математики, інформатики або суміжними спеціальностями
Маєте досвід аналітичної роботи від 2 років, бажано у телекомунікаціях, фінансах або регульованих галузях
Впевнено володієте Excel (зведені таблиці, формули, Power Query) та SQL (Oracle)
Працювали з BI-інструментами: Power BI, Tableau або аналогічними
Вмієте створювати структуровані та зрозумілі презентації у PowerPoint
Уважні до деталей, відповідальні в роботі з даними та дотримуєтеся дедлайнів
Володієте українською мовою на високому рівні та англійською від B1
Буде круто, якщо...
Маєте досвід підготовки регуляторної звітності
Знаєте основні телеком-індикатори: ARPU, churn, трафік, покриття тощо
Володієте Python на базовому рівні та можете використовувати його для автоматизації й перевірки даних
Чому Київстар?
Гнучкий графік роботи, гібридний формат
Бонуси за досягнення цілей (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)
340+ внутрішніх курсів, власна бібліотека, навчальні програми від партнерів
Страхування життя і здоров’я
Програми підтримки працівників та їхніх родин: психологічні, юридичні та ін
Безбар’єрний простір для роботи та розвитку
Проєкти на підтримку захисників, ветеранів та їхніх родин
Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок
Шукаєте команду, де ваш внесок та експертизу цінують? Це — про Київстар, долучайтеся 😉

jobs.title: Information Security Manager
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

InfoSec Manager

Security

Ebury Leon Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury is looking for an experienced, hands-on InfoSec & Compliance Specialist to join our global Information Security function, reporting directly to the CISO. This role has two sides: keeping our ISMS and compliance obligations robust and auditready, and acting as the face of Information Security to the business, supporting sales, customers, and new business initiatives.

You will maintain our security frameworks and own day-to-day governance, audits, and third-party risk. You will also act as the InfoSec subject-matter expert for commercial teams, responding to customer due diligence questionnaires and RFPs, supporting security conversations with prospects and clients, and advising on international expansions and new product launches. Your goal is to make security a business enabler: helping Ebury win and retain customers, enter new markets, and launch products with confidence.

What you’ll do

Business Enablement & Customer Assurance:

• InfoSec SME for new business: Act as the security point of contact for Sales, Account Management, and Product, supporting prospects and customers through security reviews, calls, and onboarding.

• DDQs and RFPs: Own the end-to-end response to security due diligence questionnaires, RFP/RFI security sections, and assurance requests from both existing and new customers, ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely answers.

• Customer assurance library: Build and maintain a central library of approved responses, certifications, and evidence (e.g., ISO 27001 certificate, SOC reports, PCI DSS attestation, pen test summaries), and automate response workflows where possible.

• Customer-facing support: Join customer and prospect calls as the security expert, explaining Ebury's controls and posture clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, and escalating contractual or risk concerns to the CISO.

• Expansion and launches: Advise on the security and regulatory implications of international expansion, new products, and strategic partnerships, providing early guidance so security supports rather than slows delivery.

• Commercial insight: Track recurring customer questions and requirements, and feed trends back to the CISO and product teams to inform the security

Governance & Compliance (BAU):

• ISMS and policy management: Lead the annual review and update of security policies, standards, and controls, ensuring alignment with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, DORA, and local regulations.

• Internal audits: Plan and run the internal audit programme for the ISMS and key controls, report findings, and track remediation to closure.

• External audits and certifications: Act as the point of contact for external auditors and assessors; coordinate evidence gathering, manage audit logistics, and track remediation of findings.

• Regulator engagement: Support responses to regulatory enquiries and assessments in fintech and financial services.

• Third-party risk management (TPRM): Evaluate vendor risk through due diligence questionnaires and security reviews for new and existing suppliers.

• Security exceptions: Manage the exception lifecycle: review requests, assess and quantify risk and impact, ensure formal sign-off, and drive periodic re-evaluation.

• Advisory: Address internal security queries on compliance standards and best practices, and stay ahead of evolving regulation to proactively adapt Ebury's frameworks.

Strategic Project Support:

• Regulatory mapping: Map internal controls against new or upcoming regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, or new regional cybersecurity laws) and identify gaps.

• Process maturation: Move manual BAU tasks (DDQ and RFP tracking, evidence collection, policy distribution) into automated GRC platforms (e.g., OneTrust, Vanta, or Drata).

• Risk and metrics: Help embed risk management processes, control frameworks, and security metrics that give leadership a clear view of posture.

• Security culture: Design and drive awareness programmes that generate genuine behavioural change.

What you’ll need

• 5+ years of experience in information security, GRC, or risk management roles, ideally in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment.

• Proven experience responding to customer security questionnaires, DDQs, and RFPs, and supporting sales or pre-sales teams with security assurance.

• Strong knowledge of information security standards and regulations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, FCA/DORA, NIST, etc.).

• Experience running or supporting internal and external audits, including regulatory audits and working with financial regulators.

• Analytical skills: the ability to assess a security exception not just as a "no", but as a risk to be quantified. • Hands-on experience implementing risk management processes, control frameworks, and security metrics.

• Familiarity with GRC or risk platforms (e.g., OneTrust, Vanta, Drata). • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence presenting to customers, executives, and technical teams alike.

• A commercial mindset: comfortable balancing risk, deal timelines, and customer expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Industry certifications such as CISSP, CRISC, CISA, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

• Experience in a customer-facing or trust and assurance function.

• Experience with trust centre or questionnaire automation tools.

• Experience supporting multi-jurisdiction expansion and regional regulatory requirements.

• Spanish and/or other European languages, in addition to fluent English.

Why Ebury?

• Competitive Starting Salary with an annual discretionary bonus that truly rewards your performance from day one.

• Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

• Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.

• Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

• Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.

• Central Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury!

You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Fabienne Zigrit

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

jobs.title: Assistant Property Manager
jobs.description:
We have a fantastic Assistant Property Manager opportunity available!

Weinstein Properties, headquartered in Richmond, Virginia owns and manages over 60 apartment communities in Virginia, North Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, and Georgia. Still owned and operated by the Weinstein family after 70+ years, our continued success is attributed to our hands on approach to daily operations and our focus on the customer experience.

Location: Bexley Steelecroft

Pay: Hourly rates are competitive (starting at $21/hour) and increasing based on experience + Quarterly Bonuses

Benefits: Rent discount, paid holidays, birthday time off, vacation and sick time, health, dental and vision insurance, Employee Assistance Program, 401k with company match

Schedule: Must be available to work rotating Saturdays and occasional evenings for resident events

This position’s responsibilities include front line resident services, team interaction, fast-paced learning, and communicating in persuasive and difficult situations. Leadership/management experience required. Attention to detail is necessary. Previous property management experience is a plus, but not needed if you have solid management experience from customer service, sales or hospitality environments. We offer training and coaching on how to master the necessary skill sets, and direction for professional development.

Who You Are:

• Strong Communication Skills: You're a great listener, and you can confidently and warmly connect with others, both in person and in writing.

• Customer-First Mindset: You love helping people and solving problems, even when things get tough.

• Positive Energy: You show up with enthusiasm and a can-do attitude — every day, no matter what ends up being thrown your way.

• Team Spirit: You pitch in wherever needed and care about team success over individual credit. You are game to help, even if something does not fall under your job description.

• Motivation & Drive: You’re goal-oriented, organized, and eager to grow.

• Adaptability: You can manage interruptions, shifting priorities, and fast-paced days with ease and grace.

• Initiative: You’re not afraid to jump in — whether it’s greeting someone at the door or taking ownership of a task.

What You Should Know Before You Start:

• We have high expectations — and a hands-on training program that will set you up to meet them.

• This is not a desk job — expect to be on your feet, engaging with prospects, walking the property, inspecting homes, and so much more.

• You’ll be part of a high-performing, highly collaborative team — recognition and promotion come from commitment and results.

• You’ll sometimes work outside standard hours to support resident events or assist during weather challenges.

Why Weinstein?

• Industry-Leading Training: We’ll equip you with all the tools and knowledge you need to grow — no experience necessary.

• Career Growth: Many of our leaders started in leasing. Whether you stay on-site or grow into corporate roles, the opportunities are here – we want this to be a career, not just a job.

• Supportive Culture: We’re like family. We believe in investing in you, recognizing your contributions, and growing together.

What are some tasks and responsibilities that come along with this position?

• Work with prospects who are interested in knowing more about our communities. Answer internet leads, phone calls, schedule appointments and take prospects on a tour of the community.

• Process leasing applications, put together lease paperwork, request security deposits and leaseholders to sign the lease.

• Give great customer service to our residents, assist them with any needs they have such as going over their renewal, notice to vacate, early termination, adding a pet, wanting to transfer to another apartment home, answering questions about their account.

• Work along side maintenance, walk apartments when they are ready to confirm everything looks great, monitor property needs, follow up with residents about work orders or any maintenance needs they have.

• Create a great experience for residents upon move in.

• Work with residents when they move out, process move outs and security deposit dispositions.

• Post rent money, follow up on balances owed.

• Resident activities - planning, preparing and hosting.

• Lead the team, help with training and accomplishing goals.

• Assist the Property Manager as needed

Ready to join a team that believes in your potential?
Apply today and start building your future with WP.

Weinstein Properties is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Campaign Specialist – Commercial
jobs.description:
This role is based in our New York City or Santa Monica office.

The Campaign Specialist – Commercial Marketing is a key role within the commercial marketing team. This position focuses on supporting the execution of detailed campaign briefs and tactical plans that align with the overarching marketing strategy. The Campaign Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns leverage the optimal channel mix and deliver measurable business outcomes, such as lead generation, pipeline acceleration, and client retention. Working closely with the Commercial Marketing Hub team members, Centers of Excellence and sales teams, the Campaign Specialist ensures campaign plans are well-executed, data-driven, and aligned with the commercial value proposition and sales priorities. As a key player in the agile marketing Commercial Hub, the Campaign Specialist supports agile marketing ceremonies and ensures the smooth delivery of campaign activities. By embedding insights from marketing analytics and performance reporting, the Campaign Specialist helps optimize campaigns and maximize return on investment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaign Briefing and Planning

• Collaborate with the Commercial Hub team members and Centers of Excellence to translate marketing strategies into actionable campaign briefs, outlining objectives, target audiences, messaging frameworks, and channel recommendations.
• Support the development of tactical campaign plans that align with business objectives, product launches, and revenue targets.
• Ensure campaign frameworks align with the commercial value proposition and resonate with key client personas.
• Work closely with the Product Marketing Manager to ensure campaign plans reflect broader marketing strategies and goals.
• Contribute to the agile marketing hub by supporting sprint planning cycles and collaborating with hub engagement managers and delivery partners.

Channel Strategy and Optimization

• Identify and recommend effective channels for each campaign, ensuring alignment with audience preferences and business objectives.
• Support the implementation of channel mix strategies to maximize engagement, conversion rates, and ROI.
• Use insights from marketing analytics and performance reporting to inform channel selection and targeting strategies, ensuring campaigns are optimized for measurable outcomes.

Collaboration and Alignment

• Partner with the commercial marketing team members and Centers of Excellence to deliver and execute campaigns, ensuring cohesive campaign plans and briefings.
• Collaborate with the Product Marketing Manager and Comms Planner to ensure campaign messaging is consistent, compelling, and aligned with attendee and commercial value propositions.
• Contribute to agile workflows within the commercial marketing hub to maximize campaign impact.
• Work with sales teams to ensure campaign plans support pipeline priorities and provide the tools and insights needed to engage clients effectively.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including brand, operations, and strategic insights, to ensure campaign plans align with broader portfolio goals.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

• Support the establishment and monitoring of campaign KPIs, including lead generation, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution, in collaboration with the Marketing Analytics & Marketing Performance Center of Excellence.
• Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
• Provide insights and updates to the commercial marketing team and other stakeholders, highlighting campaign impact and recommendations for optimization during sprint reviews.

Continuous Improvement

• Stay informed about industry trends, emerging channels, and best practices to contribute to campaign planning.
• Support a test-and-learn approach to campaign planning, using data to drive continuous improvement.
• Gather feedback from sales and other stakeholders to refine campaign briefs and enhance future planning.

High-Impact Sales Collateral Creation

• Collateral Development: Manage the development of compelling sales decks, case studies, and one-pagers that accelerate the sales cycle.
• Library Management: Maintain, audit, and structure our central sales collateral library to ensure all sales materials are up to date and easily accessible.
• Project Management: Provide specific, actionable feedback to the production agency while balancing competing timelines and deliverables.

• Foundational experience in campaign management or a similar role, with knowledge of briefing and planning integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
• Ability to translate marketing strategies into actionable campaign plans that deliver measurable results.
• Data-driven mindset with a focus on embedding insights from marketing analytics and performance reporting into campaign execution and optimization.
• Strong collaboration skills, with experience working closely with sales, product marketing, and other cross-functional teams.
• Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaign tasks simultaneously.
• Analytical skills, with experience in tracking and reporting on campaign performance metrics to inform decision-making.
• Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
• Familiarity with agile marketing principles and ways of working.
• Proven Sales Collateral Experience: Must have prior experience creating B2B pitch decks, case studies, or sales materials.
• Agency & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated experience navigating multi-stakeholder approval processes, managing external agencies, and keeping complex project timelines on track.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Campaign Execution: Deliver actionable campaign briefs and plans that align with business objectives and drive measurable outcomes.
• Channel Strategy Optimization: Contribute to channel mix strategies that maximize engagement, conversion rates, and ROI.
• Data-Driven Insights: Use marketing analytics and performance reporting to refine campaign execution and pivot strategies for maximum ROI.
• Strategic Alignment: Ensure campaign activities align with the overarching marketing strategy, commercial value proposition, and sales priorities.
• Collaboration Success: Build strong relationships with sales, product marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure campaign activities are aligned and impactful.
• Performance Reporting: Provide clear and actionable updates on campaign performance to inform strategy refinement and planning.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

We work hard to make sure Life at Informa is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. Here’s some of what you can expect when you join us. But don’t just take our word for it – see what our colleagues have to say at LifeAt.Informa.com

Our benefits include:

• Broader impact: take up to four days per year to volunteer, with charity match funding available too

• Time out: 15 days PTO rising to 20 after three years and 25 after six years, plus 10 national holidays, a birthday leave day and the chance to work from (almost!) anywhere for up to four weeks a year
• Competitive benefits, including a 401k match, health, vision and dental insurance, parental leave and an ESPP offering company shares at a minimum 15% discount
• Strong wellbeing support through EAP assistance, mental health first aiders, free access to a wellness app and more

• As an international company, the chance to collaborate with teams around the world

The salary range for this role is $60,000- $70,000 based on experience.

This posting will automatically expire on December 11th, 2026.

We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills. We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll their sleeves up, join in and help make things happen.
