jobs.title: Country Director - Burkina Faso
jobs.description:
Who is PawaPay

PawaPay is a pan-African fintech enabling local payment channels used by the mass market to both local and international merchants. We operate in a highly regulated, partner-driven environment and are in scale-up mode, with ambitious growth plans across multiple African markets.

Our vision is to simplify business for companies and consumers in Africa and we do that by ensuring that payments simply work, at scale, despite fragmentation and complexity that exists on the Continent.

Through our payments API we already facilitate over 4 million transactions a day across 20 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa.  We are the largest PSP on the Continent for the processing of mobile money payments, and have positioned ourselves well to lead the payment space as it grows over the next decade.

At PawaPay, there is an entrepreneurial spirit coupled with a modern and professional working culture. The fast-paced, ever-changing environment will suit someone who can adapt and think on their feet. In return, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a group of dedicated and smart individuals working towards the same mission. We work as a remote team and have team members in Europe, Africa and Asia.

The Role

As the Country Director for Burkina Faso at PawaPay, you will lead the company’s operations and partner relationships in Burkina Faso. This role combines relationship management, business development execution, and operational oversight with core governance duties. You will support the execution of Group strategy locally, helping identify growth opportunities while ensuring that PawaPay delivers exceptional service levels and strong partner performance in the market.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Sales, Operations, Compliance, Finance, and Legal, ensuring effective coordination and a seamless experience for our partners.

This position requires a proactive, strategic, and highly organised leader with excellent stakeholder management capability and a deep understanding of the mobile money and fintech ecosystem in Burkina Faso and the wider West African region.

What You’ll Own

• Relationship Management. Serve as the primary relationship holder for all in-country partners (MMOs, banks, financial institutions). Lead ongoing engagement, service reviews, and dispute resolution, and maintain a strong local presence and responsiveness.

• Business Development & Commercial Engagement. Lead initial commercial conversations with local partners, drive end-to-end onboarding and integration, identify product expansion opportunities, and generate local merchant leads.

• Operational Leadership. Own local issue resolution, manage local administrative and KYC requirements, oversee office operations, monitor operational KPIs, and maintain high service uptime with partner technical teams.

• Cross-Functional In-Country Support. Provide targeted local support to Group functions including Legal, Compliance/GRC, Finance/Tax, and People Operations.

• Governance & Representation. Act as Company Director and bank signatory for the local entity, ensure statutory compliance, submit monthly and board reports, and represent the PawaPay brand locally.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months, success in this role means:

• Strong In-Country Partner Relationships. High-trust partnerships established with key local MMOs, banks, and regulators, backed by structured recurring service reviews.

• Seamless Operations & Governance. Full statutory and legal compliance across Burkina Faso, robust local banking controls, and high operational uptime across payment channels.

• Commercial Growth. Target partners successfully onboarded and live, alongside a steady pipeline of qualified local merchant leads for Group sales.

What We’re Looking For

What you’ll bring

• Relevant experience. 5+ years in stakeholder management, business development, regulatory liaison, or operational leadership within fintech, mobile money, telecoms, or financial services.

• Senior stakeholder management. Proven track record managing external relationships with regulators, mobile network operators, and banks.

• Language proficiency. Fluency in French and English. French is essential for day-to-day engagement with regulators and partners.

• Industry expertise. Deep understanding of the African payments and mobile money ecosystem, including the WAEMU/BCEAO regulatory framework.

• Education & mindset. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; high integrity and a proactive ownership mindset.

Nice to have

• Master’s degree or MBA.

• Prior experience in cross-border regional expansion across WAEMU or other francophone West African markets.

Why PawaPay?

• Help improve financial access in Africa

• Being part of an amazing team that shapes company’s culture as a great place to be

• An ambitious, talented, and diverse team who always has your back

• We grow fast, and you will grow fast with us

• Competitive remuneration

• 35 days of paid leave per year (inclusive of public holidays) and more.

jobs.title: Intermediate Supervisor, Northern District of California
jobs.description:
Summary

The Intermediate Supervisor manages all government-facing coordination and contract execution, including supervision of security personnel, staffing oversight, and performance compliance. The role holds full authority for personnel decisions, maintains daily communication with the COR, ensures accountability of government property, and provides on-call support for emergencies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for the Government to discuss technical and security-related requirements through regular site visits to primary and sub-offices. It is the fiscal responsibility of the Contractor to provide adequate site visits necessary to successfully manage contract requirements.

• Have the ability and authority to make decisions on behalf of the company, particularly on personnel-related issues.

• Have the authority to supervise all CSOs and LCSOs working under this contract.

• Be available to the Government on a 24-hour basis, to ensure Contractor response in the event of an emergency or other exigent circumstance.

• Maintain daily contact with the COR to ensure adherence to the needs of the client/contract, with regards to manpower and hour usage.

• Receive and execute daily technical direction from the COR.

• Maintain and monitor all post-performance required by this contract and correct any and all issues or problems brought to his/her attention.

• Keep the COR informed about post coverage, potential problems, and the actions are taken to correct any and all issues or problem(s) brought to his/her attention.

• Act on and report all Performance Service Violations (PSV) without hesitation or necessary delay.

• Assure all Government-issued equipment and property is tracked and accounted for, and otherwise safeguarded until the time it is returned to the Government, in accordance with an approved property control system.

• Have the ability to carry out all administrative tasks efficiently, e.g., timely, complete, and correct (without reliance and further assistance of the CSOs).

• Are prohibited from performing duties as that of a CSO or LCSO and shall not be subject to the uniform, medical or physical requirements stated in this contract.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• The Intermediate Supervisor shall oversee and manage the security operations performed by Court Security Officers and Lead Court Security Officers.

Competency

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies (minimum of 5):

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Change’s approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events; adapt to new product introduction, emergent business needs, and business evolution.

• Judgement – Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgement; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.

• Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services; Continually works to improve supervisory skills.

• Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

• Oral Communication - speaks very clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in various meetings.

• Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

• Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.

• Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

• Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service ; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

• Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

• Diversity- Demonstrates knowledge of EEO policy; Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; Educates others on the value of diversity, Promotes a harassment- free environment; builds a diverse workforce.

• Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.

• Organizational Support – Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; supports organization’s goals and values; Benefits organization through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

• Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.

• Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and materials properly.

• Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.

• Dependability - follows instructions, responds to management direction; takes responsibility for own actions; keeps commitments; commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan. Goal and detail oriented.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• High school diploma or general education degree (GED).

• At least three calendar years of verifiable experience as a certified law enforcement officer; the experience must have included general arrest authority.

• Must possess five years of supervisory and/or management experience with projects similar in size and scope of this contract.

Language Skills

• Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos using the English language.

• Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees or organization.

• Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating policies and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals.

Mathematical Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

Reasoning Ability

• Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.

• Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Computer Skills

• To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Internet programs, Word Processing software and other software as required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

• Current/valid state driver's license

Other Qualifications

• Must be at least 21 years of age; Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check; Must have a valid driver's license from state of residency and a safe driving record for the past five years; Must receive clearance from the Department of Justice. Must have completed or graduated from certified Federal, state, county, local or military law enforcement training academy and able to provide certification as proof.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, ability to adjust focus and ability to see and distinguish basic colors.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics describes here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Other Tasks

This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions, it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

jobs.title: Business Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Why Join Exadel

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.
What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

About the Role

The Business Development Specialist is a senior “hunter” role focused on driving net new revenue within the western region of the United States, specifically the pacific northwest, across industry sectors. This individual will be responsible for originating new enterprise clients and expanding into new buying centers within existing strategic accounts. The focus is on building and converting a pipeline for Data, AI, Cloud, Engineering, and Consulting services. This is a front-end, high-impact role for a proactive, commercially savvy professional that can navigate complex sales cycles with senior stakeholders across business, technology, data, and digital transformation functions.

Work Type: Remote
Location: preferably New York City or the tri-state area

What You’ll Do

New Client Acquisition:

• Identify and pursue new enterprise clients across industry segments

• Use market intelligence to prioritize high-value targets aligned with Exadel’s offerings in data, modernization, AI, digital platforms, and managed services

Strategic Prospecting & Qualification:

• Focus on “winnable” opportunities by assessing client maturity, timing, budgets, and mutual fit

• Qualify large deals with clarity on use cases (eg., trade processing, regulatory reporting, data platforms, automation, digital channels)

Opportunity Origination & Stakeholder Engagement:

• Map and engage decision-makers, including CTOs, CIOs, Heads of Business Units, CDOs, COOs, Technology Leaders, and Procurement

• Initiate discovery conversations centered around revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk management, data automation, or platform modernization

Domain-Based Value Positioning:

• Demonstrate understanding of advisory, data and engineering services and positioning of various engagement models, ranging from embedded specialists to fully managed teams

• Craft compelling value narratives tailored to capital markets buyers

Sales Process Ownership:

• Own the full business development lifecycle from lead generation through proposal, negotiation, and closure

• Maintain high discipline in CRM management for all pipeline and forecasting activities

Collaboration & Solution Alignment:

• Work closely with solution architects and delivery leads to co-create proposals and pitches aligned to client needs and budgets

• Coordinate with marketing on industry events, thought leadership, and account-based campaigns

Forecasting & Revenue Accountability:

• Build and manage a weighted pipeline with clear monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets

• Deliver accurate forecasts based on deal velocity, qualification, and probability

Market & Brand Positioning:

• Represent the company at industry forums, capital markets conferences, and networking events

• Strengthen the company's perception as a strategic partner to financial institutions

What You Bring

• Experience in a hunter-focused Business Development or Sales role within consulting and or engineering services

jobs.title: On-Call Dock Sortation Specialist
jobs.description:
On-Call Dock Sortation Specialist, $20 to $22/hr

Hourly, on-call  ·  Short early-morning shifts  ·  Saltbox DC-Alexandria  ·  Reports to: Dock Sortation Lead

Saltbox makes the hardest parts of running a small online business simple. When you join Saltbox, you're helping real small business owners in your own backyard succeed.

Every morning before sunrise, thousands of packages land on our Alexandria dock. On big days, our on-call crew gets them all out on time. Your job is to be the person we can count on when volume spikes: when you take a shift, you show up, and every package you touch is ready for drivers by 9:00am.

What the job looks like

These are short shifts, about 5 hours, with a small crew. We aim to have every package ready for drivers by 9:00am, so you're usually done by mid-morning. We stagger start times to give you options: come in as early as 3:00am, or start at 5:00am.

You're in control of your schedule: tell us your availability and we offer you shifts that fit it, usually a week ahead. There are no guaranteed hours, so this works best as extra income around school, another job, or family.

What you will own, and how we measure it

• Showing up. On time for every shift you take. Zero no-call, no-shows.

• Scanning and sorting. Every package to the right bin, at 225 scans an hour once you're up to speed.

• Staging and handoff. Sorted loads ready for drivers by 9:00am, so every route leaves on time.

• Dock upkeep. The area clean and the equipment ready for the next morning.

Who thrives here

• You want extra hours, not a full schedule.

• You're a morning person, or willing to become one.

• When you say yes to a shift, you're there. That's the ownership mentality we hire for.

What you bring

• Reliable attendance and transportation, with early-morning availability including weekends.

• Comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT on the floor, or willing to learn quickly.

• Able to stand for 5+ hours and lift up to 50 lbs, reasonable accommodation provided.

• Warehouse or sortation experience is a plus, but we'll train you.

What we offer

• $20.00 to $22.00 per hour, plus $0.50 an hour in sunrise pay on shifts that start before 5:00am.

• A path to more: strong on-call team members get first look at regular Dock Sortation roles.

How we work with AI

AI is part of how we work at Saltbox. Every role here is expected to use AI tools as part of daily work, not as a novelty, but as a real lever for doing the job better. We invest in protected time, training budget, and a peer community to support that growth, and we expect every team member to lean in.

Ready to apply

If you want early-morning work that fits around the rest of your life, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become part of the Saltbox team. Learn more at www.saltbox.com

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. The team:

The Finance team at Jobber is responsible for anything money-related, helping us plan, budget, and implement Jobber's best ideas.



The role:

Reporting to the Manager, Accounting, the Accounting Manager will drive the accounting projects that make the rest of the function better. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, working in focused sprints — you sit outside the day-to-day general ledger close, but you understand it deeply enough to improve it. You're known for your curiosity, your bias to action, and your ability to turn an ambiguous question into a documented, defensible answer.



The Accounting Manager will:

 - Own technical accounting expertise, serving as the go-to resource for new or complex transactions — think revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), stock compensation (ASC 718), business combinations, and capitalized software.

 - Lead our controls mapping work, connecting risks to controls, documenting how our processes run, and identifying gaps — building the internal control framework that lets us scale with confidence.

 - Bring a strong working knowledge of the month-end and year-end close, without owning it, so you can map controls and redesign processes with a real understanding of how they run.

 - Collaborate across Finance and other departments to deliver projects with cross-functional impact, and act as a resource for our Finance-owned tools.

 - Reimagine our accounting processes with AI, redesigning workflows around what Company-approved AI and automation tools make possible — building processes that are faster and better controlled, while applying professional judgement and human review to every output.



To be successful, you should have:

 - Your CPA designation, with strong knowledge of US GAAP; SEC reporting experience is strongly preferred.

 - Significant accounting experience, including time in public practice, with a track record of technical accounting research and documentation of process and controls.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the judgement to make decisions based on accurate, timely analysis.

 - Solid project management instincts — the ability to scope ambiguous work, sequence it, and drive it to the finish line on your own.

 - Coachability and adaptability, with the flexibility to thrive amid change and experimentation in a growing organization.

 - A genuine team player who collaborates widely, champions best practices, and rolls up their sleeves when it's all hands on deck.

 - Experience using NetSuite is a plus.

This role has a minimum annual salary of $98,300, a midpoint of $115,700, and a maximum salary of $133,100, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!



Location:

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Surgeons need to see clearly in order heal their patients. Surgeons use the daVinci Surgical System for extended continuous duration under the intense stress of a surgical environment. Visual clarity and precise representation of the surgical field along with ease of use and optical comfort across the broad spectrum of surgeons are pillars of Intuitive’s vision products.

The Optical Engineer will utilize creativity and sound engineering judgment in the design of medical capital equipment components for volume manufacturing processes. The Optical Engineer is expected to use modeling and analytical skills to conceptualize, develop, and verify new optical components and sub-systems in the Intuitive Surgical Viewer. This position will be responsible for key system components and will interface with suppliers and manufacturing to build high-quality hardware prototypes and productize new designs. The Optical Engineer should be capable of making sound decisions when faced with the time constraints and ambiguous or incomplete information typical of research and development.

It is desired that this position maintain an awareness of developing optical imaging techniques related to surgical imaging, augmented reality, and human perception.

• Skill in the use of at least one standard optical CAD package such as Zemax or Code V
• Experience in optical and opto-mechanical tolerance analysis
• Experience in designing molded plastic optics and light pipes, using non-sequential ray trace CAD tools

The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of the technical aspects of mechanical engineering and design. He/she will work closely with senior level equipment staff and other departments to develop and sustain custom equipment for production use. This person will thrive working independently on projects with medium to high complexity.

Essential Job Duties

• Design and build in-house manufacturing equipment from concept to implementation.
• Create effective design solutions of mechanical assemblies from simple fixturing to supporting with more complex automation equipment.
• Ensure manufacturing equipment designs meet functional, safety, ergonomic, documentation, and validation requirements.
• Create and manage project plans including schedules, budgets, and stakeholder updates.
• Develop documentation for equipment including specifications, assembly instructions, maintenance, and calibration procedures.
• Create and execute protocol documentation for equipment DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ validations.
• Conduct effective design reviews of new equipment at all stages of development.
• Provide equipment-related technical support for on-going production operation and expansion.
• Establish and manage external resources (contractors, system integrators, vendors) in the planning and execution of equipment projects.
• Support quality and internal/external audits as required
• Support other equipment-related operations and duties as required

Required Skills and Experience

• Self-motivated, works well with others in a team environment.
• 3D CAD proficiency, SolidWorks preferred.
• Experience in integration of mechatronics components such as sensors, motors, pneumatics, and motion and vision control components.
• Strong understanding of tolerance analysis and statistical methods.
• Experience troubleshooting and repair of manufacturing equipment.
• Experience developing equipment qualification, calibration and PM procedures and practices.

Required Education and Training

BSME Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering with minimum of 4 years related experience.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• MSME (or equivalent) with minimum 4 plus years prior experience.
• Prior experience developing and supporting catheter manufacturing equipment.
• Knowledge in equipment control systems, PLC (Beckhoff preferred).
• Prior experience working with PLM systems (Agile preferred), SAP applications, including ECO creation, origination of equipment specification, test protocols, BOM, and work instructions.
• Structured Problem Solving. Rational thinking and root cause analysis capability.
• Experience working in a medical device or other regulated quality systems.

jobs.title: Workplace Experience - New York
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This is an exciting opportunity to anchor ElevenLabs' New York office -our second-largest hub. As Workplace Experience lead for our SoHo space, you'll be the go-to person for our rapidly growing US team and a central hub for the New York AI community.

You'll own the day-to-day workplace experience: keeping operations running smoothly, maintaining white-glove standards, and driving initiatives that elevate employee experience, optimize costs, and scale our infrastructure as we grow. You'll ensure our office is a place where people love to work. This fully in-office role is based in SoHo with on-site presence.

Perfect for a proactive, high-energy individual who thrives at the center of the action and wants to grow their career in a fast-paced AI company.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Be the Hub & Culture Driver: Serve as the main point of contact for the office, welcoming guests, leading onboarding, and boosting team culture through curated food/beverage programs, social rituals, and office perks.

 - Run Daily Operations & Vendors: Manage all day-to-day workplace logistics—including cleaning, maintenance, security, and shipping—while owning vendor relationships from contract negotiations to performance management.

 - Optimize Space & Landlord Relations: Partner with building management to maintain facilities, establish white-glove service standards, and manage ongoing space planning, floor plans, and seating charts to support a growing team.

 - Support Events & VIP Visitors: Coordinate logistics for internal and external events—such as AI hackathons, team offsites, and all-hands meetings—while ensuring a high-touch, premium experience for visiting executives and clients.

 - Own Onboarding & Internal Comms: Partner with People Ops to continuously improve the local onboarding experience (tours, swag), manage all office-related communications, and maintain clear SOPs and workplace documentation to ensure a seamless experience as the team grows.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Location & Presence: Based in New York, with a full-time presence (5 days a week) acting as the visible host, culture champion, and heartbeat of our office space.

 - Workplace Experience Mindset: Proven track record in shaping an exceptional, hospitality-driven workplace environment. Thrives in dynamic, high-visibility settings where empathy, polish, and sound judgment elevate the day-to-day employee journey.

 - High-Touch Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable acting as a gracious ambassador for the company across all levels—from welcoming clients and candidates to partnering closely with senior executives and legal partners.

 - Frictionless Workflow & Innovation: A proactive, human-centered approach to problem-solving, with a knack for anticipating team needs, eliminating daily workplace friction, and introducing modern workplace rituals and processes that enhance productivity.

 - Culture, Community & Connection: Passion for community building, with hands-on experience designing and executing engaging internal events, celebrations, and employee touchpoints—all while negotiating effectively with vendors to deliver premium, memorable experiences sustainably.

 - Environment & Vendor Stewardship: Experience curating an inspiring, seamless physical workspace—partnering with building management and premium vendors to ensure facilities, amenities, and office resources actively support team comfort, focus, and productivity.
   
   


WHY THIS ROLE?

This is an exciting opportunity to lead workplace experience at one of the world’s top AI companies. You’ll have the autonomy to shape our local culture, scale a critical hub, and directly impact how our team and the broader AI community experience ElevenLabs every day.

jobs.title: Underground Mine Planning Engineer

The Underground Mining Engineer (Planning) is responsible for producing and delivering executable weekly mine plans that align with monthly plans. This role integrates input from multiple stakeholders across operations, geology, geotechnical, backfill, ventilation, and maintenance to ensure that all activities are coordinated, realistic, and achievable.

In addition, the planner contributes to the mine design of the AFM (Approved for Mining) workflows by generating OPEX centerlines and short-range stope shapes, which are then routed through the formal review and approval processes.

This position plays a key role in driving plan compliance, leading cross-functional planning workshops, and providing short-term scheduling support to maintain operational continuity. Reporting to the Senior Short Range Planning Engineer.

• Design Contributions Create OPEX development centerlines and solids for executable cut-sheets in Deswik MDM for review and approval.Create short-range stope shapes via Deswik MDM considering most recent as-builts, grade optimization, and practical drilling & blasting requirements; submit for technical review.
• Operational SupportProvide short-term coverage for the Drill & Blast Engineer during planned or unplanned absences, including creating and peer reviewing drill, blast and timing plans.Conduct regular field inspections of headings and stopes (minimum 3 per week), raising issues and work with supervisors to mitigate risks.Prepare and maintain a rolling weekly plan.Prepare and chair the spatial compliance to plan meetings (reconciling performance to plan and highlighting risks and opportunities).Maintain and update the Stopes Priority Master Tracker, identifying trends and feeding back lessons learned into future plans.
• Collaboration & ImprovementWork closely with the Mid-Range Mine Planning Engineer and Short-Range Mine Planning Senior to ensure weekly and monthly activities align with 3 month plans/forecasts.Contribute to weekly lessons learned from stopes reconciliation and pre-stope discussions.Identify opportunities to optimize sequencing, accelerate schedules, or remove inefficiencies
• Health, Safety, and EnvironmentComply with OceanaGold Health and Safety Policy and Environment Policy.Promoting safety awareness and environmental responsibility amongst company and contract personnel.Report all personal injuries and incidents and assist with investigations.Actively supporting and participating in safety and environmental initiatives.Accepting accountability to ensure personal safety and the safety of others whilst protecting the environment.Monitor the reporting of workplace incidents and hazards to ensure effective risk mitigation is maintained.Undertake workplace inspections and audits to ensure site standards are being adhered to.Support incident investigations that occur within area of control.

• Education4-year degree in Mining Engineering
• Experience2+ years relevant experience in underground hard rock mining.Experience in mine planning using DESWIK.sched or other scheduling software’s (previous experience with DESWIK.sched will be highly regarded).Experience in Drill & Blast highly regarded.Experience in Longhole Open Stoping highly regarded.Experience in underground development planning highly regarded.

jobs.title: Public Relations/Communications Manager
jobs.description:
NerdWallet is on a mission to provide clarity for all of life’s financial decisions. Today, people look for that clarity everywhere: a Google search, an answer from ChatGPT, a Reddit thread, a TikTok from a creator they follow. We want NerdWallet to be the trusted voice that shows up everywhere consumers get their money information.



A successful candidate has a passion for a good story, views communications as a business driver and has a proven track record of turning data, expert tips and point of view into coverage consumers want to read and find helpful. The role requires strong media relationships, a clear understanding of how search, AI, UGC and social platforms shape what people trust, and the ability to build effective relationships with media and internal partners.



This role reports to the Senior Director, Public Relations & Communications.




WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

Media relations

 - Drive earned media strategy and execution across NerdWallet’s verticals, balancing proactive storytelling, newsjacking and rapid response.

 - Turn NerdWallet data, our Nerds’ expert tips and point of view into timely, helpful stories consumers want to read.

 - Pitch and land coverage in national business, consumer, personal finance and broadcast outlets.

 - Build and sustain relationships with reporters and producers so that NerdWallet is the call they make when consumer finance is the story.

 - Expand what earned means: podcasts, newsletters, YouTubers and creators who shape money conversations.

Search and AI visibility

 - Prioritize the outlets and story types that search engines rank and AI tools cite most, so NerdWallet is the source behind the answer.

 - Partner with SEO and Content to track how NerdWallet shows up in search and is cited and recommended in AI answers, and close the gaps.

 - Work with our data and research teams to turn NerdWallet surveys and studies into stories that are easy for journalists to run and for AI tools to cite.

Spokesperson coaching

 - Advise and coach our Nerds on how to show up on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit and LinkedIn: formats, topics, tone and timing. Our Social team runs the channels; you are the strategist and coach in their corner.

 - Monitor trends, community threads and viral moments to spot story openings and reputation risks early.

 - Develop the messaging, briefing docs and media training that prepare spokespeople for broadcast, print, podcast and short-form video.

Collaboration and measurement

 - Work side by side with Social, Brand, Content, SEO, Research, Legal and Compliance. You are in the room when we decide what to pitch, not handed a request after the fact.

 - Direct agency partners day to day.

 - Report on what matters: share of voice, message pull-through, search and AI visibility, spokesperson reach and business impact.




YOUR EXPERIENCE:

 - 5–8 years in PR or communications, in-house or agency, ideally in consumer, fintech or financial services.

 - A track record of top-tier national and broadcast placements, with real relationships with reporters and producers.

 - A working understanding of how search engines and AI tools find, rank and cite sources, and a point of view on how earned media drives visibility in both.

 - Fluency in social and UGC platforms. You know how TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and LinkedIn differ, and how creators and communities shape what people believe.

 - Experience coaching spokespeople, including for social-first or video-first formats.

 - Exceptional writing and comfort with data. You can find the story in a data point, turn it into a headline and a pitch, and measure your own impact.

 - Fluency with AI tools in your own workflow. You use them daily and have a point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Personal finance or consumer financial products experience.

 - Experience with SEO, AI visibility or social listening tools.

 - Experience working with creators, podcasters or influencer programs.

 - National plus regional and local media experience.




WHERE:

 - This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

 - We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.


WHAT WE OFFER:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

 - Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

 - Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

 - New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

 - Mental health support

 - Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

 - Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

 - Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

 - Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

 - Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

 - Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

 - Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction 

 - Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

 - 401K with 4% company match

 - Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

 - Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

 - Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here https://www.nerdwallet.com/privacy-policy.

We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment 

As Director of Pharma Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with Biopharmaceutical Companies related to myTomorrows' Patient Recruitment products and services for clinical trials. You will be responsible for generating leads and establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives and enhance our clinical trial portfolio.

You will develop and own strategic collaborations with BioPharma companies, from emerging innovators to global leaders, driving measurable revenue growth through our Patient Recruitment solutions and expanding our market footprint. Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, proposal and budget development, strategic partnership development, and closing high value deals.

You will be directly accountable for delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, effectively managing opportunities from lead generation through contract award, with a clear focus on pipeline conversion, deal velocity and high win rates.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities. This, collaborating closely with our operations team, marketing team, revenue operations team and as part of the Clinical Trials Business Unit.



Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.



What you'll do in this role:

 - Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a BDR

 - Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry

 - Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by driving pipeline conversion, accelerating deal velocity, and meeting or surpassing partnership targets and sales quotas.

 - Qualify deals, negotiate agreements, and close deals that align with company objectives.

 - Manage the end-to-end proposal process from opportunity qualification through contract award, including scope definition and budget development, ensuring submissions are competitive, accurate, and aligned with client needs.

 - Support the development of sales enablement material, working closely with product marketing.

 - Serve as a primary presenter during capabilities presentations, bid defenses and commercial discussions, effectively articulating myTomorrows' value proposition, Patient Recruitment expertise, and differentiated solutions.

 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and seamless implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

 - Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities and support contracting related to the expansion services for existing clients

 - Monitor market, industry and competitor trends, as well as customer feedback to identify partnership opportunities and product/service enhancements.

 - Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

 - Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build brand awareness and expand the company's presence within the pharmaceutical sector.

 - Travel to clients, conferences and prospects across the globe (up to 60% of the time)



What you bring to the table:

 - Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Science, Healthcare (Bachelor’s degree considered with strong experience)

 - 8+ years of experience in partnership development, business development, or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry

 - An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within clinical development, clinical operations, and pre-approval access space.

 - Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

 - Strong understanding of clinical trials and patient recruitment.

 - Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills in English.

 - Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

 - The ability to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans.

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

Revolutionizing access to medical treatments

We're on a mission to enable earlier and better access to treatments and improve the lives of patients. Making it possible for anyone to find and access the best possible treatment options, with the click of a button. Bringing together demand and supply like never before, in one of the world's largest industries. Our patient-centered offering is gaining traction, and with the right team we can go from helping thousands of patients each year, to millions of patients. Do you aspire to be at the forefront of innovation in healthcare and creating the next health tech unicorn? You’ve come to the right place!



The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access

As the Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with BioPharmaceutical companies for myTomorrows' Expanded Access Program (EAP) solutions, with a focus on global sustainble acess. You will be responsible for generating leads, establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives, and growing the number of chargeable expanded access programs (named patient sales) we run for our partners.

Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset, market access and expanded access experience, and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, strategic partnership development and closing high-value, multi-year deals. A clear approach to target key account and ideal customer profiles will be key.

You will be directly accountable for qualifying deals and delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, with a clear path to measurable growth and market expansion.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, regulatory developments and competitor activities. You do this in close collaboration with our EAP operations, global access, marketing and revenue operations teams, as part of the Expanded Access business unit.



Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.



What you'll do in this role

 - Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a Pharma Partnerships Associate.

 - Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners for chargeable EAPs and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry.

 - Drive revenue growth by meeting and exceeding partnership targets and sales quotas.

 - Qualify deals, negotiate agreements and close multi-year EAP partnerships that align with company objectives.

 - Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets, with clear accountability for pipeline conversion and deal velocity.

 - Together with our Director, Expanded Access Strategy and Director, Global Access, build the case for chargeable programs with BioPharma clients: identify the countries and pathways where charging for treatment is allowed, and design pricing, country selection, regulatory approach and supply model to match.

 - Lead proposals and bid defenses together with EA strategy and Global Access and finance, so every offer is commercially sound and deliverable.

 - Collaborate closely with EAP Operations and Global Access to ensure a smooth handover and the successful implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

 - Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, such as moving free-of-charge programs to a chargeble model, additional countries, assets, post-trial access, real-world data and patient recruitment, and support contracting for these expansions.

 - Support the development of sales enablement material, working closely with product marketing.

 - Act as a thought leader in Expanded Access, strengthening myTomorrows' external positioning through industry presence, conference talks and high-quality content.

 - Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

 - Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory developments and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.

 - Travel to clients, conferences and prospects across the globe (up to 60% of the time).



What you bring to the table

 - Master's degree in Business Administration, Life Science or Healthcare (Bachelor's degree considered with strong experience).

 - 5+ years of experience in partnership development, business development or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry.

 - An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within medical affairs, market access, regulatory affairs and the Expanded Access space.

 - Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

 - Strong understanding of Expanded Access, Named Patient Sales pricing and reimbursement, and the regulatory frameworks for Expanded Access in Europe and other key markets.

 - Excellent negotiation, communication and presentation skills in English.

 - Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

 - The ability to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans.

 - An AI-first way of working. You use AI tools daily to research, verify and document faster, and you are always looking for ways to do more with less, without compromising on accuracy.

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
We review applications on a rolling basis and strongly encourage candidates to apply early rather than wait until the deadline.




ABOUT CEA

The Centre for Effective Altruism (CEA) stewards the movement of people putting effective altruism (EA) principles into practice to solve the world's most pressing problems. We’re working to build a flourishing future by applying evidence, reason, and compassion to challenges like global poverty, animal suffering, and risks from transformative AI.

Our work centers on growing and supporting a global community of people who rigorously analyze where they can do the most good – and take action on those insights. Current strategic priorities include increasing understanding of effective altruism and its principles, growing the number of people who are motivated by EA principles to take significant action to address pressing problems, and diversifying funding sources for high-impact work.

We had significant success in 2025, building momentum within CEA. Our headcount grew from 42 to 66 core staff. Program participation (e.g., events, courses, groups) grew https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/NKrpEdg7wAgcoHNRG/cea-is-growing-again-25-more-people-engaged-with-our-1 by 20-25% year over year. We merged https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BLvTcMMEQGFYsh6Jw/ea-funds-and-cea-are-merging with EA Funds https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/ and are rapidly scaling up our capacity for grantmaking and associated fundraising.

In 2026, we’re maintaining ambitious momentum https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/Dy4iGHbAkKAQ4t2Dw/building-sustainable-momentum-progress-report-on-cea-s-2025 while building the foundations for a step-change in the wider EA ecosystem’s growth trajectory from 2027 onwards. We’re in the midst of the best fundraising year in CEA’s history and are looking for the right talent to help us take advantage of the many opportunities in front of us.




ABOUT THE MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS TEAM

The Marketing and Communications Team primarily exists to help people discover, understand, and engage with effective altruism, as well as CEA’s own work. This team of seven has grown significantly in the past two years, and we have existing plans to add at least four more full-time staff in the next six months.

The work of the team spans brand strategy, editorial storytelling, media relations, social media, digital and product marketing, all in service of helping people engage more deeply and thoughtfully with EA. In the past year, we've landed coverage in outlets such as the Financial Times and The Economist, run campaigns that brought thousands of people to the largest EA event in CEA’s history, and grown our social media following by 40% to over 86,000 followers.

This work is an essential part of CEA’s mission to build a global community of people who think carefully about the world's most pressing problems and take action to solve them. People applying the ideas of effective altruism have helped protect hundreds of millions of people against malaria, freed hundreds of millions of hens from battery cages, and passed lead paint regulations projected to prevent lead exposure in tens of millions of children.

As CEA scales, the Director of Marketing and Communications will develop the leadership, capabilities, and systems needed to reach new audiences, while communicating thoughtfully with the existing community. While the work of the team is primarily focused on the ideas of effective altruism, the Director will also set the team’s strategy for showcasing CEA’s role in the ecosystem, through thought leadership, brand building, and marketing.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an ambitious senior leader to build and lead a fast-paced, integrated Marketing and Communications function. You will set direction across external media, brand, content, and marketing; develop and empower leaders with complementary expertise; and turn strategy into measurable positive impact.

This role represents an opportunity to be a transformative leader at an inflection point for both CEA and the wider EA ecosystem:

 - For CEA: We’re in the midst of our best fundraising year ever, building on a year of accelerating growth. We reversed a slightly negative growth trend into 20–25% year-over-year growth across our programs in 2025, and we're now scaling from that momentum. Our headcount has approximately doubled over the past two years, and we’re looking to grow even faster. You’ll have the opportunity to build and nurture a core function as a strategic partner to the CEO and CEA's leadership team.

 - For the EA community: Interest in and scrutiny of effective altruism is rising – yet most people still haven’t heard of the movement or its powerful ideas. At the same time, there’s a new wave of philanthropy leading to a wide variety of new, impactful opportunities. You will own the strategy that shapes how EA is defined by influential commentators and understood by our key audiences, leveraging CEA’s unique role in stewardship of the EA brand. In collaboration with leaders across the EA ecosystem, your work will steer public narratives around EA and its cause areas, while maintaining the trust of an existing community that engages thoughtfully and rigorously with the work of CEA.

You will bring sound editorial and reputational judgment to equip your team to communicate EA ideas with accuracy and creativity, to navigate sensitive issues, and to maintain trust with key stakeholders, including major donors and senior leadership. As part of this role, you will also set the tone for how CEA presents itself to target audiences, expanding awareness of and engagement with our products and services.

You will have the opportunity to challenge established approaches, build new capabilities, and launch creative initiatives. You do not need to be the foremost expert in every discipline: success will depend on knowing where you bring depth, recruiting and supporting outstanding specialist leaders, and leading effectively through others.

We’re open to candidates from a range of marketing, communications, media, and brand backgrounds. You don't need to be an expert in every area; we're looking for someone who brings deep expertise in at least one of these disciplines, alongside the leadership skills and judgment to build, develop, and empower a team with complementary expertise.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will:

 - Build and lead an exceptional Marketing and Communications Team. Hire, coach, and develop the leaders of Media, Brand and Content, and Marketing, empowering them to build high-performing teams and deliver results. You'll shape the function's structure and capabilities, set clear expectations, manage performance, and foster a culture of trust, collaboration, and accountability.

 - Set an ambitious marketing and communications strategy. Lead an integrated strategy that advances CEA's priorities, strengthens its brand, and expands the reach and understanding of effective altruism. You'll identify opportunities to engage new audiences, develop creative initiatives, and turn awareness and interest into meaningful participation and action.

 - Shape public narratives and protect CEA's reputation. Guide how CEA communicates effective altruism to new audiences and the existing EA community, ensuring communications are compelling, accurate, and accessible. You'll exercise independent editorial judgment, oversee high-profile communications, and navigate sensitive issues and reputational challenges.

 - Build relationships and influence across the EA ecosystem. Collaborate with leaders and communications teams at EA-aligned organizations to identify shared opportunities, coordinate communications where appropriate, and strengthen public understanding of effective altruism.

 - Help shape CEA's organizational direction. As a strategic partner to the CEO and leadership team, contribute to organization-wide decisions, align communications priorities with CEA's broader goals, and challenge existing approaches to build new capabilities and drive greater impact.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You might be a great fit for this role if you:

 - Bring deep expertise and a strong track record in at least one of marketing, communications, media, or brand, together with enough breadth to guide strategy and recruit and lead complementary experts.

 - Have substantial experience leading teams through managers or other senior leaders, coaching their development, building buy-in, empowering specialists with complementary expertise, and delivering results through others.

 - Have experience building and scaling teams or functions in startups or similarly fast-growing environments, including attracting and hiring exceptional talent, setting clear expectations, and managing performance effectively.

 - Have experience operating in publicly visible or reputationally sensitive environments and can provide steady leadership under scrutiny.

 - Bring an entrepreneurial, ambitious approach: you can challenge assumptions, create new initiatives, operate without a fixed playbook, and turn ideas into execution.

 - Collaborate across functions and keep senior stakeholders informed of risks, trade-offs, and progress.

 - Are strongly aligned with CEA’s mission and core principles, and can engage substantively with effective altruism’s ideas, arguments, and debates; prior employment in, or long-standing membership of, the EA community is not required.

 - Can independently assess the accuracy and appropriateness of communications about EA and exercise sound judgment in shaping narratives for different audiences.

Bonus:

 - Direct experience handling crisis communications, public controversy, or a significant reputational challenge.




OTHER INFORMATION

 - This is a full-time, remote position. We prefer applicants who are able to work in time zones between US Pacific Time and CET.
   
   - We have an office in Oxford, UK, that you would have access to.

 - Start date: January 2027 or sooner

 - Reports to: Zachary Robinson, CEO

 - Compensation:
   
   - US: For this role, we offer a base salary of $219,700, and a 10% unconditional 401k contribution.
   
   - For candidates outside the US, base salary is converted from USD to your local currency using a fixed exchange rate.
   
   - Benefits include private health insurance, flexible work hours, a $6,000 annual professional development allowance, a $6,000 mental health support allowance, extended parental leave, ergonomic equipment, 25 days of paid vacation or country-specific time off entitlements, whichever is greater.

 - This role will involve travel. There are likely to be 4–6 trips annually to attend team retreats and other events, including several international trips.

We are committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. We especially encourage applications from self-identified women and people of colour who are excited about contributing to our mission. The Centre for Effective Altruism is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, or have any other questions about applying, please contact jobs@centreforeffectivealtruism.org.

CEA participates in E-Verify for US employees.

We are committed to protecting your data. See our privacy policy https://www.centreforeffectivealtruism.org/privacy for more information.




EVALUATION PLAN

We expect the interview process to include the following steps, subject to minor changes:

 1. Application

 2. Paid test task 1 (2–3 hours)

 3. Short interview

 4. Paid test task 2 (3 hours)

 5. Final interviews (3–4)

 6. 1–2 day work trial 

 7. Reference checks

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Our data team has expertise across engineering, analysis, architecture, modeling, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science. This discipline is responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights, building robust data infrastructures, and enabling data-driven decision-making and innovation through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.

You’ll design, build and maintain data pipelines using a medallion architecture, transforming operational data into trusted, well-structured datasets for reporting and analysis.

The role combines hands-on development, data modelling, production support and technical leadership. You’ll work closely with development and data teams, product owners and business stakeholders to deliver reliable data products that meet reporting and operational needs.

Responsibilities

• Work with analysts and stakeholders to understand source systems, data flows, business processes and reporting requirements, clarifying business rules and challenging unclear assumptions.
• Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Azure Databricks using Python, PySpark and SQL.
• Implement bronze, silver and gold data layers, covering raw data ingestion, cleansing, validation and preparation for reporting.
• Develop curated datasets and dimensional models, and make them available through Microsoft Fabric for Power BI reporting.
• Implement incremental processing and manage schema changes, duplicates, missing values and late-arriving data.
• Provide technical guidance and mentoring, lead code and design reviews, and support consistent development, testing and CI/CD practices.
• Contribute to product and delivery discussions by explaining technical trade-offs, identifying data dependencies and helping prioritise work based on business value and technical constraints.
• Document data models, transformations, lineage, dependencies and operational procedures.

• 7+ years of experience in data engineering, including designing, building, deploying and supporting production data pipelines.
• Strong Python and SQL skills, with strong hands-on experience using PySpark and Spark SQL in Azure Databricks.
• Experience with Microsoft Fabric, particularly making curated data available for reporting through OneLake, lakehouses or warehouses.
• Good understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling, including table grain, facts, dimensions and historical changes.
• Experience orchestrating and monitoring data pipelines.
• Experience with automated testing, data validation, Git and CI/CD practices.
• Working knowledge of Azure storage, access management and secure credential handling.
• Taking ownership of technical decisions, reviewing designs and code, and guiding other engineers.
• Ability to understand business processes and product priorities, translate requirements into practical data solutions, and explain how technical choices affect users, reporting and operational decisions.
• Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly and collaborate effectively in English with business and technical colleagues. Useful additional experience
• Experience with Snowflake.
• Experience delivering data solutions in enterprise environments. Familiarity with logistics, transportation or supply chain data is an advantage.
• Enterprise data modelling and aligning data definitions across source systems.
• Practical use of AI development tools.

Discover some of the global benefits that empower our people to become the best version of themselves:

• Finance: Competitive salary package, share plan, company performance bonuses, value-based recognition awards, referral bonus;
• Career Development: Career coaching, global career opportunities, non-linear career paths, internal development programmes for management and technical leadership;
• Learning Opportunities: Complex projects, rotations, internal tech communities, training, certifications, coaching, online learning platforms subscriptions, pass-it-on sessions, workshops, conferences;
• Work-Life Balance: Hybrid work and flexible working hours, employee assistance programme;
• Health: Global internal wellbeing programme, access to wellbeing apps;
• Community: Global internal tech communities, hobby clubs and interest groups, inclusion and diversity programmes, events and celebrations.

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.
