jobs.title: 207 - Technical Project Manager - Canada
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Since our founding in 1996, Numerix has been at the vanguard of financial technology, providing quantitative analytics and software that redefine pricing and risk management across the financial markets. Through recent strategic acquisitions, Numerix has further strengthened its leadership position, empowering financial institutions worldwide to transform risk into opportunity with confidence. As AI reshapes capital markets technology, Numerix is focused on combining the speed and flexibility of AI with the deterministic, auditable, and governed calculations that financial institutions require.

Numerix empowers Capital Market participants to solve derivative analytics problems with innovative simplicity. The key to our success for over 30 years is our unique combination of innovative engineering and a highly dedicated team committed to going above and beyond to help customers and partners achieve their goals.

As a Regional Project Management Lead, you will lead project delivery across the Americas for customer onboarding and solution implementation services for both SaaS and on-premises clients. Working closely with the Head of PMO and Professional Services leadership in Americas, you will oversee a portfolio of concurrent customer engagements, coach and support Project Managers, and ensure consistent execution against Statements of Work, delivery plans, budgets, and governance standards. You will also partner with Sales, Finance and Legal on Professional Services contracts, as well as Product & Engineering, and Customer Support to manage dependencies, risks, reporting, change control, and successful transition to ongoing operations.

What You'll Do:

• Lead projects delivery across the Americas, ensuring consistent execution of customer onboarding and implementation projects.

• Coach and support Project Managers to strengthen delivery discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Own project execution governance from initiation through closure, delivering agreed outcomes on time and within budget.

• Govern SOW execution, monitor scope adherence, and drive formal change control when required.

• Coordinate planning, resource allocation, and cost estimation across cross-functional delivery teams.

• Maintain portfolio-level reporting on project status, budget, risks, issues, and delivery forecasts.

• Partner with PMO and Finance on time tracking, billing readiness, month-end invoicing, and financial hygiene.

• Manage stakeholder communications, executive reporting, and escalations to protect delivery outcomes.

• Ensure smooth handover of implemented solutions to Customer Support and business operations teams.

• Advance PMO best practices through lessons learned, standardized delivery artifacts, and stronger governance.

Measures of success:

• Projects delivered in line with SOW commitments, including scope, milestones, budget, and acceptance criteria.

• Strong execution discipline through effective SOW reviews, scope control, and timely change management.

• Accurate portfolio reporting, forecasting, time tracking, and invoicing readiness.

• High customer satisfaction and successful onboarding against project objectives.

• A high-performing project management team developed through coaching and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For:

• 8+ years of project and/or program management experience in Capital Markets and/or enterprise software delivery, preferably leading a team.

• Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.

• Strong understanding of project governance, SOW management, change control, risk management, and delivery reporting.

• Knowledge of SDLC and Agile delivery practices, including tools such as Jira and Confluence.

• Experience delivering trading and/or risk platform implementations in SaaS and on-premises environments.

• Experience with project planning, forecasting, and reporting tools such as Microsoft Project, SharePoint, or similar PMO tooling.

• PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred

• People management experience

Extra Credit:

• Graduated with an advanced degree (Masters) in a technical or business discipline

• Worked as a consultant and/or other professional/client services teams on software implementation projects or some experience in product management.

Where You’ll Work:

This is a hybrid or remote role, open to all who reside within USA / Canada - with preference to candidates located in a commutable distance to our beautiful New York headquarters.  The successful candidate will need to work in Eastern time zone working hours.

An important note on salary:

The annual pay range for this position is based on the preferred primary location of the role which is listed above. If you are applying to this role at a location that is not the preferred primary location, please keep in mind the salary range will vary and may fall outside of what is listed. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Also note that unsolicited contact from third-party recruiters or agencies will not be considered at this time. We respectfully request no outreach from agencies.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Warehouse/Driver to join our Warshauer Electric Supply team in Tinton Falls, NJ!

Summary:

The Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role also has an essential driving component and may be assigned to operate a delivery vehicle for up to 50% of its time delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

What You'll Do:

• Contribute to a culture and environment focused daily on employee safety and a safe work environment
• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses and verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Keep incoming orders stocked on shelves orderly and in designated area and report freight damage claims
• Prepare branch orders from the warehouse and ensure that the correct number and type of product is being shipped
• Process paperwork regarding shipments including but not limited to verifying that the merchandise to be shipped is correct, applying the correct postage tape and label, following customer shipping instructions, and insuring the shipment when necessary
• Operate machinery including forklift, reach truck, and wire cutting machine when required
• Load common carrier and company vehicles
• Inspect and perform minor maintenance on equipment
• Perform inventory counts and reconcile any discrepancies
• Operate delivery vehicles to make deliveries to and from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers
• Inspect company vehicle for visual and operating defects; responsible for completing a daily inspection report
• Keep company vehicle clean, serviced, and maintained; alert supervisor of repair and/or service needed
• Must follow Department of Transportation (DOT), local and state driving laws and regulations
• Load or unload vehicle and ensure all material for each order is correct (quantity and type of material) and that material is free of damage before departure
• May assist in preparing orders for delivery
• Ensure all appropriate documentation is thoroughly completed at the time of delivery, including delivery receipt is signed by the customer, packing list and branch/warehouse manifest
• Pick up material returns from customers; responsible for inspecting the condition of the material and verify quantities and catalog numbers

jobs.title: Social Worker – Learning Disabilities and Autism Team
jobs.description:
Our client based in Cambridgeshire is seeking an experienced Social Worker to join their Learning Disabilities and Autism Team. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to support adults with learning disabilities and autism through strengths-based, person-centred social work practice.

The successful candidate will play a key role in reducing waiting lists by undertaking Adult Social Care Assessments, developing Care and Support Plans, and completing initial reviews. Working closely with individuals, families, carers, health professionals, providers, and partner agencies, you will help ensure adults receive timely, outcome-focused support that promotes independence, wellbeing, and community inclusion.

This role requires a confident Social Worker with strong assessment skills, a sound understanding of Adult Social Care legislation, and experience supporting adults with learning disabilities and autism.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Undertaking Adult Social Care Assessments in accordance with the Care Act 2014 to identify eligible care and support needs.

• Supporting the team to reduce assessment waiting lists through efficient and timely case progression.

• Developing, implementing, and reviewing person-centred Care and Support Plans that promote independence, wellbeing, and positive outcomes.

• Completing initial reviews of support arrangements and making recommendations regarding future care and support needs.

• Managing a caseload of adults with learning disabilities and autism, ensuring interventions remain strengths-based and outcome-focused.

• Working collaboratively with individuals, carers, families, advocacy services, health professionals, providers, and partner agencies.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and contributing to Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and responding appropriately to concerns relating to abuse, neglect, exploitation, and self-neglect.

• Assessing and managing risk whilst promoting positive risk-taking, choice, and control.

• Supporting individuals to access community resources, preventative services, direct payments, and personalised support options.

• Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, reviews, safeguarding discussions, and professional forums.

• Preparing high-quality assessments, support plans, review documentation, and professional reports.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant records in accordance with statutory and organisational requirements.

Qualifications and Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have;

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Learning Disabilities & Autism Experience: Experience supporting adults with learning disabilities, autism, and complex support needs.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake Care Act assessments, reviews, support planning, and risk management interventions.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing safeguarding concerns involving vulnerable adults.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with health professionals, providers, carers, families, advocacy services, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred practice and continuous professional development.

• Organisational Skills: Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain a high standard of assessment and case recording.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Member Experience
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Consultant, Member Experience

The Role

Health plans and healthcare providers are navigating an increasingly complex landscape marked by evolving quality frameworks, shifting regulatory standards, and rising expectations from the populations they serve. As a Senior Consultant in Member Experience, you will serve as a trusted advisor bringing health plans and healthcare providers together.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of a major industry shift: bridging the traditional divide between payers and providers to improve the end-to-end patient and member journey. Working directly with health plan leaders, medical groups, and clinical operations teams, you will combine deep operational healthcare knowledge with proven continuous improvement methodologies to build strong cross-entity partnerships, elevate quality metrics, and drive measurable performance across Star Ratings and CAHPS. If you are passionate about being a change agent whose work directly impacts the care and lives of millions of people nationwide, this role is for you.

How You’ll Find Success

• Payer-Provider Bridge Builder: Understands the operational realities of both health plans and medical provider groups; builds genuine collaboration and trust across executive leaders, physician groups, and clinical staff.

• Continuous Improvement Driver: Skilled in applying structured problem-solving and quality improvement frameworks (e.g., Plan-Do-Study-Act / PDSA cycles) to uncover root causes and build sustainable operational workflows.

• Coach & Facilitator: Comfortably engages and trains diverse audiences—from executive roundtables and town halls to clinic managers and frontline teams—through interactive virtual sessions and hands-on onsite workshops.

• Data-to-Action Interpreter: Adept at reading and interpreting complex performance metrics (CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, Star Ratings) and translating them into clear, practical roadmaps without getting lost in technical reporting.

• Adaptable & Client-Centric: Thrives in a dynamic consulting environment, easily shifting between strategic advisory, remote delivery, and onsite client facilitation across diverse regions.

How You’ll Grow

• Expand Scope of Influence: Broaden your reach beyond a single health system or payer to guide dozens of medical groups and major regional/national health plans across the country.

• Lead Cutting-Edge Transformation: Be an active driver in one of healthcare’s most critical evolutions—uniting health plans and provider networks into collaborative care partners.

• Hone Executive Advisory & Facilitation: Deepen your expertise in leading high-stakes client engagements, executive coaching, office hours, and collaborative exchange programs.

• Deepen Quality & Regulatory Expertise: Strengthen your mastery of modern healthcare quality programs, value-based care models, Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.

Things You’ll Do

• Bridge Health Plans & Provider Networks: Collaborate with health plan liaison teams and medical practices to align on shared quality goals, improve communications, and strengthen provider-payer relationships.

• Drive Direct Performance Improvement: Partner with provider practices and clinical groups to lead operational improvement initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) to enhance patient and member interactions.

• Facilitate Training & Coaching: Deliver impactful virtual and onsite workshops, town halls, office hours, and coaching sessions through collaborative initiatives (such as our HX Exchange program).

• Interpret Performance & Survey Metrics: Analyze and interpret CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, and Star Ratings data alongside operational metrics to identify performance gaps and track measurable progress.

• Manage End-to-End Client Engagements: Lead client project scopes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery timelines, ensuring initiatives translate into sustainable, measurable outcomes.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, performance improvement, provider relations, or health plan operations.

• Provider Operations Background: Strong background working directly within healthcare provider settings (e.g., as a Practice Manager, Practice Director, Clinic Operations Lead, or Provider Relations Specialist) with direct insight into clinic workflows and clinical staff engagement.

• Dual Payer/Provider Experience (Strong Plus): Exposure to both health plan/payer operations (e.g., Medicare Advantage, Commercial, or Medicaid) and provider environments is highly preferred.

• Quality & Survey Frameworks: Practical familiarity with healthcare quality metrics and survey frameworks, including CAHPS, HCAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, Patient Experience (PX), and Value-Based Care programs.

• Core Tool Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word), with the demonstrated ability to review, interpret, and present data-driven insights effectively.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.

• Travel Flexibility: Ability and willingness to travel nationwide based on client needs (ttravel is client-dependent and can range from remote periods up to 75% travel during onsite engagements.).

What You Should Know About This Team

• High-Impact Work: Our team directly influences the care experience and health outcomes of millions of members nationwide. This is accomplished by the team's passion to work collaboratively with both payers and providers to enhance the patient/member experience.

• Collaborative & Advisory-Led: We work hand-in-hand with our clients and internal cross-functional experts, building true partnerships to support change management that is meaningful for both payers and providers.

• Commitment to Growth: Continuous learning is embedded in how we work; team members are given immediate autonomy, executive visibility, and opportunities to stretch their skills across diverse client challenges.

• Data-Driven & Purpose-Focused: We combine rigorous analytical methodology with a deep human-centered purpose to navigate the evolving healthcare ecosystem.

• Nationwide Scale & Purpose: Our team shapes the member and patient experience across the country, from regional health plans to large national health systems, touching millions of lives.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• We participate in personalized Career Action Planning. You will work with your manager to design a plan based on your life experiences, values, and career aspirations (inside and outside Qualtrics) that helps you achieve your career goals at Qualtrics.

• Qualtrics pays 100% of the healthcare benefit premiums for employees and their dependents.

• Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

jobs.title: Продавач - консултант - Mall Galleria
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

Като продавач - консултант ти ще заемаш ключова роля в създаването на изключително клиентско преживяване. Посрещайки нашите клиенти, ще им помагаш в техния избор, като същевременно ще ги запознаваш с нашите нови продукти и колекции. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Споделяш модните си познания, така че клиентите ни да изберат най-доброто за себе си.

• Работиш заедно с екипа, за да осигурите перфектно обслужване на клента, включително активно промотиране на лоялната ни програма

• Подсигуряваш етажа и складовите помещения заредени и подредени.

• Помагаш с процедурите по отварянето и затварянето на магазина.

• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.

​

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

​

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в обслужването на клиенти в сферата на търговията ще е предимство.

• Удоволствие от общуването с клиенти и интерес към модата – ние ще те научим на всичко останало!

И човек, който е…​

• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения.

• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.

• Адаптивен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

​

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

​

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки част от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);

jobs.title: International Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Summary:
Analytic Services, Inc. (ANSER) is seeking an International Program Analyst to provide support to the Director for International Cooperation within the Office of the Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear Defense (ODASW(CBRND)). In this key role, you will support CBRND international efforts aligned to DoW, Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Nuclear Deterrence, Chemical, and Biological Defense, Policy and Programs, and Chem/Bio Defense Program (CBDP) priorities, goals, and objectives. You will also help support and streamline communication of CBDP International Program efforts across the CBDP as well as use your knowledge of DoW and A&S priorities, working closely with the International Program Director, to support development of new CBDP international relationships. Additionally, you will support development of CBDP’s International Strategy and contribute, as needed, to support the team’s other initiatives.

This position can support a hybrid work schedule with 3-4 days onsite at the Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

• Provide technical and administrative support to facilitate government oversight, coordination, and integration of initiatives on CBRND related issues and programs that involve the international community by preparing Power Point presentations, briefings, read aheads, talking points, and facilitating the development of action.

• Support ODASW(CBRND) government leads at interagency or professional meetings (may include international conferences, seminars, and meetings).

• Serve as a subject matter expert in relevant policy, cultural, and current affairs issues for the CBDP’s primary international partners. Provide technical expertise and advice to ensure ODASW(CBRND) compliance with Foreign Disclosure processes. Serve as a qualified subject matter expert in the field of international project management, to include ITAR, FMS, and foreign disclosure.

• Propose, develope, and maintain a coordinated overarching ND-CBD Strategy for international engagement including the creation of metrics-based actionable strategies, implementation guidance, and oversight plans to enable the Government to continuously monitor international cooperation and activities.

• Maintain a coordinated Calendar of Activities for ODASW(CBRND)-related international and Office of the Assistant Secretary of War (Nuclear Deterrence and Chemical Biological Defense) OASW(ND-CBD)-related interagency activities and receiving / sending Foreign Visit Requests, Country and Theater Clearances, etc.

• Coordinate ND-CBD staffing and oversight of International Agreements, e.g., Memoranda of Understanding, Memoranda of Agreement, Project Agreements, Equipment and Material Transfers, Foreign Military Sales. Drafts international agreements, requests for International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) exemption, foreign disclosure requests, and related documents. Provide technical expertise, analysis, and advice on the use of, and distinctions between, such agreements.

• Assist the government in developing and managing the office travel budget. Coordinate all aspects of domestic and international travel arrangements to include the preparation of country clearance messages, visa/passports applications, and process travel vouchers.

• Coordinate closely with CBDP components and international partners to solicit additional information, as necessary, to understand the CBR MOU portfolio.

• Support and execute recurring executive officer and program officer meetings with CBR MOU international partners.

• Assist with the development and maintenance of agreements with international partners.

Required Qualifications:

• Possess an active TS/SCI security clearance.

• Bachelor's degree in any field and 10+ years of relevant experience including working with bi-lateral or multi-lateral engagements, international partners and international institutions, and international negotiation or diplomatic experience, or a Master’s degree is equivalent to 7 years of related work experience.

• Recent experience with international engagements, agreements, and treaties.

• Experience facilitating O-6/GS-15 level meetings.

• Experience engaging SES/GO/FO level personnel.

• Experience coordinating and building relationships with international partners.

• Familiarity with chemical and biological defense subject matter.

• Experience with the MS365 Suite, including Teams and SharePoint.

• Able to travel and attend meetings within the National Capitol Region as well as potential travel within and outside the continental United States.

• Must be capable of travelling internationally ~10% annually (Usually 1 week at a time).

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with the oversight or management of international engagements within the CBDP.

• Pentagon Action officer experience.

• Knowledge of the foreign disclosure process.

• Knowledge or experience drafting and coordinating the development of bi-lateral and multi-lateral engagements.

• International Relations experience in areas regarding the Chemical and Biological Defense program or CBR MOU engagements.

• Experience working Foreign Military Sales (FMS).

• Experience working with the United Kingdom.

Individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to: business considerations, local market, internal equity, candidate qualifications such as skills, education and experience. ANSER provides employees benefits to support all aspects of their life including health, financial and well-being. For more information, please visit: http://www.anser.org

$99,000—$144,300 USD

jobs.title: Social Worker – Learning Disabilities Service
jobs.description:
Our client based in Rhondda Cynon Taf is seeking an experienced Social Worker to join their Learning Disabilities Service on a project basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled practitioner to undertake a dedicated programme of reassessment work with adults with learning disabilities, ensuring care and support arrangements remain appropriate, proportionate, and focused on achieving positive outcomes.

The successful candidate will complete strengths-based reassessments, review existing care and support arrangements, and make evidence-based recommendations regarding future support needs. Working within the framework of the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014, you will focus on promoting wellbeing, independence, choice, control, and co-production whilst ensuring individuals are supported to achieve their personal outcomes.

This role is a time-limited project assignment and does not involve ongoing case management. It is ideally suited to an experienced practitioner with strong assessment skills, knowledge of learning disability services, and experience applying the Mental Capacity Act and best interests processes.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Undertaking strengths-based reassessments of adults with learning disabilities in accordance with the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014.

• Identifying personal outcomes and determining whether current care and support arrangements continue to meet assessed needs.

• Reviewing existing care and support packages and evaluating whether alternative models of care may better support individuals to achieve their desired outcomes.

• Completing Mental Capacity Assessments where required in relation to specific decisions.

• Undertaking and contributing to Best Interest decision-making processes where individuals lack capacity for the relevant decision.

• Assessing and managing risks in a balanced and proportionate way, promoting independence, empowerment, choice, and wellbeing.

• Identifying and building upon individual strengths, capabilities, community connections, and existing support networks.

• Working collaboratively with individuals, families, carers, advocacy services, providers, health professionals, and partner agencies.

• Contributing to multidisciplinary discussions and assessments where appropriate.

• Producing clear, evidence-based recommendations regarding future care and support arrangements.

• Ensuring assessments, support plans, Mental Capacity Act documentation, Best Interest records, and professional recommendations are completed to a high standard.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant electronic case records in line with organisational policies and procedures.

• Promoting the principles of co-production and ensuring individuals remain at the centre of decision-making regarding their care and support.

Qualifications and Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have;

• Professional Qualification: Degree in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Care Wales.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Learning Disabilities Experience: Proven experience working with adults with learning disabilities and complex support needs.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Human Rights legislation, and Adult Safeguarding procedures.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake strengths-based assessments, reassessments, reviews, and outcome-focused support planning.

• Mental Capacity Experience: Experience undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and Best Interest decision-making processes.

• Risk Management: Ability to undertake balanced and proportionate risk assessments that promote independence and positive outcomes.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with providers, families, carers, advocacy services, health professionals, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to person-centred, strengths-based and outcomes-focused practice in line with the principles of the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

Reasonable Adjustments:

If you consider yourself to have a disability or require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please highlight this at the earliest opportunity by contacting our team. With this information, we will provide appropriate support to you throughout the process and into your work placement.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Team Lead
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Team Lead

Axis Automation leverages the expertise of leading engineers and machine builders to conceptualize, design, integrate, deploy, and service factory automation systems for innovative manufacturing customers.

The Supply Chain Team Lead owns $12-25M of annual spend across controls, mechanical, and machined & fabricated components. This role oversees Supply Chain and Shipping & Receiving team members, establishes sourcing strategies, develops supplier partnerships, manages supply chain risk, and drives continuous improvement initiatives – while serving as lead buyer on Axis’ most complex and highest risk projects. Reporting to Manager of Shared Services, this role serves as the leader and escalation point for supply chain and shipping and receiving activities while partnering closely with Finance, Project Management, and execution teams to support business and project success. This role requires a proactive approach, sense of urgency, strategic leadership, commitment to cost-effectiveness, ability to manage concurrent responsibilities, and a strong desire to grow with the company.

Success in this role will be measured not only on a project-by-project basis through quoted versus actual material spend and on-time delivery to project execution teams, but also through strategic sourcing decisions and supplier pricing agreements that deliver annual cost savings. Additional performance measures will include ERP data completeness and accuracy, as well as purchase requisition, purchase order, and receipt processing times.

Key Responsibilities

• Supply Chain Operations: Manage the complete supply chain workflow, including supplier requisitioning, robust negotiation, order processing, confirmation management, and delivery acceptance. Develop and maintain vendor relationships, ensuring optimal mix across all product and process categories, while strongly negotiating competitive pricing and terms. Successfully execute time-sensitive supply chain needs with a sense of urgency as driven by dynamic project circumstances. Drive regular supplier evaluations, tracking performance metrics and cost opportunities across existing and potential suppliers. Utilize project budget constraint, timelines, and internal machining and fabrication capacity reports from Machining Manager to make decisions regarding outsourced vs. in house production of machined and fabricated components.

• Shipping/Receiving: Manage shipping/receiving operations to ensure accurate and timely receiving, organization and distribution of parts and materials supporting all Axis operational departments. Implement and maintain efficient processes for inventory control and logistics support.

• Departmental Collaboration and Communication: Drive long lead component sourcing, coordinating closely with Mechanical Engineers during vendor quoting at project outset. Work with Build and Electrical departments to source vendors aligned with technical requirements and project goals. Partner with Project Management to ensure alignment with project schedules and budgets. Support Applications Engineering in finding competitive supply chain solutions to help new business. Evaluate market trends, supplier capabilities, capacity constraints, tariffs, and external risks that may impact business operations. Work cross-functionally to establish risk mitigation strategies where possible.

• Strategic Leadership: Utilize data to make informed supply chain decisions that support company profitability and growth. Investigate projects and initiatives to strengthen our long-term supply chain strategy including vendor relationship incubation, working capital management, and building negotiation leverage. Evaluation and execution of low-cost country sourcing initiatives for targeted components. Establish performance expectations, priorities, and goals for Supply Chain and Shipping & Receiving Team, providing consistent coaching and feedback. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

Qualifications

• Resourceful attitude with self-starter mindset and sense of urgency in executing open issues.

• Negotiation skills enabling an ability to advocate for company interests while building key relationships.

• Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute tasks effectively.

• Analytical and financial acumen, leveraging data to guide cost-effective decisions.

• 3+ years of experience in a project-based manufacturing environment.

• 1+ years of management experience in supply chain, procurement, or operations.

• Familiarity with machine tool and welding applications.

Base Salary Range: $85,000 - $105,000, depending on experience

Benefits: Axis offers a comprehensive benefits package with no waiting period.

jobs.title: Quantum Processor Development Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



As a Quantum Processor Development Lead you own people management and project leadership for our quantum processor developement. You rapidly grow the team by recruiting key members, while maintaining a high level of care and support for the team members. You report to the VP of Product and work closely with them to shape the team that defines the direction of key technical development at QuantWare. You will work with some of the smartest and most passionate people in the field, helping us build the world's most powerful quantum processors, as fast as possible.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own and drive processor development
   
   - Manage development work - particularly chip design and cryogenic measurement.
   
   - Run smaller, self-contained projects within your team - supporting both department and company-wide initiatives.
   
   - Partner with assigned Program Managers on larger, cross-department programs, particularly regarding technical execution and requirements compliance of QPUs.

 - Manage uncertainty and technical risk
   
   - Identify technical risks and bottlenecks early
   
   - Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies
   
   - Adapt experimental strategies dynamically based on new information

 - Develop engineering practices within the team
   
   - Develop a deep technical understanding of quantum processor technology to guide sound, well-informed decisions.
   
   - Implement strong and lean technical processes that support sound decision making processes. For example: requirements flowdown, trade studies, root cause corrective action methods, etc.

 - Support growth and development of the team
   
   - Contribute to defining role profiles and act as hiring manager for new roles across the programme.
   
   - Mentor engineers and project leads in programme execution and collaborative leadership.
   
   - Manage the engineers in your technology area: hire, coach, review performance, and grow careers.


YOUR PROFILE

 - Technical background
   
   - MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.
   
   - Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

 - Leadership experience
   
   - 4+ years delivering complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a project management capacity.
   
   - Show people-management experience: hiring, coaching, and performance management.
   
   - Lead projects as part of a larger program, with control over one’s own domain.
   
   - Run smaller projects directly, without needing dedicated program-management support.
   
   - Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.
   
   - Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

 - Approach
   
   - Translate a long-term technical strategy into an execution plan for your team.
   
   - Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.
   
   - Draw a clear line between technical leadership and program management, and partner with Program Managers instead of duplicating their function.

 - Communication
   
   - Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating technical ideas.
   
   - Communicate fluently in English.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)




YOUR ROLE

We scaled to 50 million users in just 2 years with a lean team of 100 people. Last year, we doubled our headcount. 

Now, we’re scaling again, and the next hires will shape what EverAI looks like at 100+ people. As our third Talent Acquisition Specialist, you’ll be central to that build, as you’re joining at a defining stage.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Alexis, and partner with leaders across the business to help assemble the team behind one of the fastest-growing AI products globally. We hire internationally and across every function of the company, with a strong focus on tech, bringing together people from leading tech hubs around the world.

You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Talent Acquisition evolves as we grow: refining our internal workflows, experimenting with new AI tools, launching employer branding initiatives, testing sourcing strategies that keep our quality bar high, and so on.




KEY MISSION

Identify, attract, and land top global talent, while helping build a recruitment stack that matches the scale and ambition of a company serving 50M users worldwide.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be responsible for:




TALENT MAPPING & SOURCING:

 - Global Talent Scouting: Help map and engage elite talent from Tier 1 tech hubs and companies worldwide. You’ll identify and connect with candidates who aren’t actively applying through thoughtful outreach and strong networking.

 - Smart Sourcing: Support the implementation of an AI-first recruitment stack. You’ll use tools, from AI agents to niche technical communities and unconventional channels, to help us find exceptional talent

 - Relationship Building: Maintain long-term relationships with passive talent globally to ensure we stay ahead of hiring needs as we continue scaling
   
   


CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE & EVALUATION:

 - World-Class Candidate Experience: Own the candidate journey from the first discovery call to the final close. Ensure every interaction with EverAI, whether candidates join us or not, is clear, respectful, and high-quality

 - Interviews and Screenings: Conduct structured interviews to assess technical aptitude and cultural alignment, and provide concise, actionable summaries for Hiring Managers and Leadership




PROCESS INNOVATION & COLLABORATION:

 - Hiring Operations: Work closely with Founders and Team Leads to improve hiring workflows, remove friction, and strengthen how we operate as we grow past 100+ employees

 - Employer Branding and other Initiatives: Contribute to creative initiatives and content that position EverAI as the #1 destination for the world’s best AI talent




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS




MUST-HAVES

 - Minimum 3 years of experience in recruitment, with at least 2 years in tech recruitment

 - Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment

 - Global sourcing experience: You have a track record of helping attract talent from major tech hubs (USA, EU, LATAM, etc.)

 - Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools

 - You thrive in a high-trust environment where you are empowered to learn, improve processes, and make an impact
   
   


OTHERS

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable hiring for products that are based on uncensored models and content




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience in AI recruitment or familiarity with the AI space

 - Exposure to employer branding, compensation benchmarking, or broader TA initiatives




WHY EVERAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale




WHAT WE OFFER

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows




🎯 TOP TIER TALENT IS OUR MULTIPLIER

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.title: Department Manager – Alkmaar (38 uur)
jobs.description:
WAT JE GAAT DOEN

Als Department Manager geef je leiding aan je team en ondersteun je hen, terwijl je een inclusieve cultuur stimuleert waarin samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan. Je zorgt voor een uitstekende operationele én visuele winkelbeleving – zowel voor klanten als collega’s.

Jij:

• zorgt voor een sterke visuele en commerciële presentatie om onze klanten een geweldige winkelervaring te bieden met behulp van servicetools.
• analyseert verkoop- en budgetdoelen en ontwikkelt optimalisatiemaatregelen.
• plant taken en personeelsinzet efficiënt in en zorgt ervoor dat alle operationele processen soepel verlopen – van de winkelvloer en het magazijn tot aan de kassa’s, paskamerroutines en de dagelijkse winkelopening en -sluiting.
• ontwikkelt je team op strategische wijze door middel van gerichte werving, onboarding, regelmatige feedbackgesprekken, prestatie-evaluaties en individuele ontwikkelplannen.

Wil je meer weten over de rol van Department Manager? Luister naar onze Jobcast-aflevering en kom meer tew eten over de functie uit eerste hand – rechtstreeks van ons team: Department Manager

MET WIE JE GAAT SAMENWERKEN

Onze winkels vormen het hart van H&M – daar waar klanten het merk van dichtbij beleven. Elk teamlid draagt bij aan een inspirerende en gastvrije sfeer. Je werkt nauw samen met je team om onze klanten te helpen zich zelfverzekerd te voelen en zichzelf te uiten met de nieuwste trends en tijdloze stijlen.

WIE JIJ BENT

Wij zoeken talenten met...

• Leiderschapsvaardigheden en ervaring in retail
• Motivatie en empathie om je team te inspireren en zo een geweldige winkelervaring te creëren
• Een duidelijke focus op planning en prioriteiten om de winkel efficiënt te laten draaien.

En talenten die...

• oplossingsgericht, flexibel en analytisch denken
• teamgericht werken, duidelijk communiceren en actief luisteren
• een passie hebben voor mode, trends en commercie

WIE WIJ ZIJN

De H&M Group is een wereldwijd bedrijf met sterke modemerken en innovatieve businesslijnen. Wij geloven dat excellent design, betaalbare prijzen en duurzame oplossingen hand in hand kunnen gaan. Onze klanten staan centraal in alles wat we doen. Onze bedrijfscultuur wordt gevormd door duizenden gepassioneerde en getalenteerde teamleden. Samen gebruiken we onze schaal en kennis om de mode-industrie te leiden richting een inclusievere en duurzamere toekomst.

WAAROM JE HIER GRAAG WILT WERKEN

We zijn trots op ons levendige en open karakter. Onze teams profiteren van aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en diverse ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden wereldwijd.

• Personeelskorting op al onze producten en merken
• 25 vakantiedagen
• HIP – H&M Incentive Program (bonusprogramma)
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) voor een gezonde werk-privébalans
• Corporate Benefits (exclusieve kortingen bij veel merken)
• Bedrijfspensioenregeling
• Reiskostenvergoeding
• Contract van 1 jaar met uitzicht op verlenging
• Brutosalaris afhankelijk van ervaring vanaf €2.710,47 (exclusief vakantiegeld)

KOM ERBIJ

Onze kracht en uniciteit zitten in veel dingen – in onze inclusieve cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Maar bovenal zijn het onze teams die ons maken tot wat we zijn.

** We streven naar een eerlijk en gelijk proces en vragen je geen sollicitatiebrief mee te sturen, omdat deze vaak informatie bevat die gemakkelijk kan leiden tot onbedoelde vooroordelen.

jobs.title: Client Partner - Lifesciences
jobs.location: Boston, Massachusetts, USA; Chicago, Illinois, USA; Dallas, Texas, USA; New York City, New York, USA; San Francisco, California, USA
jobs.description:
Client Partners are the trusted partner of existing Thoughtworks clients, supporting them in their business transformation journey through a technology-centric approach. They're also an extension of delivery teams, ensuring that both business and technology groups are aligned. By staying continuously connected with a customer's business and technology strategy as well as our offerings, they drive customer growth while positioning Thoughtworks as trusted industry leaders.

Job responsibilities

• Achieve established revenue targets, forecast and manage sales, revenue and margins at existing customers .

• You will establish, grow and nurture long-term, value-based relationships with a growing number of senior client stakeholders, focusing on 1-3 accounts at a time.

• You will partner closely with technical leaders to support the delivery team, ensuring they have what they need to be successful.

• You will engage in consultative business development, growing relationships both vertically and horizontally .

• Approach client executives as true business partners, expanding the company’s breadth and depth to its full potential.

• You will take a consultative approach to working with our clients’ C-level executives and other stakeholders to achieve their business goals, redefine their industries, drive complex negotiations and resolve conflicts.

• Help develop a range of IP and best practices around client and portfolio development to build the client base into a significant strategic asset.

• By understanding a client’s strategy inside out, you will identify opportunities to improve the partnership and increase revenue throughout the duration of the partnership.

• Maintain a watchful eye on how Thoughtworks’ executes engagements and take a proactive approach to mitigating potential risks before they arise.

• Stay current with Thoughtworks’ business strategy and IT goals.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

• You have experience in executive revenue-generating roles and bring comprehensive business acumen to your account strategies, cultivating ‘win-win' value propositions at both company and individual levels.

• You understand agile custom software delivery and can motivate tech teams with creativity and enthusiasm.

• Bonus points if you are well versed in agile delivery best practices.

Professional Skills

• A forward-thinking mindset - - you infuse thought leadership and innovation into how you partner with a client.

• A natural consultant, you're solutions-oriented and influence decisions by bringing in relevant industry trends and client stories.

• You're able to balance strategy and execution, while crafting visions and taking a progressive stance on agendas that drive change.

• You're comfortable interfacing with C-suite on their strategy, ensuring that we're delivering the expected outcomes while staying a step ahead to propose new solutions that may increase revenue.

• Taking abstract, technical or strategic concepts and translating them into actionable ideas comes naturally for you.

• You thrive in a collaborative, flat environment that values transparency, openness, feedback and change.

• You don't shy away from negotiation -- you see it as an opportunity to establish credibility and a positive rapport with the client.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

EEO

Thoughtworks is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, stermination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Thoughtworks is also an affirmative action employer of veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Müüginõustaja, Lõunakeskus, Tartu (20h/n, tähtajaline - 31.12)
jobs.description:
MIDA SA TEED

Müüginõustajana mängid võtmerolli silmapaistva kliendikogemuse loomisel. Tervitad kliente, juhendad neid oma poes ja toetad neid meie tooteid tutvustades vajaliku leidmisel. Tegutsedes kooskõlas meie väärtustega, aitad kaasa nii enda kui ka ettevõtte edule.

Sinu ülesanded:

• Jagad oma moe- ja tooteteadmisi, et aidata klientidel teha teadlikke valikuid.
• Teed oma meeskonnaga koostööd, et pakkuda erakordset teenust klienditeekonna igal etapil.
• Veendud, et müügisaal ja tagaruumid oleksid hästi varustatud, organiseeritud ja kutsuvad.
• Toetad kaupluse avamisel ja sulgemisel.
• Esindad ennast ja brändi positiivselt kogu kliendisuhtluse ajal.

KELLEGA SA KOOSTÖÖD TEED

Meie kauplused on meie ettevõtte süda, kus kliendid kogevad meie kaubamärki omal nahal. Dünaamilise kaupluse meeskonna osana aitavad kõik rollid – alates müüginõustajatest, osakonnajuhatajatest, poe juhatajatest ja dekoraatoritest kuni kassahalduriteni – inspireeriva ja külalislahke keskkonna loomisele. Samuti saad luua ühenduse laiema piirkonna meeskonnaga, tehes kauplustes koostööd, et jagada teadmisi ja saavutada koos edu. Koos oma meeskonnaga mängid olulist rolli, et aidata klientidel end enesekindlalt tunda ja väljendada oma individuaalsust uusimate trendide ja ajatute stiilidega. Luues oma kauplustes klientidega sisukaid sidemeid, muudame moe kõigile kättesaadavaks ja jätkusuutlikuks.

KES SA OLED​

Otsime inimesi, kellel on…​

• Eeliseks peetakse klienditeeninduse kogemust moe-, jaemüügi- või sarnastes valdkondades.
• Kirg klientide abistamise vastu ja huvi moe või jaemüügi vastu – ülejäänu õpetame sulle!

Ja inimesi, kes on…​

• Edukad koostööl põhinevates ja dünaamilistes keskkondades.
• Suhtlemisaltid, loovad, uudishimulikud kaupluse tehnoloogiaga töötama, suure innuga õppida ja areneda.
• Paindlikud ja tegevusele orienteeritud.
• Oled 18+ aastane

KES ME OLEME

H&M Group on ülemaailmne ettevõte, mis koosneb tugevatest moebrändidest ja ettevõtmistest. Meie eesmärk on tõestada, et erakordse disaini, taskukohaste hindade ja jätkusuutlike lahenduste vahel pole kompromisse. Tahame vabastada moe paljude jaoks ja meie kliendid on iga meie otsuse keskmes.​

Meid ühendavad tuhanded kirglikud ja andekad kolleegid, keda omakorda ühendab meie ühine kultuur ja väärtused. Üheskoos tahame kasutada oma jõudu, ulatust ja teadmisi, et viia moetööstust kaasavama ja jätkusuutlikuma tuleviku poole. ​

MIKS SULLE MEELDIB SIIN TÖÖTADA ​

H&M Groupis oleme uhked, et oleme elujõuline ja külalislahke ettevõte. Pakume oma töötajatele atraktiivseid hüvesid koos ulatuslike arenguvõimalustega kogu maailmas. ​

• 25% töötajate soodustus kõigilt meie H&M Groupi kaubamärkidelt nii kauplustes kui ka veebis (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ja ARKET).​
• Mitmed lisasooduskupongid terve aasta vältel
• Paindlik töögraafik
• Tasustatud soovitusprogramm

LIITU MEIEGA

Meie ainulaadsus tuleneb paljude asjade kombinatsioonist – meie kaasavast ja koostöökultuurist, tugevatest väärtustest ja kasvuvõimalustest. Kuid ennekõike on meie inimesed need, kes teevad meist need, kes me oleme.​

Osakoormusega müügikonsultant (20 tundi nädalas), tähtajaline leping kuni 31.12.2026.

Palk 6,55 EUR/Tund

Astu koos meiega oma karjääris järgmine samm. Teekond algab siit.​

*Poe rollide hindamine:

Müüginõustaja rolli suure kandideerimismahu haldamiseks kasutame mõnes meie kaupluses oskuste põhiseks värbamiseks veebipõhist hindamismeetodit. Palun täida taotlus eelvalikuprotsessi osana. Sinu vastuseid hinnatakse H&M Groupi poolt kehtestatud eelnevalt määratud kriteeriumite alusel.

Pärast hindamise lõpetamist on sul võimalus jagada tagasisidet ja esitada küsimusi. Kui tekivad tõrked või eelistad alternatiivset hindamismeetodit, võta palun ühendust recruitment_support@hm.com. Alternatiivse meetodi valimine ei mõjuta sinu kandideerimise tulemust.

Lisateabe saamiseks selle kohta, kuidas me isikuandmeid töötleme, leiad  meie privaatsusteatest.

**Oleme pühendunud värbamisprotsessile, mis on aus, õiglane ja põhineb kompetentsusel. Seetõttu palume taotlusele kaaskirja mitte lisada.

• Suhtlemisaltid, loovad, uudishimulikud kaupluse tehnoloogiaga töötama, suure innuga õppida ja areneda.
• Paindlikud ja tegevusele orienteeritud.
• Oled 18+ aastane

KES ME OLEME

H&M Group on ülemaailmne ettevõte, mis koosneb tugevatest moebrändidest ja ettevõtmistest. Meie eesmärk on tõestada, et erakordse disaini, taskukohaste hindade ja jätkusuutlike lahenduste vahel pole kompromisse. Tahame vabastada moe paljude jaoks ja meie kliendid on iga meie otsuse keskmes.​

Meid ühendavad tuhanded kirglikud ja andekad kolleegid, keda omakorda ühendab meie ühine kultuur ja väärtused. Üheskoos tahame kasutada oma jõudu, ulatust ja teadmisi, et viia moetööstust kaasavama ja jätkusuutlikuma tuleviku poole. ​

MIKS SULLE MEELDIB SIIN TÖÖTADA​

H&M Groupis oleme uhked, et oleme elujõuline ja külalislahke ettevõte. Pakume oma töötajatele atraktiivseid hüvesid koos ulatuslike arenguvõimalustega kogu maailmas. ​

• 25% töötajate soodustus kõigilt meie H&M Groupi kaubamärkidelt nii kauplustes kui ka veebis (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ja ARKET).​
• Mitmed lisasooduskupongid terve aasta vältel
• Paindlik töögraafik
• Tasustatud soovitusprogramm

LIITU MEIEGA

Meie ainulaadsus tuleneb paljude asjade kombinatsioonist – meie kaasavast ja koostöökultuurist, tugevatest väärtustest ja kasvuvõimalustest. Kuid ennekõike on meie inimesed need, kes teevad meist need, kes me oleme.​

Osakoormusega müügikonsultant (20 tundi nädalas), tähtajaline leping kuni 31.12.2026

Palk 6,55 EUR/Tund

Astu koos meiega oma karjääris järgmine samm. Teekond algab siit.​

*Poe rollide hindamine:

Müüginõustaja rolli suure kandideerimismahu haldamiseks kasutame mõnes meie kaupluses oskuste põhiseks värbamiseks veebipõhist hindamismeetodit. Palun täida taotlus eelvalikuprotsessi osana. Sinu vastuseid hinnatakse H&M Groupi poolt kehtestatud eelnevalt määratud kriteeriumite alusel.

Pärast hindamise lõpetamist on sul võimalus jagada tagasisidet ja esitada küsimusi. Kui tekivad tõrked või eelistad alternatiivset hindamismeetodit, võta palun ühendust recruitment_support@hm.com. Alternatiivse meetodi valimine ei mõjuta sinu kandideerimise tulemust.

Lisateabe saamiseks selle kohta, kuidas me isikuandmeid töötleme, leiad  meie privaatsusteatest.

**Oleme pühendunud värbamisprotsessile, mis on aus, õiglane ja põhineb kompetentsusel. Seetõttu palume taotlusele kaaskirja mitte lisada.

jobs.title: Team Leader - Medium Merchant Business 2 - Nizamabad
jobs.description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
 
About the team: 
Medium Merchant Business verticals include digital payment enablement at all Dairy outlets and its ecosystem, and other
retail business. This team is predominantly responsible for handling end-to-end sales and operations
of this category.
 
About the role: 
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of POS/EDC through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.   
 
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive POS/EDC deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market. 
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.

9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
 
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal.
