Qualification:-
Graduate/Post Graduate.
 
Compensation:-
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

jobs.title: Obsluha automatického biomasového kotla (m/ž)
jobs.description:
Vďaka vašej práci môžu mať kolegovia počas celého roka komfortné a bezpečné pracovné prostredie.

Čo bude vašou náplňou práce?

• Zabezpečovať bezpečnú, spoľahlivú a efektívnu prevádzku kotolne a energetických zariadení
• Kontrolovať technický stav zariadení s cieľom predchádzať poruchám a odstávkam
• Odstraňovať poruchy strojov, zariadení a vykurovacích systémov
• Vykonávať preventívnu údržbu, servisné zásahy a mazanie zariadení
• Podieľať sa na opravách, výmene náhradných dielov a nastavovaní zariadení
• Prostredníctvom riadiaceho systému sledovať prevádzkové parametre, teploty a stav jednotlivých vetiev vykurovania
• Viesť prevádzkovú, servisnú a technickú dokumentáciu v interných systémoch
• Dodržiavať pravidlá bezpečnosti práce, požiarnej ochrany a ochrany životného prostredia

Koho hľadáme?

• Máte základné používateľské znalosti práce s PC
• Ste držiteľom osvedčenia na obsluhu vyhradených technických zariadení (VTZ) - tlakových nádob
• Vlastníte kuričský preukaz IV. triedy
• Máte oprávnenie na obsluhu plynových kotlov

Aké vlastnosti u vás oceníme?

• Zodpovedný prístup k práci a dôraz na bezpečnosť
• Technické myslenie a schopnosť riešiť vzniknuté problémy
• Samostatnosť pri výkone práce aj schopnosť spolupracovať v tíme
• Spoľahlivosť, presnosť a dôslednosť
• Ochotu učiť sa nové technológie a rozvíjať svoje odborné znalosti

Nástupná mzda: od 1400 € + mzdové príplatky (zmenná prevádzka) + bonus za spoľahlivú dochádzku

Prečo sa oplatí pracovať práve u nás?

✅ 13. plat - každý rok získate odmenu vo výške jednej mesačnej mzdy navyše

✅ 5 dní dovolenky nad rámec zákona pre viac času na oddych, rodinu a záľuby

✅ Výhodné stravovanie priamo v závode bez starostí s každodenným obedom

✅ Zamestnanecká zľava v IKEA na zariadenie domova podľa vlastných predstáv

✅ Príspevok do doplnkového dôchodkového sporenia pre väčšiu finančnú istotu do budúcnosti

✅ Atraktívne príplatky, jubilejné odmeny a ďalšie finančné benefity

✅ Možnosti odborného vzdelávania a kariérneho rozvoja, ktoré podporia váš profesijný rast

✅ Moderné fitness centrum priamo v závode, aby ste sa mohli starať o svoje zdravie a kondíciu

A k tomu stabilné zázemie medzinárodnej spoločnosti, priateľský tím a pracovné prostredie, kde záleží na ľuďoch.

jobs.title: Department Manager (Big Fashion Kragujevac)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao menadžer odeljenja, bićeš lider u pružanju podrške i podsticanju celog svog tima. Negujući inkluzivnu kulturu koja promoviše saradnju i preduzetnički duh, stvaraćeš okruženje u kome svako može da napreduje. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim ka postizanju izvanrednog iskustva kupaca, obezbeđujući odlične operativne i vizuelne standarde, dok aktivno promovišeš prodaju naših artikala.
• Preuzeti odgovornost za prednosti svog odeljenja i prodavnice, analizirati prodajne performanse, prepoznavati komercijalne mogućnosti, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Upravljati planiranjem tima i rasporeda i obezbeđivati neometane rutine zatvaranja i otvaranja prodavnice.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendova, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.
• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

​

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju, koristeći alate orijentisane prema kupcima i izveštavanje.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoj tim, dok ilustruju kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Uživaju u saradljivim i dinamičnim okolnostima, sa načinom razmišljanja koji je orijentisan prema pronalaženju rešenja.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše artikle.
• Istinski zainteresovani za modne trendove, komercijalnost i uvide u konkurente radi podsticanja prodaje.
• Efikasni u komunikaciji, kreativni i znatiželjni.
• Fleksibilni, analitični i orijentisani ka postignućima, sa umećem da upravljaju statistikom i rade sa brojevima.

​

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

​

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10% popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.
• Poklon kartica za bebu
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Poklon za odlazak u penziju
• Bonus za preporuku prijatelja protivvrednosti
• Naknada za prevoz
• Naknada za dugogodišnji rad u kompaniji nakon 10, 15 i 20 godina
• Božićni/Novogodišnji poklon za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser (Палма Мол Тетово)
jobs.description:
ШТО ЌЕ ПРАВИТЕ

Како визуелен комерцијалист, ќе играте клучна улога во создавањето инспиративно и конзистентно искуство на клиентите со имплементирање на визуелни стандарди и поттикнување на комерцијална извонредност. Постапувајќи во согласност со нашите вредности, ќе придонесете за вашиот успех и успехот на компанијата.

Вие ќе:

• Извршите визуелно, комерцијално и стајлинг курирање во согласност со упатствата и календарите на продавниците за да го подобрите искуството на клиентите и да ја зголемите продажбата во вашата продавница.
• Анализирате перформанси на продажба, одржувате нивоа на залихи, обезбедите грижа за облеката и идентификувате и давате приоритет на визуелните и комерцијалните можности во соработка со Менаџментот на продавницата.
• Ги користите вашите трендови и сознанија за конкурентите за да го обучите и развиете тимот на продавницата, опремувајќи ги да испорачаат одлично искуство за клиентите.
• Се претставувате себеси и брендот позитивно за време на сите интеракции со клиентите.
• Го поддржите продажниот пазар со проекти за проширување на продавниците.

СО КОЈ ЌЕ РАБОТИТЕ

Нашите продавници се срцето на нашата компанија, каде што клиентите го доживуваат нашиот бренд од прва рака. Како дел од динамичниот тим на продавницата, секоја улога - од советници за продажба, менаџери на одделенија, менаџери на продавници и визуелни трговци до одговорни за благајна - придонесува за создавање инспиративна и добредојдена средина. Ќе се поврзете и со поширокиот тим на Ареа, соработувајќи низ продавници за да споделувате увиди и заедно да постигнете успех. Заедно со вашиот тим, ќе играте витална улога во помагањето на клиентите да се чувствуваат сигурни и да ја изразат својата индивидуалност со најновите трендови и безвременски стилови. Со градење значајни врски со клиентите во нашите продавници, ја правиме модата достапна и одржлива за сите..

​

КОЈ СИ ТИ

Ние бараме луѓе со…​

• ​ Силна визуелна комерцијалност и комерцијално искуство во динамично опкружување, со начин на размислување ориентиран кон решенија.
• Познавање како да управувате, анализирате и постапувате по извештаите за продажба и равенката за продажба.

И луѓе кои се…​

• Страстни за модата и обезбедување на исклучително искуство во продавницата.
• Мотивирани да создаваат извонредни искуства за клиентите додека промовираат и поттикнуваат продажба.
• Креативен, љубопитен и проактивен.
• Вешти комуникатори кои можат да ги водат и инспирираат тимовите на продавниците да постигнат заеднички резултати.
• Флексибилни и ориентирани кон акција.

​

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ​

H&M Group е глобална компанија на силни модни брендови и вложувања. Нашата цел е да докажеме дека нема компромис помеѓу исклучителен дизајн, пристапни цени и одржливи решенија. Сакаме да ја ослободиме модата за многумина, а нашите клиенти се во срцето на секоја одлука што ја носиме.

Ние сме составени од илјадници страсни и талентирани колеги обединети со нашата заедничка култура и вредности. Заедно, сакаме да ја искористиме нашата моќ, нашата скала и нашето знаење, за да ја поттикнеме модната индустрија кон поинклузивна и одржлива иднина. ​

​

ЗОШТО ЌЕ САКАТЕ ДА РАБОТИТЕ ТУКА

Во H&M Group, ние сме горди што сме енергична и гостопримлива компанија. На нашите вработени им нудиме атрактивни придобивки со широки можности за развој низ целиот свет. ​

• 25% Попуст за персоналот на сите наши брендови на H&M Group, и во продавниците и на интернет
• Приватно здравствено осигурување
• HIP - Incentive program. Дознајте повеќе за програмата тука
• Награда за долгогодишна служба на 10, 15 и 20-годишнина
• Награда при пензионирање
• Подарок-картичка за новороденче
• Отсуство за татковство
• Надоместок за транспорт
• Божиќен/Новогодишен подарок за децата на вработените
• Бонус за препорака на пријател

ПРИДРУЖИ НИ СЕ

Нашата уникатност доаѓа од комбинација на многу нешта - нашата инклузивна и колаборативна култура, нашите силни вредности и можности за раст. Но, најмногу од сè, нашите луѓе нè прават она што сме.​

Аплицирајте со испраќање на вашето CV што е можно поскоро, но не подоцна од 15.11.2026. Поради политиките за податоци, ние прифаќаме апликации само преку страницата за кариера.

Направете го следниот чекор во вашата кариера со нас. Патувањето започнува тука.​

* Посветени сме на процес на регрутирање кој е фер, правичен и заснован на компетентност. Затоа ве замолуваме да не приложувате мотивационо писмо на вашата апликација.

jobs.title: Pardavėja (-s) konsultantė (-as) PC Akropolis, Klaipėda, (20h, laikinai)
jobs.description:
Kaip pardavėjas (-a)-konsultantas (-ė), atliksite pagrindinį vaidmenį nepriekaištingos klientų patirties kūrime. Jūs sutiksite klientus, padėsite orientuotis parduotuvėje ar surasti reikalingas prekes, tuo pat metu rodydami turimas prekes. Sekdami mūsų vertybes prisidėsite prie savo ir kompanijos sėkmės.

Atsakomybės:

• Dalinsitės žiniomis apie madą ir prekes su klientais, kad padėtumėte priimti gerai informuotą sprendimą.
• Bendradarbiausite su komanda, kad pateiktumėte geriausią klientų aptarnavimą kiekviename kliento kelionė žingsnyje.
• Užtikrinsite salės ir sandėlio pakankamus prekių kiekius, tvarką ir svetingą atmosferą,
• Padėsite su parduotuvės atidarymo ir uždarymo rutinomis.
• Atstovausite sau ir kompanijai bendraudami su klientais.

KOLEKTYVAS:

Mūsų parduotuvės – kompanijos širdis, nes čia klientai patiria tiesioginį sąlytį su mūsų prekės ženklu. Kaip dalis mūsų dinamiškos komandos, kiekvienas vaidmuo, nuo pardavėjo-konsultanto, skyriaus vadovo, parduotuvės vadovo, vizualistų iki grynųjų pinigų specialisto, prisideda prie įkvepiančios ir jaukios atmosferos kūrimo. Jūs taip pat bendradarbiausite ir su didesne regiono komanda, bendradarbiausite su kitomis parduotuvėmis dalindamiesi įžvalgomis ir pastebėjimais, kad ir toliau vystytumėte kompanijos, parduotuvių ir savo sėkmę. Kartu su komanda turėsite pagrindinį vaidmenį užtikrinant, kad klientai pasitiki savimi ir parodo savo individualumą, pasirinkdami prekes iš naujausių tendencijų ir ilgaamžiškų stilių. Kurdami, prasmę turinčius santykius su klientais mūsų parduotuvėse, mes užtikriname, kad mada yra prieinama ir tvari visiems.

KO TIKIMĖS IŠ JŪSŲ

Ieškome žmogaus, kuris…​

• Turį patirties klientų aptarnavime mados ar panašiose srityse. Patirtis yra privalumas.
• Jaučia aistrą padėti klientams ir jaučią aistra madai – viso kito išmokysime!

Ir žmonių, kurie…​

• Puikiai jaučiasi dirbdami komandoje ir dinamiškoje aplinkoje.

jobs.title: Head Of Risk and Financial Manager
jobs.description:
Working Model: Hybrid, with onsite working 2–3 days per week.
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 am–6 pm.
Contract type: Full-time, Permanent.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Risk professional to join our Group Risk function in a dual role as Head of Risk Malta and (Group) Financial Risk Manager. The role combines independent oversight of the risk profile of our Malta-regulated entity with broader responsibilities across Convera’s Group Financial Risk function, including capital, liquidity, market and counterparty credit risk. The successful candidate will work closely with senior management, the local Board, regulator (i.e. MFSA) and key functions across the organisation, providing independent risk oversight, challenge and practical recommendations.

You will be responsible for:

Head of Risk Malta / Entity Risk Oversight

• Provide independent oversight of CMFL's risk profile and report material risks, challenges, and recommendations to management and the Board.

• Maintain the Risk Appetite Statement, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and monitor risk appetite breaches.

• Act as the designated Outsourcing Officer, overseeing outsourcing, third-party, ICT, and intragroup arrangements.

• Review and challenge outsourcing assessments, due diligence processes, and exit plans, ensuring regulatory compliance.

• Lead engagement with the Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA) on risk-related matters, regulatory reviews, and remediation activities.

• Identify emerging risks and control weaknesses, challenge business processes, and monitor remediation actions through to completion.

• Support the implementation of Convera's risk frameworks, policies, and methodologies within the Malta entity.

• Provide oversight across operational risk, operational resilience, and ICT risk activities.

• Promote risk awareness and deliver risk training where appropriate.

Group Financial Risk Management

• Monitor regulatory capital and liquidity positions across entities, ensuring approved buffers and risk thresholds are maintained.

• Lead the preparation of wind-down plans, capital and liquidity stress testing, and support ICARA documentation.

• Conduct quantitative and qualitative financial risk analysis and provide recommendations to support risk appetite and governance decisions.

• Contribute to the oversight of market, counterparty credit, and liquidity risks associated with FX and payments activities.

• Support the development and enhancement of financial risk methodologies, monitoring tools, and management reporting.

• Participate in strategic and regulatory projects led by the Financial Risk function.

Stakeholder Management & Governance

• Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, including Board members, regulators, Finance, Treasury, Compliance, Legal, Credit, Procurement, and Risk teams.

• Act as a risk subject matter expert within cross-functional projects and governance forums.

• Support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory reviews.

You should apply if you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Risk Management, or a related discipline.

• At least 5 years of risk management experience within a regulated financial services environment, with significant exposure to financial risk.

• Strong knowledge of capital, liquidity, market risk, and counterparty credit risk, including hands-on experience with regulatory capital and liquidity monitoring, stress testing, and risk reporting.

• Experience preparing and presenting risk analysis, insights, and recommendations to senior management, risk committees, Boards, and regulators.

• Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into clear, practical conclusions and business recommendations.

• Experience with ICARA processes, wind-down planning, capital adequacy assessments, and liquidity risk frameworks.

• Experience in foreign exchange (FX), cross-border payments, or similar financial services products.

• Strong understanding of quantitative analysis, financial risk modelling, stress testing, and risk measurement techniques.

• Exposure to outsourcing and third-party risk management, operational resilience, and ICT risk oversight.

• Knowledge of the MFSA regulatory framework, as well as PSD2, MiFID II, and IFR/IFD regulatory requirements.

• Professional qualifications such as FRM (Financial Risk Manager), PRM (Professional Risk Manager), or CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) are highly desirable.

• Excellent written, verbal, analytical, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Treasury, Compliance, Legal, and Regulatory functions.

• Please note that the successful candidate's appointment will be subject to MFSA approval.

About Convera

Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs.

Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment.

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:

• Market competitive salary

• Opportunity to earn an annual bonus

• Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization

• A flexible approach to work (6-10 days per month in the office)

• Generous insurance (health, disability, life)

• Paid holidays, time-off, and leave policies for life events (maternity, paternity, adoption)

• 3 wellness days per year

• Paid volunteering opportunities (5 days per year)

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you’re ready to unleash your potential.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Adult Community Speech and Language Therapist – Hull

Banding: Band 6 / 7

Location: Community-Based Role

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: Ongoing Contract

Hourly Rate: Competitive (Dependent on Experience)

Working Hours: Full-time or Part-time Considered

Job Overview

Pulse is currently seeking an experienced Adult Community Speech and Language Therapist to join a community-based service.

This is an excellent opportunity for a clinician with experience in adult community and neurological caseloads to deliver specialist assessment and intervention for adults with communication and swallowing difficulties. The successful candidate will work face-to-face within community settings, supporting individuals with complex needs and helping to improve their quality of life through high-quality, patient-centred care.

The role is ideally suited to a Speech and Language Therapist who is confident working independently, managing a varied caseload, and delivering evidence-based dysphagia and communication interventions.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide specialist assessment, diagnosis, and treatment for adults with speech, language, communication, and swallowing disorders.

• Manage a varied adult community caseload, including patients with neurological conditions.

• Assess and manage dysphagia using evidence-based clinical approaches.

• Deliver face-to-face therapy within community settings.

• Develop and implement personalised treatment plans to meet individual patient needs.

• Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, carers, families, and other healthcare professionals.

• Maintain accurate clinical records and documentation in line with professional standards.

• Utilise electronic patient record systems to support clinical practice.

• Contribute to service development and quality improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and Experience

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Speech and Language Therapy.

• HCPC registration.

• Minimum of 2 years' experience working within adult community and/or neurological Speech and Language Therapy services.

• Dysphagia qualification and proven experience managing swallowing disorders.

• Experience working with complex adult neurological caseloads.

• Experience using SystmOne is desirable.

• Full UK driving licence and access to own transport.

• Excellent communication, organisational, and clinical reasoning skills.

• Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Department Manager (STOP SHOP Šabac)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao menadžer odeljenja, bićeš lider u pružanju podrške i podsticanju celog svog tima. Negujući inkluzivnu kulturu koja promoviše saradnju i preduzetnički duh, stvaraćeš okruženje u kome svako može da napreduje. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim ka postizanju izvanrednog iskustva kupaca, obezbeđujući odlične operativne i vizuelne standarde, dok aktivno promovišeš prodaju naših artikala.
• Preuzeti odgovornost za prednosti svog odeljenja i prodavnice, analizirati prodajne performanse, prepoznavati komercijalne mogućnosti, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Upravljati planiranjem tima i rasporeda i obezbeđivati neometane rutine zatvaranja i otvaranja prodavnice.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendova, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.
• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

​

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju, koristeći alate orijentisane prema kupcima i izveštavanje.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoj tim, dok ilustruju kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Uživaju u saradljivim i dinamičnim okolnostima, sa načinom razmišljanja koji je orijentisan prema pronalaženju rešenja.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše artikle.
• Istinski zainteresovani za modne trendove, komercijalnost i uvide u konkurente radi podsticanja prodaje.
• Efikasni u komunikaciji, kreativni i znatiželjni.
• Fleksibilni, analitični i orijentisani ka postignućima, sa umećem da upravljaju statistikom i rade sa brojevima.

​

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

​

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

​

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10% popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.
• Poklon kartica za bebu
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Poklon za odlazak u penziju
• Bonus za preporuku prijatelja protivvrednosti
• Naknada za prevoz
• Naknada za dugogodišnji rad u kompaniji nakon 10, 15 i 20 godina
• Božićni/Novogodišnji poklon za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Prijavi se slanjem svog CV-a što pre, a najkasnije do 15.11.2026. Zbog politike o zaštiti podataka, prihvatamo samo prijave putem stranice za zapošljavanje naše kompanije.

​

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.title: Sr.Account Development Representative (Spanish Speaker)
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik, Westgate Zaprešić
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

jobs.title: Sales Advisor (24 Horas)- Contrato Temporal
jobs.description:
Como Sales Advisor, eres la cara amable que recibe a nuestros clientes y encarnas el corazón de nuestra marca. Tendrás la oportunidad de ofrecer un servicio de alto nivel en cada interacción. Desde iniciar conversaciones hasta ayudar en la caja, los probadores y en toda la tienda, desempeñarás un papel vital en mejorar la experiencia de compra.

Tus responsabilidades también incluirán procesar entregas, reponer stock y presentar las últimas prendas en el piso de ventas.

Tu rol es esencial para crear experiencias acogedoras que reflejen lo mejor de nuestra marca. Con calidez y entusiasmo, guiarás a nuestros clientes en su recorrido, ofreciendo asistencia genuina y un servicio proactivo que inspire y motive. Junto con tu equipo, crearás momentos que importan.

Aunque tener experiencia previa en atención al cliente y conocimientos sobre tejidos es valorado, no es obligatorio.

• Orientación al cliente: Te gusta interactuar con personas y estás comprometido/a con ofrecer un excelente servicio.

• Adaptabilidad y flexibilidad: Capacidad para responder a prioridades cambiantes y solicitudes de los clientes.

• Proactividad: Iniciativa para actuar y lograr resultados con calidad.

• Buena comunicación: Interés genuino por las personas, te comunicas con claridad y escuchas activamente para comprender las perspectivas y necesidades de los demás.

• Ganas de aprender: Abierto/a a recibir retroalimentación y siempre buscando oportunidades para crecer y desarrollart.

• Entusiasmo por la marca: Pasión real por nuestra marca y colección, y disfrutas compartir ese entusiasmo con los clientes.

• Disponibilidad horaria: Disposición para trabajar en horarios variados, incluyendo noches y fines de semana.

Deseable pero no obligatorio:

• Conocimiento de operaciones en tienda y habilidades de atención al cliente adquiridas en experiencias previas en retail.
• Seguridad al ofrecer asesoramiento sobre tendencias de moda, materiales, tallas, etc.

• Este es un puesto de jornada parcial con un contrato TEMPORAL de 24 horas semanales para la campaña de Black Friday y Navidad. El contrato finalizará el 10 de enero de 2027 e incluye fines de semana y disponibilidad para trabajar en turnos entre las 7:00 y las 21.30

Beneficios:

Estamos comprometidos con apoyar a nuestros empleados con una variedad de beneficios atractivos y oportunidades de desarrollo. Como miembro de nuestro equipo, disfrutarás de un 25% de descuento en todas las marcas del Grupo H&M, tanto en tienda como online. Además, todos los empleados participan en nuestro Programa de Incentivos H&M (HIP), diseñado para recompensar tus contribuciones y apoyar tu crecimiento dentro de la empresa. Puedes leer más sobre el programa aquí.

Además, los compañeros con base en España también reciben:

• Día libre en tu cumpleaños
• Hasta 800 euros anuales para la compra de prendas de ropa en Arket
• Plataforma de descuentos: Advantages Club

Inclusión y Diversidad

En H&M Group, estamos comprometidos con fomentar lugares de trabajo inclusivos, diversos y equitativos en toda nuestra organización. Creemos que los equipos prosperan cuando reúnen una amplia gama de orígenes, perspectivas y experiencias. Esta diversidad mejora nuestra capacidad para resolver problemas de forma creativa, ampliar nuestro pensamiento y construir conexiones significativas con colegas y clientes en todo el mundo. Por eso, consideramos todas las dimensiones de la diversidad durante nuestro proceso de selección, asegurando que nuestra plantilla refleje la riqueza de las comunidades a las que servimos.

ARKET

ARKET ofrece colecciones esenciales para mujeres, hombres, niños y el hogar, junto con una cafetería vegetariana estacional y una tienda de café. Inspirado por la simplicidad, la naturaleza y la estética del slow living, el surtido presenta prendas, objetos y alimentos cuidadosamente elaborados y artísticamente seleccionados para una vida cotidiana más hermosa.

jobs.title: Seasonal Sales Ambassador
jobs.description:
As the Sales Associate, you are the friendly face that greet our customers and embody the heart of our brand.

You'll have the opportunity to provide customers with high-level service at every turn. From initiating conversations to assisting at the cash desk, fitting rooms and throughout the shop floor, you'll play a vital role in enhancing the shopping experience. Your responsibilities will also include processing deliveries, replenishing stock and merchandising the latest garments on the shop floor.

Your role is essential in creating welcoming experiences that showcase the best of our brand. With warmth and enthusiasm, you'll guide our customers through their journey, offering genuine assistance and proactive service to uplift and inspire. Together, in collaboration with your team, you’ll create moments that matter.

While previous experience in customer service and familiarity with fabrics are nice to have, they're not mandatory.

• Customer-focused: You enjoy engaging with people and are committed to delivering excellent service.
• Adaptable and flexible: Adaptable and responsive to changing priorities and customer requests.
• Action-oriented: Proactive and driven to take initiative and get things done with quality.
• Strong communicator: You have a genuine interest in people, communicate clearly, and actively listen to understand others perspectives and needs.
• Eager to learn: Open to feedback and always looking for opportunities to grow and develop.
• Brand enthusiast: You have a real passion for our brand and collection, and love sharing that enthusiasm with customers.
• Schedule flexibility: Willing and able to work varied hours, including evenings and weekends

• Preferable but not mandatory
• Understanding of store operations & customer service skills from previous retail experience
• Confident in offering customers advice on fashion trends, materials, sizing etc

• This is a part-time seasonal position. 10-20 hours per week.
• Compensation $17.50

As a member of our team, you’ll enjoy a 25% staff discount across all H&M Group brands—available both in-store and online. Additionally, every employee is included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP), designed to reward your contributions and support your growth within the company. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

n addition to this, US-based colleagues also receive:

• Employee Assistance program (EPA)
• Vacation/Wellness, Holiday, and Parental Pay
• 25% Staff Discount
• Commuter Benefits
• Pet Insurance (enrollment)

jobs.title: North American Sales Manager - Superhard Materials & Advanced Components
jobs.description:
Element Six is seeking an experienced, technically adept commercial leader to serve as Sales Manager – Advanced Diamond Materials & High-Tech Solutions (North America). Based at our Customer and Application Technology Centre (CATEC) in Santa Clara, CA, this role is responsible for delivering significant revenue in 2027 by driving commercial adoption of synthetic diamond solutions grown via Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD).

This position leads the commercialization of precision-engineered synthetic diamond materials, substrates, and components into high-value, volume-scaling technology applications where diamond's extreme physical, thermal, optical, and electrochemical properties outperform all conventional materials.

A primary strategic objective for this role is to partner with our Business Development and Operations teams to transition breakthrough designs into sustained high-volume production, driving capacity utilization of the CVD reactor fleet at our Gresham, Oregon synthesis facility.

1. Commercial Leadership & Revenue Delivery

• Own and execute the North American commercial growth strategy to hit and exceed the revenue target for 2027.
• Manage sales forecasting, pipeline conversion, pricing strategies, and contract negotiations across tier-1 technology OEMs, defense contractors, research institutions, and emerging tech innovators.
• Identify application opportunities where diamond’s superior thermal conductivity, optical transparency, wide bandgap, electrochemical stability, and hardness unlock step-change system performance while driving down total cost of ownership as CVD synthesis volumes scale.

2. Target Market & Application Focus

Lead customer acquisition and design-in cycles across core high-technology focus areas:

• Thermal Management: Diamond heat spreaders and substrates for next-gen semiconductor packaging, high-power compute/AI silicon cooling, optical transceivers for telecommunications, and defense RF/radar systems.
• Optical Systems: High-power laser optics, Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography windows, fusion energy diagnostics/optics, and advanced laser metrology.
• Quantum Technologies: Diamond substrates with engineered nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers for quantum sensing, magnetometry, RF detection, and quantum communications.
• Water Treatment & Electrochemistry: Boron-Doped Diamond (BDD) wafers and electrodes for industrial wastewater remediation, PFAS degradation, and electrochemical oxidation.
• Mechanical & Precision Applications: Precision mechanical CVD diamond wear parts, dressing tools, and abrasive solutions for mission-critical mechanical environments.

3. Team Leadership & Talent Development

• Directly lead, mentor, and hold accountable a high-performing 5-person technical sales and application team:3 Field Sales Account Managers: Covering regional territories and major target market verticals across North America.1 Diamond Applications Engineer: Providing front-line technical support, design-in assistance, and proof-of-concept modeling for prospective customers.1 Inside Sales Engineer: Managing rapid inbound customer conversion and driving digital sales through the Element Six e-commerce web platform.
• Foster a culture of technical rigor, active pipeline management, customer empathy, and aggressive value selling.

4. Operational Alignment & Capacity Utilization

• Collaborate closely with the Gresham, Oregon CVD production and engineering teams to balance customer demand forecasts with synthesis reactor schedules, ensuring flawless quality and on-time fulfillment.
• Align commercial strategy with plant economics, prioritizing product lines and large-scale supply agreements that maximize CVD reactor run-time and asset utilization at 100% capacity.
• Interface with the global Element Six Business Development and R&D organizations to transition new material formulations and product developments into scalable commercial revenue streams.

Position Requirements

Education

• Required: Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, or a closely related STEM discipline.
• Preferred: Master of Science (M.S.) in a technical discipline or a Master of Business Administration (MBA).

Experience & Industry Expertise

• 8–10+ years of progressive commercial sales and business development experience selling high-performance materials, advanced engineered components, or substrates into the semiconductor, optoelectronics, defense, or advanced hardware sectors.
• Minimum 3–5 years of direct commercial or technical experience involving synthetic diamond, carbon materials, wide bandgap semiconductors, or CVD thin-film/bulk material processes.
• Proven track record of managing a team delivering an annual revenue budget in OEM/design-in component environments.
• Deep understanding of high-tech OEM qualification lifecycles, IP frameworks, and custom material integration.
• Demonstrated leadership capability in coaching both technical application engineers and commercial sales representatives.
• Strong willingness to travel (approximately 30–40%) across North America to client facilities and the Gresham, Oregon production plant.

Other Skills and Capabilities

• Adaptability. Ability to work in a fast-moving work environment. Comfortable with leading change.
• Decision Making. Makes clear, timely decisions and gives explicit and clear guidance. Decisions are focused on increasing or improving the company’s options and are owned.
• Development. Comfortable working to develop the behaviour and performance of the team.Simplifies and Avoids Complexity. Doesn’t over-engineer solutions and stays focused on the problem being solved. Considers the implications of local decisions across the whole organisation.Accountability. Looks beyond what is good for the business. Holds self and others to account. Understands that no one can see the complete picture and values perspectives from across the business.Leadership. jobs.title: Founding Content Creator
jobs.description:
Founding Content Creator



Make Kai impossible for builders to ignore.

What would you make if your job was to take over the builder internet for the day?

We’re looking for a hands-on maker with serious video craft, sharp social instincts and the ambition to create breakout moments. Someone who sees the hook, makes the thing and gets it in front of people. You want real views, real conversation and work developers remember when they build their next feature.

Kai is k-ID’s self-serve console and SDK for age- and jurisdiction-adaptive access and consent. Builders declare what their product does; Kai configures the underlying Compliance Development Kit (CDK). Their app enforces the returned permissions. The question becomes: “What can this person do in my product, and what needs to happen first?”

Your job is to make that story travel.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Make the work yourself. Research, interview, write, record, edit, package and publish. Turn builder problems into screen-recorded demos, short videos, native posts and useful explainers. Own the hook, pacing, sound, captions, readable software screens, titles and thumbnails. Know when a simple screen recording is the strongest choice.

 - Create breakout moments. Build coordinated launches around a supported demo, a useful insight or a compelling builder story. Bring together a standout video or demo, platform-native edits, founder participation and credible distribution partners. Try to make Kai the thing builders are sharing today, then learn and launch again.

 - Develop founder voices. Interview our founders for their strongest ideas. Make distinct posts, videos and conversations that sound like them. Keep approvals lightweight and help them participate when builders respond. Give people a reason to follow their thinking, beyond reposting the company account.

 - Build precise creator collaborations. Find creators and practitioners who ship software and reach the right builders. Develop joint demos, interviews and launch assets. Carry the production work that makes collaboration easy. Own the brief, delivery, disclosure and distribution, choosing credible audience overlap over follower count or mass outreach.

 - Tell the technical story accurately. Use Kai, follow a supported integration with technical help and talk to builders about their decisions. Work with Product and Engineering to validate demonstrations. Explain age signals, consent and access permissions clearly. Keep limitations honest: Kai is not compliance certification or a guarantee of platform approval.

 - Improve through evidence. Choose a few formats you can make exceptionally well. Experiment with hooks, packaging and distribution; study what traveled and why. Participate usefully in builder communities. Report genuine reach and observable product outcomes separately, distinguish organic from paid delivery and reject manufactured engagement.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Finished video and social work that shows your taste, editing ability and understanding of how each platform works.

 - Evidence you can earn attention: a launch, a cold-start channel, a breakout post or a creator collaboration you helped make happen.

 - Technical curiosity and the ability to make a software demo understandable without making unsupported claims.

 - Strong interviewing and writing instincts, with the range to preserve someone else’s voice.

 - The judgment to move quickly, finish work independently and learn from an experiment that missed.

We care about what you can make and explain. Famous logos and a large personal following won’t substitute for craft. Tools and AI can speed up production; your taste and judgment still decide what ships.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

More genuine views and impressions. Stronger sharing. Growing social audiences. Founder ideas reaching new circles. Launch moments that break beyond the people who already know us.

Builder adoption matters too: people understand Kai, visit, sign up, integrate and keep using it where those outcomes can be observed. A big attention win matters before it becomes revenue. A large view count does not prove product use. We want both reported honestly.




KAI FIRST

You’ll report to Mike Mongeau, Head of Product, and work with Product, Design and Engineering. You own media, social execution, founder programming and selected creator collaborations; product decisions and compliance sign-off stay with their owners.

Once a Kai approach works, we may reuse the production and launch kit for one bounded Ventures product, with an explicit priority and capacity decision, including what pauses. You won’t be running every venture at once.




HOW TO APPLY

Include a small portfolio of finished videos and social work you personally made. Tell us exactly what you did, the audience you were trying to reach, the observed results and their time window. Include one experiment that failed and what you learned. Be ready to walk through your source files and decisions.

Finalists may be invited to a three-hour take-home exercise, with no live posting or outreach.

If you’d rather make the thing than present the plan, we’d like to see your work.

Job Title: Adult Acute Speech and Language Therapist - Barnsley

Banding: Band 6 / 7

Location: Barnsley

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: Ongoing Contract

Hourly Rate: Competitive (Dependent on Experience)

Working Hours: Full-time or Part-time Considered

Job Overview

Pulse is currently seeking an experienced Adult Acute Speech and Language Therapist to join the team at Barnsley Hospital NHS Foundation Trust.

This is an excellent opportunity to work within a dynamic acute service, providing highly specialist assessment and therapy for adults with complex communication and swallowing disorders. The successful candidate will manage a varied caseload and play a key role in delivering evidence-based interventions for patients with complex clinical needs, including dysphagia.

You will work closely with the multidisciplinary team, delivering specialist assessments, diagnosis, and treatment while contributing to the ongoing development of acute Speech and Language Therapy services.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide highly specialist Speech and Language Therapy assessment and intervention for adults with complex communication and swallowing difficulties.

• Assess, diagnose, and manage patients presenting with dysphagia using evidence-based practice.

• Undertake and contribute to instrumental swallowing assessments, including Videofluoroscopic Swallow Studies (VFSS) and Fibreoptic Endoscopic Evaluation of Swallowing (FEES).

• Develop and implement individualized treatment plans to support patient recovery and rehabilitation.

• Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to optimize patient outcomes.

• Provide specialist advice and support to patients, families, carers, and healthcare professionals.

• Maintain accurate clinical records and reports in line with professional and organizational standards.

• Contribute to service development, audits, and quality improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and Experience

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Speech and Language Therapy.

• HCPC registration.

• Experience working within adult acute Speech and Language Therapy services.

• Proven competency in dysphagia assessment and management.

• Experience working with complex adult caseloads.

• Knowledge and experience of instrumental swallowing assessments, including VFSS and FEES, is desirable.

• Excellent communication, clinical reasoning, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Store Manager (Pančevo)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao Store Manager, nadgledaćeš čitavo iskustvo kupaca, obezbeđujući visoke vizuelne i komercijalne standarde koji su u skladu sa globalnim strategijama i kontekstom tvoje lokalne prodavnice. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim u prodavnici, kako biste zajedno ostvarili izvanredno iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišete i prodajete naše artikle.
• Biti u toku sa prednostima i prilikama za razvoj svoje prodavnice, kao i ponudom konkurenata, uz snažno razumevanje lokalnog tržišta i potreba kupaca.
• Analizirati prodajne performanse, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Efikasno upravljati rasporedima i održavanjem prodavnice, u skladu sa prodajnim budžetom i komercijalnim prioritetima.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendovima, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.
• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Dokazanim snažnim liderstvom, sa strašću prema podučavanju i razvoju timova, ilustrujući kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Dokazanim rezultatima u korišćenju alata orijentisanim prema kupcima i izveštavanju.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoje timove sa integritetom.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše atikle.
• Ambiciozni i motivisani performansom i postizanjem ciljeva.
• Analitični, usmereni ka rešavanju problema, sa odličnim veštinama u komunikaciji i smislom za rad sa brojevima i statistikom.
• Fleksibilni i orijentisani prema rešenjima.
• Strastveni kada je reč o modnim trendovima, komercijalnosti i vizuelnoj prezentaciji, sa snažnom svešću o konkurentima.
• Dobro poznavanje engleskog jezika smatraće se prednošću.

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10 popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories i ARKET).​
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.​
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Dodatni dani godišnjeg odmora na ukupan staž
• Bonus za perporuku prijatelja u iznosu do 120 evra u dinarskoj protivvrednosti
• Online i uživo treninzi za zaposlene u cilju učenja i razvoja
• Mogućnost napredovanja i razvoja u okviru kompanije
• Poklon kartica za rođenje deteta
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad
• Novogodišnji pokloni za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.description:
В качестве Продавца - Кассира в H&M вы сыграете ключевую роль в создании выдающегося покупательского опыта. Вы будете приветствовать покупателей, помогать им ориентироваться в магазине и находить нужные товары, в также представлять нашу продукцию. Действуя в соответствии с нашими ценностями, вы будете способствовать как собственному успеху, так и успеху компании.

Ваши обязанности:

• Использование знаний о моде и товарах для помощи покупателям в выборе.
• Сотрудничество с командой для обеспечения высокого уровня сервиса на всех этапах обслуживания.
• Поддержание порядка и достаточного количества товаров на торговом зале и в складских помещениях.
• Участие в открытии и закрытии магазина.
• Дружелюбное и профессиональное представление себя и бренда при каждом взаимодействии с покупателями.

С КЕМ ВЫ БУДЕТЕ РАБОТАТЬ ​

Наши магазины — это сердце компании, где покупатели впервые знакомятся с брендом. Вы станете частью динамичной команды, включающей Продавцов-Кассиров, Заведующих Отделов, Менеджеров Магазинов, Визуальных Мерчандайзеров, а также Ассистентов Менеджеров Магазина, Менеджеров по Кассовым Операциям и Специалистов по Приему Товаров в Крупных Магазинах. Кроме того, вы будете взаимодействовать с Региональной Area командой, обмениваясь опытом и совместно работая над достижением успеха. Вместе с коллегами вы будете помогать покупателям чувствовать уверенность и выражать свою индивидуальность с помощью модных и стильных решений. Благодаря нашим магазинам мы делаем моду доступной и устойчивой для всех.

КОГО МЫ ИЩЕМ ​

Мы ищем кандидатов с…​

• Опыт работы в сфере обслуживания покупателей в модной индустрии, ритейле или смежных областях.
• Страсть к работе с покупателями и интерес к моде или ритейлу - остальному мы вас научим!

И тех, кто…​

• Комфортно работает в командной и динамичной среде.
• Обладает хорошими коммуникативными навыками, креативностью и готовностью изучать технологии работы магазина.
• Гибок, активен и ориентирован на результат.

КТО МЫ ​

H&M Group — это глобальная компания, объединяющая сильные модные бренды и инновационные проекты. Мы стремимся доказать, что стильный дизайн, доступные цены и устойчивые решения могут идти рука об руку. Мы хотим сделать моду доступной для всех, и наши покупатели находятся в центре каждого принятого решения.​

​Наша команда состоит из тысяч увлеченных и талантливых людей, объединенных общей культурой и ценностями. Вместе мы используем свои возможности, масштаб и знания, чтобы двигать индустрию моды в сторону более инклюзивного и устойчивого будущего. ​

ПОЧЕМУ ВАМ ПОНРАВИТСЯ У НАС РАБОТАТЬ ​

В H&M Group мы гордимся тем, что создаем яркую и дружелюбную рабочую среду. Мы предлагаем нашим сотрудникам привлекательные условия и широкие возможности для профессионального роста по всему миру. ​

• 25% Скидка для сотрудников на все бренды H&M Group, как в магазинах, так и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).​
• Медицинское страхование здоровья
• Подарок к рождению ребенка
• Гибкие часы работы
• Реферальная программа
• Безграничные карьерные возможности
• Платформа для обучения Learning Studio

ПРИСОЕДИНЯЙТЕСЬ К НАМ​

Наша уникальность заключается в сочетании многих факторов: инклюзивной и сплоченной культуры, сильных ценностей и возможностей для развития. Но самое главное — это люди, которые делают нас теми, кто мы есть.​

Сделайте следующий шаг в своей карьере вместе с нами. Ваше путешествие начинается здесь.​

Из-за большого количества заявок на позицию Продавца-Кассира, в некоторых магазинах мы используем онлайн-оценку навыков. Вам потребуется пройти ее в рамках отбора. Ваши ответы будут оценены с помощью специального инструмента на основе заранее определенных критериев H&M Group.

После завершения оценки у вас будет возможность оставить обратную связь и задать вопросы. Если у вас возникнут трудности или вы предпочитаете альтернативный способ оценки, свяжитесь с нами по адресу recruitment_support@hm.com.   Выбор другого метода не повлияет на вашу заявку.

jobs.title: Head of Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT SIMPLE

Simple AI builds voice AI agents that help businesses grow revenue. Our customers include Omaha Steaks, DoorDash, and Renewal by Andersen. Our agents qualify leads, book appointments, take orders, and upsell, turning phone conversations into revenue opportunities.

Simple AI raised $14M from world-class investors and operators like Y Combinator, First Harmonic, Massive Tech Ventures, Michael Seibel, Jared Friedman, Alexandr Wang, Matt Van Horn, Suhail Doshi, and Scott Wu.

 


THE TEAM

The founders (Catheryn https://www.linkedin.com/in/catherynli/ and Zach https://www.linkedin.com/in/zach-kamran/) met while running software teams at YC, where they shipped tons of new products for YC founders, including YC’s co-founder matching site. Cat previously worked at Instagram and Facebook and earned degrees in math and computer science at MIT. Zach previously studied computer science and statistics at U Chicago and led software at PEAK6. We have grown into a strong team of 20+ and are continuing to scale quickly.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring our first Head of Sales to partner directly with our CEO and lead Simple's next phase of enterprise growth. You will own the revenue number, personally lead our most important deals, and turn our early sales motion into a repeatable engine.

This is a hands-on player-coach role, not a position for someone who wants to manage from the sidelines. You will prospect, run discovery, shape business cases, navigate complex buying committees, negotiate, and close while hiring and coaching the sales team around you. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and our customer-facing technical teams to sell a deeply technical product through measurable business outcomes.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary & meaningful equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - An office located in SF

 - Health, dental & vision insurance

 - Free lunch & dinner at the office

 - Late night Ubers

 - Regular team events & offsites
   
    


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including experience leading or coaching quota-carrying sellers in an early-stage or high-growth company.

 - A track record of personally exceeding seven-figure annual quotas and repeatedly closing six-figure enterprise deals.

 - Experience building a sales motion, territory, team, or playbook from an early stage

 - Strong enterprise deal judgment across outbound, multi-threaded discovery, executive alignment, technical evaluations, security, legal, and procurement.

 - Rigorous pipeline management and forecasting skills, paired with the willingness to get on calls and show the team what great selling looks like.

 - High agency, urgency, low ego, and excitement to work in person with the team in San Francisco.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Sold AI, automation, developer tools, or another technical enterprise product.

 - Closed deals with the decision makers of contact centers, customer experience, operations, or revenue leaders.

 - Partnered closely with founders, engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, or Solutions Engineers on complex deals.

 


IF YOU’RE A HUNGRY SALES LEADER EXCITED TO CLOSE ENTERPRISE DEALS, BUILD A HIGH-PERFORMING TEAM, AND HELP TURN OUR AMBITIOUS GROWTH GOALS INTO REALITY, WE’D LOVE TO CHAT.

Please note: At this time, Simple AI is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this role. We appreciate your interest and understanding.

jobs.title: Software Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 




THE ROLE

Superconducting quantum processing units (QPUs) require sophisticated classical software to characterise and calibrate them before they can run quantum applications. At QuantWare, our calibration software is a critical part of QPU development and production, ensuring that our QPUs deliver the best possible performance.

 

QuantWare is looking for an exceptional Software Manager to build and lead the team that delivers it. As line, hiring and project manager of our Calibration Software team, you will grow it to a larger team over the coming years, comprising both physicists and software engineers. You will work closely with our Technical Lead, Product Manager and PMO Programme Manager.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Core Responsibilities

 - Grow the team: Grow and develop the Calibration Software team. Own the hiring plan, process and decisions, including hiring rare quantum domain experts together with our Technical Lead.

 - Lead project execution: Set up the team’s ways of working with the Technical Lead and PMO, turn roadmaps into team plans, and manage day-to-day project execution.

 - Raise the engineering standard: Bring production-grade practices to code review, testing, CI/CD, contribution models and AI-assisted development.

 - Support our users: Balance the needs of different users, from QPU development to production.


YOUR PROFILE

 - Team leadership: 4+ years managing and growing technical R&D teams in a hardware-facing setting, including scientists or physicists.

 - Building from scratch: You have built a team from an early stage, in a start-up or scale-up.

 - Hiring: You have hired at pace, including rare domain experts outside your own expertise.

 - Software delivery: You have led software development projects from planning to delivery in a research or scientific-instrumentation setting.

 - Communication: You communicate clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Domain expertise: A quantum computing background is a plus, not required.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

 - Support semiconductor equipment integration and factory automation projects.

Manufacturing Systems Integration

 - Develop and support APIs, web services, and enterprise system integrations.

 - Support Industry 4.0, Digital Manufacturing, and Smart Factory initiatives.

Project Execution & Support

 - Support multiple MES and automation projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and delivery schedules.

 - Perform system and equipment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

 - Support deployment and production ramp-up of new manufacturing systems and automation solutions.

 - Hands-on experience with MES Master Data, Flow Creation, Constraint Management, Dispatch Management, and DOE.

 - Semiconductor equipment and tool integration.

 - Equipment characterisation, automation simulation, testing, and validation.

 - Custom automation and interlock development.

 - Knowledge of database concepts and system interfaces.

 - Experience with APIs, web services, and enterprise integrations.

 - Experience with C++, C#, .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript, and/or modern software development technologies.

 - Experience with Oracle/SQL databases and object-oriented programming.

 - Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in SECS/GEM development, template creation, equipment automation, or semiconductor equipment integration.

 - Demonstrated experience delivering MES or automation projects from design through deployment and production support.

 - Experience working with multiple equipment types, manufacturing systems, or automation platforms.
