jobs.title: Project Executive
jobs.description:
About us:

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health.  Within Inizio Ignite, the Insights team is comprised of Research Partnership and STEM.

Research Partnership (RP) is one of the world's largest pharma market research and consulting agencies with over 250 researchers, consultants, project managers and support staff. Our teams are located across the globe, in Europe (London, Lyon), North America (New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco) and Asia (Singapore, Delhi).

Your primary role:

The Project Executive plays a key role in the effective delivery of projects across Inizio Ignite, Insights, coordinating interview scheduling, project administration and field operations support across Research Partnership and Ignite Insights. The role takes ownership of complex scheduling activities, including direct engagement with senior client stakeholders, while ensuring project information, timelines and communications remain accurate and up to date. Working closely with Project Directors, Project Managers, Field Specialists and clients, the Project Executive proactively manages competing priorities, resolves scheduling challenges and escalates risks to help keep projects on track and support a seamless client experience.

Key Responsibilities

Project Coordination and Administration

• Set up and maintain projects within internal project management systems, ensuring project details, stakeholder information, schedules and key milestones remain accurate and up to date.

• Coordinate activities across a high-volume pipeline of active and upcoming projects, managing changing timelines and competing priorities.

• Respond to project-related queries and provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support to Project Managers and wider project teams.

• Proactively identify missing information, scheduling conflicts or potential delays and work with relevant teams to resolve them.

Fieldwork Interview Scheduling and Coordination

• Coordinate interviews with client stakeholders and research participants, managing initial scheduling, follow-ups, cancellations and reschedules through to confirmation.

• Proactively manage outreach and follow-up to secure interviews within project timelines.

• Coordinate the availability and assignment of internal and external interviewers, ensuring they receive the information and briefing materials required ahead of each interview.

• Prepare and distribute interview invitations and joining information, ensuring all parties have accurate and timely details.

• Identify scheduling risks and delays early, taking action to resolve them or escalating where appropriate.

Client and Senior Stakeholder Coordination

• Provide client-facing scheduling support to senior members of the project team, acting as a key point of coordination between internal teams and client stakeholders.

• Communicate directly with senior client stakeholders and their administrative teams to coordinate interviews and other project activities.

• Build effective working relationships with client contacts to navigate complex diaries, changing availability and tight project timelines.

• Manage routine client queries independently and use sound judgement to identify when senior project team involvement is required.

• Work closely with senior internal stakeholders, using shared calendars and communication tools to respond quickly to client availability and changing project requirements.

• Provide regular progress reporting, highlighting outstanding actions, scheduling risks and stakeholders requiring additional follow-up or escalation.

Project Communication and Team Support

• Provide clear and timely project updates to Project Managers and senior project leads, ensuring visibility of progress, outstanding actions and potential risks.

• Coordinate client calls, project kick-offs, presentations and other meetings as required.

• Maintain proactive and professional communication with internal teams, interviewers, research participants and clients throughout the project lifecycle.

• Provide scheduling and operational coverage across the wider team during periods of high demand.

Financial and Operational Support

• Process and reconcile project expenses accurately and within required timelines.

• Track operational support activity and maintain accurate records to support client billing and internal reporting.

• Provide additional operational and administrative support to project teams as required.

Virtual Meeting Coordination

• Set up interviews and project meetings across a range of virtual meeting platforms, ensuring invitations, joining details and meeting requirements are accurate.

• Develop strong knowledge of preferred meeting platforms and internal processes to support efficient and consistent project delivery.

Qualifications and Skills

• Strong organisational and scheduling skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, complex calendars and competing priorities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and professionalism to communicate directly with senior client stakeholders.

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at different levels.

• A proactive approach, with a strong sense of urgency and the ability to anticipate and resolve problems in time-sensitive situations.

• Excellent attention to detail and discretion when handling confidential information, calendars, project records and financial information.

• Strong follow-up skills, with the confidence to drive actions forward and escalate risks or delays appropriately.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership and remain organised within a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

• Previous experience in project coordination, scheduling, operations, market research, client services or a similar role is preferred.

• Experience using project management, scheduling or workflow platforms would be advantageous.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Microsoft Office and virtual meeting platforms.

Life at Research Partnership:

We love what we do and continuously strive for innovation and creativity. We believe everyone should continuously be learning and provide:

• A comprehensive training and development programme for all staff, from entry level apprentice to senior management

• A relaxed and friendly working environment

• Social events - including a summer day out and end of year party, along with regular social events after office hours

Employee Benefits:

• Remote and hybrid work options

• A comprehensive training and development program

• Opportunities for internal advancement

• Annual salary and promotion review

• Paid vacation and personal time off

• 401(k) plan

• Medical/vision/dental/prescription insurance plans, including heath savings and flexible spending accounts

• Company paid life insurance

• Short term/long term disability

• Employee Assistance Programs

Our Pledge

At Research Partnership, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity, and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a work environment that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications regardless of race, colour, religion or belief, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation and physical or mental disability.

Further information:

This is a full-time role. You can choose to work out of our Yardley, PA (Philadelphia), or York, PA offices on a hybrid pattern (1-2 days per week in the office).

Compensation

Salary Range Compensation: $55,000 - $60,000 per year. The range listed may be just one component the total compensation package. This range may also differ based on the applicant’s geographic location and cost of living considerations.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation

$55,000—$60,000 USD

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

jobs.title: Director of Data and Analytics, Self Service Cloud
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Head of Data and Analytics to own data and analytics for Elastic Cloud's self-service business, spanning Product, Growth Marketing, Web, and Documentation. You'll be accountable for delivering accurate and timely business and operational insights to executive leadership, and for building a single view of the customer journey across Elastic's self-service touchpoints - Paid Ads, Web, Documentation, and Product.

This is a player-coach role that spans strategy, team building, and hands-on technical work. You'll build robust data pipelines, transformations, a data warehouse, and BI reporting; own data management and governance as the steward of core data definitions and golden queries; and build and scale a team of Data Engineers and Data Analysts.

What You Will Be Doing

• Business Insights & Executive Reporting Deliver accurate and timely business and operational insights to executive leadership, covering funnel performance, revenue, and initiative impact Own the reporting cadence for the self-service business - weekly operating reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly planning Help business teams answer ad hoc analytics questions through building dashboards and through building self-serve reporting via trusted AI-powered chat responses Single View of the Customer Journey Build a single view of the customer journey across Elastic's self-service touchpoints - Paid Ads, Web, Documentation, and Product Solve identity resolution across anonymous and known users so the funnel can be measured end to end, from first touch to paying customer Partner with Growth Marketing on attribution and channel measurement, and with Product on activation and conversion analytics Data Engineering & Platform Build robust data pipelines, data transformations, a well-modeled data warehouse, and BI reporting the business can rely on Set the technical architecture and tooling standards for ingestion, orchestration, transformation, and visualization Ensure data quality, freshness, and reliability with monitoring, testing, and clear SLAs Data Management & Governance Own data management and governance for the self-service business, acting as the steward of core data definitions and golden queries Establish a single source of truth for core metrics Set instrumentation and tracking standards with Product, Web, and Marketing so new data lands clean Team Leadership Build, scale, and lead a small distributed team of Analytics Engineers, Data and Business Analysts Coach and develop the team, and set a high bar for craft, rigor, and speed Prioritize the team against the highest-impact business questions Cross-Functional Collaboration Work with Product, Growth Marketing, Web, and Documentation teams to define metrics, instrument experiences, and answer their operational questions Partner with Elastic's central Data and IT teams on shared infrastructure, data sources, and standards Act as a thought partner to the GM and functional leads on what the data says and what to do about it What You'll Drive Trusted executive reporting: accurate, timely business and operational insights leadership uses to run the business Single customer journey view: end-to-end measurement across Paid Ads, Web, Documentation, and Product Reliable data platform: robust pipelines, warehouse, and BI reporting the business can build on Data governance: a single source of truth for core data definitions and golden queries Team performance: a high-performing team of Data Engineers and Data Analysts with repeatable practices

What You Bring

• 10+ years of data and analytics experience at B2B enterprise SaaS companies, with 3+ years building and leading teams of data engineers and analysts

• Direct experience supporting a product-led growth (PLG) motion alongside an enterprise sales motion (e.g., Datadog, MongoDB, Atlassian, Confluent)

• Hands-on depth across the modern data stack: SQL, pipeline orchestration (Airflow or similar), transformation frameworks (dbt or similar), cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, or similar)

• Experience with product and web analytics tools (Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar) and marketing attribution

• Proven track record building a single view of the customer across marketing, web, and product data, including identity resolution

• Experience establishing data governance: metric definitions, golden queries, instrumentation standards, and data quality practices

• Strong business sense: able to translate executive questions into analysis, and analysis into decisions

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, from executive presentations to technical detail

• Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, energized by building systems that don't exist yet

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.  In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

$169,700—$268,400 USD

The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:

$203,900—$322,600 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

• Generous number of vacation days each year

• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Flora
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London

About the Role

Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated. Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet.

Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web.

AI Search (internal data), now generally available, is the search primitive for applications and agents. It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on Workers AI, Vectorize, R2, and Browser Run. Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs.

Web Search API (external data), now in open beta, gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on AI Gateway, so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as model inference. Developers can choose from multiple search providers and always get results back in one normalized format.

Your mission in this role is to make Cloudflare the default place developers and agents go to search, across both their own data and the open web, and eventually in a single call. You’ll also help build a search ecosystem that works for AI companies, site owners, and creators alike.

What You’ll Do

• Talk directly with developers, AI companies, publishers, and customers every day.

• Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Agentic Search (AI Search and Web Search API), from ingestion and indexing through retrieval, ranking, and answer generation.

• Define and measure what “good search” means, including relevance, freshness, latency, and cost, and build the evals that improve it with every release.

• Scale AI Search for the workloads that matter most, like multi-tenant platforms, enterprise agents, and website search, with support for billions of documents, rich media, and built-in observability.

• Take Web Search API and shape what comes next: provider partnerships, search and page extraction in one call, blending web and private data,

• Own pricing and packaging, and make our products first-class for agents through MCP, agent-friendly APIs, and templates like NLWeb.

• Partner with engineering, ML, and product teams across Workers AI, Vectorize, AI Gateway, Browser Run, and AI Crawl Control, as well as Marketing, DevRel, BD, Sales, and Support.

• Represent Cloudflare at conferences, community events, and customer and partner meetings.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Proven experience as a PM, EM, or founder shipping search, information retrieval, data infrastructure, or developer platform products. You’ve led teams to ship before and can point to impact.

• Deep understanding of how search works end to end: crawling, indexing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector), query rewriting, reranking, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). You understand the tradeoffs between relevance, freshness, latency, and cost.

• Experience defining and measuring search quality, including offline evals, relevance judgments, metrics like recall, MRR, and NDCG, and online experimentation.

• Fluency in the modern AI ecosystem: LLMs, text and multimodal embedding models, agents, tool calling, and MCP. You’ve built with them yourself and know where they break.

• Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast. You’ve built a RAG pipeline or an agent that searches the web, and you have opinions about what made it good or bad.

• Deep empathy for developers and understanding of their workflows, pain points, and how they adopt new tools and platforms.

• Understanding of the web publishing ecosystem: crawlers, bots, SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO), and the changing economics of AI search for content creators. Comfortable working where technology, business, and policy meet.

• Experience with usage-based pricing, two-sided marketplaces, or partner and business development relationships, including build-vs-partner decisions, is a plus.

• Exceptional communication and collaboration skills. You can translate between ML research, infrastructure engineering, and business stakeholders, and align diverse teams on goals.

• Passion for design details and polish. You raise the bar for sweating the details.

• External presentation skills. You can walk into a room of developers or AI company leaders and build trust and credibility.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Seattle/NYC/California based hires - Estimated annual salary of: $172,000 - $215,000

• For SF/Bay Area based hires - Estimated annual salary of: $179,000 - $224,000

• For Lisbon based hires - Estimated annual salary of: €68,000 - €85,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Impulsionar os processos e práticas de controlo financeiro interno e monitorizar o cumprimento do quadro de Controlo Financeiro Interno (IFC) aprovado pelo Grupo, com o objetivo de melhorar, influenciar e moldar continuamente a capacidade de IFC da Unidade de Negócios/País.

Manter um balanço patrimonial e certificações resilientes (monitorização de contas de suspensão, certificações de saldos de caixa das agências, acréscimos, etc.) de acordo com a política de comprovação do balanço patrimonial e comunicar os resultados das certificações à equipa de Controlo Financeiro Interno da Unidade de Negócio.

Analisar a integridade dos dados e informações financeiras transacionais através da recolha, análise, interpretação e comunicação de informações financeiras.

Analisar e interpretar dados para fornecer informações de gestão financeira às partes interessadas da empresa para a tomada de decisões (poupanças na distribuição, relatórios sobre o quadro de pessoal, perdas operacionais, etc.), o que inclui a colaboração com a área de Risco Não Financeiro (NFR) para promover

a resolução de riscos financeiros.

Preparar e apoiar a elaboração das demonstrações financeiras estatutárias e regulamentares, garantindo conformidade com as normas IFRS e com os requisitos do regulador.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Pacing
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Pacing is Anthropic's work to make sure that, as AI capabilities advance, enough time and effort goes into making them safe. It covers the safety commitments we make and carry out ourselves, the public policy we develop and support, and the research and communication that help people understand how quickly AI is progressing and what that could mean.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to run Pacing. It spans many projects led by people across Safety, Research, Policy, Legal, Communications, and Engineering, most of whom have other responsibilities too. You'll make sure each project has an owner, a clear outcome, and a date, and that leaders have high visibility and can make tradeoff decisions. You'll work closely with the team responsible for our Responsible Scaling Policy and support every project lead in delivering on their commitments.

The questions and strategies relevant to this program will change rapidly as the frontier evolves. You'll need enough technical depth to drive discussions about model training, evaluations, and compute, and the judgment to identify which decisions belong with cross-functional partners and which you can make yourself. We're looking for a generalist who can ship quickly and iteratively and drive accountability towards high-level, ambiguous objectives.

Key responsibilities

• Own the Pacing program end to end, keeping one accurate view of projects, owners, milestones, dependencies, and gaps that drives action from leadership and project leads

• Turn strategy from executive sponsors into scoped projects with measurable outcomes and timelines for execution, and drive concrete proposals to decisions

• Run the operating rhythm, including working sessions with project leads, regular written updates, and effective executive reviews, and follow decisions and action items through to completion

• Work with the Responsible Scaling Policy team and researchers to define the evidence and sign-off a model needs at key points in training and deployment, and make those reviews a dependable part of how we work

• Track the public and internal commitments Anthropic makes on pacing, and sequence the work, publications, and events behind them with Policy and Communications

• Partner with Legal throughout the lifespan of each project, and operate with high integrity on confidential and sensitive work

• Define how progress is measured, report against it candidly, and recommend which projects and practices to continue, change, or stop

• Use Claude to build automations to allow teams to have broader and deeper impact

Minimum qualifications

• Experience leading multiple complex technical programs that span organizations and involve engineering or research teams, from ambiguous goals through delivery

• Strong program management skills, including program planning, milestone and dependency tracking, and risk management across many concurrent projects

• Technical fluency sufficient to identify risks and challenge tradeoffs in how frontier AI models are trained, evaluated, and deployed

• Working knowledge of AI safety and the main debates about how frontier AI should be developed and governed

• A track record of delivering through senior leaders and teams who don't report to you, including when it meant changing how they work

• Experience preparing decisions for executives, including framing options, making a recommendation, and recording the outcome

• Sound judgment and discretion with confidential and sensitive information

Preferred qualifications

• Experience at a frontier AI developer, a government AI institute, an independent evaluator, or an AI safety or governance research organization

• Hands-on experience with frontier AI safety work, such as safety frameworks, safety cases, risk reports, model evaluations, or reviews of model training or deployment

• Familiarity with how AI progress is measured, including compute, capability trends, and the use of AI to speed up AI research

• Experience delivering programs that combine technical work with public policy, or that bring together experts from different organizations

• Experience managing published commitments or high-visibility public releases

• Experience building a program from zero and reshaping it as the strategy evolved

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

 - Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

 - Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

 - Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

 - Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

 - Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

 - Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

 - Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

 - Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

 - BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

 - 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

 - Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

 - Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

 - Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

 - A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

 - Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

 - Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

 - Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

 - Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

 - Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. jobs.title: VP Marketing

About WorkBoard

WorkBoardAI is the agentic Strategic Portfolio Management platform. We connect what enterprises invest in people, money and AI capacity to the outcomes those investments deliver. Our customers include 3M, AstraZeneca, Boeing, Optum, and many more across technology, financial services, healthcare, and manufacturing.

We’re backed by SoftBank, Andreessen Horowitz, M12 Microsoft’s Venture Fund, Notable Capital and Workday Ventures. We are defining agentic SPM against legacy, project-first vendors. The VP Marketing will set how the market understands that category and turn that position into pipeline.

The Opportunity

We are seeing the biggest shift in enterprise technology there has ever been, and WorkBoardAI is positioned to lead what comes next. Our buyers are CEOs, CIOs and Chief Strategy Officers, and we want WorkBoardAI to be oxygen for every one of them. It should be essential to how they run the business, not a nice-to-have.

As VP Marketing, you will establish WorkBoardAI as the recognized enterprise brand in strategic portfolio management (SPM) through crisp messaging, a strong enterprise brand identity and wide market recognition. You’ll also turn that position into revenue growth. This is a rare opportunity to define the agentic, outcome-centric future of a category and clearly differentiate WorkBoardAI from legacy, project-first SPM/PPM players.

The Role

Reporting to the President, you will own WorkBoardAI’s story, brand and marketing pipeline, with a goal of $xxM+ in marketing-generated pipeline per quarter. You’ll do it by leading a lean, highly efficient marketing organization that uses AI and agents at its core. You will partner closely with our CRO, Customer Success and Product to make sure every customer and prospect hears one consistent, compelling message.

What we’re looking for:

• Experience leading marketing, serving as the #2 marketer, or leading PMM at an AI/SaaS company growing from $25M to $100M.

• A track record of getting a company placed in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave or IDC MarketScape, ideally for the first time, in an established catagory.

• An enterprise focus, with experience marketing to buyers with high average deal sizes.

• Experience with large but fast top-down B2B sales, ideally with a 90–120 day sales cycle.

• Success in a highly competitive market, ideally as the smaller player or new entrant.

• Performance-obsessed. You consistently demonstrate high performance and expect it from your team.

• Deeply analytical and curious, with high EQ and a process-oriented approach.

• You set the pace and help the whole company move faster.

• Creative and innovative, and quick to recognize new ways of doing things.

• A data-honest, metrics-driven approach to problem solving.

• You value teamwork, show empathy and take ownership. You’re open to feedback and others’ ideas, and you can disagree and commit.

You’ll be skilled and super effective at:

• Building a messaging framework and product marketing plan that flows into positioning, enablement and every customer touchpoint.

• Telling the market what we stand for, what we do, who we do it for, why it matters, and why we’re the only ones who can deliver on this vision.

• Competitive marketing: displacing legacy vendors with long-standing enterprise commitments, de-positioning alternatives, and winning against the “build our own” narrative.

• Developing hard-hitting persona use cases with clear value props and comparisons to the alternatives, including doing nothing or sticking with an existing tool.

• Building and delivering an ROI narrative that lands with Fortune 500 executives.

• Running enterprise pipeline channels across field marketing, social, influencer, analyst relations, PR and ABM.

• Building a modern analyst relations, PR and brand awareness engine.

• Keeping pace with weekly product launches and communicating new capabilities consistently to customers and prospects.

• Building, coaching and leading a world-class, efficient marketing team, and setting the standard for driving results with AI.

WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU’LL:

• Deep-dive with Sales, Customer Success and Product to learn our solution, go-to-market motion and roadmap.

• Meet with X customers and X prospects to hear first-hand how senior leaders describe their challenges and our value.

• Assess the current messaging, brand, website and pipeline engine, and have a clear action plan for the Key Results of your function.

WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU’LL:

• Have customer marketing programs generating pipeline and driving adoption of new capabilities.

• Have a world-class, efficient marketing team with a data-honest culture.

THE TEAM

You will be joining a fast-moving leadership team at a company in growth mode. Our product and engineering team launches new capabilities every week, and we’re a passionate, no-ego bunch fully dedicated to our customers’ success.

OUR VALUES - WE LIVE BY THE 4 H’S

Humble experts ~ Hungry for the opportunity ~ Intellectually honest ~ Operating as one happy team

A FEW OF OUR AWESOME BENEFITS

• Flexible PTO & sick days

• Paid holidays

• Health insurance

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Lead, Education
jobs.description:
ABOUT PLAYLAB

Playlab is a tech non-profit dedicated to helping educators and students become critical consumers and creators of AI.

We believe that an open-source, community-driven approach is key to harnessing the potential of AI in education. We equip educators & students to build custom AI apps for their unique context. Over 100,000 educators have published apps on Playlab.

At Playlab, we believe that AI is a new design material, one that should be shaped by many to bring their ideas about learning to life. If you're passionate about building creative, equitable futures for students and teachers, we hope you'll join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Playlab is looking for a Trust & Safety Lead to own safety on our platform, with a focus on children and young adults. We’ve built Playlab with responsibility in mind, but this work is an ongoing commitment to the students and educators we serve. 

You'll make the calls on live incidents, moderation escalations and safety policy. Just as important, you'll help design the systems that catch problems automatically, so people step in only where human judgment matters.

Educators use Playlab to build AI apps for their own classrooms. That means our safety work covers two things: how the AI behaves, and what people build and do with it. Responsible AI in education is a young field, so many of the playbooks you'll run haven't been written yet. You'll write them.

This role owns the decision. When something happens, you decide what to do: suspend an account, take down an app, notify a school, file a required report. You'll bring in leadership for the rare calls that need it, and keep the relevant folks informed about what you did and why.

You'll report to our CTO and work closely with product, engineering, learning engineering and partnerships, as well as the people leading our responsible AI and privacy work.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build the systems that catch problems

 - Learn what "bad" looks like here. Review flagged content, hunt for misuse our filters miss, and try to build apps that break our policies. Stress-test features before and after they ship, and grow a community of internal and partner testers who do this with you.

 - Define what our systems should catch. Build a Playlab-specific harm taxonomy and clear labeling guidelines, so people and systems judge content the same way.

 - Turn what you find into examples we can build on. Collect what you see in reviews, hunts and red teaming into labeled sets engineering can use to build and test detection.

 - Write the requirements. Spell out what our filters, rules and signals need to catch and what good looks like. Engineering builds it; you decide whether it's working.

 - Track how well detection works. How much we catch automatically versus what a person finds, how often we flag things that are fine, and how long problems go unnoticed. The goal is for people to spend their time on the calls that need human judgment.

Own incidents end to end

 - Lead incident response. Triage, investigation, action, school communication, required reporting and post-incident review. You're the first responder and the decision-maker.

 - Make urgent issues reach you fast. Work with Support on intake and escalation paths so anything urgent gets to you the same day.

Turn patterns into policy

 - Write and maintain our safety and moderation policies, including what schools can and can't adjust, so frontline teams can apply them consistently. Work with our privacy and security lead where policies touch student data.

 - Review safety at launch. Act as the safety reviewer for new features, raising risks early enough to change the design.

Be the safety voice for schools and partners

 - Work directly with school and district leaders who raise safety concerns, with care, clarity and urgency.

 - Build the processes, training and resources our learning partners (many who are former school leaders) need to report incidents and handle safety situations with their schools.

Keep the team informed

 - Turn themes from incidents, reviews and hunts into clear input for the product roadmap.

 - Track incident volume, response times, policy coverage and trends, and report regularly to leadership.


WHAT THE JOB IS REALLY LIKE

 - About half proactive, half reactive. Roughly half your time goes to review, hunting and red teaming, and half to incidents, policy and schools. Reactive work always tries to take over, so we'll protect the proactive half with you.

 - You'll build some of your own tools. Part of your first few months will be shaping any new search, reporting and testing tools to enhance your work, working with engineering.

 - You'll be the primary escalation point. Incidents don't keep office hours. You'll be first in line for urgent safety issues, with backup coverage so it's sustainable.

 - You'll work with student data carefully. Access follows a clear policy aligned with our school and district agreements.

 - The work can be hard to see. Proactive safety work on a platform used by young people can mean encountering disturbing material, including content involving harm to children. You will help set the standard for handling procedures and support for the people who do the work.


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU...

We're looking for a strong and creative operator with a bias toward action, who gets excited about building new systems. You're passionate about education, steady under pressure, rigorous about process, and eager to build what doesn't exist yet.

 - Care deeply about student wellbeing, equity and access, and believe we can set a new bar for safe AI in education

 - Have 5+ years in trust & safety, including real time as the decision-maker on high-stakes escalations

 - Have strong intuition for the responsible or safe choice when there's no obvious right answer, and can explain your thinking clearly

 - Have handled safety work involving young people: disclosures of self-harm or abuse, inappropriate contact, CSAM reporting, or similar

 - Have helped design how problems get caught automatically: you've written labeling guidelines, defined what a filter should catch and checked whether it worked. You don't need to be an engineer, but you work well with them

 - Love building the human side of the system too: intake forms, triage rubrics, runbooks, training materials and dashboards

 - Write policies that are principled and practical, so frontline teams can apply them consistently

 - Stay calm, clear and thorough under pressure, and know when to act, when to slow down and when to bring others in

 - Communicate well with a worried school leader, an engineer and a learning partner in the same day, including asynchronously and remotely


BONUS POINTS FOR...

 - Enjoying breaking things, and have hands-on experience finding where generative AI tools fail

 - Experience with AI red teaming, evaluations or adversarial testing

 - Experience doing proactive investigations or abuse hunting, not only queue work or escalation management

 - Experience on platforms with user-generated content or creator tools (app review, UGC moderation, marketplace integrity)

 - Familiarity with student privacy and child safety frameworks (FERPA, COPPA, state student data privacy laws, mandated reporting)

 - Classroom, school leadership, counseling or edtech experience

 - Having built trust & safety operations from scratch at a startup or nonprofit


WHY JOIN US?

Real impact: Your work directly protects the educators and students using Playlab every day, and shapes what safe AI in education looks like across the field.

Real ownership: You'll make the calls and design the policies, processes and tools that define trust & safety at Playlab.

Room to grow: As Playlab and our safety work grow, so does this role, with significant opportunities for learning and growth.

Mission-aligned team: Join a small, passionate group committed to equity, creativity and joyful learning, backed by the Gates Foundation, Google, CZI and the Schwab Foundation.

Flexible work: Remote-first, with autonomy and a strong culture of collaboration.

Competitive pay and benefits: Competitive salary, healthcare covered 100% for you and 80% for dependents, dental/vision covered 100% for you and dependents, retirement, Life/AD&D, monthly wellness stipend, home office budget, new laptop, generous time off and opportunities for professional growth.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Operations
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.



OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The Role

At Sunrise Robotics, this role owns everything that happens after a customer signs: delivering each robotic cell, deploying it on the customer's floor, keeping it running, and growing the account. You report to the CEO and sit on the leadership team.

Our robotic cells run in electronics factories across Europe. We are moving from our first cells in production to one cell a week, then one a day. That pace only works if every deployment is repeatable and every live cell holds its performance without us on site. Today too much of that depends on heroics. Your job is to replace heroics with a system.

You lead our forward-deployed engineers and deployment program management from day one. You build support and customer success around them, and you decide how the function grows.

This is a hands-on role. One week you are on a customer's floor for a go-live. The next you are designing how we deploy and support many cells at once.

What You'll Own

 - Delivery, end to end: factory readiness, installation, commissioning, operator training, go-live and hypercare.

 - Deployment programs: readiness gates, dated plans, and coordination across engineering, manufacturing and the customer. Deployment dates are commitments. You raise slips before the deadline, with the fix.

 - The deployment playbook: standard procedures, training, and a debrief after every deployment, so each one is easier than the last.

 - Support for live cells: on-call, response and fix targets, incident communication and resolution tracking.

 - Customer success: adoption, customer health, and clear expansion signals for the revenue team.

 - The field-to-product loop: root causes and field data reach Product and Engineering as structured input they can act on.

 - The customer operations team: structure, hiring, priorities and performance.

What You'll Need

 - Experience leading deployment, field operations or customer operations for robots or autonomous hardware in real customer environments, from go-live through steady state.

 - You have taken an operation from a handful of units or sites to many, and can show the numbers.

 - You have run operations against hard commitments, such as uptime, availability or an SLA, with money or renewals at stake.

 - You have built teams: hired, set structure, grown managers and made yourself replaceable.

 - The judgement to hold the line on reliability under pressure. You have delayed a go-live or told a customer no, and can explain why it was right.

 - Enough technical depth to earn the trust of engineers and work through a root cause with them.

 - Clear written English. We are remote and run on documents, not slides.

 - Willingness to travel about one week a month.

What Makes You Stand Out

 - Experience in factories, industrial automation or electronics manufacturing.

 - Experience in a business paid on uptime or performance.

 - Remote operations, fleet monitoring or a network operations center.

 - You have built a support function from nothing.

How You'll Work

You'll work with our forward-deployed engineers and deployment program managers, and closely with revenue, product, engineering and supply chain. Revenue wins the deal; you deliver it and grow the account. Product decides what ships; you refuse to deploy what has not passed its gates. Engineering decides how to build the fix; you bring them the root cause.

The role is remote, within three hours of Central European Time, with regular time in Ljubljana and on customer sites.

What Success Looks Like

In the first months, you know every live cell and every deployment in progress, and every deployment runs on a dated plan.

After that, live cells hold their performance without us on site, issues close through a support process with agreed response times, and repeat issues stop.

Longer term, deployments are repeatable and predictable, several runs at once without heroics, and existing customers buy more cells.

Why Sunrise

 - You build the function. How Sunrise delivers, deploys and supports every cell it sells is yours to design.

 - A seat at the table. You join the leadership team and work directly with the CEO and founders.

 - Your work runs in production. Every cell that goes live, and stays live, carries your work.

jobs.title: Creator in Residence (Social Media & Content)
jobs.description:
lemlist is the sales engagement platform used by 40,000+ sales teams. Bootstrapped, profitable, and now moving upmarket. We ship a lot (AI dialer, MCP, lead finder…) and we want the world to feel it, not just read a changelog.

We're hiring a Social Media & Content Creator to become one of the faces of lemlist on social, alongside our founders, team and creators. You'll be on camera, write the copy, follow the trends before they peak and turn our launches into content sales people actually watch, share and laugh at.

Think of it as half creator, half marketer: you'll grow lemlist's accounts on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube and your own, in collab, with LinkedIn as a core channel: you'll post there 3 times a week. The scope covers lemlist and claap, the AI sales intelligence platform we bought last year https://www.lemlist.com/blog/lemlist-just-spent-over-15m-to-buy-ai-sales-intelligence-platform-claap (same audience).




WHAT YOUR IMPACT WILL LOOK LIKE


WITHIN 3 MONTHS, YOU'LL HAVE:

 - Defined lemlist's social voice and 3–4 recurring formats (skits, POVs, "reacting to", cold-call challenges, tutorials…) and tested them on IG, TikTok and LinkedIn

 - Supported with success at least 2 product launches, from script to post, on lemlist's accounts and yours

 - Built a consistent LinkedIn presence: 3 posts a week on your profile, many of them repurposed from your TikTok / IG videos

 - Published your first YouTube tutorials on lemlist / claap use cases

 - Worked with our Ads Manager to ship your first top-performing UGC ads


WITHIN 12 MONTHS, YOU'LL HAVE:

 - Made lemlist's social accounts a reference in the sales / GTM space: people follow us for the content

 - Grown lemlist's and your own audience significantly, with a few recognizable series people quote back to us

 - Become a recognized voice of the sales / GTM community on LinkedIn, posting 3 times a week

 - Proven that social drives business (more people mentioning social platforms in "how do you hear about lemlist" signup form)

 - Built a repeatable launch playbook on social, used for every major feature

 - Pulled other lemlisters (sales reps, founders, PMMs) on camera so the brand isn't just one face

 - Built, with our Ads Manager, a repeatable creative engine for paid: a steady flow of UGC-style ads, tested every month, with your best organic content turned into winning creatives
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL DO CONCRETELY

Your time splits between two types of content: one that makes our product shine, one that makes our audience laugh and share.


1. MAKE OUR LAUNCHES AND KEY FEATURES IMPOSSIBLE TO MISS

 - Turn every launch into a content moment. E.g. for our Parallel Dialer (reps call several prospects at once): an Instagram/TikTok skit, a LinkedIn post, a YouTube tutorial, a teaser before and a recap after

 - Show the product in action with 2 tutorials a month on how real teams use lemlist and claap ("How I book 10 meetings a week with lemlist", "My multichannel sequence in 5 min")

 - Pick up the phone yourself: film real (or AI-powered) cold calls with our dialer and turn the best moments into content

 - Move fast with Product Marketing: they bring the message, you bring the format. One round of feedback on the script, not five

 - Feed paid: every week, hand your best-performing videos to our Ads Manager and shoot UGC-style variations to test as ads


2. CREATE RELATABLE, VIRAL TOFU CONTENT THAT MAKES SALES PEOPLE LAUGH

 - Build 2–3 recurring characters or series people come back for. Think "the AE who always blames marketing", "SDR vs AI SDR", "cold call of the week"

 - Hijack trends early and adapt them to sales life before everyone else does

 - Find your material in real sales life: listen to calls in claap, hang out with our reps, collect the objections, fails and wins that make people say "that's literally me"

 - Bring lemlisters on camera (sales reps, our CEO, PMMs) so the brand has more than one face


3. BE A VOICE ON LINKEDIN

 - Post 3 times a week on your LinkedIn profile, in collab with lemlist

 - Repurpose smartly: many of your TikTok / IG videos can live on LinkedIn too. Adapt the hook, the caption and the format (native video, carousel, text post) so it feels made for LinkedIn

 - Engage with the community: reply to comments, react to other sales voices, join the conversations our buyers are having


IN NUMBERS

 - ~10 short videos a week across lemlist's accounts and yours (IG, TikTok, LinkedIn), mixing original videos and platform-native cuts

 - 3 LinkedIn posts a week on your profile (many repurposed from your videos)

 - 2 YouTube tutorials a month

 - 5–10 UGC-style ad variations a month (new hooks, same concept)

 - A weekly 5-line recap: what worked, what didn't, what you'll test next
   
   


ABOUT YOU

Location: US or Europe. 
Based in the US, you'll bring our content as close as possible to our American audience. 
Based in Paris, you'll work side by side with our team and turn them into content too. 
We care more about the right profile than the zip code.

 - English native (must-have): You write and speak the way our US audience does (French is a plus, not required).

 - A creator already: you have your own audience (around 10k followers is a good signal) and you know what makes people stop scrolling

 - Comfortable on camera: you can act, improvise and carry a video on your own. Being one of the faces of a brand excites you

 - Fluent in social codes: you live on IG, TikTok and LinkedIn, you know the trends, the sounds, the formats and what's already dead

 - LinkedIn-savvy: you know what works on LinkedIn, and that it's not just a TikTok copy-paste. Posting 3 times a week there sounds fun, not like a chore

 - A strong writer: punchy hooks, captions, scripts and LinkedIn posts

 - You get sales: ideally you've been in sales (SDR, BDR, AE) or close to it. You know the pain of a cold call and can make it funny

 - Fast and hands-on: you shoot, edit and publish without waiting for a production team. AI tools are part of your workflow

 - Data-minded: you look at what performs and iterate


THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - UGC-only (reading scripts written by someone else)

 - A writer / editorial content role

 - A community manager scheduling posts


BONUS POINTS

 - You've made a video in the B2B / sales niche that went viral

 - You've already done brand collabs with B2B SaaS companies
   


HOW TO APPLY & RECRUITMENT PROCESS

How to apply: send us the links to
1) your LinkedIn 2) Instagram, TikTok or YouTube accounts with content you've created.
No published content, no review. 
We won't consider an application without proven examples.



 1. Screening call (30 min)

 2. Business case (async) + live debrief (45 min)

 3. Culture fit with the team

 4. CEO interview

 5. Reference check

 6. Offer

jobs.description:
RETAIL AMBASSADOR - PART-TIME

Tysons, VA - Tysons Corner

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior
