jobs.title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner Residency Program
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

We are thrilled to welcome applicants to our prestigious Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner Residency Program designed to nurture and empower the next generation of mental health professionals!

Residency Program Overview

Blackbird’s Residency Program will prepare the next generation of Psychiatric Nurse Practitioners to practice with confidence as specialists in child/ adolescent mental healthcare.

Our next Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner Residency Program is scheduled to begin January 25th 2027.

• Residency is a 9-12 month program designed for recent graduates or those who have not worked under licensure to jumpstart their careers in the field.

• The program is designed to support the transition from graduate school to professional practice combining clinical experience and didactic learning.

• Residents will be given the tools and support they need to provide children and adolescents with cutting edge diagnosis and treatment with personalized care, while learning to thrive in an interdisciplinary outpatient model.

• Residents will grow with their colleagues and develop relationships that will support their practice and success in the PMHNP profession.

• After successful completion of residency, graduates will have the opportunity to level up their new skills as senior members of the Blackbird medical team for at least 2 years following residency completion.

Why Join Our Residency Program:

• Hands-on Experience: Immerse yourself in real-world experiences, gaining practical skills that will set you apart in the Mental Health landscape

• Mentorship: Benefit from personalized mentorship by seasoned clinical experts who are committed to helping you succeed.

• Guaranteed Salary: Achieve financial security through an annual salary and guaranteed caseload (no clawbacks or unpredictable fee for service compensation structure to navigate)

• Experienced, Clinical Leadership: As a clinician-founded, owned and operated company, our clinical model is inspired by the vision of Psychiatric Nurse Practitioners

• Professional Development: Access a tailored curriculum and workshops to continuously enhance your skill set and stay ahead of industry trends

Hybrid work model: Enjoy the flexibility of both in-person and telehealth work, giving you more control over your schedule while building relationships in person.

• Comprehensive Benefits Starting Day 1: Medical, dental, employer-paid life insurance, and 401k with company match, because your health and future are important to us.

• Generous PTO and Work Life Balance: We know how essential time off is for both personal well-being and professional growth.

• Modern Facilities: Work in newly designed, modern offices that foster collaboration and comfort.

• Top-Notch Administrative Support: From credentialing to paperwork, we’ve got you covered so you can focus on what really matters—your patients.

• Room for Professional Growth: Whether your career path involves leadership, specialization, or expansion of your skill set, we’re committed to supporting your growth.

At Blackbird, we foster an environment where humility, intelligence, compassion, and dedication come together. We believe in lifting each other up and providing ample opportunities for professional development and sharing of expertise. Here, you’ll never feel alone in your mission.

About the Role

Under the supervision of the Director of the Residency Program, you’ll play an essential role in delivering comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, treatment planning, and medication management for children, adolescents, and young adults. You’ll collaborate with an interdisciplinary team to ensure the highest quality of care and be empowered to make a tangible difference in the lives of young patients and their families.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct psychiatric evaluations, assessments, and diagnosis, creating personalized treatment plans for children and adolescents, which may include prescribing medicines and other treatments.

• Collaborate closely with other healthcare professionals including psychotherapists on an integrated treatment plan and medication management to ensure the best outcomes for patients.

• Work from our clinic in Harrisburg, PA 2 days onsite a week.

• Maintain a standard working schedule of Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM.

• Meet with residency cohort & supervisor to discuss progress and challenges on a routine basis.

• Provide education and consultation for patients and their families.

• Manage diagnostic testing, including digital and lab results.

• Participate in weekly team and supervisory clinical meetings.

• Maintain thorough records of patient meetings and progress and maintain confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations.

• Performs other clinical-related activities as assigned.

Qualifications

We’re looking for passionate, dedicated clinicians who are ready to make a difference and are looking for a unique opportunity to learn as a first year psychiatric nurse practitioner.

You’ll be a great fit for residency if you:

• Are mission-driven and excited to change the landscape of behavioral health for youth.

• Possess excellent communication skills and love working in a collaborative, team-based environment while working independently.

• Are open to feedback and eager to learn and grow in a supportive clinical community.

Requirements:

• Have national certification of a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner.

• 12 of your 40 weekly hours are required to be during our peak “after school hours” defined as after 3pm ET during the week or any time on a weekend.

• Work in person at our Harrisburg, PA clinic 2 days onsite a week.

• Maintain a standard working schedule of Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM.

• Master’s degree from an accredited nursing program (PMHNP, Master’s in NP) and must have graduated in the last ~12 months or have less than 1 year of work experience as a PMHNP.

• Candidates must have an active PMHNP license and DEA in Pennsylvania (or on track to receive it by the time residency begins.)

• Upon successfully completing the requirements of the 12-month residency program, participants will join the Blackbird Clinical Services team for an additional two-year period following their residency for a total commitment of three years.

Salary Range

$100,000—$112,000 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: Security Operations Center Watch Lead
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

As the Waymo Security Operations Center (SOC) Watch Lead, you will be a key leader responsible for the 24/7/365 operations of our global security program. You will provide critical operational direction and oversight of the SOC's day-to-day functions and vendor performance.

This role is central to shaping and building a best-in-class global security program that sets the industry standard, ensuring the safety and security of Waymo's personnel, assets, and operations. You will be responsible for developing operational procedures, managing vendor performance, and leading the team's response during critical events, all to ensure the operational resilience required to safely deliver the Waymo Driver to the world.

You will:

• Maintain Situational Awareness: Serve as the primary lead for monitoring Waymo’s global footprint, identifying and assessing potential impacts on personnel, the autonomous fleet, and facilities.

• Manage Real-Time Events: Oversee the security response for active incidents, ensuring operational excellence and strict adherence to established protocols.

• Represent Physical Security: Act as the physical security representative during the initial stages of all incident responses and crises, collaborating with partners in Facilities, EHS, Operations, Safety, Legal, and Resilience.

• Conduct Briefings: Provide clear and concise situational updates to leadership during active security events, with the professional judgment to identify when incidents require higher-level intervention.

• Ensure Operational Quality: Perform real-time audits of incident logs, dispatch recordings, and mass notifications to ensure accuracy, speed, and professionalism.

• Finalize Reporting: Review and finalize end-of-shift reports to ensure all critical data points are captured for long-term trend analysis.

You have:

• 5+ years of experience leading operations within a Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Military Operations Center, Emergency Operations Center (EOC), or a similar 24/7 command center environment with a primary focus on physical security and incident response (this is not a cybersecurity position).

• A proven track record of making independent, critical decisions in high-pressure, time-sensitive security environments.

• Bachelor’s degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Political Science, Emergency Management, Criminal Justice, or a similar field.

• Demonstrated ability to leverage internal telemetry and external risk data—including OSINT, social media analysis, and incident volume—to synthesize multiple information streams and provide actionable situational awareness.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence response actions and provide clarity during fast-paced events.

We prefer:

• Completion of advanced FEMA training, specifically ICS-300 and ICS-400.

• Knowledge of traditional facility-based security technology and infrastructure, including access control, alarm monitoring, and CCTV systems.

• Experience with global risk intelligence and incident response applications (e.g., Dataminr, Everbridge)

• Completion of industry-recognized certifications such as the CPP, PSP, or APP

The expected hourly range for this position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

$57.70—$70.68 USD

jobs.title: Accountmanager LSR
jobs.description:
KANAAL OWNERSHIP

Jouw focus ligt op het winnen en uitbreiden van nationale accounts binnen de kanalen Coffee, Bakery & Fast Casual, gezamenlijk: Limited Service Restaurant. Je werkt met bestaande klanten zoals Boerske, Fat Phills en Mr. Sushi, maar een belangrijk deel van jouw rol is ook new business: waar liggen nog kansen, welke ketens missen we nog en hoe krijgen we Red Bull daar binnen?

Omdat LSR een relatief nieuw kanaal is en er nog veel te winnen valt, ben je regelmatig in het veld. Je signaleert commerciële kansen, bepaalt waar de grootste mogelijkheden liggen en gaat proactief het gesprek aan met potentiële klanten. Met als doel: Red Bull op steeds meer relevante plekken beschikbaar en zichtbaar maken.

ACCOUNTPLANNEN & STRATEGIE

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de accountplannen voor jouw klanten. Daarbij kijk je zowel naar de korte als de lange termijn. Je analyseert wat er speelt bij jouw klanten en binnen de verschillende segmenten, ziet waar groeikansen liggen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke prioriteiten en ambitieuze targets. Om jouw plannen te realiseren werk je nauw samen met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders. Ieder segment vraagt om een eigen aanpak.

RELATIEMANAGEMENT & ONDERHANDELEN

Je bent sterk in het onderhouden en bouwen van relaties en schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende type stakeholders. Veel van de klantrelaties binnen LSR zijn nieuw en daarnaast ga je op zoek naar nieuwe klanten. Jij legt vanaf het eerste contact de basis voor een sterke en langdurige relatie.

Daarnaast voer je commerciële gesprekken en onderhandelingen en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het sluiten en uitbouwen van deals bij jouw klanten. Je stuurt op optimale distributie en executie, met als doel commerciële groei te realiseren voor je klanten en Red Bull.

EXECUTIE IN HET VELD & TRACKING

Wanneer je commerciële afspraken op het hoofdkantoor hebt gemaakt, zorg je er samen met de Reachers voor dat deze worden door vertaald op locatieniveau. Daarbij werk je ook met andere disciplines zoals (Trade) Marketing, Brand en Financial Control.

Je zorgt dat je zelf regelmatig in het veld aanwezig bent om te zien wat er op de locaties gebeurt. Je volgt continu jouw eigen doelstellingen op volume, distributie en executie bij je klanten en je past je plannen aan wanneer nodig. Je bespreekt met je klant de jaardoelstellingen, kijkt waar kansen liggen en stuurt jouw plannen bij wanneer dat nodig is.

Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding richting Economie of Business Administration met minimaal 2 jaar commerciële ervaring binnen sales

Sterke commerciële vaardigheden, je denkt in kansen, hebt lef en overtuigingskracht en gaat voor het maximaal haalbare

Een ondernemend karakter, je neemt eigenaarschap en kunt goed zelfstandig werken

Stakeholder management

Overzicht en focus staan centraal in je werk, je kunt prioriteiten stellen en houdt oog voor detail

Je staat open voor feedback en bent gemotiveerd om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen

Red Bull Nederland gelooft erin dat het hebben van een diverse pool van talenten een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan ons succes. We nemen daarom aan op ervaring, skills en mindset. We staan open voor sollicitaties van iedereen uit onze maatschappij ongeacht leeftijd, geslacht, handicap, seksuele geaardheid, ras of religie.

About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As an Associate / Provisionally Licensed Therapist at Blackbird Health, you’ll deliver high-quality, evidence-based therapy to children, adolescents, young adults, and their caregivers with full clinical supervision and administrative support provided by Blackbird.

Working on-site alongside an interdisciplinary team, you’ll receive dedicated clinical supervision hours toward independent licensure while delivering impactful care to young patients and their families.

Employment Options

W2 Full-Time (Provisionally Licensed FTE) | LMSW

• Base Compensation: $65,000 – $70,000 base salary (100% Onsite)

• Hours & Schedule:

• Workload: 36 hours of scheduled clinical availability supporting 28 completed direct care hours/week.

• Shift Schedules: 4-day workweek options including 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM or 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM (4 days/week).

• Core Hours: Minimum of 20 Core hours/week during peak evening/weekend periods (after 3:00 PM weekdays and/or weekends).

• Benefits & Supervision: Full clinical board supervision provided at no cost, medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, PTO + 11 paid holidays, life insurance, and short/long-term disability.

W2 Part-Time (Provisionally Licensed PT) | LMSW

• Base Compensation: $40,000 base salary + $65 / session incentive for completed sessions beyond the 17-hour baseline.

• Hours & Onsite Expectations:

• 100% Onsite (Flex): 20 contracted hours per week (17 completed direct care hours).

• Core Schedule: All 20 hours anchored in peak core windows (after 3:00 PM weekdays and/or weekends; e.g., Mon–Thu 3–8 PM / 3–9 PM or Fri 2–7 PM).

• Benefits & Supervision: Clinical supervision included, medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, PTO + 11 paid holidays.

Why Blackbird & Your Impact

• Focus on your clinical growth — board-approved clinical supervision is provided directly by experienced Blackbird supervisors at no cost to you.

• Do the work you trained for — we handle credentialing, billing, insurance, and EMR so you can focus entirely on your patients.

• Start seeing patients immediately — a guaranteed caseload means no waiting, no hustle, just care.

• Be part of something bigger — every session is a chance to help a child find their footing, a family breathe easier, and a young person discover what they’re capable of.

Who You Are

• Active provisionally licensed / associate credential in MD (e.g., LMSW) working toward independent licensure (LCSW-C, LCPC, LCMFT).

• 1+ year of experience providing care to children, adolescents, or young adult patients.

• Committed to 100% onsite attendance for clinical supervision, team collaboration, and core clinic presence.

• Available after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends.

Salary Range

$40,000—$85,000 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: Social Worker - Learning Disability Partnership Team
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Social Worker for its client's Learning Disability Partnership Team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to support adults with learning disabilities and complex needs through strengths-based, person-centred social work practice.

The successful candidate will work within a multidisciplinary partnership environment, collaborating closely with individuals, carers, families, Community Learning Disability Nurses, Psychologists, Occupational Therapists, and partner agencies to promote independence, wellbeing, and positive outcomes. You will undertake statutory assessments, safeguarding interventions, Mental Capacity Act work, and support planning, ensuring adults receive high-quality and outcome-focused support.

This role requires an experienced Social Worker who can manage a complex caseload, work confidently within integrated services, and apply relevant legislation to support adults with learning disabilities to live safe, independent, and fulfilling lives.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Managing a complex caseload of adults with learning disabilities and associated support needs.

• Undertaking strengths-based assessments under the Care Act 2014 to identify eligible needs and desired outcomes.

• Developing, implementing, and reviewing person-centred Care and Support Plans that promote independence, wellbeing, and choice.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and risk assessments in accordance with Adult Safeguarding legislation and local procedures.

• Completing Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Supporting adults with complex needs through assessment, intervention, advocacy, and care coordination.

• Managing and coordinating multi-agency interventions to ensure effective and integrated support arrangements.

• Preparing professional reports for safeguarding processes, funding panels, legal proceedings, and multidisciplinary meetings.

• Completing Community Deprivation of Liberty applications and supporting Court of Protection processes where required.

• Working closely with Community Learning Disability Nurses, Psychologists, Occupational Therapists, and other partnership professionals to achieve positive outcomes.

• Undertaking carers' assessments and providing information, advice, and support to carers and families.

• Assessing and managing risk appropriately whilst promoting positive risk-taking, independence, and person-centred outcomes.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant records, assessments, reports, and support plans.

• Contributing to multidisciplinary meetings, safeguarding discussions, reviews, and service development initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services. ASYE candidates will not be considered.

• Learning Disabilities Experience: Significant experience supporting adults with learning disabilities and complex care and support needs.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Human Rights Act, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Mental Capacity Experience: Proven experience undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and Best Interest decision-making processes.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing complex safeguarding concerns.

• Court of Protection Experience: Experience supporting Court of Protection applications and Community DoLS work is highly desirable.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with health professionals, carers, families, providers, and partner agencies.

• Integrated Working: Experience working within Learning Disability Partnership Teams or integrated health and social care services is desirable.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred practice and continuous professional development.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

Senior Counsel | Complex Trial Team – Sexual Torts Defense | California

Sophisticated Cases. Exceptional Trial Attorneys. Meaningful Work.

Please note: An active California Bar license is required.

Tyson & Mendes is seeking an accomplished Senior Counsel to join a specialized Complex Trial Team defending some of the most sensitive and high-exposure matters in civil litigation, including cases involving allegations of sexual assault, child sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, and institutional liability.

This is not a traditional insurance defense position. These matters require exceptional judgment, discretion, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex factual and legal issues with professionalism and sensitivity.

For an experienced litigator looking to deepen their expertise in this highly specialized practice area, this is an opportunity to work alongside exceptional trial attorneys and mentors while taking on sophisticated, meaningful litigation.

Work Alongside Proven Trial Leaders

The team is led by Equity Partner Susan Oliver, an accomplished California litigator with extensive experience handling catastrophic personal injury, sexual torts, employment practices, and medical malpractice matters.

Susan is known for identifying creative and novel legal strategies in complex cases. Her recent successes include obtaining summary judgment in two significant matters, collectively saving clients more than $100 million. Her experience extends from California state and federal courts to the California Courts of Appeal and the Ninth Circuit, as well as stepping into major cases late in litigation to evaluate, reposition, and prepare them for trial.

She works alongside other highly experienced partners and trial attorneys who are committed to collaboration, mentorship, and developing the next generation of sophisticated litigators.

Build Expertise in a Highly Specialized Practice

You’ll work on complex matters involving allegations of sexual assault, child sexual abuse, misconduct, and institutional liability; cases that can involve significant exposure, complicated legal issues, extensive discovery, expert testimony, and substantial reputational considerations for clients.

Senior Counsel are trusted to bring their own experience and judgment to the table while having access to seasoned trial attorneys for strategy, collaboration, and mentorship.

Why Tyson & Mendes?

Sophisticated, High-Exposure Work – Handle challenging matters that demand thoughtful strategy and strong litigation skills.

Exceptional Mentorship – Work alongside Susan Oliver and other accomplished trial attorneys who understand what it takes to successfully position and try complex cases.

Meaningful Case Ownership – Take an active role in strategy, discovery, depositions, experts, dispositive motions, client counseling, and trial preparation.

National Resources – Benefit from the resources of a national litigation firm, including trial training and experienced litigation support.

Collaborative Culture – Join a team where experienced attorneys share ideas, strategize together, and support one another.

Flexibility – We offer flexibility while maintaining the collaboration and connection necessary for complex litigation.

Who Will Thrive Here

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned civil litigator who is comfortable handling sensitive, emotionally complex, and high-exposure matters and wants to continue developing as a trial attorney.

Experience involving sexual assault, abuse, institutional liability, catastrophic injury, professional liability, medical malpractice, or similarly complex litigation is highly valuable. Just as important are excellent judgment, discretion, strong writing and analytical skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with clients, witnesses, experts, and opposing counsel.

Bring Your Experience. Deepen Your Expertise.

Join Tyson & Mendes and help shape the next generation of our Complex Trial Team.

jobs.description:
About Arena Club

Arena Club is building the number one digital marketplace for collectibles. We started by reinventing the hobby with the first-ever digital card show, and we are expanding into new categories so collectors can buy, sell, grade, and showcase everything they care about in one place. Spearheaded by 5x World Series Champion Derek Jeter and serial entrepreneur Brian Lee, our fully digital marketplace is grounded in trust, transparency, and fun, featuring grading and authentication, vaulting, and digital pack openings that let collectors build and display their collections in a personalized online showroom from anywhere in the world.

About the Role

We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented Vendor Operations Coordinator to be the main point of contact between our LA-based Buying team, our vendors, and our Receiving team. You'll own the vendor portal, resolve discrepancies on incoming purchase orders, and keep product moving smoothly from vendor to warehouse to sale. When things are running smoothly, you'll support inventory by preparing cards for digital repacks and auctions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, communicates clearly across teams, and knows (or wants to learn) the trading card and graded-card space.

What You Will Do

Vendor Portal & Damages

• Manage the vendor portal, including logging and tracking all damaged items identified on incoming POs

• Coordinate return shipments and chargebacks of damaged cards to vendors, message vendors about damages, and send tracking information to them

• Determine the appropriate resolution for damaged low- and mid-value cards (return, credit, or retain) in line with company guidelines

Vendor, Buying & Receiving Communication

• Act as the primary liaison between the Buying Team, External Vendors, and the Receiving Team

• Resolve issues with PO sheets, such as missing/incorrect cards or incorrect cert numbers

• Ensure sheets are added to the operations order list on time

• Identify when vendors ship incorrectly or don't follow our shipping SOP, and escalate to the Buying team or the right contact

• Communicate PO priorities from the Buying team to Receiving so the highest-priority orders are processed first to ensure the necessary cards are being processed first

• Coordinate vendor drop-offs as the on-site point of contact

Inventory Support (Secondary)

• Prepare cards for digital repacks

• Research and verify card pricing

• Prepare cards for auction listings

• Assist with card resubmissions for grading as needed

Qualifications

• 1–2+ years of experience in operations, receiving, logistics, vendor management, or a similar role

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across remote and on-site teams

• Exceptional attention to detail, especially with cert numbers, SKUs, and PO sheets

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets, web portals, and online forms

• Able to prioritize competing requests and follow through independently

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with trading cards, grading companies (PSA, BGS, SGC, etc.), and card pricing tools (CardLadder, eBay, etc.)

• Experience with auction or e-commerce inventory prep

The base salary range listed is a guideline. Actual compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the impact you bring. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity.

The Attorney Who Will Thrive Here

Two Trial Lawyers in Your Corner

And because Tyson & Mendes is a national litigation firm, you’ll have the resources, technology, training, and opportunities of a large organization while working closely with a team where your contribution is visible.

Come Grow With Us

We’re looking for an attorney who is smart, driven, detail-oriented, and excited to keep learning. Someone who wants challenging cases, meaningful responsibility, excellent mentors, and the opportunity to become an even stronger advocate.

If that sounds like the next chapter you’ve been looking for, we’d love to start a conversation.

Apply today and come see what you can build at Tyson & Mendes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Compensation Package

jobs.title: Research Associate, Analytical Development
jobs.description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Position Summary

GenScript is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate, Analytical Development to support the development, qualification, and routine execution of analytical methods for RNA, lipids, lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), and related bioconjugates at our Seattle site.

The successful candidate will perform hands-on laboratory work across HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS, nano flow cytometry, and RNA/LNP analytical testing. This role will support routine sample analysis, analytical method development and optimization, troubleshooting, and method transfer in close collaboration with R&D, QC, Production, and other cross-functional teams.

This position is well suited for a scientist who combines strong wet-lab skills with attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a desire to build technical expertise in emerging RNA and lipid nanoparticle technologies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Chromatography and Analytical Testing

• Prepare RNA, oligonucleotide, lipid, LNP, antibody, and bioconjugate samples for analytical testing according to established procedures and experimental plans.

• Perform HPLC/UHPLC analyses using UV and/or charged aerosol detection (CAD), including sample and standard preparation, instrument sequence setup, chromatogram review, peak integration, and initial data assessment.

• Support chromatographic methods for evaluating RNA purity, lipid identity and purity, lipid composition, residual components, and related product-quality attributes.

• Assist with preparative chromatography, fraction collection, sample tracking, and evaluation of purification fractions for RNA and related development projects.

• Support analytical method development, optimization, troubleshooting, and transfer under the guidance of senior scientists and the group lead.

2. LC-MS Characterization

• Support LC-MS characterization of RNA, oligonucleotides, synthetic cap analogs, and related materials.

• Assist with characterization of attributes such as molecular identity, capping efficiency, and poly(A) characteristics, as appropriate to the method and project.

• Perform sample preparation and assist with spectral review, data processing, and interpretation under scientific guidance.

• Support troubleshooting of sample-preparation, chromatographic, mass-spectrometric, and data-processing issues.

3. RNA and LNP Analytical Development

• Perform analytical testing to support characterization of mRNA, circRNA, oligonucleotides, lipids, LNPs, antibodies, and related bioconjugates, depending on project needs.

• Support assays evaluating RNA attributes such as concentration, purity, integrity/fragmentation, aggregation, and residual process-related components.

• Support characterization of LNP-related attributes, including lipid composition and purity and residual/free components associated with LNP conjugation or formulation processes.

• Perform routine sample cleanup, dilution, buffer preparation, and analytical sample processing using appropriate RNase-free techniques.

4. Nano Flow Cytometry and Targeted LNP Characterization

• Prepare fluorescently labeled samples, standards, and appropriate experimental controls for flow-cytometry analysis.

• Perform routine flow cytometer setup, instrument QC, sample acquisition, and application of established analysis and gating strategies.

• Support characterization of antibody-decorated or targeted LNPs, including evaluation of labeling and conjugation-related attributes where appropriate.

• Assist with optimization and troubleshooting of flow-cytometry-based analytical workflows.

5. Laboratory Execution and Data Analysis

• Perform routine wet-lab activities requiring accurate pipetting, serial dilution, buffer and reagent preparation, concentration measurements, and sample cleanup.

• Process analytical results using relevant instrument software and Microsoft Excel or equivalent data-analysis tools.

• Review results for consistency and data quality, prepare clear data summaries, and promptly communicate unexpected findings, deviations, or instrument issues to the group lead.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and traceable experimental documentation, sample records, reagent inventories, and laboratory records.

6. Laboratory Operations and Cross-Functional Support

• Support preparation and revision of SOPs, test methods, work instructions, and analytical documentation.

• Assist with routine instrument maintenance, laboratory organization, and method-transfer activities.

• Collaborate effectively with scientists and colleagues across R&D, QC, Production, and related functional teams.

• Follow applicable laboratory safety procedures, chemical-handling requirements, and site EHS policies.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of analytical workflows, laboratory efficiency, data quality, and technical capabilities.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.

• 0-5 years of relevant academic or industry laboratory experience, preferably in analytical chemistry, biopharmaceutical characterization, nucleic acid analysis, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience with HPLC/UHPLC and/or LC-MS, including sample preparation, execution of established analytical methods, and basic chromatographic or analytical data review.

• Practical experience with flow cytometry, including fluorescent sample preparation, use of appropriate controls, data acquisition, and basic gating or data interpretation.

• Strong fundamental wet-lab skills, including accurate pipetting, solution and buffer preparation, dilution calculations, sample handling, and contamination control.

• Ability to follow written procedures and experimental protocols accurately and maintain clear, complete, and traceable laboratory records.

• Ability to use Microsoft Excel or similar software to organize, analyze, and summarize experimental data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn new analytical technologies.

• Ability to manage multiple sample batches and experimental priorities while communicating progress, results, and technical issues clearly.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary R&D environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.

• Previous experience working with mRNA, circRNA, oligonucleotides, lipids, LNPs, antibodies, or bioconjugates.

• Experience with analytical techniques such as HPLC-CAD, SEC, ion-pair reversed-phase chromatography, ion-exchange chromatography, preparative HPLC, or RNA gel/capillary electrophoresis.

• Experience with LC-MS characterization of nucleic acids, oligonucleotides, cap structures, lipids, or related biomolecules.

• Experience with small-particle or nanoparticle flow cytometry, particularly platforms such as the Beckman Coulter CytoFLEX nano.

• Familiarity with Agilent or Waters HPLC/UHPLC systems, Thermo Scientific LC-MS platforms, or related analytical instrumentation.

• Experience using analytical software such as Empower, Xcalibur, BioPharma Finder, or CytExpert.

• Understanding of analytical method development, qualification, transfer, or troubleshooting in an R&D, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, or CDMO environment.

Core Competencies

• Scientific rigor and attention to detail

• Strong hands-on laboratory execution

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving

• Data integrity and documentation discipline

• Curiosity and willingness to learn

• Ownership and accountability

• Effective communication and teamwork

• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced R&D environment

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will become a reliable hands-on contributor to GenScript's RNA and LNP analytical capabilities, consistently generating high-quality analytical data while developing increasing independence in HPLC/UHPLC, LC-MS, flow cytometry, and RNA/LNP characterization.

Over time, the Research Associate will be expected to contribute not only to routine testing, but also to analytical method optimization, troubleshooting, method transfer, and continuous improvement, helping strengthen GenScript's analytical capabilities for next-generation RNA and lipid nanoparticle products and services.

Perks:

• Free colleague meals during shift

• Onsite gyms

Compensation:
Salary range: $65,000 – $80,000 total compensation, including bonus, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits:

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well-being initiatives, and peer-to-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work.

GenScript USA Inc/ProBio Inc. is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to attracting, retaining, and maximizing the performance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the Company's policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

GenScript USA Inc./ProBio Inc. maintains a drug-free workplace.

Please note: Genscript USA Inc./ProBio Inc. will only contact candidates through verified application sources. GenScript/Probio does not request personal information from candidates through individual email or any other platform.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Retention (People Manager), Retention Team
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As the Manager, Customer Retention, you lead Human Interest's Retention team with the primary goal of proactively intervening with at-risk customers to drive positive retention outcomes. You own the team's performance and are responsible for ensuring members focus on the right accounts using the right approach. Collaborating closely with the Sr. Director, Customer Retention, who defines the overarching strategy, you turn strategic direction into everyday operational execution for the team. While you will directly lead high-stakes and sensitive save opportunities, your core responsibility is empowering and maximizing the overall effectiveness of your team.

About the team

The Retention team is a team in motion! The team is currently undergoing an exciting evolution, shifting from traditional reactive save efforts toward predictive outreach and proactive relationship management.

Joining now presents a unique opportunity: as we deliberately scale our structure and refine our metrics,
you will have a direct hand in shaping the function's playbook. If you thrive in an environment where your
customer insights can directly influence operational strategy, this is the ideal role for you.

What you get to do every day

• Oversee team operations including full-cycle hiring, and onboarding. As well as, developing management playbooks, training materials, and talk tracks.

• Own the team's performance against retention targets. Report results and forecasts to Leadership each month. Govern the use of concessions. Review and approve concessions within your delegated approval authority, escalate requests above it, and manage the team's overall use of concessions. Report results and forecasts to the Sr. Director, Customer Retention each month and contribute to monthly business reviews.

• Run the daily operation of the retention case queue. This includes assigning new cases so workload is balanced and matched to experience, monitoring caseloads, and enforcing the team's rules of engagement on case ownership, same-day outreach, outreach cadence, documentation, and resolution coding so that reporting on saves and losses is accurate.

• Act as Retention's primary partner to the leaders of Relationship Management, Customer Success Operations, Product, Sales and Onboarding, and Finance. Run the feedback loops that route churn root causes to the teams that own the improvements. Bring recurring patterns and their financial impact to the Sr. Director, Customer Retention for escalation.

• Validating monthly commission calculations and submitting payouts on schedule. Contribute to the design of future incentive plans

• Identify segments of retention volume that can be handled through automation or AI-assisted outreach, run pilots, and scale what works, while keeping people responsible for customer-facing judgment and pricing decisions. Make sure capacity freed by automation is actually spent on outreach to at-risk accounts.

• As necessary, be personally involved in relationship-sensitive retention conversations, and use them to demonstrate the standards expected from the team.

• Oversee team operations including full-cycle hiring, and onboarding. As well as, developing management playbooks, training materials, and talk tracks.

• Other duties as assigned.

What you bring to the role

• 6+ years of experience in customer retention, customer success, account management, or client-facing sales within financial services, fintech, or B2B SaaS.

• 2+ years of experience directly managing a team. contributors, preferably a team paid partly on commission or measured against revenue targets.

• A track record of improving retention or save outcomes at the team level, and the ability to explain specifically what you changed to get there.

• Working knowledge of 401(k), 403(b), or other qualified plan administration, deep enough to coach reps through various retention scenarios and customer conversations.

• Experience coaching negotiation and objection handling, including through structured review of recorded calls.

• Comfort working with data. You can build and read Salesforce reports and dashboards, work in a BI tool such as Tableau, interpret trends and generate insights. .

• Sound commercial judgment about concessions, including experience managing approvals within defined limits.

• Demonstrated ability to influence peers and senior leaders in other functions who do not report to you.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting results and recommendations to senior leadership.

Nice to have

• Experience at a 401(k) recordkeeper, retirement plan provider, payroll company, or HR technology company serving small and mid-sized businesses.

• QKA, QPA, RPF, or a similar retirement plan designation, or a commitment to earning one within 18 months in the role.

• Experience managing a fully remote team.

• Experience working with financial advisors and third-party administrators.

• Bachelor's degree.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

• Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.

• Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.

• Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!

• An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.

• Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $90,000 - $100,000 plus a variable target component of $100,000 annually and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximum in our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

• Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

We are committed to making every stage of our application process fully accessible to all individuals. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the process, please let us know at applicantaccommodations@humaninterest.com.

If you have questions, please reach out to us directly at careers@humaninterest.com

jobs.title: Manager, LNP R&D
jobs.description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Position Summary

GenScript is seeking a highly motivated and experienced scientific leader to lead its Lipid Nanoparticle (LNP) R&D team in Seattle. The successful candidate will bring multidisciplinary expertise in lipid nanoparticles, nucleic acid delivery, formulation development, and RNA therapeutics, together with demonstrated scientific leadership and people-management capability.

This role will lead the development and commercialization of innovative RNA and nucleic acid delivery technologies, with a focus on LNP platforms for mRNA, DNA, small RNAs, and other emerging nucleic acid modalities. The team will translate new delivery technologies, formulations, workflows, and operating capabilities into differentiated GenScript products and services for global research and drug-development customers.

The ideal candidate is both a scientific innovator and a people leader who can convert emerging delivery technologies into scalable, reproducible, and commercially relevant solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific and Technology Leadership

• Lead the development of innovative LNP and nucleic acid delivery platforms for mRNA, DNA, small RNAs, and other therapeutic payloads across diverse research and therapeutic applications.

• Drive next-generation LNP development, including novel ionizable lipid design and synthesis, formulation optimization, targeted LNPs, extrahepatic delivery, and tissue- or cell-specific delivery strategies.

• Establish technology roadmaps and development strategies that create differentiated LNP capabilities, products, and services.

• Partner with the RNA R&D team to develop integrated RNA and delivery solutions for vaccines, gene editing, protein replacement, cell engineering, and other emerging applications.

• Provide scientific leadership for LNP formulation design, screening, characterization, optimization, and delivery-performance evaluation.

• Monitor emerging technologies, scientific publications, competitive platforms, intellectual-property trends, and industry developments in nucleic acid delivery.

Team Leadership and Development

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing LNP R&D team, with responsibility for workforce planning, hiring, resource allocation, budgeting, performance management, and employee development.

• Foster a culture of scientific rigor, innovation, accountability, collaboration, transparency, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

• Mentor scientists through regular one-on-one meetings, technical guidance, career-development discussions, and timely, constructive feedback.

• Allocate resources effectively to achieve project milestones, platform-development objectives, and organizational priorities.

Cross-Functional and Project Leadership

• Serve as the primary technical and organizational leader for LNP R&D and partner with RNA R&D, Operations, Production, Quality, Marketing, Sales, and Program Management.

• Define project scope, technical strategy, milestones, resource requirements, risks, and timelines for key R&D programs.

• Monitor project and team performance and communicate progress, risks, scientific findings, and recommendations to senior leadership through project reviews and presentations.

• Review and approve key R&D deliverables, including research reports, experimental protocols, SOPs, technical procedures, production records, presentations, and scientific publications.

Technology Transfer and Commercialization

• Lead the translation of new LNP technologies from early-stage R&D into robust, scalable, customer-facing products and services.

• Provide technical leadership for formulation scale-up, process optimization, technology transfer, and implementation in Production and Operations.

• Work with Production, Quality, and Operations to establish reproducible processes, critical process parameters, analytical requirements, and fit-for-purpose documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, operational efficiency, scalability, reproducibility, profitability, and customer value.

Customer and Market Engagement

• Serve as a technical expert in customer discussions involving LNP formulation, nucleic acid delivery, troubleshooting, and customized development programs.

• Partner with Commercial, Marketing, and Program Management to understand customer needs and translate them into new capabilities and service offerings.

• Participate in scientific conferences, technical seminars, and customer engagements to identify emerging trends and unmet needs.

• Translate market and customer insights into actionable R&D priorities and technology roadmaps.

Laboratory, Quality, and Safety

• Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of laboratory procedures and technical workflows.

• Promote high standards of scientific documentation, experimental reproducibility, data integrity, and laboratory organization.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laboratory-safety requirements and GenScript EHS policies, particularly for lipid chemistry, formulation development, and chemical handling.

• Collaborate with EHS, Quality, and site leadership to maintain a safe and compliant laboratory environment.

• Perform other responsibilities consistent with leading and continuously improving GenScript LNP R&D capabilities.

Required Qualifications

• PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related discipline.

• At least 5 years of relevant post-PhD industry or research experience in nucleic acid delivery, drug delivery, lipid nanoparticles, or related technologies.

• At least 2 years of direct people-management experience leading scientific or technical teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, employee development, and resource planning.

• Deep scientific expertise in lipid nanoparticle formulation and nucleic acid delivery, particularly RNA delivery.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience in LNP formulation, production, optimization, and analytical characterization.

• Strong understanding of lipid-based and/or polymeric nucleic acid delivery technologies.

• Experience with particle size/PDI, zeta potential, encapsulation efficiency, RNA concentration, lipid composition, morphology, and stability assessment.

• Experience evaluating nucleic acid delivery performance in relevant in vitro and/or in vivo models.

• Strong understanding of RNA biology and analytical methods for evaluating RNA quality, delivery, and functional expression.

• Experience with relevant molecular and cellular methods, which may include RT-qPCR, ELISA, Western blotting, flow cytometry, fluorescence-based assays, gel electrophoresis, capillary electrophoresis, and RNA-quantification methods.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data, identify root causes, design effective experiments, and make data-driven development decisions.

• Strong project-management and organizational capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and development programs.

• Excellent scientific writing, presentation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively and influence across technical and business functions without direct authority.

• High standards of integrity, scientific rigor, accountability, teamwork, and professional conduct.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in novel ionizable lipid design or synthesis, targeted LNPs, extrahepatic delivery, or cell-specific nucleic acid delivery.

• Experience developing LNPs for mRNA therapeutics, vaccines, gene editing, in vivo cell engineering, siRNA, or other nucleic acid modalities.

• Experience transitioning technologies from early-stage R&D through scale-up, technology transfer, production, or commercial service launch.

• Experience in a CRO/CDMO, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life-science service organization.

• Experience working directly with customers, external collaborators, or commercial teams on technical development programs.

• Demonstrated innovation through new technology development, patents, publications, platform development, or successful product/service launches.

Success Profile

The successful candidate will combine deep scientific expertise with strong leadership and execution. They will be comfortable moving between hands-on scientific problem-solving, technology strategy, team development, cross-functional execution, and customer engagement. Most importantly, they will bring scientific curiosity, ownership, creativity, and urgency to building next-generation LNP technologies that strengthen GenScript's global RNA and nucleic acid delivery capabilities.

Perks:

• Free colleague meals during shift

• Onsite gyms

Compensation:
Salary range: $125,000 – $160,000 total compensation, including bonus, depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
JOIN THE SLEEP FITNESS MOVEMENT

1 in 3 US adults have poor sleep, which raises the risk of diabetes, cardiovascular disease and dementia. At Eight Sleep, we’re building electromechanical systems that change how you sleep, not just tell you how you slept. Continuous sensing drives real-time temperature, head elevation, and sound changes, with clinically proven results: 34% more deep sleep and cardiovascular recovery similar to 12 weeks of exercise training. To do this, we solve actuation, sensing, thermal, fluids, AI and manufacturing challenges across hundreds of thousands of units a year - in a form factor that needs to blend seamlessly into the home.

Over 400k members in 34 countries sleep on our products, from health-conscious consumers to professional athletes. Fast Company has named us one of its Most Innovative Companies four times, and TIME has twice named our products to its Best Inventions of the Year. 

 


HIGH STANDARDS. NO APOLOGIES.

We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.

 


THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Staff Mechanical Engineer to lead new product development from concept through to production. You’ll be part of a small, mission-driven team and have significant ownership over decisions. We’re growing quickly so there are ample opportunities for career growth.

 

This role is based out of our San Francisco Office 5 days/week.

 


WHAT YOU'LL HELP BUILD

 - Architect and design complex electromechanical systems, including plastic, metal, and soft goods components integrated with novel sensors and actuators.

 - Drive designs across the entire development lifecycle, including brainstorming, CAD, prototyping, testing, and ramp into production in Asia.

 - Shape the direction of our products and features by collaborating with industrial design, marketing, and product teams as well as company leadership.

 - Solve highly cross-functional problems by working with electrical, software, reliability, and manufacturing engineering teams.

 - Perform analysis and testing to ensure designs meet product goals, including thermal, fluid, and structural analysis.
   
    


WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

 - 8+ years of consumer product design experience with knowledge of injection molding, sheet metal forming, and sensor/electronics integration.

 - Track records of shipping high-volume consumer products, including manufacturing support in Asia. Willingness and ability to travel to China as needed.

 - Highly proficient with 3D modeling and simulation tools (e.g. Solidworks, NX, Creo).

 - Experience with high-volume manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA), tolerance analysis, functional dimensioning and geometric tolerancing (GD&T).

 - Solid understanding of root cause analysis, DOEs, and other quality measuring techniques.

 - BSME or equivalent. MS preferred.
   
    


WHY JOIN EIGHT SLEEP?

Innovation in a culture of excellence

Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

 

Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth

From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards.

 

Collaboration with exceptional talent

Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 

Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment

We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company.

 
 

Your own Pod - and other great benefits

Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod https://www.eightsleep.com/, along with*:

 - Lunch in the SF office 5 days a week

 - Full access to health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents

 - Supplemental life insurance

 - Flexible PTO

 - Commuter benefits to ease your daily commute

 - Paid parental leave

 

At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Founding AE – Founder's Office
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. 




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Founder's Office – GTM Innovation Team works directly with our CEO, Dan Lee, on GTM innovation: testing new products, new motions and new ways of selling, then figuring out what's ready to scale across the company. Internally, we call the people on this team our astronauts.

The team is small and new. Today it includes a GTM leader who is taking our newest product to market and a GTM engineer who extends Dan's reach on deals, executive relationships and pipeline. You'll join as a peer, sitting between the product team building something new and the sales team that will eventually sell it at scale.


THE ROLE

We're hiring a Founding AE to sell Nooks' newest products before there is a playbook for them. You'll take products from early access to repeatable revenue: finding the first buyers, running fast trials, closing lighthouse customers and turning what you learn into the motion our broader sales team will run.

This is not a standard, scaled AE role. You'll work side by side with Dan, our founders and the product team. You'll carry a number, but your job is just as much to figure out who buys, why they buy, how we price it and the fastest path from first call to live customer. When a product is ready to scale, you'll help hand it to the broader sales team and move on to the next bet.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle for new products, from first conversation through trial, close and handoff to onboarding.

 - Get customers live fast. Define the minimum a customer needs to start a trial, cut unnecessary steps and create urgency on both sides.

 - Find the right buyers. Test ICP, persona and messaging hypotheses, and learn where each product lands best.

 - Shape pricing and packaging with our founders as you learn what customers will pay for.

 - Partner with product and engineering. Bring customer feedback into the roadmap and help decide what has to ship before a product can scale.

 - Work across the GTM org. Partner with AEs, CSMs and marketing on sourced opportunities, existing customers and launch campaigns.

 - Build the playbook. Document what works, including pitch, demo flow, trial criteria and objection handling, so the broader sales team can scale it.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of closing.

 - Experience selling a new product, opening a new market or being an early AE at a startup.

 - Comfort selling something that is still being built, and the judgment to know what to promise.

 - A bias for action. You move deals forward without waiting for a process to exist.

 - Strong product intuition and credibility with technical buyers and senior executives.

 - Curiosity and pattern recognition. You turn customer conversations into clear insight for product and GTM.

 - Low ego and high ownership. You're as happy writing the playbook as you are closing the deal.

Nice to have

 - Experience selling AI, automation or agent products.

 - Experience selling to sales, marketing or RevOps leaders.

 - Experience as a founder, a founding AE or in a founder's office role.


WHY THIS ROLE

 - Work directly with the CEO. You'll be part of the Founder's Office and in the room for the decisions that shape our next products.

 - Be first on what's next. You'll sell products before anyone else at Nooks does and help define how they go to market.

 - Startup scope with real momentum. You get a 0-to-1 mandate, plus 2,000+ customers and a sales team ready to scale what works.

 - Grow fast. The skills here, including selling, pricing, launching and building teams, set you up for GTM leadership.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.  

Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
