For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: PMO Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry  we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. 

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.




YOUR ROLE

As a PMO Operations Specialist, you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives.

You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone.

This is an opportunity to join the PMO during its early development and make a meaningful impact on how Focused Energy plans, tracks, and delivers its most important initiatives. You'll bring structure to complexity, ensure important details don't fall through the cracks, and help build a scalable foundation for the company's continued growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the PMO Operating Rhythm: Coordinate and manage the weekly project reporting cycle across dozens of active initiatives, ensuring timely updates, accurate information, and consistent visibility into project progress.

 - Drive Portfolio Data Quality: Monitor project information, identify missing or inconsistent data, follow up with project leads, and ensure leadership and teams can rely on accurate portfolio reporting.

 - Make PMO Processes Work in Practice: Translate newly designed PMO processes into simple, documented, and usable workflows that can be adopted consistently by project leads and non-PM colleagues.

 - Lead Project Onboarding and Training: Coordinate onboarding for new project leads and deliver training on PMO processes, tools, reporting expectations, and ways of working to build confidence and self-sufficiency.

 - Improve Processes and Efficiency: Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, helping streamline workflows and flag opportunities for automation.

 - Drive Improvement Initiatives: Partner with the PMO Lead on selected PMO improvement projects, taking ownership of execution, coordination, documentation, and follow-through.

 - Support Cross-Functional Collaboration: Prepare and support workshops, meetings, and working sessions, ensuring the right information is available, discussions stay organized, and agreed actions are followed through.

 - Maintain Clear Documentation: Ensure PMO processes, project information, and supporting documentation are complete, accessible, and consistently maintained.

 - Keep Things Moving: Proactively identify overdue actions, unclear responsibilities, and emerging gaps, escalating risks to the PMO Lead before they impact project delivery.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have a degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - You bring experience in project management, PMO operations, project coordination, or business operations, ideally within a technical, engineering, R&D, or fast-growing organization.

 - You understand project management fundamentals and the importance of consistent reporting, reliable documentation, clear ownership, and effective coordination across multiple initiatives.

 - You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and large volumes of project information without losing sight of the bigger picture.

 - You are comfortable translating processes and concepts into practical workflows, documentation, and guidance that people outside of project management can easily understand and adopt.

 - You take an ownership-driven approach to your work, naturally identifying what's missing, unclear, or unfinished and proactively driving it toward resolution.

 - You are a clear and confident communicator in both German and English, able to follow up persistently and constructively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical expertise.

 - You enjoy working with diverse teams, including scientists, engineers, and business professionals, and can adapt your communication style to different audiences.

 - You demonstrate good judgment and understand when to make decisions independently versus when to escalate process or scope changes to leadership.

 - You have a continuous improvement mindset and are interested in simplifying processes, reducing manual work, and leveraging automation and AI tools to improve efficiency.

 - You thrive in an evolving environment where processes are still being established and enjoy bringing structure, consistency, and momentum to a growing organization.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Partnerships & External Affairs Associate, Global Affairs
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Global Affairs team builds relationships with communities to help ensure that artificial intelligence benefits people broadly. The partnership team works with organizations and leaders across education, workforce development, labor, faith, civil rights, and other communities. We build partnerships that help people use AI in ways that matter to their lives, strengthen the organizations serving their communities, and ensure their experiences and concerns help shape OpenAI’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a resourceful partnerships professional who combines strong external relationship skills with the judgment and organizational ability to move complex initiatives forward.

You will manage designated external relationships and lead the day-to-day delivery of partnerships across the team’s portfolios and Working with portfolio leads, you will translate agreed objectives into practical programs, represent OpenAI in partner conversations, coordinate internal contributions, and carry commitments through delivery. 

You will also step into emerging priorities: helping launch a new collaboration, advancing an existing partnership, preparing a senior leader for an external engagement, or coordinating a project involving several teams. Your portfolio will evolve with team priorities, with clear ownership and agreed outcomes for each assignment.

This role requires someone who enjoys building relationships and doing the detailed work that makes those relationships productive. You should be comfortable working independently, learning unfamiliar issues quickly, and knowing when to seek expertise or escalate a decision.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own external relationships. Build and manage trusted relationships with nonprofit organizations, civic leaders, community institutions, and other partners across a range of diverse perspectives and communities.

 - Develop and deliver partnerships. Translate shared interests into practical collaborations with clear objectives, scope, responsibilities, timelines, and measures of success.

 - Represent OpenAI externally. Lead partner meetings and briefings, participate in convenings, and communicate clearly about AI’s opportunities and safe and responsible use.

 - Contribute across the team’s priorities. Take ownership of defined projects across different portfolios, support colleagues during major initiatives, and help establish new areas of engagement.

 - Connect partners with internal expertise. Work with policy, product, safety, legal, communications, and education colleagues to develop substantive engagements and secure the contributions needed for delivery.

 - Turn stakeholder insight into action. Identify concerns and opportunities, synthesize what we hear, bring relevant feedback to internal owners, and close the loop with partners.

 - Deliver funded partnership programs. Translate agreed commitments into feasible workplans with clear owners, milestones, and outcomes. Work directly with partners and portfolio leads to resolve program questions, coordinate implementation, and assess results, including recommendations for improvement or renewal.

 - Coordinate partnership implementation across teams. Bring together relationship owners and colleagues in policy, legal, finance, procurement, product, and communications to move agreements, funding processes, and program launches forward; track dependencies, resolve or escalate blockers, and keep partners and internal teams informed of progress.

 - Maintain reliable follow-through. Manage workplans, partner commitments, budgets, and approval processes for your projects; surface dependencies and risks early and recommend solutions.

 - Exercise sound prioritization. Assess incoming opportunities against team goals, recommend where to invest time and resources, and adjust plans as circumstances change.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Bring 6+ years of relevant experience in partnerships, external affairs, public policy, campaigns, government, nonprofits, or community engagement, or equivalent experience demonstrating these capabilities.

 - Have independently managed external relationships and delivered complex partnership programs, including scoping commitments, coordinating multiple teams, managing budgets, and evaluating outcomes.

 - Combine political and stakeholder judgment with strong execution skills, including navigating disagreement and sensitive issues.

 - Can build credibility with people whose experiences and views differ from your own.

 - Write clearly, communicate confidently, and translate complex topics for nontechnical audiences.

 - Are organized and responsive, can manage several projects at once, and take responsibility for completing commitments.

 - Work effectively across teams without formal authority and make thoughtful decisions about when to act independently and when to seek alignment.

 - Enjoy a varied portfolio and can move between relationship development, strategic thinking, and hands-on delivery.

 - Are curious about AI and its implications for communities, public institutions, and economic opportunity.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Thailand
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Singapore

About the Role

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in Enterprise accounts of the Thailand market. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Bachelor's degree required.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

• The portfolio for this role consists of customers based in Thailand. Proficiency in Thai to communicate with these customers would be required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist – Molecular Diagnostics
jobs.description:
Our Bosch Research team occupies a critical position between academic research and product development, distinguishing us from many other companies. We engage with academia, incubate ideas, advance them to the prototype stage, and collaborate with development teams in our business units to support product development based on our research outcomes. We are seeking a research scientist with a strong academic background, proven industry experience, and a passion for tackling complex, real-world problems in molecular diagnostics.

Our R&D center is located in Sunnyvale, CA, USA. This is in the heart of Silicon Valley in close proximity to Stanford University and UC Berkeley. The candidate will be a key contributor to our research and development efforts, from conceptualization to the creation of novel technologies. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with industry experience who is eager to make a significant impact in the field of molecular sensors and biotechnology.

Responsibilities:

• Identify, incubate, and translate cutting-edge academic research into functional, scalable proof-of-concept technologies in molecular diagnostics and biosensing.
• Lead hands-on development and testing of prototype diagnostic systems, integrating microfluidics, electrochemical sensing, soft electronics, and chip-scale nanofabrication.
• Collaborate closely with internal business units, engineering teams, and external academic partners (e.g., Stanford, UC Berkeley) to transition early-stage research into commercially viable product pipelines.
• Design and execute advanced experiments for single-molecule detection, assay integration, and sample-to-answer cartridge performance.
• Protect innovation through patent filings while contributing high-impact scientific publications and technical documentation.
• Serve as a subject matter expert in biosensors and bioelectronics, advising multidisciplinary teams on technical feasibility, risk mitigation, and system architecture.

• Education: PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, Physics, or a related discipline)
• Industry Experience: 3-5 years of previous industry experience in a relevant biotechnology company. We highly value experience in translating academic ideas into real-world products.
• Molecular Diagnostics Expertise: Proven experience in building real-world solutions in the biotechnology sector, particularly in single molecule detection and instrumentation for molecular diagnostics.
• Integrated Systems Experience: Demonstrated experience with integrated molecular diagnostic platforms, such as cartridge design, on-chip sample-prep, and electronics.
• Soft Electronics: experience with soft electronics for applications in biosensing.
• Micro/Nanofabrication: experience with chip design and process development for applications in biosensing.
• Electrochemical Sensing: experience with electrochemical systems and biosensors.
• Biochemistry: familiarity with the principles of biochemistry.
• Proven track record of scientific accomplishment/patent filings
• Soft skills: highly motivated and passionate about developing new technologies and products; strong documentation, oral and interpersonal skills, experience working in a multidisciplinary team.

This is a U.S. based position, domestic relocation and local sponsorship considered on a per candidate basis.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $170,000 - $200,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. Your Recruiter can share more details about the specific salary range for this position during the interview process.

In addition to your base salary, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plans with an employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description:
About the Team

We are building general-purpose robotics. In the short term, we are focused on robots to support skilled workers to build our future infrastructure. In the long term, we imagine everyone having a personal robot doing anything they need. Progress is rapid, and based on a foundation of co-design between robotics hardware and ML research.

About the Role

As a Firmware Engineer, you will define and drive the architecture of embedded systems for next-generation hardware products. You will own foundational firmware decisions across real-time execution, device bring-up, hardware interfaces, fault handling, safety mechanisms, and production readiness.

We’re looking for someone with deep experience building safety-critical or high-consequence systems, where failures can have meaningful consequences. You should be comfortable reasoning about risk, designing for diagnosability and graceful degradation, and creating engineering practices that raise the reliability bar for the entire team.

You should also be unusually good at moving fast. Sometimes the right answer is a carefully reviewed architecture that will endure for years; sometimes it is getting a rough-but-useful prototype working by the end of the afternoon so the team can learn something concrete tomorrow. We value engineers who know the difference, make that call well, and can operate credibly in both modes.

You will be both a technical leader and a hands-on builder: setting direction, reviewing critical designs, unblocking the hardest problems, and writing production firmware when it matters most.

Our embedded stack uses a lot of Rust. Extensive experience in the language is a big help!

In this role, you will:

 - Rapidly bring up new hardware and set execution pace for the team.

 - Lead firmware architecture for embedded systems spanning boot, RTOS/runtime behavior, peripheral control, power management, communications, and field diagnostics.

 - Define engineering standards for reliability, fault tolerance, observability, and maintainability across the firmware stack.

 - Design and review safety-critical mechanisms, including fault detection, recovery paths, watchdog strategies, redundancy where appropriate, and safe-state behavior.

 - Build quick, scrappy prototypes when speed of learning matters, then harden the right ideas into production-quality systems.

 - Partner closely with engineers in hardware, software, and AI research from early prototype through production.

 - Build rigorous bring-up, validation, and release processes for embedded platforms.

 - Establish testing strategies across unit, hardware-in-the-loop, integration, stress, and failure-injection testing.

 - Drive root-cause analysis for subtle hardware, firmware, and system interactions.

 - Make clear tradeoffs across performance, memory, power, schedule, and safety.

 - Mentor firmware engineers and help shape a culture of urgency, technical rigor, practical judgment, and high-quality execution.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have extensive experience developing firmware in an iterative environment.

 - Get a thrill from bringing up new hardware and taking end-to-end ownership over ensuring it works.

 - Have led architecture and delivery for complex embedded products that shipped to real users or operated in demanding production environments.

 - Are deeply fluent in low-level languages (we use Rust!) and comfortable working close to hardware under real-time constraints.

 - Understand embedded systems from first principles, including interrupts, scheduling, memory layout, buses, DMA, timing behavior, and failure modes.

 - Have strong instincts for defensive design, fault containment, validation depth, and post-deployment diagnosability.

 - Know when to build the durable system and when to produce the fastest credible artifact that unlocks the next decision.

 - Communicate clearly across disciplines and can turn ambiguity into sound technical direction.

 - Care about building systems that are not only fast and capable, but also trustworthy.

 - Make heavy use of Codex, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted coding systems to accelerate implementation, prototyping, debugging, and iteration.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with Rust in embedded environments.

 - Experience with Embassy or other async embedded Rust frameworks.

 - Familiarity with mixed-language firmware architectures, including introducing Rust incrementally into existing C/C++ systems.

 - Experience with ARM Cortex-M or Cortex-R platforms, RTOSes, and low-power embedded designs.

 - Experience building firmware for sensor-rich, latency-sensitive, or tightly integrated electromechanical products.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Security
jobs.description:
About Us

Sieve is a multi-modal lab curating the world's highest-quality training datasets, spanning video, audio, images, text, and 3D. We combine exabyte-scale data infrastructure and novel multimodal understanding techniques that push the frontier of foundation models. Video alone makes up 80% of internet traffic, and across modalities, data has become the enabling medium powering creativity, communication, gaming, AR/VR, and robotics. Sieve exists to solve the biggest bottleneck in the growth of these applications: high-quality training data.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, as a team of ~30 people. We also raised our Series A from Tier 1 firms such as Matrix Partners, Swift Ventures, Y Combinator, and AI Grant.


Why Now

 - Frontier technology: Help protect the data that supports advances in AI, from generative media to robotics.

 - Research and engineering: Work alongside teams building data collection systems, distributed infrastructure, and tools for AI research and customer delivery.

 - Velocity and ownership: Shape the security roadmap, influence architecture, and carry improvements from design through production as our systems evolve.

 - Strong team culture: Collaborate directly with a close-knit team focused on helping AI understand and interact with the world.

About the Role

As a Security Engineer at Sieve, you will serve as the technical and strategic owner of our security program. Your mission is to protect the data, infrastructure, and applications that help AI understand and interact with the world. Every control you build supports the trust of our contributors, partners, and customers.

Sieve builds training data for AI across video, audio, images, and robotics. Our work spans real-world data collection, large-scale processing, and customer delivery across cloud infrastructure, applications, and recording devices. You will secure this full lifecycle, including sensitive recordings, untrusted uploads, and access across customer and partner organizations.

This is a hands-on role with ownership of both strategy and implementation. We are looking for a security engineer with a builder's mindset who wants to set the standard for protecting the data behind frontier AI.


What You'll Do

 - Secure systems at scale: Partner with product, infrastructure, and research teams to design, implement, and improve secure systems at scale.

 - Detection and response: Build and operate detection and response capabilities.

 - Incident command: Serve as incident commander for high-severity security incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, and remediation.

 - Hands-on engineering: Write code, strengthen security foundations, and help engineering teams build and release software securely.


Requirements

Significant security experience

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, including technical ownership of security initiatives in production

 - Demonstrated expertise in cloud security across GCP, AWS, or Oracle Cloud, and container security with Docker and Kubernetes

 - Hands-on experience building and operating detection and response pipelines and handling incidents from investigation through recovery

 - Deep understanding of networking, authentication, authorization, encryption, and identity-based access for people, services, and automation

 - Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and privacy requirements, with the ability to translate them into technical controls

 - Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or a comparable language, with experience automating security controls and securing software delivery

Technical leadership

 - Ability to design network isolation, cloud permissions, and customer access boundaries that enforce least privilege across infrastructure and applications

 - Proven ability to define a security roadmap that balances research and engineering speed, customer commitments, compliance, and business risk

 - Track record producing clear security metrics, audit evidence, and risk updates that help leadership make informed decisions

Collaboration and mindset

 - Clear verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain security risks and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical audiences

 - Comfortable partnering with product, infrastructure, research, data operations, and legal teams to embed security throughout the stack

 - Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor engineers through design reviews, practical guidance, and hands-on implementation

 - Thrives amid rapid change and ambiguity, where sound technical judgment and practical risk reduction matter more than checklists

 - In person at our SF HQ


Bonus

 - Hands-on experience in hardware security for recording devices and embedded systems, including device authentication, encryption key protection, secure firmware updates, and physical tampering defenses


Benefits

 - 401k + Full Health Insurance

 - Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner covered and your choice of snacks

 - Ubers covered home


All roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week.

jobs.description:
NIQ technology initiatives, like our clients, span the globe and require leaders who can connect the dots between business strategy, technology execution, and organizational transformation. We are building a world-class Program Management organization comprised of highly motivated, analytical, and dynamic leaders who drive outcomes across Product, Technology, Operations, and Enterprise-wide Business Functions.

As a Program Director at NIQ, you will lead strategic programs and portfolios that drive business transformation, operational excellence, technology modernization, and enterprise-wide capabilities across the organization.

You will oversee a team of program managers responsible for delivering large, complex initiatives spanning multiple business functions, geographies, stakeholders, and technology domains. Success in this role requires the ability to align business and technology priorities, lead cross-functional teams, manage strategic investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

This role combines portfolio leadership, organizational transformation, financial stewardship, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You will partner closely with senior business and technology leaders to define priorities, remove barriers, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives that support NIQ's long-term objectives.

At NIQ, we empower our Program Management leaders to drive results and organizational change. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy partnering across every business function, you would be a great fit for our team.

Roles and Responsibilities

Program & Portfolio Leadership

• Coordinate between stakeholders and technology teams to develop and manage plans throughout the program lifecycle.
• Lead and mentor program managers and program leads, providing guidance, coaching, and support.
• Manage and develop a team of 4-8 Program managers or Senior Program managers, including performance management and career development.
• Develop and implement program management processes, governance frameworks, best practices, and delivery standards across the organization.
• Ensure successful delivery and tracking of portfolio and program objectives while maintaining overall program performance and value realization.
• Manage program documentation, scope changes, stakeholder communications, and governance requirements.
• Facilitate planning sessions to identify dependencies, resource constraints, risks, and mitigation strategies.
• Monitor and communicate program status, business outcomes, and portfolio performance to executive leadership and stakeholders.
• Lead portfolio reviews, governance forums, steering committees, and cross-functional planning activities.
• Proactively identify and resolve issues, risks, and dependencies that may impact successful delivery.
• Ensure appropriate operational readiness, compliance, approvals, and transition activities are completed prior to deployment.
• Lead annual and multi-year strategic planning efforts, including business case development, investment planning, budget management, and resource forecasting.
• Establish, track, and report portfolio and program metrics that enable informed decision-making and transparency.
• Collaborate with business and technology leadership to define and execute strategic initiatives aligned with organizational priorities.
• Develop and manage capital and operational budgets supporting portfolio and program objectives.
• Conduct regular executive portfolio reviews to assess delivery performance, financial health, strategic alignment, risks, and opportunities.
• Partner with leadership teams to develop and maintain multi-year business and technology roadmaps.
• Engage senior leaders in evaluating strategic priorities, investment opportunities, and long-term business objectives.
• Maintain transparent and effective communication across stakeholders to ensure alignment and support for program goals.
• Foster talent development, succession planning, and organizational growth within the program management organization.
• Promote Agile and modern delivery methodologies that improve execution, predictability, and business outcomes.

Business Transformation & Strategic Delivery

• Lead large-scale business transformation, process optimization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
• Partner with business executives and technology leaders to align investments, priorities, and delivery plans with organizational objectives.
• Collaborate with business, product, engineering, architecture, operations, finance, and support teams to ensure successful program execution.
• Facilitate prioritization of initiatives by balancing business value, resource capacity, risks, and organizational goals.
• Establish governance processes that provide executive visibility, accountability, risk management, and delivery oversight.
• Ensure programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational efficiencies, compliance objectives, and user adoption goals.
• Lead organizational change management efforts that support successful adoption of new processes, technologies, and capabilities.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders on strategic initiatives and transformation efforts.
• Manage relationships with external vendors, consulting partners, and service providers supporting program delivery.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and execution excellence.

• 15+ years of experience in program management, portfolio management, transformation leadership, or a related role leading large-scale technology and business initiatives.
• 8+ years of leadership experience managing complex programs, portfolios, and cross-functional teams.
• Proven experience leading large-scale business transformation, operational improvement, enterprise application, or technology modernization initiatives within global organizations.
• Strong understanding of enterprise business processes and operating models across functions such as Finance, Human Resources, Commercial Operations, Corporate Services, or Shared Services.
• Demonstrated ability to partner with executive business and technology leaders to define strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Experience overseeing complex initiatives involving process transformation, systems modernization, integrations, automation, data initiatives, or organizational change.
• Strong portfolio management, governance, strategic planning, and execution capabilities.
• Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence, negotiate, and gain alignment across organizational levels, functions, and geographies.
• Expertise in developing executive presentations and business communications using PowerPoint, Excel, and analytics tools.
• Proven ability to lead globally distributed teams and work effectively across diverse cultures and regions.
• Strong financial management experience, including business cases, budget planning, forecasting, investment management, and value realization.
• Experience managing third-party vendors, consulting partners, and external service providers.
• Practical experience with Agile delivery methodologies and organizational transformation initiatives.
• Strong leadership skills with a bias toward action, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Positive attitude, team player, self-starter, and demonstrated ability to achieve results in ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualification

• Experience leading portfolios that support enterprise-wide business capabilities and critical operational processes.
• Experience managing large-scale transformation initiatives spanning multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
• Familiarity with modern cloud-based, Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), and enterprise technology environments.
• Experience working with globally distributed delivery teams and external consulting organizations.
• PMP, PgMP, Agile, SAFe, or related professional certifications.

Education

Chamberlain College of Nursing needs qualified Adult Health/Medical-Surgical Clinical Faculty (Part-Time) in our Bachelor's of Science in Nursing program in Jacksonville, Florida.

The focus is on the needs of adult patients and their families regarding health promotion and management of conditions that require acute and chronic care. The nursing process is used in the discussion of health alterations affecting selected life processes. Students continue their professional skill development as members of the health team.

In this role, the clinical instructor:

• Teaching is onsite (in clinical setting) with one of our clinical partners. Schedule: most commonly 12-hour rotations (7a-7p) for three to four consecutive days.

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Team

Antares is looking for its first General Counsel — a seasoned legal leader who will build and own the legal and compliance foundation required to take our nuclear microreactors from prototyping through full-rate production and commercial deployment. This is a defining leadership role at a pivotal moment in the company's growth.

As GC, you will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the CEO and executive team. You will lead legal and compliance functions across the company, and you will partner closely with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, business development, and people teams to enable rapid execution while ensuring Antares operates within an appropriate legal and regulatory framework.

The ideal candidate has deep experience at the intersection of government contracting, nuclear or regulated environments, and export controls, and thrives in the ambiguity and pace of an early-stage, mission-driven company. You are not just a legal advisor; you are a builder, a business partner, and a key member of the leadership team.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Serve as Antares’ first in-house legal hire and primary legal partner to leadership, engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, business development, and people teams.

 - Support government contracts and government-funded programs, including proposal review, flow-down analysis, contract negotiation, compliance obligations, data rights, deliverables, reporting requirements, and program execution risk.

 - Serve as the primary legal point of contact for DOE, DoD, and other federal agency relationships and contractual obligations

 - Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain a broad range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, vendor agreements, services agreements, consulting agreements, manufacturing and supply agreements, software/SaaS agreements, testing agreements, teaming agreements, and strategic partnership agreements.

 - Provide legal counsel on nuclear regulatory matters, including NRC licensing, DOE regulatory frameworks, nuclear materials handling, and compliance with applicable federal and state nuclear safety requirements.

 - Build, own, and continuously improve Antares’ export controls compliance program, including ITAR, EAR, and other applicable regimes, including policies, procedures, training, technology-control plans, visitor controls, deemed export processes, data handling practices, and escalation workflows.

 - Manage and scope external counsel across specialized areas including export controls, contracts, nuclear regulatory, corporate, employment, intellectual property, litigation, real estate, and financing matters.

 - Define the company’s legal infrastructure and procedures, including document retention, signature authority, contract lifecycle management, legal intake, entity management, board support, and corporate governance processes.

 - Create scalable contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval workflows, fallback positions, and internal guidance to reduce legal bottlenecks as Antares grows.

 - Own day-to-day legal support across the company, providing practical, business-oriented advice that enables rapid execution while appropriately managing legal, regulatory, and reputational risk



Basic Qualifications:

 - JD from an accredited law school and active bar membership

 - 12 + years of legal experience

 - Experience in 2 out of the 3 areas of expertise
   
   - Demonstrated experience managing government contracts (FAR/DFARS) and government-funded programs
   
   - Hands-on experience building or leading an export controls compliance program (ITAR and/or EAR)
   
   - Experience with commercial contracts and regulatory matters



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - Experience as General Counsel or Deputy General Counsel at a high-growth technology or deep tech company

 - Deep familiarity with NRC licensing processes, DOE contracting vehicles (e.g. CRADA, WFO), and nuclear materials regulations

 - Experience supporting board governance, venture financings, and M&A transactions

 - Broad experience in a range of legal domains across contracts, intellectual property, export compliance, and others

 - Proven success in a start-up environment or similar, with the ability to manage ambiguity and wear many different hats



Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

 - Ability to travel to regulatory locations as needed



Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and Enterprise Sales continues to scale Brex upmarket. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. Brex wins by changing how companies control spend (corporate cards, spend management, and expense in one platform, with AI agents that act upstream of the expense report) against both legacy tools and modern competitors. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, transparency, and execution.

What You’ll Do

As Director of Sales for our Enterprise segment, you will lead a team of approximately five Account Executives driving new customer acquisition as Brex moves further upmarket. You will own team performance and help customers build the business case for an enterprise-wide platform spanning corporate cards, spend management, and expense management.

You will operate at every level: in the deals, not above them. That means joining customer conversations, coaching multi-threading and executive engagement, and running a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting. Observing a forecast from the sidelines is not the job; being present on customer calls and shaping deal strategy with your AEs is non-negotiable. Success means exceeding team targets, developing strong enterprise sellers, and introducing repeatable ways of working that raise performance across Enterprise and Brex.

Where You’ll Work

This role can be based in any of our hubs: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, or Salt Lake City. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connection of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop approximately five Account Executives; hire and onboard additional talent while setting clear expectations for performance and accountability.

• Own team bookings and new customer acquisition; guide account prioritization and pipeline creation across direct, partner, and Capital One commercial bank opportunities.

• Establish a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting, with clear milestones, risks, owners, and next steps.

• Join customer calls and actively shape deal strategy, helping AEs build executive relationships, establish value before signature, and align Finance, Accounting, IT, HR, and Travel and Expense stakeholders.

• Orchestrate complex opportunities across Product, Marketing, Finance, Pricing, and implementation teams; translate customer needs into business cases, resolve blockers, and align commitments with delivery readiness.

• Partner with implementation and customer-facing teams on mutual action plans that extend from signature through go-live, helping closed deals convert into realized revenue.

• Build and test industry-specific messaging and sales playbooks from customer insights and successful deals; share effective practices across Enterprise and the broader business.

• Build trust through transparency, candid feedback, and direct conflict resolution; take ownership of improvements and partner with Enterprise Sales leadership and cross-functional GTM partners (Product, Marketing, Finance, Implementation, and Enablement) to strengthen how the segment operates.

Requirements

• 5+ years of first-line Enterprise sales leadership experience, including direct management, hiring, and development of Account Executives or transferable leadership experience.

• Proven record of meeting or exceeding team targets in complex, competitive B2B sales, with evidence of improving seller performance and sales execution.

• Experience leading enterprise-wide platform sales with long cycles and multiple buying functions; ability to establish a compelling business case and secure commitment before deployment.

• Hands-on deal leadership: joins customer conversations, coaches multithreading and executive engagement, and helps teams resolve difficult decisions that stall opportunities.

• Strong operating and project management discipline, with an established approach to account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and coordinating internal and customer stakeholders.

• Ability to influence cross-functional priorities, articulate the commercial value of customer needs, and coordinate execution across Product, Marketing, Finance, and customer-facing teams.

• Experience selling with partners and navigating the dependencies of a complex platform; financial services, spend management, or Office of the CFO experience is a plus.

• Clear communicator and low-ego, high-ownership leader who builds trust, acts with sound judgment in ambiguity, and introduces improvements that other teams can adopt.

Compensation

The target OTE range for this position is $316,400 - $395,500. Final base salary determination accounts for individual expertise, geographical location, relevant background, market dynamics, and internal equity alignment. Beyond base pay, comprehensive offer packages may encompass equity grants alongside additional total rewards components.

Brex LLC operates as a fully owned subsidiary under Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Full-time and Part-time

PAY

$17 per hour

BENEFITS

• Training provided

• Employee meal discounts

Strong communication, organization, and customer service skills. Dependable, self-motivated, and able to work with a team in a fast-paced restaurant. Training provided.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.
