jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Revenue & Billing
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


WHO WE NEED

Rillet is building accounting and finance software for teams that need to move quickly and trust their numbers. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader on our Revenue, Accounting & Tax (RAT) team, led by Victoria Zheng.

RAT owns billing, revenue recognition, tax integrations, and the financial data layer behind these workflows. You'll help turn complex contracts and financial rules into reliable systems and clear product experiences. This is a role for someone who can set technical direction, make difficult tradeoffs, and stay close to implementation.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own significant product and technical problems across billing and revenue, from clarifying requirements and designing the data model through implementation, rollout, and production support.

 - Shape the architecture behind contracts, pricing, invoicing, amendments, revenue recognition, and related tax workflows. Make the behavior accurate, explainable, and easier to extend.

 - Improve the reliability and performance of financial workflows as customer complexity and data volumes grow. Build strong validation, testing, and observability into the systems you own.

 - Partner with product, design, accounting experts, and customer-facing teams to make sound tradeoffs and deliver work that solves real customer problems.

 - Work across the stack, with a strong backend focus and the willingness to build the interfaces customers use to understand and manage their financial data.

 - Use AI to amplify your impact and deliver more value to our customers.

 - Raise the team's technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on collaboration. Help other engineers take on larger problems and make better decisions.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent depth and impact, with a track record of leading complex product systems from ambiguous problem to production outcome.

 - Strong backend and architectural fundamentals. You can reason about data modeling, correctness, system boundaries, performance, and safe changes to existing systems.

 - Staff-level technical leadership: you establish direction, explain your reasoning, bring partners with you, and remain accountable for the result.

 - Strong product judgment and clear communication. You can translate a complicated domain into models and decisions that engineers and business partners understand.

 - A practical approach to quality and delivery. You can balance immediate customer needs with the foundational improvements that make future work faster and safer.

 - Thoughtful use of AI in your engineering workflow, backed by your own technical judgment and careful validation.




OUR STACK

Svelte 5 and TypeScript on the frontend; Kotlin and Spring Boot on the backend; PostgreSQL and AWS. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn the tools needed for the problem.




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience building billing, subscription, usage-based pricing, revenue recognition, ERP, accounting, or other financial software.

 - Hands-on experience with Kotlin, Java, or TypeScript.

 - Experience evolving complex financial data models or improving the reliability and performance of business-critical systems.
   
   

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.




LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: DC Power Systems and Protection Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE PRODUCT ENGINEERING TEAM

Product Engineering builds the power and cooling systems that let Fluidstack deliver gigawatt-scale AI data centers faster and denser than the grid-standard supply chain allows. The SST group is designing solid-state transformers as a core building block of that power architecture.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Architect a medium-voltage solid-state transformer that can be manufactured, serviced, and scaled across gigawatt-scale campuses, not just demonstrated in a lab.

 - Define the interface between the SST and the MVDC distribution system, including protection, control boundaries, and fault behavior.

 - Build a semiconductor and magnetics supply strategy that survives a thin 10kV SiC market over a multi-year horizon.

 - Take converter hardware from topology selection through working prototypes on a schedule that data center construction actually depends on.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own protection and grounding for every zone, from a bipolar medium-voltage DC bus carrying hundreds of megawatts over miles to the 1,500 V solar and battery bus and the 800 V racks.

 - Specify, and where no product exists co-develop with vendors, the DC breakers, fuses, and disconnects for these buses, from medium-voltage feeders to hall buses carrying tens of thousands of amps.

 - Design fault clearing without conventional breakers where possible, using SSTs that stop switching within microseconds, isolators that open at zero current, and fuses only where paralleled units can backfeed, and prove it in electromagnetic transient studies.

 - Turn fault studies into requirements every SST, battery converter, and breaker vendor must meet: fault current contribution, interruption time, and coordination settings.

 - Run live short-circuit and interruption tests on an energized multi-SST bus that prove the design to insurers, lenders, and the authority having jurisdiction.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've designed protection for a medium- or high-voltage DC system (MVDC, HVDC, shipboard, rail, or DC microgrid) and seen it through commissioning.

 - You've built and run electromagnetic transient models of converter-dominated systems, and used them to set breaker, fuse, or relay requirements.

 - You've made a grounding call (solid, resistance, or floating) and defended its trade-off between fault current and insulation stress.

 - You've specified, designed, or qualified DC breakers, fuses, or switchgear for medium-voltage or high-current DC, and tested them through interruption.

 - You've written protection requirements a converter or breaker vendor had to redesign to meet.

 - You find the failure case others missed and can show it in a single simulation plot.

 - Bonus: DC interruption technology (solid-state and hybrid breakers, high-speed DC fuses). EMT simulation (PSCAD/EMTDC, EMTP, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink). Protection coordination and relay settings (ANSI device functions, IEC 61850). MVDC standards (IEEE 1709). Professional Engineer license (PE).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliaiblity Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Define what reliability means for a GPU-accelerated AI platform and make it measurable. You will own the service-level indicators and objectives for the K0rdent Observability Framework (KOF) — deriving meaningful SLIs from the signals the platform already emits, and exposing them to Platform Administrators through a clean API. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior SRE who thinks past dashboards to the contract between a platform and its operators. The right candidate can look at raw telemetry from Kubernetes, bare metal, and NVIDIA infrastructure, decide which signals actually predict user-visible reliability, and turn them into SLIs and SLOs that operators can act on. You are equally comfortable writing the service that exposes those SLIs through an API and reasoning about error budgets, alerting quality, and signal-to-noise. You should be self-directed, able to own reliability definitions end to end, and effectively communicate them across teams.

Responsibilities

• Define SLIs and SLOs based on the signals available across the platform — Kubernetes, bare-metal hosts, and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).
• Design and build the API that exposes SLIs and reliability state to Platform Administrators and downstream systems.
• Establish alerting and error-budget practices that maximize signal and minimize noise.
• Partner with infrastructure, storage, and networking teams to ensure the right signals are instrumented and collected.
• Diagnose reliability and performance issues across the observability stack and drive their resolution.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in SRE, platform reliability, or a closely related software/infrastructure role.
• Strong software engineering skills (e.g., Go or Python) with experience building and operating APIs or services in production.
• Demonstrated experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for real production systems.
• Hands-on experience with observability tooling — metrics, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).
• Solid understanding of Kubernetes and the signals it and its workloads emit.
• Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

• Experience instrumenting or monitoring bare-metal and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC/Redfish, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).
• Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, KOF) and Cluster API.
• Familiarity with VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs at scale.
• Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
• Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
• Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com

jobs.title: Content Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. 



We're looking for a Content Lead to own the ideas and stories that make Nooks the company revenue leaders learn from.

Nooks is defining a new category. Revenue agents are changing how sales teams are built, how reps spend their time and how pipeline gets created, and the leaders we sell to are trying to figure out what that means for them. You'll build the content program that answers their questions and shows them where things are going: original research and guides they want to download, a blog and newsletter they come back to, and technical writing from Nooks Research that proves we're building the future, not just talking about it.

We're looking for an editor and a strategist in one person: someone with a strong point of view, a high bar for writing, and the operating discipline to run a publishing engine that drives pipeline. You'll report to the Head of Communications & Content and partner closely with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Nooks Research, Brand Design and the executive team.

Responsibilities:

 - Own our editorial strategy
   
   - Set the content strategy and editorial calendar for Nooks, built around our point of view on revenue agents and the agent-era sales org
   
   - Decide what we publish, for which audience and why, across the blog, newsletter, guides, research and video
   
   - Hold a high bar for every piece, so our content reads as sharp and opinionated rather than generic

 - Create content that drives pipeline
   
   - Produce flagship demand content, including guides, original research, benchmarks and white papers, that gives buyers a reason to raise their hand
   
   - Partner with Growth Marketing to turn that content into offers for paid, email and webinars, and track how it converts into S0s
   
   - Build content for each stage of the buying journey and each segment, from first touch to the business case

 - Tell the story of what we're building
   
   - Partner with Product Marketing on launch content, customer stories and the narrative behind major releases
   
   - Work with Nooks Research and Engineering to publish technical writing that shows how our agents work and what we're learning
   
   - Help our executives publish bylines, essays and thought leadership in their own voice

 - Run the content engine
   
   - Manage freelance writers, agencies and contractors, and build a repeatable process for briefs, editing and review
   
   - Repurpose flagship pieces across formats and channels with Social, Brand Design and Field, so every big idea reaches more people
   
   - Use AI tools to research, draft and produce faster without lowering the bar

 - Measure what matters
   
   - Track engagement, organic and AI-search visibility, offer conversion and pipeline influenced by content
   
   - Use what you learn to double down on what works and cut what doesn't

Requirements:

 - 6+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial or journalism, including leading content strategy at a B2B technology company

 - A portfolio of work you've written and edited that shows a clear point of view and a high bar for quality

 - A track record of content that drove measurable demand or pipeline, not just traffic

 - Experience running an editorial calendar and managing freelance writers or agencies

 - The ability to work with product, engineering and research teams to turn complex technical topics into clear, compelling stories

 - Comfort writing for senior business buyers, especially sales, RevOps and GTM leaders

 - Curiosity about AI and daily use of AI tools in your own work

Nice to have:

 - Experience building a research report, benchmark or flagship publication from scratch

 - Experience at an AI or fast-growing SaaS company during a category-creation moment

 - Experience ghostwriting for executives

Dependable team player with good communication, customer service, and basic math skills. Willing to learn food preparation, order taking, and restaurant cleanliness standards. Training provided.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

AT A GLANCE

As part of our RVO Health Security team, you will play a major part in strategic initiatives that improve our security posture and protect our sensitive data. You will work in a collaborative Agile environment, working closely with the business, IT, and engineering teams. You will apply your skills in a highly dynamic, innovative, cloud-native environment with a strong security-minded culture.

What You’ll Do

• Design, implement, and maintain security controls and architectures to protect the company's cloud infrastructure, applications, and data from cyber threats.

• Improve our cloud security posture and vulnerability management program — pull-request scanning, triage and tracking of findings to closure across engineering teams, and coverage and license optimization.

• Build and enforce software supply chain controls across the developer toolchain — package, dependency, and extension guardrails, with enforcement thresholds tuned to reduce noise rather than generate it.

• Extend security into CI/CD pipelines, including the emerging problem of governing AI-authored code at the pipeline chokepoint.

• Build automation, internal tooling, and integrations against our developer platform and security stack so that security controls are self-service rather than ticket-driven.

• Partner with Platform & Software Engineering teams to create visibility and awareness of security issues and work to prioritize their resolution in a collaborative way.

• Perform security assessments, including code reviews and application security testing, to identify and mitigate risk in new and changing systems.

• Participate in a weekly on-call rotation for managed detection and response escalations; investigate potential threats, respond to security incidents, and perform root cause analysis.

• Develop and maintain security standard operating procedures and policies in accordance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, NIST CSF).

• Stay informed of the latest developments in tactics, techniques, and procedures related to application and infrastructure vulnerabilities — especially in the healthcare space — and adapt the strategy or tooling to address new threats.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field OR equivalent experience

• Minimum 4+ years of experience in application security, cloud security, or a related cybersecurity role.

• Solid understanding of cloud security principles, architectures, and services (AWS or Azure preferred).

• Hands-on experience with cloud security posture management or CNAPP tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud), and a track record of driving vulnerability findings to closure with engineering teams.

• Experience building security automation, tooling, and integrations, with working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language.

• Working knowledge of secure coding practices.

• Knowledge of security frameworks, standards, and regulations (e.g., NIST CSF, HIPAA, MITRE ATT&CK).

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think critically and make sound decisions.

• Experience in incident response and recovery.

Preferred:

• Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC).

• Expertise in AWS security controls, monitoring, and orchestration (SCPs, GuardDuty, Config, Macie, etc.)

• Working familiarity with Terraform, GitHub, and DevSecOps workflows — particularly securing GitHub Actions and other CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience securing AI- or LLM-assisted development workflows, or reviewing AI-generated code at scale.

• Experience with internal developer platforms or portals (e.g., Backstage).

• Experience working alongside an MDR or managed SOC provider.

• Life Insurance

• Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Paid Time Off

• Holiday Pay

• 401(k) with match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program

• Pharmacy Benefits

• Income Protection Plans

• Pet Services Plans

• Mental Health Support

• Wellness Coaching

• HSA- Health Savings Account

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager — Quantum Enablement Platform
jobs.description:
Summary

QuEra develops quantum hardware, software tools, and educational resources to advance the understanding and use of neutral atom fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC). We are seeking a Technical Product Manager with knowledge of FTQC to own the user experience of our Quantum Enablement Platform, serving our partners, collaborators, and the broader quantum computing community.

About the Role

Your goal will be to define and deliver a product vision that helps users progress from learning about FTQC and neutral atom quantum computing to exploring QuEra’s capabilities and designing experiments for our systems. You will draw on your expertise in quantum computing and product development to work closely with scientists, software engineers, and other product managers, translating user feedback and advances in QuEra’s software and hardware into clear product priorities. You will also prepare the platform for AI-enabled learning workflows, helping users explore concepts, navigate resources, and apply what they learn with the support of AI assistants.

Responsibilities

• Shape product planning: Work alongside scientists, software engineers, and other product managers to define the Quantum Enablement Platform vision, roadmap, and priorities.

• Define product requirements and priorities: Collect and analyze usage data, learning outcomes, and user feedback to identify improvements. Translate these insights and advances in QuEra’s hardware and software into clear platform requirements.

• Improve the learning experience: Help users progress from understanding quantum computing concepts to exploring QuEra’s capabilities and designing experiments, including through AI-enabled learning workflows.

• Develop educational offerings: Identify gaps in educational content and interactive tooling, and work with our internal experts to address them.

• Coordinate updates and releases: Plan platform updates, track dependencies, and coordinate testing, content reviews, and release materials.

• Inform software interfaces: Analyze user behavior and feedback from the platform to identify usability gaps and help software development teams improve interfaces and workflows.

Qualifications

• Professional experience managing a user-facing online platform, including gathering user feedback, prioritizing improvements, and coordinating ongoing updates.

• Substantial experience designing or improving AI-assisted workflows, with an understanding of how users use AI tools to explore technical concepts, navigate resources, and apply what they learn.

• Foundational knowledge of quantum error correction and FTQC, with the ability to explain technical concepts to audiences with different levels of expertise.

• Ability to collect and analyze usage data and user feedback to assess user needs, recommend improvements, and define clear requirements and priorities.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, physics, engineering, chemistry, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating technical documentation, tutorials, interactive demonstrations, or workshops for quantum computing or scientific software.

• Experience developing or managing educational platforms, including evaluating learning outcomes and user engagement.

• Experience with neutral atom quantum computing.

• Graduate-level study in a relevant technical field, or technology management.

Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for an experienced Principal Engineering Architect to help shape the architecture of Dotmatics Luma, our next-generation, multi-tenant, AI-powered data management and workflow automation platform for multimodal scientific discovery. You will design and refine the AWS systems that deploy Luma efficiently to customers.

As a Principal Software Engineering Architect, you will be a key driver in delivering Luma to customers. This role will be an influential leader and advisor to the Engineering and Product teams. You will provide deep technical expertise on our current technologies, and technical leadership that promotes new ideas and improves how we build and release Luma, including how instruments, scientific data, and the AI agent at the core of the platform connect.

In this role you will get to

• Support and drive the end-to-end architecture of Luma, from instrument connectivity and data ingestion through to the platform services and AI agent experience

• Influence technology choices for the platform

• Design solutions that are enterprise scalable and maintainable, with the data isolation and auditability that regulated scientific customers

• Collaborate on architectural principles, frameworks, best practices, and standards, including how the AI agent and extension points such as MCP connect securely to platform services

• Drive strategic technology initiatives with Product Managers, other Architects, and Engineers

• Be hands-on in developing and delivering Luma, this includes prototyping and guiding the implementation of components inside of Luma.

• Help improve developer experience and software lifecycle by proposing tools and pipelines that increase the quality of the software development experience.

• Advise the product team in clarifying requirements for deploying Luma into customer clouds, including multi-tenant and regulated-environment needs

• Work with customer cloud teams.

• Facilitate the architecture processes, including architecture reviews and documentation

• Mentor other software engineers on the team

• Shape projects in a timely manner to established architecture patterns

• Work in a consultative fashion to improve communication, collaboration, and alignment among teams inside and outside the organization

• Analyse and provide feedback on Luma product strategy

We are looking for people who have a BSc in Computer Science and 10+ equivalent, with deep technical expertise in engineering architecture and engineering design. You will have expert knowledge of building, releasing, and maintaining a complex scientific enterprise software platform.

The Key Skills we are looking for:

• Deep understanding of modern cloud software architecture, including multi-tenant platforms

• Systems design and development, with a solid understanding of application development best practices and core enterprise applications

• Deep knowledge of AWS services

• Knowledge of cloud-native infrastructure such as Kubernetes and Kafka

• Working technical knowledge of integration strategies, including web services and APIs

• Experience setting up agentic harnesses for code generation

• Influential communication with core and cross-functional teams

• Infrastructure-as-code solutions (CloudFormation, Terraform)

• Software containerization concepts (Docker, Podman)

• CI/CD tools (Jenkins, TeamCity, CodePipeline)

• Knowledge of networking concepts in cloud environments

• Software development lifecycle processes and version control

• Modern back-end JavaScript and Node.js, Python

• Business requirements gathering and analysis, strategic planning, and project planning and management

• Engineering evaluation principles and practice

You may also have:

• Instrument integration and scientific data ingestion (e.g. SiLA, OPC-UA)

• Apache Spark, Databricks, or comparable data platforms

• Securing AI agent integrations (permissions, sandboxing, prompt injection defense)

• Experience using research informatics software and tools

THE OPPORTUNITY 

The Program Manager owns the end-to-end delivery and execution of the onsite and in-the-wild data collection client programs, overseeing financial performance, client engagement, and cross-functional execution from pre-sales through delivery. This role is business-minded and delivery-focused: it requires deep operational excellence, client satisfaction, and strategic execution in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where quality, throughput, and safety all matter simultaneously.

 


LOCATION & FLEXIBILITY 

Our ideal candidate will work remotely out of the Unites States. This role has required and regular travel to program facilities and field data collection sites.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES 

 


PROGRAM OWNERSHIP & LEADERSHIP

 - Own overall program performance, including financial health (forecasting, P&L, invoicing), delivery success, and client satisfaction.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation point for operational and client challenges, leading regular client syncs and on-site or virtual business reviews (weekly/quarterly).

 - Drive consistent reporting through weekly status updates, dashboards, and progress reviews to internal leadership and client stakeholders.

 - Lead and develop project teams with direct people management responsibility, monitoring performance metrics and productivity across teams and addressing gaps through coaching and development.

OPERATIONAL STRATEGY & EXECUTION

 - Oversee procurement strategy for equipment and staffing to match approved program scope.

 - Support the launch of new workstreams and oversee integration of third-party contributions into the overall delivery model.

 - Proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, recommending interventions or contingency plans to close gaps or resolve quality and yield issues before they affect the client.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Align Operations, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Quality, and vendors around a single delivery plan.

 - Partner closely with the client — translating their requirements on approach, calibration, and equipment into staffing plans, timelines, and budgets, and ensuring field execution reflects the agreed technical standard.

 - Ensure alignment between execution and financial expectations, and drive clear communication across stakeholders for accountability.

 - Contribute to strategic planning with the client account and broader leadership team, identifying opportunities to scale the data collection delivery model to new accounts and programs.

 


QUALIFICATIONS 

 - 3–5+ years managing global or large-scale onsite/field operations programs supporting Data Collection, User Research, Clinical Research, Machine Learning or a similar environment/domain.

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; relevant experience accepted in place of formal education.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Compliance Edition
jobs.description:
Compliance Edition helps vendors and suppliers meet the EDI requirements set by their customers and trading partners with back-end integration into key applications that allows them to automate these critical processes. As an Account Executive on this team, you will own the primary sales motions to these customers, including account research, discovery and qualification calls, solution selection and presentation, and proposals to closed deals.

You will interact professionally and as a solution advisor with all key stakeholders involved in the sales process, including C-Suite Executives, Partners & Consultants, Operational and IT personas.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Research. Research prospect targets and understand their business, partner relationships, who owns the decision and a position on the value we can provide to them.

• Discover. Run discovery with key stakeholders in management, operations, IT, finance, and procurement; understand their requirements, deadlines, and volumes; and position Cleo Compliance Edition as the right EDI solution with automation for them to start and grow with. Key stakeholders may include Cleo channel partners and supporting them in the sales cycle, positioning Cleo as the best solution.

• Close. Own the full sales cycle from first touch through close — qualifying opportunities, delivering demos with Solution Consultants, building proposals, handling objections, and negotiating terms. A sales cycle may include working with a customer hub with a supplier community that will use Cleo to become EDI compliant. You will work with the Hub Stakeholders to design and sell the program for their supplier community.

• Hand off. Hand off new customers smoothly to services and customer success teams so vendors are live and compliant before their deadlines

• Collaborate. Partner with Marketing, Customer Success, Cleo Channel, and Cleo’s existing customers on mandate-driven vendor lists, campaigns, and referral opportunities

• Advise. Educate prospects and customers on EDI basics, trading partner requirements, value delivery, and the value of Cleo’s ecosystem to build trust early and position yourself as a helpful advisor, not just a seller. Know how to build a business case that solves the problem they are having and justify the investment in Cleo.

• Forecast. Maintain accurate opportunity, account, and activity data in the CRM, and deliver reliable pipeline and revenue forecasts

• Share insights. Capture what you hear from vendors — objections, competitors, common compliance pain points — and share it with Product and Marketing to sharpen messaging

• Deliver. Consistently meet or exceed activity, pipeline, and quota targets

AI Fluency Competencies

• Prospect research and planning. Use AI to research target vendors, their trading partners, and the compliance requirements they face, and to prepare sharp, relevant call and meeting plans.

• Signal-driven prioritization. Interpret AI-driven intent and engagement signals to decide which vendors to prioritize and when to reach out.

• Prompting and iteration. Write clear prompts, give AI useful context, and refine outputs until they are accurate, specific, and ready to use.

• Tailored outbound communication. Use AI to draft and tailor outbound emails, call scripts, proposals, and follow-ups to each stakeholder’s role and priorities, then edit them so they sound authentic and are correct.

• Conversation intelligence. Use AI-generated call summaries, themes, and action items to capture next steps, coach yourself, and share insights with the team.

• Forecasting and CRM hygiene. Use AI assistance to keep records current, flag stalled deals, and pressure-test your forecast.

• Sound judgment and verification. Verify AI output before sharing it with a customer, know where AI helps and where human insight is needed, and keep your own judgment in every customer interaction.

• Responsible use. Follow Cleo’s AI, data security, and confidentiality policies. Never enter customer confidential or sensitive data into unapproved tools.

• Continuous learning. Stay curious about new AI capabilities, share what works with your peers, and help the team raise its collective AI skills.

Prerequisites

• Have received a Bachelor’s degree

• 2–3 years of experience in a quota-carrying B2B sales role (AE, SDR/BDR with closing responsibility, or inside sales), preferably in SaaS or technology

• Hands-on WebEDI experience — a working understanding of how vendors and suppliers connect with trading partners through web-based EDI, and familiarity with common transaction types (e.g., purchase orders, advance ship notices, invoices)

• Proven track record of account and campaign management, managing the details of a nurture campaign with targeted messaging to elicit positive responses.

• Ability to communicate clearly and with confidence in person, over the phone, in writing and online, and to build credibility and rapport quickly with operational and business stakeholders

• Comfortable using AI and automated marketing tools to research, plan, and communicate, with sound judgment about when and how to use them.

• Ability to travel 30%

Nice to have

• Background in retail, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution supply chains

jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, New Products
jobs.description:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world's largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Goldman Sachs, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, and Y Combinator.

We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble, and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building, seeking teammates who are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As a growth stage startup employee, you'll have the opportunity to build the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners' lives easier by eliminating up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.

 

About the Role

You will be the Director/Senior Director of Fieldguide's internal audit product: own the P&L, set the strategy, and take it from first design partners to a repeatable, multi-million-dollar business.

Internal audit teams carry the same capacity problem as external auditors, often with smaller budgets: rising SOX and regulatory scope, new risk areas like AI, cyber and third parties, and a shrinking talent pool. Much of their work (walkthroughs, controls testing, evidence requests, workpapers, issue tracking) looks like the work Fieldguide's agents already execute for audit firms. This role takes that engine to a new buyer: Chief Audit Executives and internal audit leaders at corporations, plus the firms that deliver co-sourced and outsourced internal audit for them.

This is not a product management or a sales role. You will make the calls a founder makes: which internal audit workflows to attack first, which companies are the first customers, what to build next and what to kill. You will have a dedicated pod of engineers, designers and internal audit subject-matter experts, and the full weight of Fieldguide's platform, brand and firm relationships behind you.



What You'll Do

 - Find the wedge. Spend real time inside internal audit functions with CAEs, audit directors, SOX program leads and staff auditors. Identify the high-volume, high-pain work (SOX controls testing, walkthroughs, evidence collection, risk assessments, operational audits) where an agent can do the job end to end, and decide which problem we win first.

 - Build the product with the pod. Partner with engineering, and design leads and our internal audit SMEs to define what ships, in what order, and what "good enough" means for work that lands in front of audit committees and external auditors. Write the spec when needed; sit in the eval reviews.

 - Land design partners, then customers. Help close the first 5–10 internal audit teams. Turn them into referenceable deployments with measurable hours saved, coverage gained and quality improved.

 - Partner with GTM. Work with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to shape how the product is positioned, sold and expanded: into corporate IA teams directly and through co-sourcing firms already on Fieldguide. Bring the customer insight and proof points they need, and help build a playbook they can run without you.

 - Know the landscape. Understand where incumbent GRC and audit-management tools stop, and position Fieldguide as the system that does the work, not just tracks it.

 - Build the team. Hire the first dedicated GTM, deployment and IA SME roles for the line as it scales.

 - Know when to double down or stop. Run tight experiments, read the signal honestly, and bring the company a clear recommendation.



Who You Are

 - 8+ years of experience, including at least one stint taking a product or business from zero to one: as a founder, a GM of a new line, or the first operator on a new product at a high-growth company.

 - Real P&L or revenue ownership, with numbers you can talk through.

 - Strong commercial instinct: you have sold complex B2B software to senior, skeptical buyers and closed deals yourself.

 - Enough technical depth to work as a peer with AI engineers: you understand what agents can and can't do today, and how evals and human review fit in.

 - Clear, structured writing. You turn ambiguity into a crisp memo and a plan people can act on.



Bonus Points

 - Background in internal audit, SOX, risk or controls: as a practitioner or leader in a corporate IA function, in a Big Four or Top 100 firm's risk advisory or internal audit practice, or selling into CAEs. CIA or CPA a plus.

 - Experience at a vertical SaaS, GRC or AI-native company between Series B and pre-IPO.

 - Management consulting, investment or strategy background paired with hands-on operating experience.

 

More About Fieldguide

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless: Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast: Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable: Deliver happiness and 11 star experiences.

 - Owners: Execute and run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win: Create mutual value and earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive: Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

 

Benefits

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits, including a bundle of free therapy sessions

 - Technology and Work from Home reimbursement

jobs.title: Product Manager, Legal
jobs.description:
In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We’ve scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing, and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.

Thousands of attorneys, Am Law firms, and corporate legal teams already rely on Perplexity every week—and Legal is one of our highest-conviction enterprise verticals. Following the playbook that scaled Perplexity Finance, we are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to build and scale our Legal vertical from the ground up.

Product Managers at Perplexity work closely with design, engineering, research, and go-to-market teams to turn frontier AI capabilities into indispensable daily workflows. Whether you have a couple of years of product experience at a legal AI or B2B software company, or you are an early-career builder or operator with high agency and a steep trajectory, this role offers rare end-to-end ownership of a flagship vertical. In your application, please highlight a product, workflow, or agent system you’ve built—or a specific legal problem you believe AI is uniquely positioned to solve.


THE ROLE

Legal work sits at the exact intersection where Perplexity shines: high-stakes research, multi-document synthesis, verifiable citations, and multi-step execution across specialized systems. Winning in Legal requires clearing an uncompromising bar for accuracy, source authority, document fidelity, and enterprise governance—without sacrificing the speed and simplicity that make Perplexity magical.

Sitting within our AI Capabilities & Verticals PM team, you will be the dedicated product owner for Perplexity’s Legal vertical. Rather than building an isolated point solution, you will shape how core Perplexity surfaces—Computer, Search, Teammates, Projects, Plugins, Skills, and Artifacts—come together into a cohesive, trusted experience for litigators, transactional counsel, and in-house legal teams. You will partner across Engineering, Design, AI Research, Partnerships, Sales, and Product Marketing to close product and data gaps, co-design with leading law firms and legal departments, and scale Legal into one of Perplexity’s flagship enterprise businesses.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the Legal vertical roadmap end-to-end: Define and execute product strategy across litigation research, M&A and transactional diligence, contract review and drafting, and in-house legal workflows—translating attorney pain points into modular capabilities that benefit the entire platform.

 - Ship core legal primitives and entrypoints: Partner with Engineering and Design to build the product surfaces high-stakes legal work demands—including structured multi-document review tables for diligence and discovery, passage-level inline citations with side-by-side source verification across PDFs/DOCX/spreadsheets, precision redlining and document comparison, and seamless workflows inside Microsoft Word, Outlook/email, and Slack.

 - Expand the legal data and connector ecosystem: Work closely with Business Development/Partnerships and Engineering to prioritize, integrate, and launch authoritative legal research sources (case law, citators, dockets, secondary sources) and system-of-record connectors across DMS, VDRs, CLM, e-discovery, and practice management (e.g., LexisNexis, Westlaw, iManage, NetDocuments, Datasite, Intralinks, Ironclad, Clio).

 - Build Legal Skills, Plugins, Teammates, and tailored onboarding: Design out-of-the-box legal workflows, domain-specific Skills, and tailored onboarding flows that ingest a lawyer’s or firm’s clause playbooks, precedent templates, and drafting conventions for immediate time-to-value.

 - Set the bar for accuracy, evaluations, and enterprise trust: Partner with AI Research and Engineering to build realistic, workflow-level legal benchmarks and evaluation harnesses (measuring citation fidelity, retrieval recall, tabular extraction, and redline quality), alongside enterprise controls for permissions, matter-level governance, and data handling.

 - Co-design with customers and accelerate vertical GTM: Build design partnerships with leading law firms and corporate legal teams, join strategic customer calls to turn live blockers into shipped product, and partner with Sales, Applied AI, and Product Marketing to craft category-defining demos, case studies, and self-serve and enterprise growth loops.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1–4+ years of experience in product management, founding/early-stage product building, forward-deployed product/solutions, or a high-intensity analytical/operating role (such as startup operations, strategy consulting, or investment banking) paired with hands-on product shipping. We index heavily on slope, curiosity, and execution speed rather than years on a resume.

 - No JD or formal legal degree required—though genuine curiosity about how legal professionals research, analyze risk, negotiate, and deliver work is essential.

 - AI-native builder: You actively build with LLMs and agents. You are comfortable writing and tuning prompts and Skills, prototyping workflows end-to-end, reasoning about tool calls and context budgets, and designing evaluations and human-in-the-loop safeguards for non-deterministic systems.

 - Analytical and data-fluent: Comfortable writing SQL, pulling your own cohorts, instrumenting failure modes, running guarded experiments, and pairing warehouse metrics with qualitative user research to focus on what drives retention and repeat high-value usage.

 - Crisp communicator and high-velocity executor: Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable moving directly from a partner call with an Am Law firm into writing a tight spec with engineers and shipping iterations the same week.

 - High-ownership operator: Thrives in a small, agile, low-ego team where processes are still being defined and you own the full stack of the outcome—from multi-quarter vertical strategy down to dogfooding edge cases in redlined Word documents.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building or operating at a legal AI, legal tech, e-discovery, CLM, or vertical enterprise AI company (or working directly with law firms and corporate legal departments).

 - Familiarity with real-world legal workflows and tooling—such as litigation cite-checking (Shepard’s/KeyCite), M&A virtual data rooms, contract redlining playbooks, DMS/CLM integrations, or Microsoft Office add-ins.

 - Technical foundation (CS, engineering, data science, or dual technical/business training) with comfort reading API documentation, MCP/connector schemas, and system architectures.

jobs.title: Principal Investigator, MD/DO
jobs.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

Principal Investigator (MD/DO)

Location: Scottsdale, Arizona
Employment Type: Part-Time, ideally looking for 2-3 days per week, potentially open to more flexibility.

Join Us in Improving Lives Through Clinical Research

At Headlands Research, we're committed to advancing medical science and improving lives by bringing innovative clinical trials to communities across North America. Our growing network of clinical research sites combines experienced medical professionals, advanced technology, and dedicated support teams to accelerate the development of new treatments.

Founded in 2018, Headlands Research has expanded into a leading clinical research network with locations throughout the United States and Canada. We are passionate about expanding access to clinical trials, improving participant experiences, and ensuring that diverse populations are represented in medical research.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Investigator (MD/DO) to join our clinical research team in Scottsdale, Arizona.

This is an exciting opportunity for a physician who is passionate about patient care, medical innovation, and advancing new treatments through clinical research.

As a Principal Investigator, you will provide medical leadership and oversight for clinical trials, ensuring participant safety, regulatory compliance, and high-quality study execution. You will collaborate with an experienced team of clinical research professionals and play an important role in bringing promising new therapies to market.

Prior clinical research experience is preferred but not required. We welcome physicians interested in transitioning into clinical research who bring strong clinical judgment, a commitment to patient safety, and a willingness to learn.

Why Join Headlands Research?

• Meaningful Impact: Contribute to the development of innovative treatments that have the potential to improve patients' lives.

• Collaborative Environment: Work alongside experienced clinical research coordinators, research assistants, physicians, advanced practice providers, and patient recruitment specialists.

• Dedicated Research Support: Benefit from an established clinical research infrastructure and operational support, allowing you to focus on medical oversight, participant safety, and study quality.

• Professional Growth: Expand your clinical research expertise while participating in studies across a variety of therapeutic areas.

• Commitment to Excellence: Join an organization that values professionalism, collaboration, diversity, and high-quality clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as Principal Investigator for assigned clinical trials, providing medical oversight and ensuring studies are conducted in accordance with approved protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Maintain responsibility for participant safety, medical decision-making, and the overall quality and integrity of clinical trial conduct.

• Evaluate potential study participants for eligibility, review medical histories, and assess clinical findings.

• Oversee the informed consent process, ensuring participants understand study procedures, potential risks, and their rights.

• Evaluate, document, and oversee the reporting of adverse events and serious adverse events in accordance with study protocols and regulatory requirements.

• Provide medical oversight for investigational products, including appropriate administration, monitoring, and assessment of treatment responses.

• Collaborate with clinical research coordinators, Sub-Investigators, and other site personnel to ensure efficient and compliant study execution.

• Ensure appropriate delegation of study responsibilities to qualified research personnel and provide ongoing supervision and training.

• Review and maintain accurate, complete, and timely clinical research documentation.

• Participate in sponsor meetings, investigator meetings, site initiation visits, monitoring visits, and regulatory inspections as needed.

• Work collaboratively with sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), Institutional Review Boards (IRBs), and regulatory agencies.

• Support participant recruitment and retention efforts while maintaining the highest standards of ethical research conduct.

• Contribute to a professional, collaborative, and participant-focused research environment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree from an accredited institution.

• Active, unrestricted medical license in the state of Arizona, or eligibility to obtain an Arizona medical license prior to beginning clinical research responsibilities.

• Board-certified or board-eligible in a recognized medical specialty.

• Strong clinical judgment and commitment to patient safety and ethical medical practices.

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary clinical research teams.

• Willingness to learn and follow clinical trial protocols, GCP guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience serving as a Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator in clinical research.

• Familiarity with FDA regulations, ICH-GCP guidelines, and clinical trial documentation requirements.

• Experience working with pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, or clinical research organizations.

• Experience evaluating and managing patients in therapeutic areas relevant to the site's clinical trial portfolio.

• Demonstrated ability to provide medical leadership and collaborate effectively with clinical and operational teams.

Clinical research experience is a plus, but we encourage qualified physicians who are interested in entering the clinical research field to apply.

Make an Impact with Headlands Research

At Headlands Research, you'll have the opportunity to apply your medical expertise in a collaborative research environment while helping advance treatments that could benefit patients around the world.

Whether you're an experienced clinical investigator or a physician exploring a new direction in your medical career, we invite you to learn more about joining our team in Scottsdale, Arizona.

Apply today and help shape the future of clinical research.

Headlands Research will never ask a candidate for personal identifiable information (date of birth, social security number, driver’s license information, etc) via email or messenger tools, or for a financial deposit of any kind.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketer, Neurology (East Region)
jobs.description:
Axsome Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company leading a new era in the treatment of central nervous system (CNS) conditions. We deliver scientific breakthroughs by identifying critical gaps in care and develop differentiated products with a focus on novel mechanisms of action that enable meaningful advancements in patient outcomes. Our industry-leading neuroscience portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for major depressive disorder, agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease, excessive daytime sleepiness associated with narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, and migraine, as well as multiple novel product candidates addressing a broad range of serious neurological and psychiatric conditions that impact over 150 million people in the United States. Together, we are on a mission to solve some of the brain’s biggest problems so patients and their loved ones can flourish. For more information, please visit us at www.axsome.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

About This Role:

Axsome Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Regional Marketer (Thought Leader Liaison) to join our Neurology Marketing team. This field-based role will serve as a strategic connection between key thought leaders, regional markets, and the broader Axsome organization, helping translate customer and marketplace insights into meaningful commercial strategies and initiatives across our neurology portfolio.

The Senior Regional Marketer will develop and maintain relationships with regional, and local thought leaders across relevant neurology communities, gathering insights that help inform brand strategy, customer engagement, educational initiatives, and future marketing efforts. The role will also lead regional execution of key HCP marketing initiatives, including peer-to-peer education, speaker identification and development, advisory boards, congress engagement, and other thought leader programs aligned with brand and portfolio priorities.

Success in this role requires strong external relationship-building capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to connect insights from the field with opportunities for the business. The Senior Regional Marketer will collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Field Medical, Training, Market Access, Market Research, and Medical Affairs in accordance with applicable policies and procedures. This position reports to the Senior Director, Regional Marketing for Neurology.

This is a field-based position supporting the East Region, including CT, D.C., DE, FL, GA, KY, MA, MD, ME, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TN, VA, VT, WV. Candidates must reside within the assigned geography.

Job Responsibilities and Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

Thought Leader Engagement & Insights

• Serve as a key commercial liaison to national, regional, and local thought leaders across relevant neurology communities, building trusted relationships and creating a strong bridge between external stakeholders and Axsome.

• Develop and execute strategic thought leader engagement plans based on regional dynamics, stakeholder needs, brand priorities, and business objectives.

• Develop and maintain thought leader mapping and engagement strategies to identify key relationships and opportunities across the region.

• Engage thought leaders at local, regional, and national congresses, professional meetings, and advocacy events to support appropriate commercial and brand initiatives.

• Gather and synthesize actionable insights from thought leaders and the regional marketplace to help inform brand strategy, messaging, educational needs, resources, and future marketing initiatives.

• Facilitate appropriate engagement opportunities between thought leaders and Axsome leadership in support of strategic marketing initiatives.

Regional & Brand Strategy

• Serve as a voice of the region to brand and commercial teams, communicating emerging customer needs, competitive dynamics, market trends, and opportunities across relevant neurology markets.

• Partner cross-functionally to translate regional and thought leader insights into actionable recommendations for commercial strategy and execution.

• Support the development and execution of regional HCP marketing initiatives aligned with brand and portfolio strategies and objectives.

• Provide insight into local marketplace dynamics, including customer education needs, clinical messaging, access considerations, and other factors influencing the treatment landscape.

• Partner with Marketing and other stakeholders to evaluate existing programs and identify opportunities to strengthen future customer engagement.

• Identify potential HCP speakers consistent with approved criteria and business needs.

• Lead the development, training, engagement, and ongoing support of promotional speakers to enable high-quality peer-to-peer education.

• Partner with Marketing and other internal stakeholders to support compliant execution of speaker programs.

• Attend and monitor speaker programs, providing appropriate coaching and feedback to support effective program delivery.

• Gather and synthesize speaker feedback to help inform current and future content, resources, and educational initiatives.

Advisory Boards & Congress Engagement

• Support the planning and execution of commercial advisory boards and other approved thought leader engagements.

• Identify potential HCP consultants consistent with approved consultant engagement criteria.

• Support and, where appropriate, facilitate advisory boards designed to gather meaningful customer and market insights.

• Represent Regional Marketing at relevant local, regional, and national congresses and professional meetings.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to maximize appropriate thought leader engagement opportunities surrounding major congresses and events.

• Build strong partnerships with field-based and corporate colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Field Medical, Training, Market Access, Market Research, and Medical Affairs.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Army Strategic Partner Business Developer (BD)
jobs.description:

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Army Strategic Partner Business Developer (BD) to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Army Strategic Partner BD plays a critical role in supporting and enhancing the effectiveness of the sales team focused on federal accounts. This role involves partnering with Army End Customer & Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) to identify opportunities, provide specialized knowledge, and drive strategic sales initiatives for Echodyne radars. The Army Strategic Partner BD will work alongside the sales team to engage with prime/partner/integrator clients, develop tailored solutions, and support the sales process from lead generation to closing deals. They will be responsible for delivering high-impact presentations and demonstrations, addressing complex customer inquiries, and staying up-to-date with industry trends, product developments, and the competitive landscape. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in sales within the federal sector, exceptional interpersonal skills, and a deep understanding of the UAS / CUAS markets.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Function as a Counter-Drone SME, collaborating with Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) and BD personnel to advance Echodyne sales efforts with key Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) players.

• Act as an overlay while aiding BD and RSMs in initiating and advancing sales activities.

• Collaborate effectively with internal teams, including RSMs, Solutions Engineers (SEs), and BD personnel, as well as engage with customers to understand their needs and advance sales efforts.

• Identify internal and external support needed to cultivate strategic partnerships.

• Conduct high-level conversations with senior executives at prospective partners and customers.
