jobs.title: Principal ASIC Synthesis and Timing Engineer
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are looking for a Principal ASIC Synthesis and Timing Engineer to lead the implementation of complex SoCs for next-generation satellite and space systems. You will own the constraints development and validation—from RTL handoff to synthesis —and collaborate closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, and physical design team. This role also involves managing external physical design partners, driving convergence of schedule and ensuring first-pass silicon success in advanced FinFET technologies. You’ll be a key contributor in achieving timing closure, optimizing PPA, and supporting design integration with external partners. You will be part of a collaborative design team developing state-of-the-art mixed-signal SoCs to be hosted on some of the largest, most powerful, rapidly designed and rapidly manufactured satellites ever deployed in space. In your first 6 months, you will develop and implement new SoC sub-systems for satellite communications and beyond. In your first two years, you will have contributed to developing cutting-edge SoCs that will fly in space.

Responsibilities

• Own the complete RTL-to-Synthesis flow: Do synthesis at block and top level, Work with physical design team to integrate the floorplanning information for physical synthesis.

• Develop and maintain design methodologies, scripts, and automation to optimize performance, power, and area (PPA).

• Collaborate with front-end and verification teams to ensure clean handoffs, timing closure, and efficient design iteration.

• Drive timing closure across multiple voltage and process corners, including sign-off with foundry-qualified tools.

• Own Lint, CDC and UPF checks and drive collaboration to close out issues.

• Develop an end to end formal verification methodology without any gap to deliver on full confidence functionality between the RTL and the post layout netlist.

• Manage and technically guide external physical design partners and service vendors, ensuring alignment on milestones, deliverables, and quality standards.

• Work with EDA vendors to debug and optimize tool flows, and evaluate new methodologies.

• Support chip bring-up and debug through close collaboration with post-silicon and test teams.

• Support your product through production and spaceflight.

Qualifications

• B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in ASIC design for high-performance SoCs.

• Proven end-to-end expertise in RTL-to-GDSII flows using industry tools (Synopsys, Cadence, or Siemens).

• Strong hands-on experience with timing closure, IR drop analysis, low power implementation and ECO implementation.

• Deep understanding of physical design constraints for multi-clock, multi-voltage, and hierarchical SoCs.

• Experience with advanced FinFET process nodes.

• Prior experience in design convergence with offshore/outsourced PD teams or vendors.

• Able to resolve formal verification issues.

• Able to analyze and fix VCLP issues regarding UPF.

• Experience with Logic equivalence check debug, Functional ECO development and implementation with minimal database disruption, Low power checker to validate UPF;

• Familiarity with DFT integration, STA sign-off with functional ECO implementation.

• Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Act as technical leader and subject-matter expert helping to teach, grow, and mentor others in the team.

Nice to Have

• Exposure to radiation-hardened or space-qualified ASICs.

• Familiarity with physical design service vendor management or offshore collaboration.

• Experience driving tapeouts through TSMC.

• Experience with Gate-All-Around technologies.

• Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $280,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

jobs.title: Product Design, Manager
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.



Learn more at envoy.com http://envoy.com



About the Role: Great Product Design is critical to ensuring safe, secure environments worldwide. The more complex a process or procedure is, the less likely it is to be skipped/bypassed, and the more likely an intrusion or anomaly will occur. Product Design at Envoy exists to ensure that the products we build will have the true impact our customers hope for.

This is not an easy job. Our customers always want every security feature turned on because it seems like a good idea. Of course they want an ID scan, a photo taken, a background check done, and an NDA the legal team wanted – all of these are great for security and compliance. But are they really practical for a guest coming in for a casual lunch? More likely than not, it’ll take too much time, bring too much surveillance, and solidify a pretty bad, memorable experience. So what naturally happens? Hosts will skip the steps altogether, not record anything down, and bring their guest in anyway. It’s only natural. Your job at Envoy is to be hypervigilant about what’s being tried to be achieved and find ways to help our buyer achieve what they want, but in new, thoughtful, easier ways. This is what makes the job hard and where the best designers shine: how can you make all the security needs easy? 

What you build should be so easy to understand that anyone can set it up. Our industry, physical security, is not used to this. This is the opportunity.

As a Product Design Manager, you’ll own Envoy’s user experience and lead the design team behind it. You’ll work directly with our CEO and with product and engineering leadership to set the design vision and help shape product and business strategy.

Day to day, that means turning layered workflows into clear information architecture and strong visual and interaction design across a broad product surface. You’ll also grow the design organization, much of it from the ground up: coaching and mentoring designers, shaping the team’s structure, developing design leaders, and building research practices that put real customer insight into product decisions. You’ll set the processes and principles that keep quality consistent as the team scales.

You’ll move between vision and execution, bringing executives along, influencing partners across the company, and working with brand marketing to keep the customer experience cohesive across every product and touchpoint.

We’re looking for someone who advocates hard for end users while understanding what buyers need, spots problems before anyone asks, pushes through friction to get results, earns trust, makes thoughtful trade-offs, and helps teams move fast without cutting corners. If you love building products and helping talented designers do the best work of their careers, you’ll enjoy this a lot.

This is a full-time, 5-day onsite role (Monday–Friday) at our San Francisco HQ (410 Townsend St). We build products for workplaces, and we believe being together helps us solve problems faster, collaborate more effectively, and build better experiences for our customers. 

We hope this all sounds great to you so far!

As a baseline, you will need:

 - 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years managing people.

 - 5+ years of interaction design across web and/or mobile, and 3+ years in information architecture and visual design.

 - A strong portfolio showing design leadership, end-to-end ownership, and deep knowledge of user-centered design and prototyping.

 - Experience building or leading SaaS or mobile products.

 - A track record of leading teams through complex design challenges and delivering meaningful customer impact.

 - A bias toward action. You find problems and opportunities without being asked, and you’ve built products or teams without all the pieces in place.

 - Experience adapting across different problem spaces, products, or industries.

 - Experience creating customer journeys and Jobs-to-be-Done frameworks.

 - Strong customer advocacy grounded in data and business context, and a collaborative approach with product, engineering, and other partners.

 - A BA/BS or MA/MS in a design-related field, or equivalent experience.

In this role, you will:

 - Own Envoy’s design vision and the framework for our customers’ end-to-end experience, keeping it cohesive and consistent across every product and touchpoint, including with brand marketing.

 - Work with our CEO and product and engineering leadership to turn business and product strategy into a compelling design direction.

 - Decide what to cut, keep, and rebuild across our existing products, and make the call without waiting for perfect information.

 - Build, lead, and grow a world-class design team that consistently delivers exceptional work.

 - Establish the design philosophy, culture, and principles that guide how we build products.

 - Build design processes, tools, and methods where none exist, and improve the ones that do, so teams can move quickly without lowering the quality bar.

 - Champion interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and prototyping that simplify complex workflows.

 - Build and lead research that delivers meaningful customer insights and informs product decisions.

 - Communicate design strategy, decisions, and trade-offs clearly to executives and stakeholders, building alignment along the way.

 - Set the plans, team structures, and budgets that support the design organization’s growth.

 - Advocate for the customer while balancing business priorities, technical constraints, and urgency.

And yes, roles change over time. This job description is dynamic, and you need to be comfortable with evolving priorities, teams, and responsibilities.

Your values: Every company has its own culture and values, and what makes a place great comes down to how well yours match. So as you read the list below, be real with yourself: if it’s not a “yes, absolutely,” it’s best not to apply. Trust us, you’ll have a bad time. But if these describe you, you’ll have an amazing time here, with friends you’ll keep for years.

 - You have strong end-user intuition and an exceptionally high bar for how products look, feel, and function. You believe enterprise software deserves the same craftsmanship as the best consumer products, and you want to build things you’d proudly use every day.

 - You thrive in ambiguous, low-guidance environments and own the quality and impact of everything your team delivers.

 - You don’t wait for the right process or infrastructure to show up. You find what’s broken, fix it, and build what’s missing.

 - You’d rather build from scratch than maintain what’s already there, and you adapt quickly when the problem space changes.

 - You’re a coach and mentor at heart, committed to developing designers and building a team that consistently produces outstanding work.

 - You’re data-driven, using research, insights, and measurable outcomes rather than opinions or anecdotes to make design decisions.

 - You’re impatient for progress, measured in days rather than months or quarters, and you help your team balance quality with urgency.

 - You advocate strongly for design while knowing the best outcomes come from close collaboration with product, engineering, and business partners.

 - You embrace AI tooling as a force multiplier for exploration, research, prototyping, and execution, and you’re excited to share what you learn.

 - You believe being in-office is the best way to solve problems fast and build great products.

 - You have empathy and humility, know you’re always learning, and look for the same in your teammates.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have fully read and understand the job requirements and received the Envoy Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here https://envoy.com/privacypolicy/. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

 - Newer reps, college students and recent grads ready to start a sales career

 - Competitive, coachable, and comfortable hearing "no"

 - Clear, confident speaker

 - A quiet place to work, a reliable computer, a headset, and stable internet (you'll pass a short equipment check)

About the contractor role

This is an independent contractor (1099) position, not employment with Sellfire. As a contractor:

 - You set your own hours within the dialing window (8 AM to 6 PM in each prospect's local time) and decide how much you work

 - You provide and maintain your own equipment

 - You choose which customer programs to work on

 - You're paid 100% commission for results, not hourly, and you're responsible for your own taxes

 - You don't receive employee benefits such as health insurance or paid time off

The only things we require: pass screening and the equipment check, complete certification, and meet our quality standards on every call, including sticking to each customer's approved script.

New to sales? Start here.

In tech, the SDR (sales development rep) role is the most common way into sales, and the hardest part is landing the first one without experience. Here you get real dials, connects and meetings booked to point to, and a clear path: SDR, then account executive, then senior AE, sales manager or sales leader. Sales pay is tied to results, promotions come from performance, and building trust on a live call is a skill AI can't easily replace.

Already selling? This is built for you too.

 - Your hours, your location. Dial whenever the businesses you call are open: 8 AM to 6 PM in their local time, Monday to Friday, across every US time zone from Eastern to Alaska and Hawaii. Work from wherever you are, around a day job, or full days when you want them. No shifts and no minimum schedule.

 - Top-rate campaigns, no quota. Choose the programs that pay best, up to $450 per held meeting. No manager, no minimums, no cap.

 - Skip the busywork. Lists, dialer, scripts and call prep are ready when you log in. You just make the calls.

How it works

 1. Apply (2 minutes, or one click with Indeed Apply)

 2. Take the 10-minute call challenge (we'll email you the link; includes a quick equipment check)

 3. If you pass, finish Sellfire training and certification

 4. Start calling on your own schedule

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Realtime
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Realtime team at Supabase. Realtime lets developers send low-latency messages between clients, track and synchronize user state, and listen to database changes. Those three features are Broadcast, Presence and Postgres Changes. Broadcast also sends from the database and over HTTP, and clients can replay recent messages.

Realtime is a globally distributed Elixir cluster built on Phoenix. The team balances low latency, fair limits between projects, and the cost of running the service. Customers expect connections to stay up, so reliability matters as much as new features.

The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code, but you you will lead a team of experienced engineers. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Team & People

 - Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

 - Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

 - Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

 - Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

 - Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery & Roadmap

 - Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

 - Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

 - Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

 - Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

 - Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

 - Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

 - Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

 - Have managed a team that built and ran a low-latency, high-connection service. Examples are WebSockets, pub/sub, messaging, presence or streaming systems.

 - Have strong technical credibility in distributed systems. We look for clustering, rate limiting, backpressure and capacity planning.

 - Have led a team through production incidents on a customer-facing service. You ran the follow-up work and kept the review blameless.

 - Understand what developers need from a real-time API or SDK, and have shipped one to customers outside your company.

 - Have experience with Elixir, Erlang or BEAM (not required but a plus).

 - Have experience with Postgres logical replication and Row Level Security (not required but a plus).

 - Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

 - Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

 - Build psychological safety and a feedback culture. You give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

 - Operate as a multiplier. You help individuals achieve more than they could alone, and you don't need to be the best technical voice in the room.

 - Coach rather than direct. You remove blockers, connect people to context, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

 - Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and can build structure where there isn't much.

 - Communicate clearly and write well. You default to async and written, set context early, and surface risks early.

 - Are collaborative, low-ego and adaptable. You thrive with high-autonomy senior engineers who don't need you to be the smartest person in the room.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Pizza Maker - 429 E Main St
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the

phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Registered Sleep Technologist - Part Time NIghts
jobs.description:
The  Registered Sleep Technologist  reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

This position performs all aspects of overnight polysomnograms, including CPAP/Bi-PAP titrations.  A Registered Sleep Technologist must have achieved competency in the following areas:

•    Independently prepare patients for and perform diagnostic polysomnograms.

•    Independently perform CPAP and Bi-PAP titrations according to national standards and departmental guidelines.  Includes ability to articulate indications for administration of humidification.

•    Demonstrate knowledge of indications (and procedure for obtaining orders) for administration of oxygen.

•    Demonstrate the ability to score and process sleep records.

This position works closely with other members of the NTC/SDC staff, including physicians.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

•    Completes all required paperwork before study is performed, including consent, relevant patient history, questionnaires, etc. Clarify unclear or inappropriate orders.  Complete billing information upon completion of procedure.

•    Independently prepare equipment for monitoring by performing necessary calibrations, selecting filter settings, determining appropriate monitoring montage, and entering required patient information.

•    Provide CPAP training by utilizing appropriate patient education materials.

•    Prepare patients for study by accurately placing recording devices required for procedure.  Utilizes International 10-20 system for EEG electrode placement.

•    Record study by entering appropriate notations and clinical observations into computer system and on technician worksheet.

•    Identify abnormalities such as apneas, PLM’s, and other sleep disturbances.  Seeks assistance to adjust recording technique to best enhance and provide a clearly interpretable record.

•    Recognize and respond appropriately to medical problems and physiological events, especially cardiac dysrhythmias, respiratory events and seizures.

•    Recognize technically inadequate signals and initiate troubleshooting techniques.  Obtain additional assistance as needed.  Appropriately document barriers to resolution.

•    Maintain monitoring equipment in clean and organized condition.

•    Participate in departmental in-services and continuing education.

•    Encourage teamwork through interdepartmental communication and constructive problem resolution.

•    Provide training for new Sleep Technicians and student preceptors.

•    Score sleep records according to department guidelines.

•    Maintain registry in good standing by completing the necessary CEU requirements (10 CEs or equivalent per year) as established by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine

•    Provides testing information, reassures and relaxes patients, and prepares patients for their procedure.

•    Provides assistance to all patients as needed.

•    Requires interaction with patients of all ages (pediatric, adult and geriatric).

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

•    High school diploma or equivalent

Certification:

•    Certification by Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists, RPSGT or Registered Respiratory Therapist.

•    BLS CPR certified

Experience:

•    At minimum of 12 months prior sleep tech experience.

Behavioral Attributes:

•    Knowledge of the International 10-20 system of electrode placement.

•    Familiarity with personal computers.

Preferred:

•    Bachelor’s Degree or additional training in electroneurodiagnostics, anatomy, or successful completion of certification in allied health school.

•    Prior sleep experience at a facility accredited by the AASM.

•    At minimum of 18 months prior sleep tech experience.

jobs.title: Delivery Driver(07920) - 1215 Lincoln Ave
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from

the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner

for families all across the nation - we do it because we can.

What do we mean by that, you ask?We mean that we offer a

great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking

for.That means you're free when you need to be.

You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your

friends, or whatever.Even if you need a second job for some

extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in

your area.We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and

that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what

you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond.Whether

it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online.

We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a

safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an

insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should

possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within

designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain

including multi-story buildings.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and

today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to

management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate

Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique

talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment

where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their

highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in

Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world

requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza,

our people come first!

Qualifications

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in

cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to

process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly

(may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor

coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately

make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions whenremoving trash and

performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and

above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most

in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone

and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control

standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements

and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some

food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36

and 48.

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded

by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to

50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72

high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the

workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the

storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances,

and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

HAND TASKS

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, WORK AIDS

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer. Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

Essential Skills

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Physical Demands

CARRYING: During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

DRIVING: Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

WALKING: Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

CLIMBING: During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Engineer

Since 2011, THE ICONIC has redefined the future of retail in Australia and New Zealand. As the #1 fashion e-commerce destination in the region, our e-commerce platforms (Retail, Marketplace and Services) provide an inspiring and seamless end-to-end customer experience through our own technology innovations. We stand for benchmark-setting customer service, delivery options, returns policies, and curation of brands.

IT at THE ICONIC..

Our IT team keeps our metaphorical lights on when it comes to our tech. We design, implement, manage and support the enabling technologies to keep our hubs and teams operational. We are always working towards enhancing our systems, infrastructure and processes, with our commitment to continuous improvement, to support better performance across the organisation. We are a dedicated group of IT Service Desk Specialists, Business Partners & Systems Engineers and we are here to help all Iconites.

About the role..

Keep the Fulfilment Centre operational by delivering reliable, secure network connectivity for the Warehouse Management System and the picking devices, computers and printers that keep orders moving.

Own network and firewall engineering, while supporting Windows, identity, virtualization and resilience services with the Infrastructure team. Investigate complex issues and maintain secure, reliable connectivity across the Fulfilment Centre and wider business.

Partner with technical teams to deliver safe changes and resolve incidents. Take ownership, document work clearly and share knowledge.

Use AI tools to support research, troubleshooting, analysis, documentation and automation; validate outputs and handle information responsibly.

Participate in occasional after-hours upgrades, maintenance and other changes.

Network design and operations

• Design, implement and maintain secure LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and internet services.

• Keep Fulfilment Centre network services available, prioritising WMS-connected devices, computers and printers.

• Maintain Documentation, network diagrams, configuration records and operational standards.

• Configure and troubleshoot switching, wireless, routing and VPN services.

• Monitor network health, respond to alerts, improve resilience and resolve root causes.

• Administer and troubleshoot core network services, including DHCP, DNS, Network Policy Server (NPS) and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).

• Support on-premises connectivity to AWS, including Direct Connect, EC2 and VPC.

Firewall and network security

• Administer and improve Fortinet firewall services, including FortiGate, FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.

• Analyse firewall logs and traffic flows to diagnose connectivity or security issues.

• Manage firewall rules in line with approved business and security requirements.

• Apply least privilege, segmentation and controlled-access principles.

Infrastructure resilience and site services

• Support network availability by working with the teams responsible for virtualisation, backups and site power protection.

• Assist with monitoring and troubleshooting Veeam and Hyper-V services where they affect network or infrastructure operations.

AI and workflow automation

• Use AI to improve research, analysis, troubleshooting and technical documentation.

• Validate AI outputs for accuracy, security and suitability before use or sharing.

• Identify opportunities to automate repeatable processes and workflows, including using n8n where appropriate.

• AI and automation tools used: Onyx, Gemini, ChatGPT and n8n

Project delivery

• Deliver network and infrastructure projects from requirements through implementation and handover.

• Coordinate timelines, dependencies, risks and stakeholder communications.

• Align project outcomes with operational needs through stakeholder collaboration.

Change, incident and problem management

• Deliver network upgrades and configuration changes through established change processes.

• Participate in after-hours implementation and support when required.

• Assess risks and prepare implementation, validation and rollback plans.

• Investigate and escalate network incidents and recurring problems.

Documentation and team contribution

• Document work clearly so it can be reviewed, repeated and shared.

• Maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides and network records.

Technologies you will be supporting..

• Networking and security: FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, Meraki MS & MR, Zscaler

• Core network services and certificates: DHCP, DNS, NPS, AD CS and SSL/TLS certificates

• Cloud, monitoring and operations: AWS EC2, AWS Direct Connect, Amazon VPC, PRTG, Datadog, Veeam and Hyper-V

• Identity, access and endpoint management: Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra, Single Sign-On (SSO), 1Password, Intune, Okta, JAMF and CrowdStrike

• Collaboration and service management: Atlassian Confluence, Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Slack, Google Workspace and Miro

• AI and automation: Onyx, Gemini, ChatGPT and n8n

• Site power protection: APC UPS systems and Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS)

What you’ll bring to the role..

• 3 to 5 years experience in a similar role

• Strong enterprise networking skills, including solution design and complex troubleshooting.

• Strong Fortinet firewall skills, including log analysis and rule management.

• Strong experience with Meraki switching and Wi-Fi in a warehouse environment

• Experience with DHCP, DNS, NPS and AD CS.

• Experience supporting Windows Server, Hyper-V, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and Intune.

• Understanding of SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management.

• Understanding of network routing, VPNs, security, segmentation and secure access.

• Experience planning and implementing technical changes, including testing and rollback.

• Strong technical documentation and record-keeping skills.

• Proficient in using AI tools for research, troubleshooting, documentation or automation, with the judgement to validate outputs.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Life at THE ICONIC..

From our ways of working to our growth mindset and sustainable approach, we each add unique value and have an incredible amount of fun doing it! People are our greatest asset and our ICONITE experience is designed to empower you to do your best work.Here’s what to expect when you join THE ICONIC:

• The learning collective. Get your knowledge fix with our learning days, hackathons & Linkedin Learning

• Parents at THE ICONIC. Access to our parental leave program and an extra day off for your kids' first day of school every year

• Birthday leave. Enjoy a paid day off for your birthday and an ICONIC voucher to treat yourself

• Curate your style. No matter what your style is, we have got you covered with our Amazing staff discount and our famous sample sales

• Wellbeing. Access to our Fitness Passport and our company wellbeing programs

• People first. Access to our Employee Assistance Program for you and your family

• Volunteer days. Work as a Charity Partner with Thread Together for society and environmental change.

We are committed to providing reasonable arrangements to all individuals participating in our application and interview process, and while performing job functions. If you require any accommodations or adjustments prior to the submission of your application or throughout your interview process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team directly: talent.attraction@theiconic.com.au
By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of THE ICONIC's Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Beach Attendant | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Share your passion for culture with our guests and be their trusted guide as they visit the island we call home.  As a Beach Attendant, you will provide warm and engaging beach services to our registered Guests to create memorable experiences.

Hourly Rate:  $27.00

What you will be doing:

• Ensure all beach chairs are well maintained and clean. Set up and tear down consistently in accordance to guidelines
• Assist guests in finding a location on the beach, setting up their area as requested
• Inform guests about safety flags, ocean conditions and safety precautions
• Ensure that overall cleanliness and maintenance of beach exceeds expectations
• Maintain atmosphere of aloha spirit by providing engaging, personalized, timely, and efficient service to our discerning guests

Schedule:  Due to the nature of the hospitality industry, employees are required to work varying schedules, including weekends and holidays, to accommodate the business and demands of the hotel.

Your experience and skills include:

• Able to work in a high-pressure environment
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; a team player
• One year experience in customer service
• Previous experience in luxury hotel environment desirable involving multi-tasking, attention to detail, and customer service

Licenses or Certificates (*required prior to start date)

• CPR and First Aid Certification required*
• Tuberculosis (TB) Clearance required*
• Valid Driver License required*
• Clean Drivers Abstract required*
• Water Safety Certification is an asset

Your working environment:

• Must be able to withstand very warm and sunny conditions
• Must be able to lift, carry, push and pull 100 lbs.
• Constant standing, walking and reaching
• Occasional lifting/carrying, pushing and pulling
• Occasional crouching, bending, stooping, and kneeling
• Requires grasping, writing, repetitive motions, listening, hearing and visual acuity

All Candidates must be in possession of identification proving authorization to work in the United States as defined in the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA). This Position does not offer sponsorship of Work Visas. Resumes submitted that cannot fulfill these requirements will not be considered.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Join our ‘ohana today:  Visit our website to learn more about living and working for Fairmont Hawai’i.  www.fairmonthawaiijobs.com

Why work for Accor? You can discover a world where life pulses with passion!​

Join the Accor Group, an ecosystem of over 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle places, that welcome you.  With us, your personality is valued, your opportunities for growth know no boundaries.  Every action you take has a positive and memorable impact on the experience of our customers, your colleagues, and also, on the planet, contributing to pioneering the art of responsible hospitality.

Hospitality is a work of heart! #fairmontcareers #alwayskealani

jobs.description:

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically shift leaders. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

jobs.title: Operations Manager / Front Office Manager / Rooms Department Manager (Residential Property)
jobs.description:
We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Fairmont Heritage Place Ghirardelli Square as our new Front Office Manager. Reporting to the Director of Residences, the Front Office Manager is responsible for providing engaging, sincere, and personalized services is one of the ways our team is Making Special Happen for our Owners and Guests. As Front Office Manager, you will work in conjunction with Housekeeping, Engineering, and Residence Services team to turn moments into special memories.

What You Will Be Doing

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and manage all aspects of Front Office and Residential Services operations, ensuring consistent delivery of Fairmont brand service standards.
• Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Front Office and Residential Services colleagues and supervisors.
• Establish clear performance expectations and hold supervisors and colleagues accountable for service standards, professionalism, attendance, appearance standards, and operational execution.
• Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
• Maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the operation and provide ongoing coaching and support.
• Conduct performance evaluations, coaching discussions, recognition initiatives, and corrective action when appropriate.
• Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and succession planning efforts.
• Participate in colleague relations matters in partnership with Human Resources.
• Ensure consistent and equitable administration of departmental policies, procedures, and the Collective Bargaining Agreement.
• Promote colleague engagement while fostering a positive and collaborative workplace culture.

Owner, Resident & Guest Experience

• Champion the Fairmont Promise and inspire colleagues to create memorable experiences for every Owner, Resident, and Guest.
• Deliver personalized luxury service while anticipating needs and exceeding expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with Owners and Residents.
• Lead service recovery efforts and ensure concerns are addressed promptly, professionally, and completely.
• Ensure all Owner and Guest concerns are documented, communicated appropriately, and resolved through final follow-up.
• Maintain ownership of escalated issues through completion and confirmation of satisfaction.
• Ensure key Owner and Guest preferences, stay history, residence information, and special requests are properly documented and maintained.
• Monitor guest feedback platforms and implement action plans to improve service results and satisfaction scores.

Residential Operations & Owner Relations

• Maintain a thorough understanding of HOA governing documents, property policies, and community standards.
• Ensure operational compliance with applicable California Civil Code requirements and Association regulations.
• Partner with Association leadership and ownership representatives as appropriate.
• Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive Owner and Resident matters.
• Support the Director of Residences in fostering positive relationships throughout the ownership community.

Front Office Operations

• Oversee daily Front Office operations including arrivals, departures, residence assignments, Owner stays, Resident interactions, and guest services.
• Ensure all Front Office procedures are executed in accordance with Fairmont standards and departmental requirements.
• Maintain awareness of all significant operational activities occurring throughout the property.
• Conduct regular inspections and audits of Front Office operations and service delivery.
• Monitor departmental productivity, operational efficiency, and service consistency.
• Ensure department records, reports, operating packets, and checklists are completed accurately and on time.
• Serve as Manager on Duty as scheduled.
• Respond to emergencies, service escalations, operational challenges, and guest concerns requiring leadership intervention.
• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Housekeeping, Engineering & Interdepartmental Coordination

• Maintain strong partnerships with Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Food & Beverage, and other operational departments.
• Coordinate room readiness, residence inspections, maintenance concerns, arrivals, departures, and recovery efforts.
• Participate in daily operational meetings and communicate departmental priorities and service opportunities.
• Ensure cross-departmental follow-through on Owner, Resident, and Guest requests.
• Collaborate with department leaders to identify and resolve recurring operational issues.

ALICE Administration & Service Follow-Up

• Maintain ownership of ALICE workflows and ensure requests are assigned, tracked, communicated, and completed within established service standards.
• Monitor open requests daily and ensure timely follow-up and closure.
• Analyze ALICE reporting to identify trends, service gaps, recurring concerns, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Hold supervisors and colleagues accountable for completion of assigned requests.
• Ensure traces, guest requests, service opportunities, and departmental follow-up items are properly documented and resolved.
• Ensure effective shift handovers through accurate pass-on communication and operational follow-up.

TARS, ACDC & Systems Administration

• Maintain proficiency in Opera PMS, TARS, ACDC, ALICE, and related hospitality systems.
• Ensure Owner and Guest information is accurately maintained within all applicable systems.
• Monitor reservation accuracy, inventory controls, room assignments, upgrades, and profile management.
• Ensure colleagues are properly trained on system functionality and operating procedures.
• Support inventory integrity, forecasting accuracy, and operational efficiency through effective systems utilization.
• Maintain data accuracy and appropriate Owner and Guest recognition standards.

ALL - Accor Live Limitless Loyalty Program

• Champion ALL - Accor Live Limitless enrollment, recognition, and engagement initiatives.
• Ensure eligible Owners and Guests consistently receive program benefits and recognition.
• Serve as the departmental subject matter expert for ALL program standards and procedures.
• Review, investigate, reconcile, and process loyalty point discrepancies, retro claims, missing stay requests, and point adjustment requests.
• Conduct regular audits of loyalty transactions, guest profiles, and member recognition performance.
• Partner with Reservations and Revenue Management teams to ensure loyalty data integrity.
• Coach colleagues on enrollment opportunities, member engagement, and loyalty standards.
• Monitor loyalty performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve participation and member satisfaction.

Payroll, Scheduling & Labor Management

• Monitor colleague attendance and review timekeeping daily to ensure accuracy.
• Oversee departmental payroll administration and payroll processing deadlines.
• Ensure timely resolution of payroll discrepancies, missed punches, scheduling concerns, and labor compliance issues.
• Review meal period compliance and labor utilization.
• Develop schedules that support operational needs while achieving productivity goals.
• Assist with labor forecasting, departmental budgeting, and expense management.
• Reinforce colleague accountability regarding timekeeping, attendance, and scheduling practices.
• Maintain labor practices consistent with company policy and applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement requirements.

Standards, Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with all Fairmont, Accor, property, departmental, SOP, and LSOP standards and procedures.
• Regularly review departmental practices and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Participate in the development, implementation, and enhancement of departmental SOPs and LSOPs.
• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, security procedures, and company policies.
• Maintain appropriate documentation related to investigations, coaching discussions, and corrective action.
• Escalate operational, guest, safety, and colleague concerns appropriately.
• Lead by example through professionalism, ethical decision-making, integrity, and accountability.

Communication & Professional Standards

• Model exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
• Ensure communication remains professional, respectful, service-focused, and solution-oriented.
• Uphold Fairmont appearance, grooming, and professionalism standards.
• Conduct regular audits of colleague appearance and uniform compliance.
• Ensure effective communication between shifts and departments.
• Communicate operational priorities, service opportunities, and departmental objectives clearly and consistently.

Reporting & Business Analytics

• Analyze guest feedback, loyalty performance, labor metrics, ALICE reporting, operational reports, and departmental KPIs.
• Identify trends and opportunities to improve service, efficiency, engagement, and financial performance.
• Prepare and communicate departmental performance updates and action plans.
• Utilize reporting tools to support data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate is a highly engaged leader who embraces the Fairmont Promise, develops strong teams, takes ownership of results, and drives operational excellence. Success is measured not only by exceptional Owner, Resident, and Guest experiences, but also by strong colleague engagement, effective service recovery, loyalty program performance, operational discipline, labor stewardship, regulatory compliance, and consistent execution of Fairmont brand standards.

Qualifications

• Minimum two (2) years of management experience required.
• Previous Front Office, Guest Services, Residential Services, Rooms Division, or hospitality leadership experience preferred.
• Luxury hospitality, residential hospitality, private residence club, resort, or hotel experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage performance, drive accountability, and develop colleagues.
• Strong service recovery and conflict resolution skills.
• Knowledge of HOA operations and California Civil Code requirements preferred.
• Experience working within union environments and administering Collective Bargaining Agreements preferred.
• Experience with Opera PMS, TARS, ACDC, ALICE, ALL - Accor Live Limitless, and Microsoft Office Suite preferred.
• Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.
• Flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays as operationally required.

Physical Aspects of Position (include but are not limited to):
