jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
COMPANY 

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.


Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki https://www.linkedin.com/in/ed-harycki/, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017 https://techcrunch.com/2017/08/10/paypal-acquires-swift-financial/). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.



Overview

We are building something that matters. Our most important advantage is the people we bring in to solve this problem. This role is the foundation of how we build our organization. Talent is our most important competitive advantage, and we treat it that way. That means knowing who we want before the role opens, hiring for ceiling not credentials, and making conviction-based decisions rather than consensus-based ones. This seat sits at the center of that work.

We believe recruiting is company-building, and this seat reflects that. You will own full-cycle searches across technical and cross-functional functions, partner directly with hiring managers and EPD leadership, and be accountable for the quality of the people we bring through the door. This is a craft role. You will define the hiring thesis for each search: the one or two spikes that make a hire exceptional, not a checklist. You will build proactive pipelines before the req opens and run candidate processes with urgency and care. You won't be working off a req list. We need someone who can take high-level direction from leadership and turn it into a sharp, targeted search: knowing exactly who we want before the role even opens, building the case for it, and defending that point of view with evidence. Good enough is not good enough here. If the bar is at risk, you push back. Recruiting at Credit Genie is owned end to end, not handed off. That means staying close to the candidate, close to the hiring manager, and close to the work so context never gets lost and quality never gets diluted. We move with purpose. We own every outcome.



Responsibilities

 - Partner with EPD leaders and hiring managers to understand each role's requirements and how it fits the organization.

 - Manage full-cycle recruiting across multiple complex searches, owning every stage from first touch to signed offer.

 - Build targeted sourcing strategies. Know the companies, the teams, and the people worth pursuing before the req opens.

 - Use AI tools across sourcing, outreach, research, and pipeline as a core part of how you work, not an experiment.

 - Own your funnel metrics and the infrastructure behind them. Maintain data integrity in Ashby, know where the bottlenecks are before someone tells you, and bring evidence to calibration conversations: passthrough rates, pipeline stage data, not just gut.

 - Own offer processes end to end: extending, negotiating, closing, and generating offer letters.

 - Act as a strategic advisor. Use market intelligence to anticipate hiring needs, push back on misaligned expectations, and shift strategy when the signal changes. Translate abstract asks into concrete target lists, comp frameworks, and close plans, and bring data, not just instinct, to every conversation.



Qualifications

 - High ownership is your default, not your mode. You notice what is broken and fix it without being asked. If something in your scope is off, you own it.

 - You run every candidate process with urgency and care.

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting at a high-growth startup. You have closed strong candidates in competitive markets and have the track record to show it.

 - Genuine talent judgment: You can map a market, identify the signal that separates exceptional from competent, and explain your reasoning. Your point of view is grounded in research and pattern recognition.

 - AI-fluent: AI is embedded in how you work: sourcing, outreach, research, pipeline. You can walk through your setup, explain what you have iterated on, and demonstrate what changed because of it.



Preferred

 - Scale-up and start-up experience.

 - Experience building recruiting infrastructure from scratch: intake frameworks, scorecards, sourcing playbooks.

 - Demonstrated use of AI recruiting tools as core stack with concrete before/after




BENEFITS AND PERKS

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.



We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.



Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

 - 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment. 

 - Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.

 - 401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting 

 - Meal program available for both lunch and dinner

 - Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match

 - Life and accidental insurance

 - Flexible PTO
   
   

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.



Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.




THE OPPORTUNITY:



Abby Care is at a significant inflection point and is poised to make an impact. Backed by Khosla, Thrive, and Sequoia through our Series B, and now closing our Series C, we are partnering with some of the nation's largest health plans to solve a pervasive problem in the healthcare space. We’re looking for a VP of Marketing who is excited to define a new category - AI enabled home care: where Abby Care is the definition of  quality AI-enabled care at home. This is the most senior marketing hire in the organization, and the person who will set the bar high for how we tell our story and articulate our value proposition.

This role goes beyond growth, creative, and brand, though all three matter deeply. You will be strategic about how AbbyCare is positioned to multiple, very different audiences at once: caregivers who need to see us as the organization of choice, and executives, plans, providers, and regulators who need to see us as the standard the category is measured against. You will lead and grow a team that already reports into this role, centralizing content and creative so AbbyCare speaks with one voice as we scale. You are agnostic to background (brand, creative, or growth marketing all qualify) but you've worked as a generalist inside a company on a steep growth curve, and know how to scale a function and a team. Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

You take pride in your craft, prioritize excellence, and you believe good enough isn't good enough. Whether taking a 10,000 foot view or zooming back into the details you are able to navigate the big picture and granularity with ease. You're comfortable in a startup environment, low ego, high EQ, and genuinely driven by the mission, with no hesitation about rolling up your sleeves even as a leader. You have a bias for action and move with intention rather than waiting for certainty. You ask whether something being untried is a reason to do it, not avoid it. You're resourceful, you work well with others, and you're confident enough to bring a real point of view to the table. If you are excited about the opportunity to define the standard for home care on a national scale, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a Full-Time Hybrid opportunity based in San Francisco




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Define category strategy: Set Abby Care's positioning as AI-enabled home care, building the narrative and messaging that differentiates us to caregivers, plans, providers, and regulators.

 - Own brand consistency: Ensure a single Abby Care voice across all channels, centralizing content and creative so output reflects one standard as the team and company scale.

 - Build and lead the team: Lead, mentor, and grow the marketing organization reporting into this role, fostering a culture built on craft, excellence, and high standards.

 - Partner across the business: Collaborate closely with the CEO, executive team, partnerships, product, and health plan strategy teams to align marketing with company goals and positioning.

 - Drive strategic growth: Align marketing strategy  with a health plan led model, supporting customer acquisition and retention both at the executive and caregiver level.

 - Report on performance: Brief the CEO and executive team on marketing performance, campaign outcomes, and key insights.

 - Oversee the full function: Manage content, creative, brand, and growth marketing, ensuring all disciplines work from a shared playbook.

 - Refine continuously: Evaluate and adjust marketing approaches as Abby Care's audiences and market position evolve.

 - Manage resources: Own the marketing budget, directing spend toward initiatives most likely to drive category-defining impact.

 - Expand market reach: Identify new audiences and opportunities to support AbbyCare's growth into payer and health plan relationships.




WHAT YOU’LL HAVE:

 - 8+ years of marketing leadership experience with experience managing managers, with a track record of building and scaling a marketing function inside category-defining organizations

 - Demonstrated outsized impact relative to tenure, with early career experience as a generalist across brand, creative, or growth marketing.

 - Proven ability to zoom from the 10,000 foot view down to the details, setting strategy and still being comfortable in the execution.

 - Strong track record of leading and growing a marketing team, instilling high craft, high standards, and a culture of excellence

 - Outstanding storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to shift narrative and tone across very different audiences, from caregivers to executives, health plans, providers, and regulators.

 - Solid quantitative skills, with experience leading the marketing function from a data-driven perspective.

 - Low ego, high EQ, and a genuine passion for the mission, with no hesitation to roll up your sleeves even as a senior leader.

 - Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, moving with intention rather than waiting for certainty in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Resourceful and collaborative, with the confidence to bring a strong point of view to the table and work well across teams.

 - Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement.




BENEFITS:

 - Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work.

 - Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance.

 - Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays.

 - Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered).

 - Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide up to 10 weeks of paid parental leave based on tenure, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows.



Abby Care believes in fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors unique to each candidate's experience and professional leveling; it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. These factors include, but are not limited to:

 - Job-related knowledge and specialized skill sets

 - Depth of industry experience

 - Relevant certifications, degrees, and licensures

 - Specific work location and market data

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, consistent with applicable laws. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, satisfactory references, and any required documentation.




OUR VALUES

 1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

 2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

 3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

 4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, contact talent@abbycare.org.



Abby Care considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company.



Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Pipelines
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Pipelines team at Supabase. Supabase Pipelines is a managed change data capture product. It copies the tables you select from Supabase Postgres to other systems, then streams later changes. The product is in public alpha, with BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckLake and Snowflake destinations.

Pipelines uses Postgres logical replication and Supabase ETL, our open source replication engine written in Rust. The team works close to the database. That means replication slots, WAL retention, initial table syncs, and the load they place on a customer's source database. The team also builds and runs the destination connectors. Correctness, ordering and recovery matter there as much as speed.

The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Team & People

 - Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

 - Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

 - Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

 - Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

 - Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery & Roadmap

 - Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

 - Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

 - Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

 - Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

 - Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

 - Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

 - Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

 - Have managed a team that built and ran data pipelines, change data capture, replication or streaming systems.

 - Have strong technical credibility in data systems. We look for delivery guarantees, ordering, idempotency, schema changes and backfills.

 - Know Postgres replication well, including logical replication, the WAL and replication slots, and how they affect a production database.

 - Know analytical destinations such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse or lakehouse table formats like Iceberg.

 - Have led a team through production incidents on a system that holds customer data. You ran the follow-up work and kept the review blameless.

 - Have shipped a developer-facing data product to customers outside your company.

 - Have experience with Rust (not required but a plus)

 - Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

 - Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

 - Build psychological safety and a feedback culture. You give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

 - Operate as a multiplier. You help individuals achieve more than they could alone, and you don't need to be the best technical voice in the room.

 - Coach rather than direct. You remove blockers, connect people to context, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

 - Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and can build structure where there isn't much.

 - Communicate clearly and write well. You default to async and written, set context early, and surface risks early.

 - Are collaborative, low-ego and adaptable. You thrive with high-autonomy senior engineers who don't need you to be the smartest person in the room.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Platform)
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role
Northwood runs a global network of phased array ground stations supported by cloud infrastructure; clusters that run mission software, identity systems every service depends on, the observability stack that tells operators what is happening at every site, and the IaC that defines all of it. The Infrastructure Engineer – Cloud owns and operates that environment.
This is a core individual contributor role on the Infrastructure team. You take a defined scope, run it independently, and bring real depth in cloud infrastructure. You'll work directly with Platform software engineers building the services and config models that describe what the environment should be. You'll make that intent real in cloud infrastructure, and keep it running.


Responsibilities

 - Own and operate all components of the cloud infrastructure stack: cloud accounts, hosted k8s clusters, CA, secrets, IAM, the observability pipeline. Take a defined scope and execute it without ongoing oversight.

 - Build and maintain infrastructure as code. Define and implement GitOps practices and proper CI gates to test, audit, and approve infrastructure changes.

 - Implement cloud-side networking: VPCs, transit route tables, VPNs and Direct Connect attachments, egress and ingress inspection. Partner with the network engineering on cloud to site handoff.

 - Carry on-call for the cloud stack. Resolve the majority of incidents independently and run post-incident reviews for the ones you own.

 - Partner with security engineering and compliance on controls implementation in your areas: policies, IAM boundaries, logging coverage, evidence collection, CVE mitigation.

 - Treat toil as a design signal. When manual work repeats, automate it or fix the underlying system.

 - Write and maintain runbooks, design docs, and component documentation. Keep them current with the system.

 - Collaborate across infrastructure, platform software, security, and ground station operations on cross-cutting work.



Basic Qualifications

 - 2–7 years of production infrastructure experience (SRE, DevOps, platform, cloud, or systems engineering). See Levels below for what we expect across that range.

 - Depth in cloud: multi-account organizations, IAM, VPC networking, EKS or equivalent managed Kubernetes.

 - Strong IaC experience: state management, CI-driven plan and apply, working in a shared monorepo with other engineers.

 - Working competence across Linux, networking fundamentals, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

 - Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a production system: design, implementation, operation.

 - On-call experience in a production environment with measurable reliability outcomes.

 - Comfortable in code (Python, Go, or similar) for automation, tooling, and integration work.

 - Strong technical writing: design docs, runbooks, post-mortems.



Preferred Qualifications
Depth in one or more of the following weighs heavily. We hire generalists with a spike.

 - AWS GovCloud or other regulated or air-gapped cloud environments, including the service gaps and workarounds that come with them.

 - Secrets and identity infrastructure: Vault (PKI, auth methods, policy design), Okta or IAM Identity Center integration, workload identity.

 - Observability at scale: VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus, Grafana, alerting design, log pipelines (Vector, Loki).

 - EKS: multi-cluster ArgoCD, cluster lifecycle, node and network policy, workload isolation.

 - Cloudflare: Zero Trust, DNS, tunnels, WAF.

 - Compliance partnership: implementing technical controls for CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP.

 - Hybrid connectivity between cloud and on-prem or edge sites.



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. 



If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know at accommodations@northwoodspace.io

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Claims & AI Billing
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out-of-pocket costs.

Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly.

We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll work across the stack, from data-dense workflows in the UI to the backend pipelines, integrations, and rule engines that power them. You'll own important projects and subsystems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help us solve the right problems for the people working through claims every day. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll own multi-component projects where requirements may be incomplete or evolving. You'll define the approach, sequence the work, anticipate failure modes, and own problems from the first conversation through launch and beyond. This role is for someone who likes working with messy real-world data, cares about the people using their software, is looking for high levels of ownership, and enjoys turning a complicated problem into something useful.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build fast, intuitive claims workflows in Air that help billers find, understand, correct, and prioritize work, whether they're working one claim or thousands.

 - Design and build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, from user experience and APIs to data models and production operations.

 - Build and scale the claims generation and submission pipeline, transforming encounter data into valid electronic claims across professional, institutional, and dental formats, as well as paper claims when needed.

 - Integrate with clearinghouses and handle the varied responses, verification requirements, and errors that come with getting claims to payers.

 - Improve coverage and payer routing, with guardrails that protect against using the wrong person's coverage information.

 - Build configurable automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work. Give billers and administrators the visibility and control to manage agents and correct mistakes.

 - Use LLMs and agents to streamline customer onboarding and billing setup, helping each customer get configured accurately with as much automation as practical and appropriate human review.

 - Design and build reliable subsystems with clear interfaces and data models. Improve their maintainability and operational stability over time.

 - Solve hard reliability and scale problems, including bulk operations, partial failures, idempotency, performance, observability, and auditability. Find root causes and prevent recurring issues.

 - Work closely with product, design, billing operations, and other engineers to understand real user problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and measure improvements in user experience and operational outcomes.

 - Lead technical discussions and design reviews within the team, and coordinate dependencies with other teams.

 - Make decisions that account for downstream dependencies, persisted data, and the long-term health of the system.

 - Mentor other engineers, including peers and those earlier in their careers.

 - Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, clear documentation, and practical patterns other engineers can use.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 10+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production applications.

 - Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React and backend development in Python or Go. Our primary stack includes TypeScript, React, Python, and PostgreSQL.

 - Experience designing and building production subsystems, including their interfaces, reliability, and evolution.

 - Strong technical judgment in ambiguous situations. You can balance speed, correctness, performance, compliance, and simplicity while considering downstream dependencies and future changes.

 - A track record of leading complex work from problem definition through delivery and ongoing operation, with measurable improvements to user experience, reliability, or operational outcomes.

 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including using monitoring, logging, and alerting to identify root causes and prevent problems from recurring.

 - Product-mindedness and empathy for users: you want to understand how people actually work and build software that makes their jobs easier.

 - Clear communication and collaboration skills. You can explain decisions and tradeoffs, lead team-level technical discussions, and coordinate with stakeholders across teams.

 - Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and practices others adopt.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building data-dense operational tools, workflow automation, bulk operations, or high-volume transaction systems.

 - Familiarity with healthcare billing, claims, EDI, or clearinghouse integrations, or a demonstrated ability to learn a complex domain quickly.

 - Experience shipping AI-assisted features in real workflows, with good judgment about where automation is appropriate and where people need visibility and control.

 - Experience improving React performance, building interactive analytics, or designing intuitive experiences for non-technical users.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and modern observability tools.

 - Experience working in a regulated industry with a focus on security and compliance.

 - A passion for improving healthcare and healthcare operations in America.



Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com http://commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

jobs.title: HPC Data Center Ops Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAN FRANCISCO COMPUTE

San Francisco Compute exists to give ambitious teams large scale supercomputers without taking on a catastrophic balance sheet risk. Most GPU clouds force you to sign long term contracts with no way out. If you underbuy, you miss the window. If you overbuy, you’ll blow up with no way out. It’s a desperate gamble that San Francisco Compute does not force you to play.

 

Originally, SFC was an AI lab that bought too big of a GPU cluster and was forced to sublease it or go under. Today, we build data centers and supercomputers, then lease those machines on contracts that let our customers sublease. More than anyone else in the industry, we deeply felt the pain and fear of being forced to bet the farm with your neocloud vendor. To enable subleasing, we invented the first compute market and became the first to offer physical settlement. That means we operate GPU clusters like a neocloud and derisk our customers like a market.

 

Customers buying GPU clusters don’t want to work through a network of brokers. They want to transact with the folks that have the keys to the cluster and can own the SLA.

 

To keep the industry safe from unnecessary risk, SFC needs to scale fast. To do that, we serve financially motivated parties as a technical partner to build, operate, & lease supercomputers on their behalf. Basically, we help folks who want an economic return build GPU clusters on their balance sheet, but operated in full by us. That lets us retain the technical control needed to run a cloud while scaling fast like a market. SFC’s ability to offer subleasing can significantly increase the levered returns for cluster owners. 

 

Our hybrid model outperforms brokered contracts or other “compute markets,” which have to go through a network of counterparties to solve problems. It also lets us design custom solutions for our customers, like clusters deployed in regions next to your dataset or physical eval set or a large CPU fleet deployed colocated with your GPU cluster.

 

Our team includes senior & technical leadership from places like Lambda, Crusoe, Digital Ocean, AWS, and Hut8. Our CTO is the cofounder and former CEO of Voltage Park. In prior roles, our team has deployed 8GW of datacenter capacity & hundreds of thousands of GPUs. We’ve been described as having “the highest talent density in the space.” If you are an honorable, gritty person with eyes wide open & good epistemics, who wants to see AI go right, we’d love to work with you. 



There has never been a more critical moment in history and it is up to us to shape it on behalf of those who come after us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our clusters don’t run themselves. Someone has to pull the failed tray, chase the bad optic that’s flapping a link at 3am, and make sure the spare was already on the shelf before anyone needed it. That’s this role, and it’s as hands-on as it gets.

From racking and commissioning systems to replacing failed components, managing fiber, transceivers, liquid cooling, and maintaining accurate asset records. You’ll also manage procurement, including BOMs, vendor quotes, lead times, spares, warranties, and RMAs.

Around 80% of the role focuses on data center operations and procurement, with 20% supporting office IT. Regular visits to local facilities and occasional travel to remote sites are required.

You’ll work with cutting-edge infrastructure, including HGX/DGX-class GPU systems, InfiniBand and 400G+ networks, high-density power, and liquid cooling. As part of a small team, you’ll also help establish standards, develop runbooks, and mentor future team members.




ABOUT YOU

 - You have 5+ years in data center operations, infrastructure support, or systems administration, with real hands-on hardware and cabling responsibility

 - You know fiber — high-density trunks and breakouts, end-face inspection and cleaning, transceiver swaps — and you can tell a dirty connector from a dying optic

 - You’ve replaced server FRUs and racked, cabled, and commissioned equipment, and you work safely in and around energized racks

 - You’ve bought hardware, not just installed it: BOMs, vendor quotes, POs, receiving, warranty, and RMAs are familiar territory

 - You keep inventory and asset records that would survive an audit, across more than one site

 - You’re comfortable with TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, out-of-band management (IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, Redfish), and the Linux command line

 - You’re open to occasional travel to remote sites and to after-hours maintenance windows when the work requires it
   
   


SOME NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience in HPC, GPU, or other high-density compute environments, including HGX- or DGX-class platforms and rack-scale designs

 - Experience with InfiniBand or high-rate Ethernet at 400G and above

 - Experience with liquid cooling — CDUs, manifolds, and direct-to-chip cold plates

 - Colocation experience and familiarity with the tenant/operator relationship

 - NetBox or similar DCIM, and procurement or ERP systems

 - Scripting for automation and inventory reconciliation (Bash, Python, or PowerShell)

 - Enterprise wireless (Meraki, Ubiquiti, Aruba, Mist), MDM (Jamf, Intune, Kandji), and identity providers (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID)

 - Certifications such as CompTIA Server+, Cisco CCNA, or NVIDIA credentials
   
   


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job is physical. With or without reasonable accommodation, you’ll need to lift and position equipment up to 50 lbs unassisted (heavier chassis by team lift), work at elevation and in confined spaces behind racks, stand and walk for extended periods, handle fine motor work with optics and liquid-cooling quick-disconnects, work in sustained cold-aisle temperatures and elevated noise (hearing protection provided), read small-format labels and status indicators, and wear required PPE.




BENEFITS





GENEROUS EQUITY GRANT

Team members are offered a competitive salary along with equity in the company




VISA SPONSORSHIPS

Yes, we sponsor visas and work permits




RETIREMENT MATCHING

We match 401(k) plans up to 4%




MEDICAL, DENTAL & VISION

We offer highly competitive medical, dental, vision insurance for employees and dependents.




TIME OFF

We offer unlimited paid time off as well as 10+ observed holidays




PARENTAL LEAVE

We offer biological, adoptive, and foster parents paid time off to spend quality time with family




DAILY LUNCH

We cover lunch daily for employees




UNLIMITED OFFICE BOOK BUDGET

You can buy as many books for the office as you want

jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out-of-pocket costs.

Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly.

We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll work across the stack, from data-dense workflows in the UI to the backend pipelines, integrations, and rule engines that power them. You'll own important projects and subsystems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help us solve the right problems for the people working through claims every day. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own multi-component projects where requirements may be incomplete or evolving. You'll define the approach, sequence the work, anticipate failure modes, and own problems from the first conversation through launch and beyond. This role is for someone who likes working with messy real-world data, cares about the people using their software, is looking for high levels of ownership, and enjoys turning a complicated problem into something useful.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build fast, intuitive claims workflows in Air that help billers find, understand, correct, and prioritize work, whether they're working one claim or thousands.

 - Design and build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, from user experience and APIs to data models and production operations.

 - Build and scale the claims generation and submission pipeline, transforming encounter data into valid electronic claims across professional, institutional, and dental formats, as well as paper claims when needed.

 - Integrate with clearinghouses and handle the varied responses, verification requirements, and errors that come with getting claims to payers.

 - Improve coverage and payer routing, with guardrails that protect against using the wrong person's coverage information.

 - Build configurable automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work. Give billers and administrators the visibility and control to manage agents and correct mistakes.

 - Use LLMs and agents to streamline customer onboarding and billing setup, helping each customer get configured accurately with as much automation as practical and appropriate human review.

 - Design and build reliable subsystems with clear interfaces and data models. Improve their maintainability and operational stability over time.

 - Solve hard reliability and scale problems, including bulk operations, partial failures, idempotency, performance, observability, and auditability. Find root causes and prevent recurring issues.

 - Work closely with product, design, billing operations, and other engineers to understand real user problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and measure improvements in user experience and operational outcomes.

 - Lead technical discussions and design reviews within the team, and coordinate dependencies with other teams.

 - Make decisions that account for downstream dependencies, persisted data, and the long-term health of the system.

 - Mentor other engineers, including peers and those earlier in their careers.

 - Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, clear documentation, and practical patterns other engineers can use.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production applications.

 - Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React and backend development in Python or Go. Our primary stack includes TypeScript, React, Python, and PostgreSQL.

 - Experience designing and building production subsystems, including their interfaces, reliability, and evolution.

 - Strong technical judgment in ambiguous situations. You can balance speed, correctness, performance, compliance, and simplicity while considering downstream dependencies and future changes.

 - A track record of leading complex work from problem definition through delivery and ongoing operation, with measurable improvements to user experience, reliability, or operational outcomes.

 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including using monitoring, logging, and alerting to identify root causes and prevent problems from recurring.

 - Product-mindedness and empathy for users: you want to understand how people actually work and build software that makes their jobs easier.

 - Clear communication and collaboration skills. You can explain decisions and tradeoffs, lead team-level technical discussions, and coordinate with stakeholders across teams.

 - Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and practices others adopt.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building data-dense operational tools, workflow automation, bulk operations, or high-volume transaction systems.

 - Familiarity with healthcare billing, claims, EDI, or clearinghouse integrations, or a demonstrated ability to learn a complex domain quickly.

 - Experience shipping AI-assisted features in real workflows, with good judgment about where automation is appropriate and where people need visibility and control.

 - Experience improving React performance, building interactive analytics, or designing intuitive experiences for non-technical users.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and modern observability tools.

 - Experience working in a regulated industry with a focus on security and compliance.

 - A passion for improving healthcare and healthcare operations in America.

jobs.title: Tech Ops Lead
jobs.description:
Icarus was founded on the belief that the Stratosphere is the Forgotten Frontier and that reclaiming it will define the next era of aerospace and what is possible from the sky. We build solar-powered aircraft that fly at 60,000 ft for weeks at a time, delivering persistent, affordable, and scalable presence from this layer of the atmosphere. You will build and run the IT systems that keep our engineers, technicians, and operators moving.

Mission

Re-establish and maintain dominance in the Stratosphere.

The role

As a Tech Ops Lead, you will own internal IT from the laptop on a new hire's desk to the systems that keep our factory connected. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end responsibility. You will configure hardware, administer systems, troubleshoot issues, write automation, and see projects through to a working result.

We need someone who can execute independently: understand the problem, decide what matters, get it working, and make sure it stays fixed. You should be equally comfortable helping a teammate recover access, tracing a network issue, deploying a fleet of devices, and eliminating a recurring task with a script. You will work on-site with engineering, manufacturing, operations, and leadership.

Clear communication and initiative are essential. You will explain technical tradeoffs in plain language, advocate for a practical plan, and implement improvements that help the business move faster. We value evidence of systems you have built and operated over employer names or compliance credentials alone.

What you'll own

• Day-to-day IT execution. Be the first point of contact for internal IT issues. Diagnose problems, communicate clearly, restore service, and close the loop with the people affected.

• Devices and workstations. Purchase, provision, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, engineering workstations, peripherals, printers, and meeting-room equipment. Keep asset records, spares, and software licenses organized.

• Identity and business systems. Administer Microsoft 365, accounts, groups, email, collaboration tools, and application access. Make onboarding fast and offboarding complete, with access approved and documented.

• Reliable connectivity. Deploy and troubleshoot office and factory Wi-Fi, switches, firewalls, VPNs, cabling, DNS, and DHCP. Work with engineering on clear boundaries between corporate IT and product or test systems.

• Practical security. Implement and maintain MFA, least-privilege access, device management, encryption, patching, endpoint protection, and appropriate logging. Partner with compliance owners on required controls and evidence.

• Automation. Use PowerShell, Python, shell scripts, or APIs to automate device setup, account lifecycle tasks, inventory, and recurring administration. Use AI tools and agents where they make operations faster and more reliable, with appropriate access controls and human review. Test changes and document how they work.

• Recovery and reliability. Maintain backups, test restores, monitor critical services, and document recovery steps. Handle incidents with clear priorities, safe changes, and verified fixes.

• Projects from start to finish. Own migrations, new tools, vendor coordination, and factory IT improvements. Manage the details, follow through on dependencies, and verify that the result works for its users.

• Simple, useful documentation. Keep systems, ownership, access procedures, and troubleshooting guides current so important knowledge does not live in one person's head.

What we're looking for

• 3+ years of hands-on IT, systems administration, or infrastructure experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering and operating these systems.

• A record of personally shipping improvements and resolving difficult problems. Be ready to explain what you did, how you tested it, and what changed as a result.

• Strong Windows and Microsoft 365 administration skills, including identity, permissions, endpoint management, and practical security controls.

• Networking fundamentals and the ability to troubleshoot methodically across devices, services, and connectivity.

• Comfort writing and maintaining scripts or small integrations that remove repetitive work.

• Good judgment when handling sensitive information, privileged access, incidents, and production changes. You know when to act, when to escalate, and how to leave a clear record.

• Clear communication, responsive support, and the ability to prioritize urgent issues while completing longer-term projects.

• Ability to work at our El Segundo factory five days a week.

Bonus

• Built or scaled IT at a startup, hardware company, factory, or other fast-moving environment.

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, macOS or Linux administration, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, or engineering software environments.

• Implemented technical controls and gathered evidence for NIST 800-171, CMMC, or similar security programs.

• Supported site moves, factory expansion, or recovery from a significant outage.

• Used AI tools or agents to automate operational work and can explain the measurable result.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

• New hires have working equipment and the right access on day one.

• IT issues are resolved with clear communication, and repeat problems become permanent fixes.

• Devices, accounts, licenses, and critical systems have accurate records, secure configurations, and tested recovery procedures.

• Routine work becomes simpler and more reliable through automation that the team can maintain.

• Phishing-resistant sign-in controls, tested incident playbooks, and a weekly control-review cadence improve security without unnecessary friction.

• Leadership can see current user and license inventories, ticket ownership, and service metrics.

• Onboarding and offboarding are reliable, password-manager adoption is practical, and required compliance evidence stays current.

Our culture = elite sports team. Winning = having fun

• Hyperfocus

• Extreme Ownership

• Radical Transparency

Why Icarus

• Meaningful equity

• Top market salary and bonuses

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Factory in El Segundo

• Real ownership, real hardware, real flight

• Small team, massive responsibility

• High signal (engineering) to noise (management) culture

• Dream desk setup

• Daily lunch

• Unlimited Celsius

Hiring process

• Practical technical interview focused on troubleshooting, systems ownership, and work you have delivered

• One-on-one with CEO

• Meet the team in person

US salary range

$120,000 - $160,000 USD per year

This range reflects base salary only. Actual compensation depends on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and role scope. Equity is part of Icarus' total compensation package.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a detail-oriented, driven Senior Accountant to join our Accounting team at an exciting time of growth for Supabase. As we continue to scale, we're expanding the team to add experience, spread responsibilities, and strengthen the processes that keep our financials accurate and timely. This is a hands-on role with real ownership and a lot of autonomy.

In this role, you'll support the month-end close, perform analytics on financial results, assist with external audit and tax requests, and take on ad-hoc projects. You'll collaborate across Finance and the wider company, including FP&A, People/Payroll, and Legal, and work with our external audit, tax, and technical accounting partners, while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes and controls. This role is open to candidates based in North America.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Own key areas of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close within your assigned areas, preparing workpapers, journal entries, account reconciliations, flux analysis, and accruals in accordance with US GAAP

 - Perform detailed analytics over financial results to confirm completeness and accuracy, and investigate and communicate discrepancies promptly

 - Partner with FP&A, People/Payroll, Legal, and other teams to understand business processes, ensure proper accounting, and resolve reconciling differences

 - Support external audits and tax requests, serving as a point of contact and coordinating with external partners

 - Prepare ad-hoc analyses and support reporting requirements

 - Take initiative to recommend and implement process improvements that simplify, standardize, and streamline how we work

 - Participate in special projects, including process and system improvements

 - Handle day-to-day operational accounting activities with a high level of accuracy


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally a mix of public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and private industry

 - Have a CPA or equivalent (preferred)

 - Have a strong technical accounting background and solid knowledge of US GAAP

 - Have ERP experience, and experience in tech or high-growth company accounting is a plus

 - Are willing to roll up your sleeves and dig into the details

 - Communicate clearly, both in writing and verbally, and are comfortable building relationships at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership and audit partners

 - Are self-motivated and proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions

 - Are organized and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, and can switch gears quickly in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Work well both independently and collaboratively, are comfortable in async teams, and navigate ambiguity with ease

 - Are energized by improving processes

We know not everyone will meet every qualification on day one. If you're excited about this role and want to grow with us, we encourage you to apply.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.description:

Contributes to the provision of high-quality, cost-effective health care through the direct care of patients and in collaboration with other members of the health care team. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

• Participates in the orientation of new staff acting as mentor when necessary and requested.
• Transports medications, as necessary during the usual course of transporting patients within the institution, in keeping with policy and procedure regarding medication security. Ensures that medication is delivered to persons authorized to handle medication according to AAMC policy.
• Maintains adequate levels of supplies and equipment on the unit.
• Transports patients in accordance with established safety policies.
• Processes written medical staff orders in accordance with established policy and procedure; communicating STAT or urgent orders to the care provider.

Educational/Experience Requirements:

• High School Diploma or GED
• One year of experience as a CNA in acute care setting preferred.
• If serving as a bilingual/multilingual interpreter, certification in Medical Interpretation is required to perform the duties of a qualified interpreter

Required License/Certifications:

• Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)
• American Heart Association HealthCare Provider BLS

Additional Requirements by Department:

• STABLE: Pediatric Unit, Postpartum Care Unit, Neonatal Intensive Care Unit, and Labor and Delivery Unit within 6 months of hire

Working Conditions, Equipment, Physical Demands:

There is a reasonable expectation that employees in this position will be exposed to blood-borne pathogens.

Physical Demands –

Heavy work. Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

The physical demands and work environment that have been described are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.



About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on sales enablement professional who enjoys creating, teaching, and making things work better. You’ll work alongside the Director of Sales Enablement, Enterprise to build and deliver virtual and onsite onboarding, ongoing training, sales technology education, and practical resources that help our enterprise sellers succeed.

You understand how enterprise sellers work, how complex buying decisions unfold, and what prepares sellers for effective customer conversations. You bring instructional design and facilitation skills, along with the creativity to make learning engaging, useful, and memorable.

We use AI, we love it, and we encourage you to explore what it can do. Bring your ideas, experiment with new approaches, and find ways to make the work easier and more effective. There’s room to build, test, learn, and improve, whether you’re creating an interactive learning experience or simplifying a recurring task.

Our business moves quickly, and our enablement needs to keep pace. As our products evolve, buyer needs change, and new technologies emerge, we adapt with purpose. You’ll help translate those developments into timely, accurate training and resources that keep our sellers prepared. We value speed, sound judgment, and quality in equal measure.

You’ll partner with the Director to set priorities, design programs, and identify improvements, then bring that work to life with sound judgment. As you learn our products, sellers, and business, you’ll take on greater responsibility and ownership of defined programs and workstreams.

What you’ll do

 - Partner with the Director to develop, deliver, and improve enterprise sales onboarding, including learning paths, live sessions, self-paced content, practice activities, and readiness assessments.

 - Facilitate both live virtual and onsite onboarding and training on products, positioning, sales processes, tools, and methodologies.

 - Lead interactive discussions, roleplays, and practice exercises that reflect enterprise selling situations, adapting your approach to the audience and learning environment.

 - Coordinate onboarding schedules, logistics, facilitator preparation, subject matter expert contributions, and new-hire communications.

 - Deliver technology training through live demonstrations, guided practice, and practical resources that help sellers use our sales tools effectively.

 - Maintain and organize enablement boards, the Notion hub, and supporting content libraries so sellers can find current, approved resources.

 - Build and update learning content, assignments, and assessments in WorkRamp, and track completion.

 - Identify content gaps, outdated materials, and access issues, and coordinate updates with the appropriate partners.

What you have 

 - 4+ years of relevant experience across sales enablement, learning and development, or instructional design, including direct sales enablement experience supporting onboarding or ongoing seller development.

 - Experience supporting enterprise B2B sales teams, with an understanding of complex sales cycles, multiple buying stakeholders, and account strategy.

jobs.title: Director/Senior Manager, Government Affairs
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

Verkada’s legal team is looking for a government and policy advocate to help build our Government Affairs and Public Policy functions from the ground up. You will work hand-in-hand with internal leadership to set our overall public policy strategy—establishing our presence across state, local, and federal governments to lay the groundwork for Verkada’s first entree into policy and legislative engagement. You will also support our federal and state public sector go-to-market teams, by leveraging your networks, relationships, and policy engagements to open doors and create opportunities.

As the company’s primary policy representative, you will blend strategic foresight with hands-on execution: building relationships with key decision-makers, leading legislative advocacy, and developing high-impact partnerships with industry associations, trade groups, and peer organizations. The ideal candidate brings 10–15 years of policy experience, strong relationship-building capabilities, and a proven track record of connecting policy strategy directly to business growth. This position reports directly to the company’s Chief Privacy Officer, who heads our policy and government affairs functions.There is no existing team or playbook. You will help build both, starting with your own relationships, experience, and credibility.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture but this role can be remote for the right candidates, so long as you are willing to regularly travel to key areas, such as San Mateo, California (our headquarters), Washington, DC, and state and local government hubs to meet with key stakeholders and constituents.

What You'll Do

• Framework & Strategy: Help design and execute our first Government Affairs framework, defining company policy priorities, legislative tracking systems, and political governance across local, state, and emerging federal levels.

• Policy Roadmapping: Develop, execute, and refine a scalable 50-state policy strategy, categorizing target jurisdictions by legislative risk, market opportunity, and regulatory complexity.

• Lobbyist Management: Recruit, direct, and actively manage external state and local contract lobbyists and political consultants across priority target states to ensure accountability and measurable outcomes.

• Public Sector Business Development: Partner directly with go-to-market teams to unlock procurement pathways and develop a practical, ground-level government playbook, navigating agency requirements and supporting active deals to accelerate time-to-close.

• Funding & Procurement Strategy: Shape policy and public sector funding and appropriations conversations—including school safety and infrastructure grants—that favor modern, cloud-based public sector infrastructure.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Legal, Product, Public Relations, and Public Sector Sales Teams to align policy strategies with commercial revenue goals and procurement opportunities.

What You Bring

• Education: Must have a Bachelor’s degree; Master’s or J.D. helpful but not required.

• Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in government relations, public policy, legislative staff roles, or corporate advocacy, with deep state and local expertise and familiarity with federal policy processes.

• 50-State & Lobbyist Management Expertise: Proven track record of designing multi-state policy strategies and effectively directing state and local contract lobbyists across multiple jurisdictions.

• Commercial & Sales Alignment: Demonstrated experience partnering closely with public sector sales and business leads to align policy initiatives with state/local government procurement and revenue growth.

• Partnership Mindset: Ability to partner effectively with senior executive leadership to shape policy priorities.

• Relationship & Network Capabilities: Proven ability to build meaningful networks, open doors with senior officials, and earn credibility across diverse political environments.

• Coalition & Trade Expertise: Track record of actively working within trade associations, leading industry committees, and building multi-stakeholder coalitions.

• Skills: Exceptional written and oral communication skills; ability to translate complex technical or business models into clear, compelling policy narratives for lawmakers, regulators, and internal leadership; strong political acumen and cross-functional alignment skills to gain consensus across internal teams.

• Travel: Willingness to regularly travel (aligned with state legislative sessions, municipal council calendars, and industry conferences).

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

• Professional development stipend

• Wellness/fitness benefits

• Healthy lunches provided daily

• Commuter benefits

Additional Information

You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

$205,000—$265,000 USD
