jobs.title: Semi Fab Operator (Hiring for night shift 6pm-6am)
jobs.description:
The Semiconductor Fabrication Operator Level 1 (Manufacturing Operator) is an entry-level position responsible for assisting in the semiconductor manufacturing process. This role involves learning to operate basic fabrication equipment, following established procedures, and ensuring product quality under the guidance of more experienced operators. The Level 1 operator will gain foundational knowledge and skills necessary for advancement within the semiconductor manufacturing field.

The role will temporarily operate Monday through Thursday from 7:00am to 5:00pm. When production ramps up in the second half of the year, operations will transition back to our compressed 12-hour shift model. At that time, you will be assigned to one of the following shifts:

• C Shift: Sunday-Tuesday and every other Saturday (6:00pm-6:00am)

• D Shift: Wednesday-Friday and every other Saturday (6:00pm-6:00am)

Responsibilities:

• Engage in on-the-job training and development opportunities as directed by trainer/supervisor to enhance skills and knowledge.
• Complete all required training on equipment operation to include certification.
• Efficiently operate equipment in an assigned functional area as well as test/measurement equipment in support of primary equipment responsibilities under the supervision of trainer or supervision.
• Collaborate closely with trainer to develop skills and knowledge in fabrication techniques.
• Adhere to all written specifications. 100% compliance for all qualified tasks.
• Does not perform tasks where not qualified or certified without direction of trainer or supervision.
• Basic problem solving.
• Maintains accurate records of production activities under the guidance of the trainer/supervision.
• Complies with all safety protocols and guidelines to maintain a safe working environment.
• Responds to discrepant material dispositions under direction of trainer.
• Abides by all protocols of working in a cleanroom environment, such as gowning, wafer handling, and other cleanroom standards.
• Maintaining a clean and organized work area.
• Develop positive working relationships with peers and support groups.
• Recognize a variety of visual and audible alarms. Must be able to distinguish between distinct types of alarms and be able to evacuate safely if deemed necessary.
• Strict adherence to attendance and break policies.
• Remain alert and engaged and alert for the entire shift.
• Make effective use of idle time through equipment setup, staging of product, and lot transportation.

• High School Diploma or equivalent.
• Has the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Basic problem-solving skills.
• Basic math (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, averaging, interpreting graphs)
• Effective oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including reading and interpreting documents such as operating specifications and engineering change orders.
• Sit, stand, or walk for extended periods of time (up to 11 hours per shift).
• Routinely uses 5 – 15 pounds of pushing/pulling force to move a fully loaded cart throughout the factory. Up to thirty pounds of force if needed infrequently for evasive moves.
• Reaching (above and below shoulder height, stoop, bend squat, kneel, and crouch to retrieve product, transport work and take equipment readings etc.
• Routinely lifts and carries using both hands approximately15 pounds.

• This role will work on site in Roseville, CA.
• B-shift is eligible for 5% shift premium pay.
• C-shift is eligible for 15% shift premium pay.
• D-shift is eligible for 15% shift premium pay.
• Indefinite US work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Must be a people person with great customer service skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

iCapital is seeking an ERISA Compliance Assistant Vice President to support its compliance program relating to the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA), Department of Labor regulations, prohibited transaction exemptions, and Qualified Professional Asset Manager (QPAM) requirements. • Provide practical guidance regarding ERISA fiduciary duties, plan-asset rules, prohibited transactions, party-in-interest restrictions, and applicable exemptions.

• Support the firm’s ongoing compliance with the QPAM Exemption and related prohibited transaction exemption requirements.

• Administer QPAM monitoring and testing, including annual and periodic certifications.

• Coordinate reviews of QPAM eligibility criteria, including assets under management, shareholder equity, affiliate requirements, guarantees, and integrity standards.

• Maintain documentation evidencing compliance with QPAM conditions and regulatory requirements.

• Assess ERISA implications of investment products, distribution activities, service arrangements, transactions, and operational processes.

• Execute risk-based compliance reviews, monitoring, testing, certifications, and issue-management processes relating to ERISA and retirement-plan activities.

• Monitor developments from the Department of Labor, IRS, SEC, and other regulatory authorities and help implement required policy, control, and business changes.

• Bachelor's degree is required; J.D., MBA, or other advanced degree is a plus

• 5–8+ years of relevant experience in investment adviser, asset management, retirement, ERISA, legal, regulatory, or compliance functions

• Experience with QPAM compliance, prohibited transaction exemptions, or retirement-focused investment products is preferred

• Familiar with collective investment trusts, private funds, alternative investments, or institutional asset management is preferred

• Experience executing compliance monitoring, testing, certifications, issue management, or regulatory examination support

• Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills

• Able to independently manage assigned responsibilities, exercise sound judgment, and escalate significant issues appropriately

• Able to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business guidance and effective compliance controls

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $145,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. · Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

jobs.title: Customer Service Rep - Mt. View
jobs.description:
Customer Service Representative

ABOUT THE POSITION

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.
We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.
General Job Duties For All Store Team Members
Operate all equipment.
Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
Prepare product.
Receive and process telephone orders.
Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.
Training
Orientation and training provided on the job.
Communication Skills
Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.
Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.
Essential Functions/Skills
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
Must be able to make correct monetary change.
Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO:
Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
Fumes from food odors.
Exposure to cornmeal dust.
Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING
Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
Depth perception.
Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS
The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.
Additional Job Details PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:
Standing
Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".
Walking
For short distances for short durations
Sitting
Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table
Lifting
Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.
Carrying
Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.
Pushing
To move trays which are placed on dollies.
A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing
Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.
Stooping/Bending
Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.
Crouching/Squatting
Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.
Reaching
Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.
Hand Tasks
Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.
Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids
Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Customer Service Rep(07180) - 14415 SE MILL PLAIN
jobs.description:
Our Customer Service Position is an entry level position.

Wage Rates

All CSR positions are paid hourly at minimum wage- Washington is $17.13 and maximum $17.13. We have many opportunities for advancement. Our first raise after completion of shift lead evaluation is $1.30.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Medical, Dental and Vision insurance are available to employees who have worked at least a year and who average at least 32 hours per week. If you have any questions about Benefits Qualifications, please contact HR@hamiltonholdings.net.

We abide by WA State requirements for sick pay.

HOURS: All scheduled hours are based off what employee is available for and what the store needs. All positions are part time unless otherwise stated. Every employee has the opportunity to work into full time as long as the store has the hours to accommodate and employee completes training, is reliable for shifts and communicating full time needs with manager.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

· Ability to communicate and interact respectfully and effectively with people across cultures, abilities, genders, ethnicities, and races.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

Exposure To

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

Sensing: Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for

most in-store tasks. Depth perception. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

Temperaments: The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work

alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

Physical Demands

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48 inches.

Walking: Walking is generally in short distances for short durations.

Sitting: Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting: Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded

by the team member using a hand truck. Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3 x 1.5. Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 inches high.

Carrying: Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves. Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store. Trays of pizza dough

are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing: Pushing is performed to move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 inches in height and requires a force of up

to 7.5 pounds to push. Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing: Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending: Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees

while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting: Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

·Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

Valid Driver License (2 Years)

Valid Proof of Automotive Insurance

Valid Vehicle Registration

Valid Food Handler's Permit

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Must be 18, have a reliable vehicle, and have a clean motor vehicle record

At Domino's, we are a brand of honesty, transparency and accountability and we want exceptional people like you to join our team! We have continued to prove we “Put our People First” by making sure our work environment is safe and provides stability for you as a team member. The brand continues to deliver the “Power of Possible” to local Domino’s store owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores!

jobs.title: Assistant Manager(04109)
jobs.description:
Overview:

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you have always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance, Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically Assistant Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills- judgement, math and the ability to multi-task.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Assistant managers are responsible for everything that happens during the shift. This includes cost control, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You set the tone and the example for the store and you have to be on your game 100% of the time!

Your job responsibilities would include (but are not limited to):

• Perform all the duties of the Customer Services Representatives and Delivery Drivers.
• Manage anywhere from 3 to 30 employees during your scheduled shift.
• Responsible for all store operations.
• Greeting customers and taking orders with a smile (yes, you even have to smile when you answer the phone)!
• Operating the cash register and collecting payment from customers.
• Making fast, accurate and consistent products while complying with all portion sizes, recipes and baking procedures.
• Delivering product by vehicle from the store to the customer in a safe and courteous manner.
• Maintaining cleanliness of the restaurant from the first thing the customer sees all the way to the back of the store.
• Maintain a professional appearance at all times in compliance within the Domino's Pizza Grooming Standards.

What are we looking for?

The good news is we can teach you how to answer the phone and make a perfect pizza. But here are a few skills you should have to be a successful Assistant Manager:

• Experience leading a team; during your shift, you will manage a staff of anywhere from 3 to 30 people. You will need to use your stellar attitude and motivational skills to get them in the right place, at the right time and doing the right thing all while creating a great place to work.
• A clean driving record and the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Record check. Safety is a priority for us and we want to make sure anyone we put on the road is safe to be there. You will also need access to reliable vehicle that is insured and have a valid driver's license
• A great role model - you're the person everyone will look to. From being on time for your shift, to having a great attitude to customers and co-workers and even how you dress - you have to have high standards for yourself and the rest of the team.
• Our stores are open 365 days a week. Yes, that's right even on the weekends and the holidays; that's when we are busiest! While you schedule is pretty flexible, you have to be willing to work when the team needs you the most.
• You have to be at least 18 years old.

You'll be working for a company that is fun and flexible. Not to mention, its work experience you will rely on for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now it's time to help up be the pizza delivery company in the world. Go on, boss, show us what you've got.  We offer weekly pay. Apply now!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineering Manager – Supplier Controls
jobs.description:
General Summary
We are seeking a Supplier Quality Engineering Manager to help manage our Supplier Controls. This position is responsible for the effective execution, oversight, and continuous improvement of supplier quality processes and controls that support manufacturing operations and regulatory compliance.
The manager will own key supplier quality processes, including Approved Supplier List (ASL) management, supplier onboarding and qualification controls, and supplier performance monitoring. This individual will ensure that established processes are consistently executed, appropriately controlled, and compliant with quality management system requirements while driving improvements that enhance efficiency, standardization, and operational effectiveness.
The role will play an important part in modernizing supplier quality processes and systems, leveraging enterprise platforms and cross-functional partnerships to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, and improve how supplier quality activities are managed. The manager will also lead a dedicated team of Supplier Quality Engineers supporting supplier quality operations and the needs of Operational Procurement across multiple manufacturing sites.
The successful candidate will bring strong supplier quality engineering fundamentals, practical experience managing quality processes, effective people leadership, and a continuous improvement mindset.
Primary Responsibilities
Supplier Quality Controls 
Own and manage supplier quality control processes, including ASL maintenance, supplier addition requests, supplier approval status, and associated supplier qualification controls.
Ensure supplier onboarding, approval, and qualification activities are executed consistently, efficiently, and in accordance with established risk-based requirements and quality management system procedures.
Maintain effective governance of supplier quality records, approval workflows, supplier status, and associated documentation to ensure traceability, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
Establish and maintain standardized processes, clear accountability, and appropriate controls to ensure reliable execution and sustained compliance.
Monitor process effectiveness, address execution gaps, and drive improvements in process adherence, turnaround times, and operational efficiency.
Supplier Quality Process Improvement
Drive the improvement and modernization of supplier quality processes to enhance efficiency, simplify workflows, strengthen controls, and support evolving business needs.
Improve the utilization and effectiveness of enterprise systems, including SAP, AssurX, TrackWise, and other applicable quality management platforms, to support supplier quality activities.
Partner with Quality Engineering leadership, IT, Quality Systems, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, define business requirements, and implement practical, sustainable solutions.
Support the transition of manual supplier quality activities to streamlined, electronically managed processes that maintain appropriate quality system controls and regulatory compliance.
Coordinate process changes, system implementation activities, validation support, and associated QMS documentation updates with appropriate functional stakeholders.
Ensure improvements are effectively implemented, adopted, and sustained through standardized practices, training, and ongoing process monitoring.
Supplier Quality Performance Monitoring 
Manage standardized processes for monitoring, tracking, and reporting supplier quality performance, including supplier nonconformances, corrective actions, supplier changes, and other established quality indicators.
Ensure supplier quality data is accurate, consistent, and accessible to support supplier performance evaluations, trend analysis, and management decision-making.
Collaborate with manufacturing sites to ensure consistent application of supplier quality processes, controls, and performance monitoring practices.
Support supplier quality activities across domestic and international manufacturing locations, including supplier onboarding, supplier-related requests, receiving quality issues, and supplier changes.
Partner with site Quality Engineering, Incoming Quality Control, and Operational Procurement teams to address process inconsistencies and improve cross-site coordination.
Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Supplier Quality Engineers responsible for supplier controls and assigned operational support activities.
Provide dedicated engineering support for Supplier Change assessments, incoming quality nonconformances, and other supplier quality activities in coordination with Supplier Quality Engineering leadership.
Ensure timely, technically sound, and risk-based execution of assigned supplier quality activities in accordance with established procedures and quality system requirements.
Partner closely with other SQE Managers and Operational Procurement to align priorities, balance resources, and support timely resolution of supplier quality needs.
Establish clear team expectations, develop employee capabilities, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.
8+ years of progressive experience in Supplier Quality Engineering, Quality Engineering, or related quality functions within a regulated manufacturing environment.
Strong working knowledge of supplier quality management processes, including supplier qualification, supplier onboarding and approval, supplier controls, supplier performance monitoring, supplier changes, and nonconformance management.
Experience managing or providing technical leadership to quality engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage quality processes, ensure procedural compliance, and drive improvements in operational execution.
Experience working with ERP and/or electronic quality management systems in support of quality processes and controls.
Working knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), and applicable supplier control requirements.
Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Supplier Quality Engineering experience in medical device manufacturing.
Experience managing Approved Supplier Lists, supplier qualification records, supplier approval workflows, and related QMS processes.
Experience with SAP, AssurX, TrackWise, MasterControl, or comparable enterprise and quality management systems.
Experience improving quality workflows, defining business requirements, and supporting electronic system enhancements and implementation.
Experience establishing or maintaining supplier performance metrics, scorecards, and quality reporting.
Experience supporting supplier quality activities across multiple manufacturing locations.
Demonstrated success improving quality process efficiency, standardization, and execution.
ASQ certification, Lean Six Sigma certification, or relevant continuous improvement training.
Leadership Expectations
The Supplier Controls Manager is expected to demonstrate strong ownership of supplier quality processes, ensuring they are effectively executed, appropriately controlled, and continuously improved.
This individual should possess the technical judgment to evaluate supplier quality risks, the operational discipline to maintain reliable and compliant processes, and the initiative to improve and modernize established ways of working.
Success in this role requires balancing daily supplier quality responsibilities with process improvement, effective cross-functional collaboration, employee development, and support for manufacturing operations.
Location and Salary 
Location: Alameda, CA
Annual Base Salary Range: $145,000 to $214,000
We offer a competitive compensation package plus a benefits and equity program, when applicable. Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.
Working Conditions
General office, laboratory, and cleanroom environments
Willingness and ability to work on site. May have business travel from 0% - 25%
Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens
Requires some lifting and moving of up to 25 pounds
Must be able to move between buildings and floors.
Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day.
Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.
Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.
Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

jobs.title: Producer, Main Channel
jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

The Process

One Question. That’s It.

Forget the formalities. We don’t care where you went to school or how long you credits are. We care about you think, so show us! Submit a quick video with the answer to the question below. You can submit with visuals or just talking. As long as you answer the question in the way that best represents you, that's all we need.

The Question: What is the hardest problem you have had to solve?

To be considered for this role, you need to submit your answer via video at the link below. Please limit it to 5 minutes.

We want to watch every single video submitted, so please submit either a YouTube unlisted link or a Loom link so the team can access it. You will receive an email link to submit your video immediately following this application!

About the Role

Producers at MrBeast are creative-first problem solvers who are obsessed with finding the answers, requiring someone who takes charge and can make the hard calls. This is a role that it is highly critical on making calls and understanding how to research to solve problems quickly. If you are dedicated and love turning an idea into a reality, this is your role!

Our ideal candidate above all else, will need to be adaptable and thrive under pressure.  We work on short timetables to keep up with virality, and this role especially has to know when to make adjustments and when to push back on asks that may derail a shoot’s timeline and budget.

If a candidate wants to exceed our expectations, they will obsess over marrying their knowledge and skill set into our culture and content formats. You will love this role if you like to solve complex problems (like burying jimmy alive) and love to be on set.

What you’ll be doing:

• Working with the team to prioritize tasks needed to execute bits and scenes

• Researching hard to find people, locations, and props

• Negotiation with vendors, locations and any other big components for a video

• Working with the team with day to day tasks for the overall video

• Pitching options and visuals to creative

• Owning the execution and flow of your bit/s and testing

• On Set execution of your piece of the video

• Working with the Team on costing, time, and logistical requirements of the bits

What makes you a fit:

• Experience picking up the phone, building relationships, and getting the yes

• Understand how to think creative first, production second

• Heavily organized with excellent communication skills

• Leadership qualities, not just management practices

• Previous experience in YouTube or heavy consumer of YouTube

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

• Competitive Salary

• Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance

• Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)

• 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching

• Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

• Company-provided technology package

• Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Discovery Science
jobs.description:
What if… you could join an organization that creates, resources, and builds life sciences companies that invent breakthrough technologies in order to transform health care and sustainability?

FL125 is a cutting-edge biotechnology platform company developing oligonucleotide therapies enabling superior solutions for therapeutic, diagnostics and tool development. This is a unique opportunity to be one of the first employees of a biotech startup that combines an innovative, and disruptive mindset with the resources and know-how of Flagship Pioneering.

Position Summary: We are seeking a motivated and highly collaborative Senior Scientist to join our Discovery Biology team. The successful candidate will bring a deep understanding of biochemistry, assay development, and tissue sample processing, with a strong track record of collaborating with in-vivo pharmacologists / in-vivo biologists, NGS scientists, and bioinformatics teams. The role also involves management of contract research organizations (CROs). The ideal candidate will be highly adaptable, have strong organizational and communication skills, and will thrive in a highly collaborative, and multidisciplinary environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive translational platform innovation aligned with FL125’s core strategic goals, with a focus on biochemical assay development, analysis of oligonucleotides in complex mixtures, and tissue processing.

• Generate and develop enhanced oligonucleotides in different biological settings and against a broad set of drug targets.

• Support the design of in vivo experiments based on protocols developed in-vitro

• Work in close collaboration with biochemists, in-vivo biologists, NGS scientists, and bioinformatics teams.

• Work closely with CROs conducting in-vitro / in-vivo experiments to identify new drug molecules

• Generate rapid and accurate turnaround of high-quality experimental data to drive decision-making for platform and pipeline programs.

• Establish and refine workflows, SOPs, and documentation practices for experimental processes at scale.

• Clearly communicate experimental design, results, challenges, and next steps in internal meetings and with external collaborators.

Qualifications:

• PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, drug discovery, or a related field, with 3+ years of industry experience in discovery research. Postdoctoral experience may also be acceptable depending on research focus.

• Hands-on experience designing and interpreting complex in vitro and ex vivo experimental workflows, including sample processing and assay development.

• Good understanding of in vivo experiments for drug discovery and development in mouse models.

• Some familiarity with high-dimensional readouts such as NGS and proteomics.

• Hands-on experience with standard biochemical techniques and an ability to troubleshoot and optimize complex experimental workflows.

• Track record of working in multidisciplinary teams, including biochemists, in vivo biologists, and bioinformaticians.

• Motivated team-player and independent force-of-nature with strong organizational and written/verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working with oligonucleotides.

• Experience designing and executing mouse model experiments.

• Experience working with contract research organizations (CROs).

What we can offer you:

• Opportunity to lay the scientific foundation of a transformative platform company as an early employee.

• A custom-tailored role to maximize impactful contributions, professional growth, and scientific interests.

• Tightly knit team, social activities and community lunchroom with free snacks, and a vibrant community of scientists and entrepreneurs.

About Flagship

Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in generation of over 500 patents, initiation of over 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents and an aggregate value of more than $90 billion. jobs.title: Senior/Lead DevOps Engineer – Federal
jobs.description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI

C3 AI is seeking a Senior/Lead DevOps Engineer – Federal to join our team in Tysons, VA. You will lead deployments of the C3 Agentic AI Platform into federal customer environments, from initial architecture through production handoff, working directly with customers and with C3 AI Services and Engineering teams.

This role requires US Citizenship and an active Secret clearance or higher. TS/SCI or higher is preferred. A CI or Full-Scope polygraph is preferred.

Responsibilities:

• Lead new federal customer deployments of the C3 AI Platform end to end, from requirements and architecture through installation, validation, and handoff to operations.

• Design and implement customized installations that meet the unique access and security requirements of federal environments, including on-premises, disconnected, and air-gapped networks.

• Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters using infrastructure as code (Terraform), and deploy containerized applications with Helm.

• Initiate and lead scripting and automation (Ansible, Bash, Python) to streamline system updates and upgrades.

• Set up critical infrastructure, tools, and frameworks to streamline the deployment cycle, including CI/CD pipelines and artifact repositories.

• Establish end-to-end monitoring and alerting on all critical aspects of deployed systems.

• Solve complex problems for critical services, build automation to prevent recurrence, and deliver root cause analyses and postmortems.

• Ensure system uptime and availability, meeting functional and performance SLAs.

• Work cross-functionally with Services, Engineering, and the C3 AI Platform operations team.

• Serve as the technical point of contact for customer engineering teams: brief status, document architectures, and write runbooks.

• Travel to customer sites (up to 50%, primarily in the DC area).

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM), or comparable area of study.

• Active Secret clearance or higher; TS/SCI or higher preferred; CI or Full-Scope polygraph preferred.

• 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles.

• Demonstrated experience deploying, managing, and operating scalable and fault-tolerant Kubernetes-based infrastructure in AWS and Azure clouds; on-premises deployment experience preferred.

• Hands-on administration of one or more Kubernetes distributions: AKS, EKS, GKE, RKE2, K3s, or OpenShift.

• Experience deploying Kubernetes with infrastructure as code, Terraform preferred.

• Experience packaging and deploying containerized applications with Helm.

• Configuration management and automation with Ansible; Puppet a plus.

• Experience with CI/CD and artifact tooling such as GitLab CI, Argo CD, Nexus, or Artifactory.

• Expertise in Linux operating systems, networking, and database concepts.

• Experience with cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including government regions (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government).

• Experience in Python or Bash to automate and monitor systems.

• Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.

• Customer-facing experience leading deployments or technical engagements, working independently with strong initiative.

Preferred

• Experience in disconnected or air-gapped environments, including DISA STIG hardening and RMF/ATO support.

• Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).

• Experience administering Kubernetes-based microservices and databases (Postgres, Cassandra).

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.

C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.

$159,000—$230,000 USD

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager, AI Products & Strategic Technology Partnerships (Contract)
jobs.description:
Contract details: Project Consultant

Duration: Through June 30, 2027

Hours: 40 hours per week

Compensation: $80–90/hour, depending on skills, experience, and location

Location: Bay Area or NYC; PST hours preferred

About the role

We’re seeking a Partner Marketing Manager with direct experience leading digitally focused co-marketing initiatives for AI products within enterprise-level technology partnerships. You’ll work with major technology companies and their strategic partners to develop joint go-to-market strategies, shape shared product messaging, and execute integrated digital campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and adoption.

This role requires ownership of the marketing strategy and execution behind complex technology partnerships. You’ll translate shared business objectives into digital campaign plans, manage joint marketing investments, and align product, marketing, creative, and partner stakeholders across both organizations. Your experience should include substantial ownership of digital partner campaigns beyond field marketing and event activation.

What you’ll do

• Develop joint GTM strategies: Define shared audiences, product positioning, priority use cases, digital channels, campaign objectives, and success measures with enterprise technology partners.
• Assess partnership opportunities: Evaluate audience fit, complementary product capabilities, mutual value, and potential positioning conflicts to inform co-marketing strategy.
• Shape joint product messaging: Develop a compelling narrative for what the products offer together, accurately reflecting AI capabilities, limitations, and approved claims.
• Lead integrated digital co-marketing: Own campaign planning and execution across relevant channels, including co-branded web experiences, landing pages, email, paid media, social, digital content, and online product demonstrations.
• Direct campaign development: Translate strategy into clear briefs, messaging frameworks, asset requirements, and channel plans that guide copy, design, content, and production teams.
• Manage enterprise partner relationships: Serve as a day-to-day marketing counterpart to partner teams, aligning objectives, negotiating campaign commitments, resolving competing priorities, and maintaining accountability across organizations.
• Manage MDF and co-marketing investments: Plan, allocate, and track market development funds (MDF) and joint marketing budgets, including funding approvals, partner contributions, spend, reimbursement requirements where applicable, and campaign ROI.
• Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Align product marketing, partnerships, digital marketing, creative, legal, operations, and analytics teams on timelines, dependencies, deliverables, and approvals.
• Own brand and messaging governance: Maintain a shared source of truth for both partners’ brand guidelines, logo usage, asset specifications, product messaging restrictions, and approval requirements.
• Ensure launch readiness: Review digital experiences and campaign assets for strategic alignment, messaging accuracy, brand consistency, and adherence to partner requirements.
• Measure and optimize performance: Work with marketing operations and analytics teams to evaluate campaign engagement, conversion, product adoption, and other agreed business outcomes; recommend changes to strategy, channels, and investment.
• Build repeatable programs: Develop playbooks, templates, and workflows that improve planning, approvals, digital execution, and reporting across strategic partnerships.

What success looks like

Partners and internal teams share a clear GTM strategy and compelling, accurate joint messaging. Digital campaigns launch with coordinated channel plans, approved assets, and reliable measurement. Joint marketing investments are accountable to agreed outcomes, and campaign insights inform future partner strategy and execution.

What you bring

• 5+ years in partner marketing, co-marketing, alliances marketing, or product marketing, with substantial ownership of digitally focused campaigns involving external technology partners.
• Direct experience managing marketing initiatives within enterprise-level technology partnerships, including complex stakeholder structures, joint planning, brand governance, and approvals across organizations.
• Direct experience leading co-marketing for an AI product, with clear examples of the products involved, your ownership, the digital campaign, and its results.
• Proven experience developing joint GTM strategies with technology partners, including audience definition, positioning, digital channel selection, and campaign planning.
• Demonstrated ownership of integrated digital partner campaigns from strategy through launch and optimization, spanning channels such as web, email, paid media, social, and digital content.
• Experience managing MDF or co-marketing budgets, including investment planning, funding approvals, spend tracking, and performance reporting.
• Ability to translate AI product capabilities into clear customer benefits and credible joint positioning, working with product and technical stakeholders to validate messaging.
• Experience developing creative briefs and guiding co-branded digital assets through production, partner review, and launch.
• Strong relationship management and negotiation skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders and resolve competing priorities across partner organizations.
• Strong project management skills and the ability to independently manage multiple complex workstreams.
• Excellent writing, presentation, and executive communication skills.
• Sound professional judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to learn unfamiliar products quickly.

Candidates should bring substantive digital campaign ownership within technology partnerships. Experience centered primarily on field marketing, events, or partner logistics alone will not meet the scope of this role.

Experience using AI tools in marketing workflows is valuable, but does not replace direct experience marketing an AI product through partner initiatives.

Additional experience we value

• Co-marketing for generative AI products, AI applications, or AI-enabled platforms.
• Building repeatable digital partner marketing programs across multiple partners or markets.
• Working in consulting or agency environments supporting major technology clients.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

jobs.title: Director, Merchandise Strategy
jobs.description:

Golden State is looking for a Director to define and execute the strategic vision that connects our brands to retail revenue opportunities. In this role you will be accountable for building a cohesive merchandise roadmap that translates brand positioning, fan insights, and business objectives into compelling product collections, partnerships, and growth-driving initiatives. This role requires both creative vision to identify emerging trends and business acumen to build great products and storytelling. You will partner with our Merchandise Operations, Brand Marketing, and Partnerships teams to own what we create, why it matters to fans, and how it drives both fan acquisition and revenue. This position reports to the Vice President, Growth and Retention.

Come share your expertise while learning more about this growing sports and entertainment organization that values your initiative and dedication!

This is a full-time position based onsite in San Francisco, CA with time spent at our offices in Oakland.

• Translate brand campaigns, tentpole moments, and organizational priorities into cohesive product collections

• Stay current on fashion, streetwear, and sports apparel trends to inform product direction and brand positioning

• Partner with Analytics and Merchandise Operations to evaluate performance, sell-through, and fan response to collections and initiatives

• Use insights from sales data, market trends, and fan behavior to continuously refine assortment strategy and storytelling

• Experience working with licensed products and external vendors

• Background working in cross-functional environments with marketing, creative, and operations teams

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision benefits for employees and dependents

• Employer 401K match

• Vacation, Summer Half-Day Fridays and a generous paid time off plan for pregnancy and parental leaves

• Warriors home tickets, team store discount and more!

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager Intern
jobs.description:
About Parspec

Parspec is building the AI and digital infrastructure for the construction materials supply chain. Construction is a $15 trillion industry, yet the systems that underpin the buying and selling of materials remain fragmented, manual, and disconnected. Distributors and rep agencies rely on spreadsheets, PDFs, phone calls, and siloed tools to find new products and quote and manage projects — creating delays, errors, and margin erosion across the supply chain.

Parspec is an AI-native platform that powers how construction products are discovered, bought, and sold. Trusted by more than 300 MEP distributors and rep agencies, Parspec helps project-driven businesses bid faster, win more work, and operate more profitably. By combining product intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and a connected ecosystem, Parspec is laying the foundation for a more intelligent, efficient construction supply chain.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, Parspec has raised $31 million from leading deep-tech and construction-technology investors.



The Role

As a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) Intern, you will sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing. You will get hands-on experience bringing agentic technology to market by equipping our sales team to win, supporting major product releases, and uncovering insights that drive our go-to-market strategy.



Key Responsibilities

 - Product Launches
   
   - Orchestrate go-to-market (GTM) activities for upcoming product features and platform updates.
   
   - Translate technical product capabilities into clear and engaging communication materials
   
   - Draft launch materials, including release notes, internal FAQs, and customer-facing email copy.

   - Build and maintain our social proof library, owning the drafting and organization of customer testimonials, case studies, and ROI metrics for use across all marketing and sales channels.
   
   - Partner with Sales and Product Marketing leadership to develop and refine high-impact collateral, including pitch decks, battle cards, cold emails, and website content.

 - Market Research & Customer Insights
   
   - Collect and organize feedback from customers and sales teams, translating market insights into actionable messaging recommendations.
   
   - Track industry trends and competitor positioning across the construction supply chain to keep leadership informed on market shifts and emerging opportunities.

Qualifications

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, customer-friendly messaging.

 - Highly organized and analytical, with a natural curiosity for conducting research, spotting patterns in customer feedback, and maintaining structured repositories.

 - Proactive, cross-functional team player who is comfortable navigating the fast-paced, ambiguous environment of an early-stage startup.

The Parspec team believes that varied backgrounds drive better outcomes and fuel innovation. We are a team of self-starters who lead from every seat. We think big, set a standard of excellence, and are committed to diversity and a discrimination-free workplace. We welcome applicants from all walks of life to join us and help shape the future of our industry.

jobs.location: United States, UNITED STATES, United States
jobs.description:
Overview

Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms.

You will help investigate new fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers throughout the model development lifecycle, from problem definition and data assembly through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment.

Your work will contribute to the techniques, analytical tools, and capabilities Experian's fraud analytics team has spent years refining. This is an individual contributor position and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics

What you'll do

• Explore large datasets, with guidance from senior team members, to identify fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals.
• Work with senior data scientists to translate fraud questions into testable hypotheses and analytical approaches.
• Help build machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk.

• Develop and validate features using identity, transactional, behavioral, and other available data sources.
• Write clean, well-tested code, and work with engineering to bring models and features into production.
• Partner with the score monitoring team to help set up model and feature monitoring, and support research on related client questions.

• 1+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or advanced analytics
• Foundation in supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, and techniques such as classification and anomaly detection.
• Proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, readable, and well-tested code.
• Familiarity with common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
