jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter (Product & Engineering)
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Where We Work: At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

What You'll Do
We’re looking for a high-energy, relationship-driven Technical Recruiter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and is passionate about finding and closing top-tier engineering & product talent. In this role, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for all technical roles, acting as a true partner to hiring managers and a champion of candidate experience. We have a strong foundation but lots of opportunity to build and experiment. If you enjoy iterating quickly, and making an impact at a company where talent is our greatest asset, we’d love to connect.

Sourcing & Pipeline Building

• Proactively source and engage passive technical candidates using various platforms (Linkedin Recruiter, Juicebox, etc).

• Build and maintain pipelines of top engineering and product talent to support both current and future hiring needs.

• Leverage creative and data-informed sourcing strategies to proactively uncover and engage a diverse pool of top-tier talent.

• Process Optimization: Embrace a mindset of continuous iteration, regularly evaluating and refining recruitment processes to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and candidate experience.

• Champion best practices while identifying opportunities through AI to streamline workflows and elevate hiring outcomes across the organization.

Recruiting & Candidate Management

• Own the end-to-end recruiting process for engineering & product roles (e.g. software engineers, product managers, leadership roles).

• Act as a strategic partner to Engineering and Product leadership by driving kickoff and calibration meetings to define role requirements, align on candidate expectations, and architect effective interview strategies laying the foundation for successful technical hiring.

• Navigate evolving hiring needs and shifting candidate profiles by working closely with Engineering Leadership to adapt recruiting strategies in real time, ensuring alignment through agile planning, transparent communication, and data-driven adjustments.

• Conduct in-depth interviews to assess technical and cultural fit, present qualified candidates to hiring managers, and facilitate a seamless interview process.

• Communicate our mission, values, and growth story to inspire and attract top technical talent.

• Ensure a high-quality candidate experience with timely updates, transparent feedback, and thoughtful communication.

• Track pipeline activity and maintain accurate records in our ATS (Greenhouse experience preferred).

• Report on key hiring metrics to help improve process efficiency and transparency.

Collaboration & Onboarding Support

• Partner with various departments to ensure smooth transitions from offer to onboarding.

• Assist with coordinating new hire onboarding activities specific to engineering & product roles.

What You'll Bring

• 6+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with a strong focus on engineering & product roles

• Previous experience working in a hyper growth SaaS company (required)

• Working knowledge of ATS platforms (Greenhouse preferred) and sourcing tools

• Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative without waiting to be asked, anticipates needs, and drives action

• Influence & Persuasion: Builds alignment and momentum across stakeholders to move processes ahead

• Highly Organized & Efficient: Strong time management skills and the ability to juggle multiple open roles, hiring processes, and competing priorities without dropping the ball

• Excellent Communicator & Relationship-Builder: Builds trust and credibility with candidates and stakeholders; ensures a high-touch, thoughtful experience throughout the hiring journey

• Self-Motivated & Adaptable: Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments; operates with initiative and flexibility even as priorities shift and needs evolve

• Candidates must be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

• Enjoy the flexibility of remote work

• Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.

• Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge.

• Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.

• Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.

• Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing in Your Future (and Present):

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.

• Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.

• Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.

• After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.

• Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.

Most importantly, we have a stellar team, a whole lot of fun, and work that actually matters to the shops and families we serve!

We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.

jobs.title: Senior Counsel
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Where We Work: At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

What You’ll Do

We are hiring a Senior Counsel, a hands-on generalist who will build and run the legal function. You will be our first dedicated legal leader, covering commercial, corporate, employment, compliance and risk work, and partnering closely with executives and cross-functional teams.

• Corporate matters: Lead corporate legal work, including governance, entity matters and transactions.

• Customer contracts: Draft, review and negotiate customer agreements.

• Product terms and conditions: Own the product T&Cs and related consumer-facing policies, keeping them distinct from negotiated customer contracts.

• Litigation: Manage disputes and claims, working with outside counsel as needed.

• Employment law: Advise on employment matters in partnership with the People team.

• Compliance and risk management: Build the compliance program and assess legal risk across the business.

• External counsel: Manage outside law firms and decide when to bring in specialist support.

• Executive partnership: Advise leaders on decisions, set out degrees of risk and trade-offs, and recommend practical workarounds rather than defaulting to "no."

• Function building: Define legal processes and priorities, and grow the team as scope expands.

• Equity: Manage equity compensation administration and advise on equity plan design and structure as the company scales.

What You’ll Bring

• Minimum of 6 years of experience and 3 years in-house, ideally at another tech or SaaS company

• Corporate law background, with exposure to several of: customer contracts, product T&Cs, litigation and employment

• Experience in a smaller or mid-sized company where you handled a broad scope, not a single specialty

• Influence without authority: Leads through relationships and persuasion, since the role advises rather than makes final business decisions.

• Risk translation: Turns complex legal issues into plain language and lays out degrees of risk and trade-offs so leaders can decide.

• Collaboration: Acts as a flexible, cross-functional partner, not a command-and-control gatekeeper.

• Pragmatism: Offers workarounds that reduce risk while keeping the business moving.

• Self-sufficiency: Hits the ground running and needs little training.

• Builder mindset: Comfortable as a first hire, setting up processes and priorities from scratch.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

• Enjoy the flexibility of remote work

• Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.

• Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge.

• Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.

• Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.

• Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing in Your Future (and Present):

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.

• Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.

• Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.

• After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.

• Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.

Most importantly, we have a stellar team, a whole lot of fun, and work that actually matters to the shops and families we serve!

Tekmetric is an equal opportunity employer. We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. jobs.title: Director, Global Medical Information
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a strategic and experienced professional to join our team as Director of Medical Information. This role will lead the delivery of timely, accurate, and evidence-based Medical Information to healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and caregivers.

As a key member of the Medical Affairs team, you will provide therapeutic-area leadership across the Medical Information lifecycle, including strategy, scientific content, launch readiness, contact-center operations support, and customer inquiry management. The role will lead Medical Information related scientific and operational priorities; translate customer insights into actionable recommendations; and partner with cross-functional and regional stakeholders to ensure aligned, high-quality Medical Information support. The Director will also support Medical Information activities at scientific congresses. The ideal candidate is a skilled communicator and people leader with strong scientific acumen, demonstrated Medical Information expertise, and the ability to lead complex initiatives in a dynamic environment. The role will report to the Head of Medical Information within Global Medical Excellence.

• Develops and execute Medical Information strategy and therapeutic-area priorities for assigned therapeutic area in alignment with Medical Strategy leads, regional Medical Information teams, and other key stakeholders.

• Owns the Medical Information content plan, including the development, review, approval, deployment, and maintenance of standard response letters, custom response letters, FAQs, inquiry response guidance, and special handling instructions.

• Collaborates with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biology, Medical Strategy and other internal stakeholders to interpret emerging evidence, identify information needs, and inform content priorities.

• Ensures all medical information content is evidence-based, consistent, and aligned with the latest scientific and clinical data.

• Coordinates with regional leads to support localization, regional review, and country implementation of global medical information resources.

• Supports the management of unsolicited inquiries from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, ensuring responses are accurate, compliant and timely.

• Serves as medical reviewer for therapeutic-area materials through the Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) process, ensuring that materials support evidence-based communication and comply with company policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Partners with the MICC lead and Medical Information vendors on agent training, content deployment, response quality, and inquiry escalation. Contribute to vendor performance reviews and corrective actions within the role’s therapeutic-area scope.

• Monitors and analyzes inquiry trends to identify opportunities for operational improvements and inform the medical strategy.

• Monitors relevant scientific publications, clinical trial results, and treatment developments to inform Medical Information strategy, content updates and training.

• Provides Medical Information support for congresses, including developing resources, staffing Medical Information booths and responding to HCP inquiries.

• Contributes to the development and maintenance of internal SOPs and processes to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

• Provides support for other Medical Affairs projects as needed.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Advanced degree in scientific or medical discipline; doctoral degree preferred (PharmD, MD, PhD).

• 10+ years relevant experience.

• Experience in oncology therapeutic area and demonstrated ability to critically evaluate clinical trial data and communicate complex scientific information.

• Proven experience in medical information within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Experience creating, reviewing and managing scientific content for diverse audience.

• Strong organizational, problem-solving and project management skills.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor and analyze data to inform decision-making.

• Knowledge of regulatory guidelines related to medical information and safety reporting.

• Proficiency in medical information databases, content management systems and other relevant software tools.

• Experience with Veeva PromoMats advantageous.

• Ability to effectively negotiate and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced dynamic environment.

• Self-motivated with ability to make sound decisions and adapt to changing priorities.

• Experience in managing medical information vendors.

• Willingness to travel, approximately 10-20%.

Preferred Skills:

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in Medical Affairs or a related field within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience in the lung cancer therapeutic area strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Integrations Engineer
jobs.description:
💡 MISSION

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn't be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we're building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate bills, and make coverage easier to understand, saving people time, money, and energy. Our goal is simple: to be the platform that empowers all Americans to take charge of their healthcare.

 


🩺 ABOUT US

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we're a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We're lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded and have solid runway.

People come to us when they have a bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it, catches errors, overcharges and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. That earns us the right to be connected to their insurance and their patient data, and from there Granted runs in the background, proactively monitoring every bill to help patients lower and pay what they owe.

 


🔎 ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Integrations Pod builds the infrastructure that connects to the systems where members' healthcare and insurance information lives, bringing everything together so we can understand their coverage, identify billing issues, and take action to lower their medical bills. With AI, we have an opportunity to rethink how these integrations work: building highly personalized systems that can retrieve and make sense of the information needed to resolve a member's billing issues, without requiring them to track down documents, navigate portals, or do the legwork themselves.

As a member of our Integrations and Platform team, you'll work across backend systems and integrations. You'll leverage AI-native software paradigms and cutting-edge development tools to build a world-class application. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering leadership, and senior engineers on the pod, owning features from idea to production, with plenty of room to grow your scope as you ramp.

 


📖 READ MORE ABOUT OUR STACK AND ENG CULTURE HERE https://grantedhealth.com/blog/engineering-how-we-build-for-speed-craft-and-ownership

 


🚀 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own the pipelines that pull claims, bills, EOBs and coverage data from payer portals, providers and partners

 - Design for failure: portal changes, auth and 2FA, partial data, rate limits, and knowing something broke before an advocate does

 - Own the path from raw capture to normalized records to analytics, including where PHI lives and how it's protected

 - Set technical direction for the pod: architecture, sequencing, and what we say no to

 - Mentor engineers on the pod through code review, pairing and design, and raise the bar for how we build with agents

 


🧪 WHAT YOU MIGHT WORK ON

 - Insurance and portal linking that lets a patient connect their accounts in a few taps

 - Data integrations that monitor every connected account and flag new bills, claims and deductible changes

 - Inbound channels like email, fax and partner webhooks, landed safely and exactly once

 - The warehouse layer that turns raw healthcare data into anonymized, analytics-ready tables

 


🛠 TECH STACK

 - TypeScript frontend & backend

 - React Native, NextJS, NestJS, GraphQL

 - Postgres, amplitude, sentry, datadog

 - Temporal, Pulumi, Docker, AWS

 


👩‍💻 YOU'LL BRING


MUST-HAVES

 - 5+ years of backend engineering experience, including integrations or data pipelines in production

 - Strong TypeScript or Node experience, and deep comfort with relational databases and data modeling

 - A track record of building systems against unreliable third parties: scraping or browser automation, flaky APIs, webhooks, file drops

 - Reliability and observability instincts: idempotency, replay, monitoring, and data quality checks you bring up without being asked

 - Technical leadership: you've set direction on a team, made architecture calls, and mentored other engineers

 - AI-native workflow: you use coding agents daily for real work and want to make how the team uses them better


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Data engineering: warehousing, Snowflake, dbt or similar, and anonymization pipelines

 - Experience with workflow engines like Temporal

 - Healthcare data experience: claims, EOBs, X12/EDI, FHIR, or payer and provider systems

 - Experience handling PHI or working under HIPAA or SOC 2

📢 You don't need to check every single box. If you're passionate, driven, and excited about the impact AI can make on the healthcare system, we'd love to hear from you!

 


🦸 WORKING WITH US

Granted is headquartered in New York, with our office near Union Square. Our team is split between in-office and remote across the US: Engineering and CX are remote-first, while other teams work hybrid from our NYC office (in-office Monday to Thursday, Fridays from home). We're intentional about when we're together and flexible where it enables deep, high-quality work.

More than anything, we're here because we care deeply about the problem we're solving and the standard we hold ourselves to. Healthcare is broken, and fixing it requires people who want ownership, impact, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of their careers.

Job Title: Coater

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Warehouse
Location: Rawlins, WY / Field Projects Throughout the West Region
Reports to:  Coatings Superintendent / Coatings Foreman
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

Loenbro is seeking a skilled and experienced Coater to join our Coatings Division. The Coater is responsible for performing all aspects of industrial surface preparation, abrasive blasting, and protective coating application on structural steel, piping, equipment, tanks, and industrial facilities. This position requires a strong understanding of coating systems, surface preparation standards, and safe work practices to ensure projects meet quality, production, and customer requirements.

The ideal candidate has experience applying industrial coatings in fabrication, construction, manufacturing, maintenance, or industrial environments and can work independently while maintaining high standards of workmanship, safety, and quality.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Prepare steel, piping, equipment, and industrial surfaces for coating using abrasive blasting, power tools, hand tools, grinding, sanding, cleaning, and masking techniques.

• Perform abrasive blasting and surface preparation activities in accordance with project specifications and SSPC/NACE industry standards.

• Apply industrial coating systems, including primers, epoxies, zinc-rich coatings, polyurethanes, and specialty protective coatings using spray, brush, and roller methods.

• Mix and apply coatings according to manufacturer specifications, ensuring proper thickness, coverage, and finish quality requirements are achieved.

• Inspect surfaces and completed coatings, measure film thickness, identify defects, and perform touch-up or corrective work as needed.

• Safely operate, maintain, clean, and store blasting and coating equipment, while reporting maintenance or repair needs promptly.

• Follow OSHA regulations, site safety requirements, PPE standards, hazardous material handling procedures, and environmental compliance practices.

• Collaborate with supervisors, inspectors, and team members to meet project schedules, maintain quality standards, support training efforts, and complete additional assigned duties.

Other duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• Minimum 2-4 years of industrial painting experience in construction, fabrication, manufacturing, refinery, mining, power generation, or similar industrial environments.

• Proven experience with abrasive blasting, surface preparation, and the application of industrial protective coating systems.

• Working knowledge of SSPC/NACE surface preparation standards and coating industry best practices.

• Proficiency applying epoxy, polyurethane, zinc-rich, and specialty coatings using brush and roll, conventional spray, and airless spray application methods, as well as conventional coating application equipment.

• Ability to read and interpret coating specifications, product data sheets (PDS), and safety documentation, while maintaining high standards of quality and productivity.

• Ability to pass respirator fit testing and medical evaluations, and work safely at heights, in confined spaces, and other physically demanding environments.

Preferred:

• SSPC/AMPP certification or industrial coatings certification.

• Experience in structural steel fabrication shops or industrial construction projects.

• Forklift certification.

• Aerial lift certification.

• OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.

• Experience with plural-component coating equipment.

• Bilingual in English and Spanish.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Work Environment:

• Work performed in fabrication shops, industrial facilities, construction sites, and outdoor environments.

• Regular exposure to dust, abrasive media, paint fumes, chemicals, solvents, noise, and varying weather conditions.

• Frequent use of respirators and other personal protective equipment.

• Requires travel to project sites throughout the West Region.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay

jobs.description:
🚀 ABOUT WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

 

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 
 


📐 ABOUT THE ROLE

AI research at WRITER isn't just about publishing papers; it's about building the scientific foundation that powers some of the most ambitious enterprise AI deployments in the world. As an AI research scientist, you'll be at the center of that work. You'll drive a high-impact research agenda focused on large language models, agentic reasoning, and the system-level capabilities that make AI genuinely useful at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to do research that matters twice over: advancing the field and shipping directly into products used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.



We're at an inflection point. Enterprises are moving from experimenting with AI to deeply embedding it across their operations, and WRITER's models are the engine making that possible. The work you do here—on post-training, planning, multi-step reasoning, and agentic workflows—will directly shape how the next generation of enterprise AI behaves, performs, and scales. You'll have the resources, infrastructure, and cross-functional support to pursue ambitious ideas and bring them to life quickly.

This role is hybrid, based out of our San Francisco or New York City hub. You’ll report to our VP of AI research. 



Please note: role is open to Staff, and Sr. Staff applicants
We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 
 


🦸🏻‍♀️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead an independent, high-impact research agenda on large language models and agentic systems, owning projects from early hypothesis through model training, evaluation, and production deployment

 - Design and execute large-scale post-training experiments using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), RLAIF, DPO, and emerging alignment techniques, with a focus on improving multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use in enterprise agentic workflows

 - Build novel evaluation benchmarks and methodologies that push beyond existing limitations, establishing rigorous measures for how well models perform on complex, real-world enterprise tasks

 - Develop scalable data synthesis and curation pipelines that generate the high-quality training signal driving model improvement, including LLM-as-judge frameworks, synthetic data generation, and adversarial dataset construction

 - Shape WRITER's model architecture and training roadmap by translating your research insights into concrete improvements to our enterprise-grade LLMs, working hand-in-hand with research engineering and product teams

 - Publish and present original research at top-tier venues—NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, and others—representing WRITER at the frontier of the field and contributing to the broader scientific community

 - Mentor and uplevel fellow researchers and engineers on the team, helping set a high bar for scientific rigor, experimental design, and research culture

 
 


⭐️ WHAT YOU NEED

 - 7+ years of hands-on ML research experience, with deep expertise in large language model pre-training and post-training — you've trained models at scale, debugged distributed jobs, and shipped improvements that made a measurable difference

 - A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated research experience with a strong portfolio of independent, published work

 - Expert-level knowledge of post-training methods including SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, GRPO, and related alignment and reasoning techniques, with a track record of applying them to real, production-grade systems

 - Strong command of Python and PyTorch (or JAX), with the engineering depth to build and scale training pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, and data synthesis workflows yourself — not just direct others to do it

 - A meaningful publication record at competitive ML/AI venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, or equivalent), evidencing your ability to originate ideas and execute on a multi-month research agenda independently

 - Hands-on experience designing or evaluating agentic systems: models that plan, reason through multi-step tasks, use tools, and recover gracefully from errors, with a nuanced understanding of where they break and how to fix them

 - The instincts and orientation that match WRITER's values:
   
   - you Connect: you collaborate openly across research, engineering, and product and communicate complex ideas with clarity to both technical and non-technical audiences
   
   - you Challenge: you ask the hard questions, push back on conventional wisdom, and pursue the research directions others haven't tried yet
   
   - you Own: you drive your projects end-to-end with urgency, take accountability for results, and care deeply about the impact your work has on real customers


🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees)

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

Fin is preparing for it's next phase of expansion and are hiring managers across every segment.

Fin is the leading AI agent for customer service, and we’re scaling our North America sales team to match demand. As Manager, Account Executives, you’ll lead a team of Fin AEs who win new logos and grow a portfolio of existing customers. Reporting to the Director, Sales, you’ll own the strategy, operating plan, and results for your team.

We’re looking for an experienced first-line leader who hires and develops great sellers, coaches them through complex deals, and partners across functions to build a repeatable, customer-centric sales motion. You’ll play a central role in shaping our value-led sales strategy and scaling the NAMER sales engine alongside our Salesforce counterparts.

This is a builder’s role. The market is moving fast, the playbook is still being written, and we need a leader who is innovative, agile, and resilient.

What will I be doing?

Sales strategy and planning

• Own both new logo and expansion targets for your territory.

• Turn company goals into a team plan that delivers predictable, repeatable performance.

• Own pipeline generation, quality, and hygiene, and forecast accurately.

• Build new sales motions where needed to capture market or segment opportunities.

Deal and account leadership

Hiring and team development

Cross-functional collaboration

Reporting and analytics

• Report regularly to senior leadership on team performance, pipeline, and market conditions.

What skills do I need?

• 5+ years in a quota-carrying new business role with a record of overachievement, including complex deals involving procurement, legal, and security (must have 6 figure closing experience) .

• A track record of, and passion for, hiring, coaching, and developing top talent.

• Strong new logo acumen with experience self generating pipeline

• Operational excellence and forecasting expertise.

• A builder mindset, with experience shaping go-to-market strategy and sales programs (capacity, territory, quota, headcount).

• AI fluency

Bonus Skills & Attributes

• Experience selling a consumption-based or AI product.

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The OTE range for candidates within the Greater Chicago Area is $247,860 - $314,440. Actual OTE pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The OTE pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: AI research scientist
jobs.description:
🚀 ABOUT WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

 

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 
 


📐 ABOUT THE ROLE

AI research at WRITER isn't just about publishing papers; it's about building the scientific foundation that powers some of the most ambitious enterprise AI deployments in the world. As an AI research scientist, you'll be at the center of that work. You'll drive a high-impact research agenda focused on large language models, agentic reasoning, and the system-level capabilities that make AI genuinely useful at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to do research that matters twice over: advancing the field and shipping directly into products used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.



We're at an inflection point. Enterprises are moving from experimenting with AI to deeply embedding it across their operations, and WRITER's models are the engine making that possible. The work you do here—on post-training, planning, multi-step reasoning, and agentic workflows—will directly shape how the next generation of enterprise AI behaves, performs, and scales. You'll have the resources, infrastructure, and cross-functional support to pursue ambitious ideas and bring them to life quickly.

This role is hybrid, based out of our San Francisco or New York City hub. You’ll report to our VP of AI research. 



Please note: role is open to Senior applicants
We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 
 
 


🦸🏻‍♀️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work on a high-impact research agenda on large language models and agentic systems, being a core member of a team working on projects involving data synthesis, novel model architectures, model training, evaluation, and production deployment

 - Help design and execute post-training experiments using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), RLAIF, DPO, etc., and emerging alignment techniques, with a focus on improving multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use in enterprise agentic workflows

 - Build novel evaluation benchmarks and methodologies that push beyond existing limitations, establishing rigorous measures for how well models perform on complex, real-world enterprise tasks

 - Develop scalable data synthesis and curation pipelines that generate the high-quality training signal driving model improvement, including LLM-as-judge frameworks, synthetic data generation, and adversarial dataset construction

 - Shape WRITER's model architecture and training roadmap by translating your research insights into concrete improvements to our enterprise-grade LLMs, working hand-in-hand with research engineering and product teams

 - Publish and present original research at top-tier venues—NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, and others—representing WRITER at the frontier of the field and contributing to the broader scientific community

 - Work closely with fellow researchers and engineers on the team, helping set a high bar for scientific rigor, experimental design, and research culture

 
 


⭐️ WHAT YOU NEED

 - 4+ years of hands-on ML research experience (can include years obtaining advanced degree), with deep expertise in large language model pre-training and post-training — you've trained models at scale, debugged distributed jobs, and shipped improvements that made a measurable difference

 - A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated research experience with a strong portfolio of independent, published work

 - Expert-level knowledge of post-training methods including SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, GRPO, and related alignment and reasoning techniques, with a track record of applying them to real, production-grade systems

 - Strong command of Python and PyTorch (or JAX), with the engineering depth to build and scale training pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, and data synthesis workflows yourself — not just direct others to do it

 - One or more publications at a competitive ML/AI venue (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, or equivalent), evidencing your ability to originate ideas and execute on a multi-month research agenda independently

 - Hands-on experience designing or evaluating agentic systems: models that plan, reason through multi-step tasks, use tools, and recover gracefully from errors, with a nuanced understanding of where they break and how to fix them

 - The instincts and orientation that match WRITER's values:
   
   - you Connect: you collaborate openly across research, engineering, and product and communicate complex ideas with clarity to both technical and non-technical audiences
   
   - you Challenge: you ask the hard questions, push back on conventional wisdom, and pursue the research directions others haven't tried yet
   
   - you Own: you drive your projects end-to-end with urgency, take accountability for results, and care deeply about the impact your work has on real customers


🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees)

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

 - Fertility and family planning support

 - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer

 - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options

 - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution

 - Annual work-life stipends for:
   
   - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.
   
   - Learning and development stipend

 - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

 - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k

WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law. Under the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By submitting your application on the application page,  you acknowledge and agree to WRITER's Global Candidate Privacy Notice https://writer.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

• Real-world scale: Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.

• Complex markets, rich signals: Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.

• Strategic ownership: Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.

• Impact meets innovation: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

• Design Economic Systems: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem.

• Master Pricing & Supply Response: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies.

• Spearhead UGC Category Launches: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity.

• Apply Deep Causal Inference: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics.

• Drive Strategy: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.

You have (at least some of) the following:

• 6+ years of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies.

• Deep Methodological Expertise in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design.

• Marketplace Intuition with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health.

• Executive Communication & Leadership skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences.

• An Advanced Degree (Master’s or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

Annual Salary Range

$263,670—$322,820 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Join a small, high-impact design team where your work will directly influence how revenue teams operate every day.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team

About the job

Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3-5 years are the right ones.

You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy-by-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Own the architecture and multi-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them.

• Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build-versus-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints.

• Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy.

• Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt.

• Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right-to-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems.

• Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use.

• Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed-systems and performance problems.

• Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad.

• Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re-sequence when the tradeoffs require it.

• Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming-first architectures, federated query, and AI-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 15+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role.

• Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm.

• Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake and lakehouse architecture, partitioning, indexing, query planning, and how the choices affect cost and performance at petabyte scale.

• Breadth across data storage and retrieval technologies, with hands-on depth in at least two of: analytical/OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse), search engines (e.g., ElasticSearch/OpenSearch), and lake or distributed processing engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink). You can reason about when to use each, how they interoperate, and how to migrate between them.

• Working knowledge of streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) and how they interact with downstream storage.

• Practical experience designing data governance at scale: data classification, catalog and metadata management, lineage, and access control integrated with authentication and authorization systems.

• Practical experience implementing privacy and compliance requirements (deletion, retention, residency) across a large, heterogeneous data estate.

• Proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, and Go.

• Track record of writing and driving architecture decisions across multiple teams, and of changing the direction of an organization’s technical roadmap through influence rather than authority.

• Experience elevating engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers across teams.

• Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence: architecting for high availability, observability and incident response in distributed systems, and being credible when a platform is failing in production.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including making a complex tradeoff clear to engineers and to senior leadership.

Desired:

jobs.title: Test and Launch Operations Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

TEST & LAUNCH OPERATIONS ENGINEER I

Test and Launch Operations Engineers are responsible for taking years of design and manufacturing to flight in the operation of launch vehicles. As a member of Rocket Lab's Test & Launch Operations team, you will be directly responsible for operating the Electron HASTE and Neutron launch vehicles from the control room throughout all phases of integrated systems testing and launch operations. You will execute complex test sequences, monitor real-time avionics data, make critical go/no-go decisions, and command Avionics systems during countdown and flight operations.

This role is within the Avionics discipline, responsible for Avionics Hardware and software, Radio Frequency (RF) systems, Ground Segment, Telemetry, Networking and all Avionics operations that enable launch.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO

• Operate Electron and Neutron Avionics as a launch console operator during tests, rehearsals, and launches.

• Support development, integration, and testing of Avionics systems.

• Lead and execute testing campaigns, including Avionics Integrated Systems testing and readiness checks.

• Manage configuration and verification of Avionics hardware and systems.

• Develop operational procedures, test plans, and emergency response protocols.

• Design and improve HMIs for Avionics systems to enhance operator efficiency.

• Troubleshoot and resolve real-time issues during test and launch operations.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS TEST & LAUNCH OPERATIONS ENGINEER I

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (preferably Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Mechatronic Engineering)

• 1+ years of experience in engineering design, test and/or operations, electrical/software engineering

• 2+ years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

• 2+ years of experience in engineering design, test, and/or operations

• Background in Avionics equipment design/operations

• Solid understanding and hands-on experience working with Avionics Hardware/Software, RF systems, Ground Segment, Telemetry Tracking and Command

• Good understanding and practical experience conducting real-time hazardous operations with Avionics Systems

• Experience developing operational procedures, test plans, CONOPS documentation, or emergency response procedures

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the state of Virginia’s pay transparency requirements. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience.

Base salary is only one part of Rocket Lab’s compensation package for this role. You may be eligible for company stock, or cash incentives, and can purchase discounted stock through Rocket Lab’s Employee Stock Purchase Program. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Base Pay Range (VA Only)

$85,000—$95,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Payscale is the pioneer of compensation intelligence, helping organizations make smarter pay decisions that drive business performance. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Agents — SF
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is redefining what’s possible in legal work by combining cutting-edge AI with intuitive product experiences. As we scale rapidly and take on increasingly complex use cases, we’re expanding our product engineering team to accelerate our ability to ship fast, delight users, and build infrastructure that scales with us.

Agents at Harvey let lawyers turn their expertise into reusable, automated work: custom agents and workflows that draft, review and analyze across a firm’s documents. The Agents team owns Agent Builder, the Agents experience, workflows and the foundations underneath them: orchestration, durable execution, permissions and reliability. Other Harvey products build on this platform as well.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a large, senior team of full-stack and backend engineers through the shift from single-turn assistants to long-running, multi-agent systems that firms trust with their most sensitive work. This role is equal parts product judgment and systems depth.

We move with urgency, bias toward simplicity, and expect our leaders to be hands-on when needed. If you’re energized by ownership, decisive execution, and solving real user problems, we'd love to hear from you.




WHY NOW

 - Agents are how firms put Harvey to work: lawyers are turning their expertise into reusable agents and workflows that run across their documents and matters.

 - The work is moving from single-turn assistance to long-running, scheduled and multi-agent work. That demands durable execution, sandboxed tools and recovery from failure at scale.

 - Agents now reach deep into a firm’s most sensitive data, so permissions, tenant isolation and governance have to hold everywhere an agent can act.

 - Other Harvey products are building on this platform, so its quality and speed set the pace for much of the company.

 - We need a leader who can raise the bar on reliability and evaluation while the team keeps shipping quickly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the Agents engineering team, a group of senior full-stack and backend engineers building Agent Builder, the Agents experience, workflows and the runtime underneath them.

 - Own reliability and quality for agent and workflow execution, including on-call health, incident follow-through, SLOs and evals as part of how the team ships.

 - Set technical direction for orchestration, durable execution and agent composition, and stay close enough to the code to make sound architecture calls and unblock hard problems.

 - Hold a high bar on security and customer data boundaries, so permissions, isolation and admin controls are designed in from the start rather than patched later.

 - Partner with Product, Design and Data Science on what agents should do for lawyers. Work with Agent Platform, Infrastructure and Security on the shared foundations.

 - Shape how the team builds with AI coding agents: review practices, verification and test infrastructure that keep quality high as output grows.

 - Hire, develop and retain strong engineers, grow tech leads, and build a team culture of ownership and candor.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - You have 3+ years managing engineering teams, including teams of 10 or more, and 5+ years as a backend or full-stack engineer before that.

 - You’ve shipped LLM-powered or agentic products in production and understand orchestration, tool use, evals, and latency and cost trade-offs from experience.

 - You’ve operated multi-tenant systems with strict security, permission or compliance requirements, and you treat a permissions bug as a trust issue.

 - You’re comfortable going deep on distributed systems: workflow engines such as Temporal, queues, sandboxing and long-running jobs.

 - You have strong product judgment and can weigh speed, quality and user impact in a domain where accuracy matters.

 - You lead by raising the bar on quality without slowing the team down. You know when to step in and when to let your tech leads lead.

 - Nice to have: experience with builder, low-code or automation tools for non-engineers, or with legal or other professional-services workflows.
