jobs.title: Head of Corporate Legal
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.




THE ROLE 

We're hiring a Head of Corporate Legal to build and lead Legora's corporate, securities, governance and M&A function as we prepare to operate as a public company. You will build the team and do the work on the Legora aOS, shaping the product along the way.

At Legora’s pace of growth, new entities, acquisitions, financings and Board work land in the same quarter, and public-company discipline has to arrive early, without slowing the company down.

The right candidate will have taken a company public from the inside and then run the corporate function through the quarters that followed. You know where that work most needs a lawyer's judgment, and you are excited about how much technology can now help with the rest.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work closely with the entire C-Suite and Board of Directors, as well as the Finance team, Corporate Development, Product and People teams.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

1. Build the Corporate Legal Team of the Future on Legora

Legora Legal is customer zero. You will run our corporate function on the Legora aOS, and help shape it into the platform of choice that the best corporate legal teams run on.

 - Run the full corporate calendar and on Legora. Start with the rhythm every company keeps: entity formation, Board and committee meetings, approvals and equity grants. Then mature it into the rhythm a public company requires: quaterly earnings cycle preparation, disclosures, public filings and trading windows. Each cycle should teach the system more of our context, judgment and risk tolerance as a company.

 - Work side by side with Product and Legal Engineering to turn what we learn into product, so that Legora can be trusted to do the most demanding corporate and public-company work.

 - Design the team with a clear view of how legal professionals and technology work together to move legal professionals up the value chain.

 - Document the results and publish the playbook, so customers can see how a corporate function against a public-company standard runs on Legora.

2. Build Public-Company Reporting

Bring Legora's reporting and disclosure to the standard the public markets expect.

 - Lead the corporate, governance and securities work of public-company readiness.

 - Partner with Finance to build the reporting function to public-market maturity, including disclosure controls,  disclosure committee, and periodic reporting, proxy and earnings processes, all leveraging Legora.

 - Design insider trading, Section 16 and Rule 10b5-1 programs, and the employee equity education that goes with them.

 - Work with Finance, Investor Relations and Communications so that what Legora says publicly is accurate and consistent.

3. Uplevel Board Interactions

Ensure sound governance and effective Board operations.

 - Own Board and committee operations, including meeting cadence, materials, minutes and the flow of information between management and directors, all built leveraging Legora.

 - Advise on director independence, committee charters, governance policies, and the annual meeting and proxy season.

 - Be a trusted counselor to directors and executives.

4. Lead M&A and Global Expansion

Legora grows by acquiring companies and entering new markets, and you keep Legal ahead of both.

 - Partner with Corporate Development on acquisitions from term sheet through integration, structuring and negotiating for speed, risk and long-term value.

 - Stand up and govern entities as Legora enters new markets, working with Finance, Tax and People so that a launch never waits on Legal.

 - Support financings, tender offers and the equity program alongside Finance.

 - Build playbooks and run them on Legora, making each deal more efficient than the last.




WHAT YOU BRING

Three things matter most.

 1. You have a point of view on the in-house legal team of the future, and you have started building it. You reach for systems as often as people. You can describe how a corporate legal team should be structured when technology sits at the center of how it works, what talent it needs, and what belongs with outside counsel. You use AI in your own work every day, and you want to shape the product as well as use it.

 2. You have taken a company public and run what came after. You were in-house, in a lead corporate or securities role, through an IPO. You then operated and scaled the function as a public company: periodic reporting, earnings, the proxy, Section 16, and Board and committee management.

 3. You are at ease with very fast scaling. New countries and entities, acquisitions and financings in parallel, a company that doubles while you are building. You keep the quality high and you do not become the bottleneck.

You also bring:

 - 9+ years of corporate and securities experience across a top law firm and a public technology company.

 - Experience leading M&A from term sheet through integration, and managing global entity structures.

 - A record of close collaboration with Finance. The finance leaders you have worked with would describe you as part of their team.

 - The presence to advise directors and executives, and the plain speech to make complex requirements usable.

 - A JD and active bar membership.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America.

 - Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

 - Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

jobs.title: Sr. Physical Design Flow & Methodology Engineer
jobs.description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

We’re looking for a Physical Design Flow & Methodology Engineer to help build the tools, flows and automation our physical design teams use to tape out high-performance ASICs and mixed-signal chips. You’ll write production Python, use AI and LLM-based tools to make our flows smarter and faster, and evaluate new EDA capabilities before they reach our implementation teams. You’ll also work with a team of world-class scientists and engineers on design problems that are new to the photonics industry. If you like writing code that makes other engineers more productive, and you want to shape how next-generation chips get built, we’d like to hear from you.

Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain and extend our physical design flows from synthesis through signoff (place-and-route, CTS, STA, power integrity, DRC/LVS), mostly in Python and TCL.

• Use AI and LLM-based tools to automate flow tasks such as report triage, debug, constraint checking, DRC/LVS analysis, run monitoring and QoR prediction.

• Research and prototype new flow capabilities, EDA tool features and methodologies, then turn the successful ones into production flows.

• Build tools for regression testing, QoR tracking and dashboards so flow changes are measurable and safe.

• Support the implementation teams by debugging flow problems, reproducing tool issues and working with EDA vendors on fixes.

• Run blocks through the flow as needed to validate methodology changes, including timing closure, ECOs and DRC/LVS cleanup.

• Write clear documentation and train the PD team on new flows and tools.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, plus at least 5 years of related industry experience.

• Has contributed to at least one ASIC or mixed-signal chip through tapeout.

• Solid understanding of the RTL-to-GDS flow, including synthesis, place-and-route, clock tree synthesis, static timing analysis and physical verification.

• Strong Python skills (maintainable, tested, version-controlled code) and working knowledge of TCL and shell scripting.

• Practical experience using AI coding assistants or LLM-based tools to automate engineering work, or a strong interest in learning to.

• Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work with PD, RTL, verification, CAD and photonics teams.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast-paced research-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree with at least 3 years of experience in physical design OR PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science

• Hands-on experience with Cadence tools (Genus, Innovus, Tempus, Voltus, Pegasus) and/or Siemens Calibre.

• Experience developing or owning a production PD flow, or contributing to CAD and methodology infrastructure.

• Familiarity with advanced process nodes (FinFET or newer).

• Experience with software engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, unit and regression testing, code review.

• Experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks or ML techniques applied to EDA problems.

• Experience with layout data formats and tools (GDS/OASIS, LEF/DEF, KLayout scripting).

• Interest in silicon photonics and in custom or photonic layout automation.

We offer competitive compensation. The base salary range for this role determined based on location, experience, educational background, and market data.

Salary Range: total compensation goes beyond base salary, it also includes a new hire equity grant, annual performance-based equity, and other rewards that recognize your impact and contribution.

$154,000—$175,000 USD

Benefits

• Retirement Savings Matching Program

• Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

• Generous Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)

• Paid Family Leave

• Short Term & Long Term Disability

• Training & Development

• Commuter Benefits

• Flexible, hybrid workplace model

• Equity grants (applicable to full-time employees)

jobs.title: Media Measurement Analyst
jobs.description:
Vestcom is seeking a Media Measurement Analyst to drive in-store media performance analytics across key retail accounts. In this role, you will design test-vs-control evaluations and use SQL to dig deep into underlying POS data to determine exactly why a campaign worked or underperformed.

You will act as the analytical engine supporting our Data Strategy & Insights (DSI) client-facing and internal sales teams—equipping them with the reporting, dashboards, and diagnostic insights they need to deliver client recommendations. As a Media Measurement Analyst, you will serve as the vital analytical engine for our Data Strategy & Insights (DSI) team, equipping our client-facing and internal sales teams with media performance measurement, comprehensive reporting, and diagnostic insights to fuel client strategies and future recommendations. This role is structured as a contract position of up to 40 hours per week with contract-to-hire potential, offering an hourly rate of $35.00 to $40.00 and a standard 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM schedule. The position is based in Cincinnati on a hybrid schedule of two days per week in the office, with fully remote arrangements considered for highly qualified applicants. This role does not offer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

• What this role IS: Hands-on SQL querying, executing test-vs-control (TvC) measurement, extracting POS data, and diagnosing the root causes behind campaign performance or designing optimal campaigns, to support internal stakeholders and clients; as well as general brand and category trends and insights.
• What this role IS NOT: Building predictive algorithms, machine learning modeling, data science modeling, architecture, engineering, machine learning, or platform design.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct test-vs-control performance analytics for in-store media programs across retail channels.
• Extract and analyze POS datasets using SQL to evaluate brand trends, determine campaign success factors, and optimize future media plans.
• Prepare results, dynamic reports, and dashboards to equip internal sales and client-facing DSI teams with clear, actionable insights.
• Support data integration initiatives, document technical requirements, and collaborate with technology and operations teams to improve analytical processes at scale.
• Translate complex quantitative findings clearly for internal technical and non-technical stakeholders across Vestcom’s solutions portfolio.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency with SQL for data extraction and querying, alongside experience in Tableau, Excel, and Google Workspace tools.
• Analytical Capability: Strong quantitative background with a proven ability to design TvC analyses, interpret performance metrics, and diagnose underlying data trends.
• Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner cross-functionally and effectively package insights for internal sales and client services teams.
• Time Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

Position Overview

We are looking for an analytical and practical Senior Financial Analyst to join the Harbinger FP&A team. You will be the finance business partner to our Logistics team, which covers material handling, warehouse management, third-party logistics (3PL) locations, receiving of all goods, outsourced manufacturing logistics, and shipment of finished goods. This team is scaling our warehouse and logistics network as Harbinger scales production.

You will sit on the leadership team of the business you support. You will own their financial plan, help leaders understand how their decisions show up in the numbers, and build the metrics that show whether we are getting more efficient as volume grows. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, likes working directly with operations and engineering teams, and wants to build something rather than maintain it.

Passion for our mission and vision is required.

What You'll Do:

• Own annual and multi-year financial planning (headcount, OPEX, and capital) for the Logistics team, including warehousing, material handling, receiving, and 3PL locations.

• Own the inbound and outbound freight forecast and month-end freight accruals, including spend by mode (truckload, LTL, and expedited) and tracking of premium and expedited freight.

• Build operating and financial metrics such as cost per part received, stored, and shipped, 3PL cost per unit, and finished goods freight cost per vehicle, and track how they change as volume grows.

• Build and track business cases for warehouse, material handling, and automation investments, including network expansion and in-house versus 3PL decisions, and track actual capital spend and returns against those cases.

• Measure 3PL, carrier, and outsourced manufacturing logistics costs and service performance against plan and contracted rates, and track realized savings.

• Partner with Logistics and Accounting so receiving, inventory in transit, inventory held at third-party locations, capitalized inbound freight, and finished goods shipping costs are accurately reflected in the financials, and help explain inventory adjustments at our warehouses and 3PL locations.

• Analyze and explain variances to plan and forecast, with a focus on drivers and actions the business can take.

• Create and present content for business reviews and finance reviews.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a STEM field

• 3-5+ years of financial analysis experience

• Advanced Excel skills, including building models with multiple inputs, constraints, and scenarios

• Experience with data mining using SQL

• Experience partnering directly with operations, supply chain, logistics, or engineering leaders

• Working knowledge of transportation modes and freight cost drivers

• Strong written communication and presentation skills

• Experience with logistics, freight, warehouse, or distribution finance, including unit cost and capacity modeling

• Experience with capital business cases for automation or facilities

• Experience with a transportation management system (TMS) or warehouse management system (WMS)

About Glia

Glia is the #1 Banking AI platform, empowering community and regional financial institutions to create efficiencies, accelerate loan growth, drive deposits, and deliver experiences that win against megabanks and fintechs.

Glia's Banking AI Operating System is a central intelligence layer on top of existing tech stacks, activating an AI workforce of specialized agents that draw from banking data, interaction history, and integrated systems of record. These banking-trained agents automate workflows across voice and digital–from front office to back office–resulting in decreased operational costs and the Universal Banker model.

Trusted by 700+ banks and credit unions for its ironclad security and reliability, Glia delivers the industry’s first contractual no-hallucination guarantee. It’s why Glia customers quickly and confidently put Banking AI to work with measurable results from day one. More information about Glia can be found at glia.com http://glia.com.



The Role

We’re looking for a Senior GRC Specialist to play a critical role in maintaining, enhancing, and scaling our control environment. This position is key to strengthening our security compliance posture, increasing customer trust, and enabling company growth.

You will operate as a senior member of the Information Security & Compliance team, owning compliance initiatives end-to-end, leading audits, and acting as a trusted partner to both internal teams and external stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

 - Own and lead compliance programs and audit processes (SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA/HITECH) from planning through successful completion.

 - Drive evidence collection, documentation, and audit readiness, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.

 - Act as a primary point of contact for external auditors, customers, and prospects on security and compliance matters.

 - Lead security discussions with enterprise customers, including deep-dive reviews and security questionnaires.

 - Oversee internal and external assessments across systems, services, and teams.

 - Own and evolve the Third-Party Risk Management program, managing and monitoring the security compliance of vendors and partners.

 - Maintain, enhance, and scale security controls and compliance processes across the organization.

 - Partner with engineering and product teams to translate compliance requirements into practical implementations.

 - Track and drive remediation efforts, ensuring accountability and timely resolution.

 - Produce and present audit and compliance reports to internal stakeholders and leadership.

 - Act as a strategic advisor by promoting security awareness and staying ahead of evolving regulatory and compliance trends.

Requirements

 - 6+ years of experience in Information Security, Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC), Audit, or Risk Management.

 - Strong hands-on experience with frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA/HITECH.

 - Proven experience owning and leading audits and compliance initiatives.

 - Experience working with cloud-based and distributed systems (preferably AWS).

 - Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.

 - Ability to translate complex security and compliance concepts into clear documentation and business-friendly language.

 - Strong communication skills with experience engaging both technical teams and external stakeholders.

 - High level of curiosity, adaptability, and proactive ownership in navigating evolving security challenges.

 - Excellent written and spoken English.

Strongly Preferred

 - Hands-on experience with ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System).

 - One or more relevant certifications: CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor, or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with ISO/IEC 27001 implementation.

Glia is an equal-opportunity employer. Glia does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASATA

Basata is an AI-powered platform transforming how specialty healthcare organizations operate. Its AI agents automate complex administrative and clinical workflows, from patient calls and referral management to scheduling and medical records. By integrating with existing EHRs and practice systems, Basata helps organizations reduce administrative burden, improve operational efficiency, and expand capacity for patient care.

We are hiring our first Marketing Engineer.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Preferred Locations: Arizona or California

Open to remote with travel to HQ for the right candidate.



This role focuses on two areas: driving measurable revenue through SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization), and website conversion, and building AI-powered workflows that make the whole marketing department faster, starting with events and webinars.

You recommend the strategy, own it once the VP of Marketing approves it, and ship the pages, schema, experiments, and automations yourself.

You'll be measured on a qualified pipeline from organic and website channels.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Drive revenue through SEO, AEO, and website conversion

 - Own Basata's organic strategy end to end: keyword research, site architecture, technical SEO, and useful programmatic pages (by specialty, use case, EMR, and integration), built around what our buyers search for.

 - Build our AEO program so the major AI answer engines cite and recommend Basata. Track prompt sets and citation share, act on the results, and earn mentions where citations originate, such as healthcare review sites, directories, communities, and industry press.

 - Write the copy for website, landing, and SEO pages, and run it through content optimization and AI-visibility tools. Implement structured data (JSON-LD), semantic HTML, internal linking, and page-speed improvements directly on the site.

 - Run a steady program of conversion experiments on landing pages, forms, demo flows, and calls to action to lift visit-to-opportunity conversion.

 - Own HubSpot lead capture, routing, and attribution for organic and website leads, plus the dashboards that tie rankings, AI visibility, traffic, and conversion to sales-accepted pipeline.

2. Build AI-powered marketing workflows

 - Map how the marketing team works today, find the manual steps, and replace them with agents and automations the team uses every day. Build with LLM APIs, MCP, and automation tools, with evals and guardrails for accurate, on-brand output.

 - Start with events and webinars: automate pre-event research and outreach, registration and follow-up sequences, attendee enrichment, session recaps, and the handoff of event leads to sales.

 - Build a workflow that turns webinar and event content into blog posts, social posts, emails, and AEO-ready pages, with human review before anything is published.

 - Document each workflow, page template, and experiment as you build it, and train the team to run and extend it on their own.

 - Help set marketing's AI standards and tool choices, with extra care for accuracy and compliance in healthcare.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5 years in B2B SEO, growth marketing, web or marketing operations, or growth engineering, including owning an SEO or website program and a track record of organic or website-sourced pipeline.

 - Hands-on technical SEO (crawling and indexing, site architecture, structured data and JSON-LD, Core Web Vitals) and working knowledge of how LLMs retrieve and cite sources. Experience with AI-visibility tools such as Profound, Peec AI, or Scrunch.

 - Strong writing skills, with content credible to physicians and practice administrators, and experience running website conversion experiments.

 - Fluency with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, HubSpot, and a modern CMS such as Webflow or WordPress, plus comfort editing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

 - Experience building AI agents or automations that a team uses every day, and daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

Nice to have

 - Experience marketing to healthcare providers, or in another regulated category.

 - Python or SQL to pull and analyze your own data.

 - Experience automating event and webinar marketing.

 - Early-stage startup experience as the first or only person in a function.




WHY JOIN BASATA?

 - Drive real impact. Your work helps clinics run more smoothly and gets patients care faster, with fewer headaches.

 - Shape something meaningful. You'll play a real role in both the systems and the experience, not just execute someone else's design.

 - High ownership. We trust you to lead, build, and bring ideas to life.

 - Work with purpose. We're solving real problems in healthcare with tools people rely on every day.


OUR CORE VALUES

 - Find a way: We own outcomes — no excuses, no shortcuts. Whatever the challenge, we find a way.

 - Dream big: We refuse to accept that healthcare has to be broken, and we act deliberately to build a better version of it.

 - Obsess over the customer: Every decision starts with empathy for the people we serve — without compromising ethics, privacy, or trust.

 - Always be learning: We're relentless about growth — our own and each other's — because it makes us better teammates and leaders.

 - Move fast, deliver excellence: Speed unlocks momentum, but only paired with precision. We test, ship, and iterate quickly, and hold a high bar.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead
jobs.description:
You'll build the engine that fills Comfy's enterprise pipeline.

Comfy is the most powerful workflow engine for visual AI, used by 4 million people and a growing list of studios, agencies and brands. A few months ago we started selling Comfy Enterprise, and it's working. Today, most of our enterprise pipeline comes in on its own from the community. To grow the business many times over in 2027, that won't be enough.

As our Demand Generation Lead, you'll change that. You'll own enterprise pipeline from first touch to qualified meeting: turning our massive community and site traffic into enterprise leads, and reaching the studios, game companies, agencies and brands who haven't found us yet.

This is a 0→1 role and our first dedicated demand gen hire. You won't inherit a funnel, a scoring model or a campaign calendar. You'll build them, working closely with our Enterprise sales team, product marketing, community and growth. You'll stay hands-on: launching the campaigns, running the programs and wiring up the systems yourself, with AI doing as much of the heavy lifting as possible.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own enterprise pipeline: Set the pipeline targets with sales, and be accountable for the meetings and qualified opportunities marketing creates each quarter.

 - Turn the community into customers: Find the enterprise teams already using ComfyUI, Comfy Cloud and the API, and build the signals, routing and programs that move them to a sales conversation.

 - Run account-based programs: Build target account lists with sales across film, VFX, games, advertising and brands, and run multi-channel plays that open doors at those accounts.

 - Build the funnel and the stack: Own lead capture, scoring, routing and attribution in HubSpot, and use AI tools for research, enrichment and personalized outreach so a small team covers a lot of accounts.

 - Make events and field marketing count: Turn NAB, SIGGRAPH, GDC, Cannes Lions, exec dinners and our own community events into pipeline, not just badge scans.

 - Run paid and content programs that convert: Test paid, webinars, workflow demos and customer stories, keep what drives pipeline and cut what doesn't.

 - Report what's working: Own the numbers from first touch to closed revenue, and share them openly with sales and leadership every week.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 6+ years in demand generation or growth marketing, including owning enterprise pipeline targets at a B2B SaaS, developer-tools or AI company, with results to show.

 - Have built demand gen 0→1: a funnel, a lead scoring model or an ABM program from a blank page.

 - Have turned a product-led or community-led user base into enterprise pipeline.

 - Are deeply data-literate and comfortable running HubSpot (or Salesforce), attribution and funnel reporting yourself.

 - Are an early adopter of AI in marketing: you already use AI tools for research, enrichment, outreach and content, and want to build a lean, automated function.

 - Stay hands-on: you'd rather launch the campaign than manage an agency doing it.

 - Operate from first principles with high agency and low ego.

 - Are SF-based or willing to relocate to join our in-person team.


BONUS IF YOU HAVE

 - Marketed an open-source or open-core product, and know how to grow a business without losing the community.

 - Sold or marketed into the creative industry: film and TV, VFX, animation, games, advertising or agencies.

 - Experience at an AI or developer platform company (APIs, model platforms, creative AI tools).

 - Used Comfy or have real familiarity with AI creative tools.


COMPENSATION

 - Base salary: $ 200k-$280K

 - Equity: + meaningful equity

 - Plus benefits and relocation support for SF.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician - South Florida
jobs.description:
At PEARCE, we've got a career for you!

Pearce is a leading technology-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce-services.com.

Your Impact

We are searching for a skilled and motivated EV Charging Field Service Technician. This key role is responsible for the onsite repair and maintenance of EV charging stations in a specific geographic region, including but not limited to site safety, electrical system maintenance/repair, field service reports, and other duties as required to properly maintain and operate the site within the contractual requirements. This role must be able to work independently with little to no supervision and will be required to work in the field under various conditions. The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work and is accountable for the performance and condition of the equipment they service. They are continually looking to develop their technical skills, learn new technologies, and improve their ability to support our customers and field operations. Electrical expertise, relevant certifications, and prior EVSE experience are valued and will be considered when determining the level of responsibility and technical work assigned to the technician.

Core Responsibilities

• Perform OEM testing, troubleshooting, repairs, upgrades/revisions, and preventive/corrective maintenance across a broad range of EV charging equipment, ranging from Level 2 EV chargers to DC Fast Chargers.

• Perform electrical and equipment testing, including but not limited to insulation testing (megger testing), thermal imaging, torque testing, performance evaluations, and other diagnostic testing as required.

• Troubleshoot EV charging system performance issues, identify and isolate faults, including ground faults, and determine appropriate corrective actions.

• Review and interpret site manuals, electrical drawings, and OEM documentation to properly service and maintain equipment and complete work safely and effectively.

• Take ownership of assigned work from regional scheduling through completion, including completing accurate field reports and work orders, documenting site conditions and issues, and ensuring identified deficiencies are communicated and addressed in a timely manner.

• Conduct site safety assessments and identify safety hazards on the job site, properly generate and complete JHA, Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO), and other safety-related documentation in accordance with OSHA and site-specific requirements.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Specific duties may vary or evolve over time based on business and client needs.

Core Experience

• Electrical – Certified Electrician (Journeyman level) from a relevant state is preferred but not required, except where required by applicable state or local regulations.

• 2+ years’ equivalent experience in EVSE field service, servicing electrical power equipment in the commercial or utility energy field, and/or formal electrical training.

• Strong electrical, electronic, and mechanical troubleshooting skills.

• Technical knowledge of Electric Vehicle (EV) chargers, solar power installations, or other applicable power electronics is preferred, but not required.

• Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to generate, track, and complete site work requirements.

• Strong Microsoft Office skills.

• Ability to analyze and resolve problems independently with a high level of results orientation.

• Must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking, and understanding English to safely perform job duties, interpret technical instructions, and communicate effectively with team members and customers. Interpreter services are not available for this position.

• Relevant EVSE field service experience, electrical experience, technical certifications, formal electrical training, and demonstrated technical proficiency will be considered when evaluating candidates and determining compensation.

• Candidates must meet all applicable state and local licensing requirements for the work they will perform.

What You'll Receive

• Industry-leading OEM and EVSE training from certified Pearce trainers at multiple locations across the U.S., complemented by comprehensive on-the-job training.

• Typical schedule consists of approximately 10-hour workdays.

• Paid port-to-port, including travel time between job sites.

• Company vehicles are provided for all work-related transportation.

• All tools, equipment, and personal protective equipment (PPE) are supplied by the company.

• Comprehensive on-the-job training provided.

• Opportunity for paid overtime when applicable.

• $100 bonus for each after-hours service call, including emergency calls.

Physical/Work Environment

• This role requires working in all elements, depending on job location, time of year, heat, cold, rain & snow (depending on geographic region for the role).

• Working around high voltages and currents.

• Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), including but not limited to a hard hat and safety glasses, as required by company and site-specific safety requirements.

• Repetitive use of legs, arms, hands, and fingers.

At Pearce, we are committed to fair and transparent pay practices.  Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

In addition to wages, employees may also be eligible for performance and referral bonuses, production incentives, tool/equipment and fuel stipends, company vehicle, per diem or other applicable compensation.  We also offer all full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package including health and life insurance, 401k with employer match, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and professional development courses.

This pay range reflects our commitment to pay equity and compliance with state and federal pay transparency laws. If you have questions about compensation, we encourage open discussions during the hiring process.

Base Pay Range

$23—$40 USD

What We Offer

Pearce offers a family-friendly and innovative culture with opportunities for growth, competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, HSA option. To help you recharge, we have paid vacation and paid holidays. For your future, we offer a company-matching 401(k) Retirement, Life Insurance, Tuition reimbursement, and professional development training.  To help you be successful at work, as required for the role, we will provide a company vehicle, phone, laptop, or tablet along with all necessary tools and safety equipment.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Learn more about us at www.Pearce-Services.com!

jobs.title: Clinical Care Reviewer
jobs.description:
At Rula, we are a remote-first company that believes mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms.

We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well-being. 

We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Clinical Care Reviewer to help bring Rula’s care efficiency pilots to life as part of our Clinical Quality team. In this role, you’ll work directly with providers across our network, coaching them 1:1, leading consultation and education groups, and responding to their questions by email, to support efficient, effective, and clinically appropriate care. You’ll also support Continued Care Review work as needed, reviewing charts and treatment progress to guide next steps in care. Because you’re closest to the provider experience, your observations about what’s working and what isn’t will directly shape how Rula’s pilots are refined. This role is ideal for a licensed clinician who enjoys working with other clinicians, communicates clearly in writing, and wants to help improve care at both the individual and population level.

Required Qualifications

 - Master’s degree and active, unencumbered clinical license (LCSW, LMFT, LPC, or equivalent) and 3+ years of post-licensure experience in behavioral health

 - Experience reviewing clinical documentation and applying medical necessity criteria, with a strong understanding of behavioral health treatment planning, progression, and appropriate episode duration

 - Experience coaching, training, supervising, or giving feedback to clinicians, including facilitating consultation or education groups

 - Excellent written communication, including the ability to respond to clinician emails clearly, respectfully, and efficiently

 - Comfort working with EHRs and digital tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Salesforce)

Preferred Qualifications

While having the preferred qualifications enhances your candidacy, having all of them is not mandatory. We encourage all interested applicants to apply, even those who may not meet every preferred requirement.

 - Experience in utilization management, peer review, or clinical quality roles

 - Familiarity working with or for health plans, managed care organizations, or value-based care programs (e.g., Kaiser Permanente)

 - 1+ year experience in high growth startup environment

 - Experience with measurement-informed care and comfort working with data (e.g., outcome measures, utilization trends) to inform clinical decisions and provider coaching

 - Experience carrying out new programs, pilots, or initiatives in an evolving environment, and sharing structured feedback to improve them

 - Experience using, or openness to using, AI tools to improve efficiency and support clinical review and provider communication workflows

 - MST and PST timezones are preferred

We're serious about your well-being! As part of our team, full-time employees receive:

 - 100% remote work environment: Working hours to support a healthy work-life balance, ensuring you can meet both professional and personal commitments (must be based in United States, currently not hiring in Hawaii)

 - Attractive pay and benefits: Full transparency of pay ranges regardless of where you live in the United States

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and FSA/HSA

 - 401(k) plan access: Start saving for your future

 - Generous time-off policies: Including 2 company-wide shutdown weeks each year for self-care (for most employees)

 - Paid parental leave: Available for all parents, including birthing, non-birthing, adopting, and fostering

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Supporting your mental and physical health

 - Quarterly department stipend: Fun team-building activities or in-person gatherings

 - Community and employee resource groups: Participate in groups that celebrate employee identity and lived experiences, fostering a sense of community and belonging for all

 - Home office stipend: New hire home office stipend & $50 monthly stipend to help cover internet or cell phone expenses

 - Wellness at Rula program: Year-round wellness initiatives and a $50/month wellness stipend

Our team

We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our mission of making mental healthcare work for everyone.  We are dedicated to having a culture of inclusion that will support our employees in feeling safe, seen, heard, and valued.

jobs.title: Director, Accounting
jobs.description:
About the Position

Golden State is looking for a strategic and operationally minded Director to uphold the financial integrity and reporting accuracy of three of the company’s primary business units: Arena, Events, and Retail Real Estate Portfolio. This is a high-impact leadership role that requires navigating complex revenue and real estate transactions, event-based settlement processes, and large-scale facility management accounting.

Beyond managing the day-to-day accounting functions, you will act as a strategic partner to senior leadership, providing financial insights that drive business decisions. Additionally, you will be responsible for maintaining a robust internal control environment, managing the external audit relationships, and leading a professional accounting staff. The position reports to the Controller.

Come share your expertise while learning more about this growing sports and entertainment organization that values your initiative and dedication!

This is a full-time position based onsite in San Francisco, CA.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and develop team members responsible for general accounting functions – revenue, leases, GL, and reporting.

• Serve as the subject matter expert for revenue and lease accounting related to Arena products and real estate portfolio.

• Lead the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes across all three business units.

• Ensure all financial statements are compliant with GAAP and internal policies.

• Manage fixed assets accounting for existing arena and retail spaces; and construction/build-out of future retail spaces.

• Maintain a rigorous fixed asset ledger for the arena, managing depreciation schedules and tracking the lifecycle of large-scale facility equipment.

• Manage the recognition of multi-year sponsorship and suite revenue, ensuring alignment with ASC 606.

• Oversee the accounting for retail spaces ensuring timely and accurate CAM reconciliations, lease administration, and responses to tenant revenue audits.

• Direct the end-to-end settlement process for concerts and other events. Ensure accurate distribution of funds between the venue, promoters, and talent based on complex contractual split arrangements.

• Partner closely with Arena Operations teams to timely and accurately account for capital & maintenance projects.

• Author and oversee the research and drafting of comprehensive technical accounting memos for complex transactions and non-recurring events.

• Drive continuous improvement in the Record-to-Report cycle, ensuring scalable processes and robust internal controls.

• Design, implement, and maintain a strong system of internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure financial data integrity.

• Support internal and external audit requests by ensuring team provides timely and accurate documentation and explanations.

• Other duties as assigned

Required Experience & Skills

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Accounting, or equivalent work experience

• Certified Professional Accountant (CPA) certification

• A minimum of 10 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. A mix of public accounting and corporate experience is preferred.

• Deep expertise in US GAAP, specifically ASC 606 and ASC 842.

• Proven experience leading process improvement, control design, and/or system implementation projects in a high-volume transactional environment.

• Commercial real estate accounting experience is a plus.

• Experience with major ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and financial reporting software, and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Experience in a SOX environment preferred.

• Ability to mentor and develop a diverse team of accounting professions.

• Strong executive presence with the ability to explain complex accounting concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

• Exceptional problem-solving skills with a focus on data driven decision making.

• Ability to thrive and lead teams through change in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation

• $175,000 - $185,000 Per Year + Bonus

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision benefits for employees and dependents

• Employer 401K match

• Vacation, Summer Half-Day Fridays and a generous paid time off plan for pregnancy and parental leaves

• Warriors home tickets, team store discount and more!

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Golden State is an equal opportunity employer.

We will ensure that qualified applicants with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Want to learn more about who we are and what we value? Visit www.warriors.com/employment

Please refer to our California Privacy Notice for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Clear Capital is building the future of real estate data. Our goal is knowing more about a property than anybody else and in the process, making home ownership valuations more fair and equitable for millions of people.Every project our data team works on ships as a product or directly supports one that does. We are not a reporting team, our work moves Clear Capital's revenue.
As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the data pipelines and platforms behind our data & analytics products. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About the role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

Within Netskope Engineering, the Netskope AI Labs is responsible for advancing state-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technology to power the Netskope Intelligent Security Service Edge (SSE) security platform. Leveraging our expertise in AI/ML and security, we are developing large-scale AI/ML solutions for SSE. For example, we are integrating the latest AI/ML technology into our data security and threat protection features, as well as business operations.

What’s in it for you

We are looking for a talented and motivated machine learning scientist to join our team. A successful candidate has deep technical expertise in applying AI/ML technologies in security applications and/or adjacent domains, and must be passionate about cloud security and AI security. You will have the opportunity to work with a team of talented engineers, researchers, and machine learning engineers to solve the most challenging cloud security problems today.

What you will be doing

• Identify strong AI/ML use cases in AI security, data security, and adjacent domains, leveraging Netskope’s rich set of data sources

• Define scalable data acquisition and labeling strategy for specific use cases

• Work with data engineers to retrieve, clean, and normalize data and ensure a scalable and continuous high-quality data stream

• Work closely with threat research and development teams in feature engineering, making sure high-quality feature sets are chosen in a systematic way

• Develop ML models for defined use cases and implement KPIs to ensure optimal algorithms and results

• Conduct strict internal testing to ensure high efficacy, low false positive and false negative rate

• Interpret results and communicate findings

• Document use case, data acquisition, feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, future improvement opportunity, and other important aspects

• Work closely with development and QE teams in productization

• Be an evangelist of AI/ML within Netskope and promote AI/ML wherever applicable, beyond security use cases

• Staying up-to-date with the latest developments in AI/ML such as large language models (LLM)

Required skills and experience

• Must have a true startup spirit and be willing to wear multiple hats and deliver end-to-end solutions

• 8+ years of industry experience in developing AI/ML models, preferably on security products or services

• Hands-on experience with relevant technology stacks such as CUDA, Python, Tensorflow, LLM, etc.

• Hands-on experience using modern big data pipelines and cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

• Natural language process (NLP) and data mining experience highly desirable

• Energetic self-starter with the desire to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to influence without authority

Education

• Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree

#LI-SD1

Compensation:

At Netskope, salary is one component of our competitive total rewards package. The salary range for this position is as listed below. This is a national range. jobs.title: 1191 - Scheduler
jobs.description:
We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm

Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

We need an English-fluent Scheduler, based in Latin America, available to work remotely.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.

Are you the one we are looking for?

Responsibilities:

• Create, assign, and manage all client visits in WellSky, including Start of Care (SOC), Recertification, Resumption of Care (ROC), Follow-Up, and Routine visits.
• Build and maintain accurate visit schedules for skilled nursing (RN/LPN), therapy (PT, OT, SLP), and aide staff.
• Enter and update visit authorizations based on payer source, including Medicare, Medicaid, private pay, and managed care plans.
• Process physician orders tied to visit frequency and duration within WellSky.
• Monitor the scheduling dashboard daily for unscheduled, missed, or conflicting visits.
• Coordinate with the clinical team to ensure visit frequency aligns with the Plan of Care (485).
• Match field clinicians and aides to clients based on availability, geographic location, skill set, and payer requirements.
• Maintain staff availability calendars, including PTO, call-outs, and schedule changes.
• Communicate schedule changes to clinicians, aides, and supervisors in a prompt and professional manner.
• Identify and fill coverage gaps to prevent missed visits and care disruptions.
• Maintain accurate employee profiles in WellSky, including credentials and authorized service types.
• Verify and track visit authorizations for all payers prior to scheduling any visit.
• Alert the billing and intake teams of authorization changes, expirations, or denials in a timely manner.
• Ensure all visits are scheduled within authorized units, service codes, and effective dates.
• Flag potential compliance issues including overlapping visits, duplicate billing risks, or frequency discrepancies.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for scheduling inquiries from clinicians, clients, and family members.
• Communicate daily with the clinical supervisor regarding visit coverage, staffing needs, and patient care priorities.
• Escalate urgent or clinical concerns to the appropriate supervisor immediately and without delay.
• Participate in daily or weekly scheduling huddles and interdisciplinary team meetings as required.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date visit records in WellSky at all times.
• Run and review scheduling reports — including missed visits, visit utilization, and authorization utilization — and distribute findings to supervisors.
• Support the billing team by ensuring visit documentation is complete, accurate, and submitted in a timely manner.
• Assist with internal audits, external reviews, and compliance activities as needed.

Requirements:

• High school diploma or GED required.
• Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
• 1+ years of experience as a Scheduler.
• 1 - 2 years of scheduling experience in a home health, hospice, or healthcare setting preferred.
• Prior experience with WellSky (formerly Kinnser) strongly preferred.
• Experience with managed care authorization processes preferred.
• Proficient in the WellSky EMR and scheduling platform.
• Strong organizational skills with the demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills across clinical and administrative settings.
• Ability to problem-solve quickly and adapt effectively to rapidly changing schedules and priorities.
• High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record maintenance.
• Familiarity with home health regulations, payer requirements, and visit compliance standards.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

It's a plus:

• Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Prior experience with WellSky (formerly Kinnser).
• Experience with managed care authorization processes.

Compensation:

• The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $1,000 - $1,500 per month, depending on seniority and skillset.
• This is a 40 hours per week.
• This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform.
• The talent will work remotely allocated at our client.

Here are the steps for this process:

Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding.

Once you apply for the job, our team will review your resume. If it meets the requirements, we will contact you and move forward in the process.

Note for Candidates Approached Directly:
If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting.

Thank you!

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst – Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

Position Overview

We are looking for an analytical Senior Financial Analyst to join the Harbinger FP&A team as the finance business partner to our Operations and Supply Chain organization. This team runs Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) for Harbinger.

Harbinger is scaling production of our commercial electric vehicles. Operations will own the material budget and FP&A will own tracking and reporting on those costs. You will be the finance subject matter expert in S&OP and MRP across Harbinger Finance. You will help standardize how we forecast materials with our operating teams, and use planning data to explain how on-time delivery and changes to plan affect our financial results. You will also help us understand and manage the cost of our global supplier base, including landed cost, tariffs, and currency exposure.

Passion for our mission and vision is required.

What You'll Do:

• Serve as finance business partner to the Operations and Supply Chain leadership team, including financial planning for headcount and OPEX.

• Become the finance subject matter expert in S&OP and MRP. Understand how demand, supply, and lead times flow through the system and into the financial forecast.

• Lead a standard materials forecasting method with operating teams, including how committed, planned, and not-yet-planned demand are estimated and time phased.

• Analyze direct material spend by supplier, commodity, and region, and support sourcing decisions with should-cost models, quote comparisons, and business cases for second sources or make-vs-buy.

• Model and report the landed cost of parts, including tariffs, duties, and inbound freight (partnering with the Logistics finance analyst), and show how trade and tariff changes affect cost of goods sold.

• Track purchase price variance against standard cost and measure progress on supplier cost-reduction targets.

• Develop trackable ways to reflect supplier delivery performance in the forecast, and measure forecast accuracy over time.

• Identify supplier risk, including foreign currency exposure, single-source dependencies, and supplier financial health.

• Build inventory reporting, including inventory levels, excess and obsolete, scrap, and shortages.

• Partner with Procurement and Treasury on supplier payment terms and inventory days, and how both affect cash.

• Partner with Accounting so inventory costing and cost allocation stay compliant with GAAP and audit requirements.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a STEM field

• 3-5+ years of financial analysis experience

• Experience with materials or inventory forecasting, S&OP, or MRP in a manufacturing environment

• Experience supporting procurement or direct materials sourcing, including supplier quote analysis or should-cost modeling

• Advanced Excel skills, including large data sets and scenario modeling

• Experience with data mining using SQL and with ERP data

• Strong written communication and presentation skills, including explaining complex data to non-finance partners

Preferred Qualifications:

• MBA or Master's degree in a related field

• Experience with NetSuite, Coupa, or another ERP migration

• Experience with procurement analytics in Coupa or a similar tool

• Experience with inventory accounting, excess and obsolete reserves, or standard costing

• Familiarity with landed cost, tariffs, customs, or foreign currency in a global supply base

• Familiarity with public company reporting and SOX controls

• Experience in high-rate manufacturing, automotive, EV, or industrial companies

Key Benefits & Perks:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered

• Early-stage Stock Options

• Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave

• Annual Vacation Bonus

• Wellness & Fertility Benefits

• Cell Phone Stipend

• Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens

California Pay Range

$100,000—$120,000 USD

Equal Opportunity

Harbinger is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com.

Candidate Data Privacy

Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Harbinger may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our HR, legal, and finance teams, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Harbinger affiliates; and (iii) Harbinger’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

jobs.description:

This platform has recently gone live and management of its stabilization and backlog will be key to its critical ongoing success. The Director will lead the Finance IT Team, oversee system project implementations and enhancements, system configuration, integrations, managing vendor relationships, compliance and driving continuous improvement, and initiatives that support business growth and operational excellence, while keeping team motivated and engaged.

• Lead administration, configuration, enhancement, and support of the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financial platform

Continuous Improvement

Leadership & Team Development

• Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing IT managers, analysts, and technical professionals.

What We’re Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Business Administration, Human Resources Information Systems, or a related field
• Master’s Degree preferred; MBA strongly desired
• 10+ years of progressive IT experience supporting enterprise, large-scale Finance systems.
• 7+ years of leadership experience managing in-house technical teams and enterprise applications.

• Strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities and business acumen

• Demonstrated executive presence with C-suite

• Strong project management, stakeholder management, and executive presence and communication skills.
• Internal candidates to be considered based on experience relative to the position

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Beware of recruiting scams: Mattel will only contact you through official @mattel.com or @smartrecruiters.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran and protected veteran status, disability status, and or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act, qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

The pay range for this position is between $192,000 and $240,000 annual. The pay range is indicative of projected hiring range, however base pay will be determined based on a candidate’s work location, skills and experience.
