jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Electromagnetic Warfare
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our Electromagnetic Warfare team. The EW Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.

As a Manufacturing Engineer within EW, you will be responsible for driving process improvements, ensuring the highest quality of production, and supporting the development and implementation of new products. You will play a crucial role in optimizing manufacturing processes, reducing costs, and increasing efficiencies on existing technologies while also developing new products and scaling to full scale production.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain that includes Assembly, Integration & Test (AI&T) for electro-mechanical assemblies

• Contribute to operational excellence with a strong continuous improvement mindset and leading impactful Kaizen events

• Be a strong partner with Product Quality Engineering to drive and support RCCA burndowns that tackle key issues both internally and externally to EW Production

• Collaborate with Design Engineering teams in early to late phases of the development process to provide DFx for smooth NPI transitions

• Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes

• Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.

• Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, harnesses, Electrical COTS/MOTS, antennas, radios, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production

• Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware

• Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree in a technical field preferred such as engineering, math, or a hard science

• 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware

• Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Demonstrated ability to contribute to the delivery of electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Experience with Harness or PCBA design review

• Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (soldering, SMT, harnessing, box assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

• Prior experience working with JIRA, Siemens NX, Teamcenter (PLM), or Oracle (ERP) or equivalents

• A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with RF Products that require system AI&T (assembly, integration, and test)

• Exposure to or interest in scaling product testing and production.

• Hands-on experience with software & firmware flashing or end-of-line testing & troubleshooting

• Software scripting experience in any language

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
From autonomous uncrewed defense systems to next-generation avionics and integrated battle management systems, RTI’s software powers the world’s most demanding real-time platforms. We are looking for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of distributed architecture, deep-dive systems debugging, and direct customer engagement.

As a key member of our Professional Services team, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to leading Aerospace & Defense engineering teams. You will tackle complex distributed systems challenges, optimize microsecond-level deterministic data flows, and ensure mission-critical software performs reliably when failure is not an option.

Learn more about the journey of an Application Engineer here!

✨ What You’ll Do / Responsibilities

• Work directly with customer engineers to design and prototype distributed systems using RTI Connext.

• Debug network, performance, and concurrency bugs across customer codebases and embedded environments.

• Review customer architecture, configuration, and code to catch bottlenecks before deployment.

• Build working proof-of-concept demos and code examples for customer-specific use cases.

• Run technical training sessions and deep-dive design reviews, both remotely and on-site at customer facilities.

• Pass field insights, edge cases, and feature requests directly back to our internal teams.

🎯 What We’re Looking For / Requirements

• 7-10+ years of software engineering or technical customer-facing engineering experience, with a degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical background.

• Solid development and debugging skills in C and C++.

• Strong working knowledge of Linux, sockets, and network protocols (UDP, TCP, multicast).

• Comfortable using tools like Wireshark and GDB to track down packet loss, latency spikes, or thread deadlocks.

• Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly to other engineers and project leads.

• Willing and able to travel 20–35% to customer sites.

• US Citizenship required*

• *Due to applicable laws, government regulations and contract specifications, we are required to fill this position only with an individual who qualifies as a "U.S. Citizen."

💎 Nice To Have / Preferred Skills

• Prior experience with RTI Connext, DDS, ROS 2, or message brokers like Kafka and MQTT.

• Experience working on defense platforms, avionics, radar, or robotics.

• Familiarity with MOSA open architecture standards (such as FACE or SOSA).

• Experience using AI developer tools (like GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT) to speed up coding, debugging, and prototyping.

• Experience with Java, C#, or Python.

• Experience with RTOS like VxWorks or QNX.

• An active U.S. security clearance.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At RTI, we are dedicated to building a fair and inclusive workplace so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t perfectly align with all qualifications in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway – especially if you have strong systems programming fundamentals, understand networking, and enjoy working directly with people! You may be just the right candidate for this or another one of our open roles. Learn more about our commitment to our workforce, here!

🌟 What We Offer You

• Flexible working schedule

• Remote working + Home Office Stipend to cover the costs of working from home

• Flexible Paid Time Off + “Real Vacation Bonus,” an additional bonus for taking more than 1-week of uninterrupted vacation

• Annual bonus based on individual and company performance + other prizes and awards

• We recognize employees for their achievements, offer great opportunities for career growth and development, and provide the tools they need to succeed

💙 How is life at RTI

• We have been certified as a Great Place to Work for seven consecutive years both in Spain and the US. In addition, we were listed as one of the Best Companies for Women to Advance.

• We live and work by our core values, which emphasize excellence, teamwork, and reaching your potential. Our motto is “Enjoy the journey,” above all we must enjoy what we do and have fun at work. At RTI, you will work in a positive, supportive, diverse environment with a team that truly cares about you.

• We are defined by our “Working as One” culture and truly care about team’s interaction. That is why we plan trips for teams to get together in person, enjoy fun team-building activities and events, and feel more connected.

🌍 What We Do

Real-Time Innovations (RTI) is the data-streaming company for intelligent distributed systems. RTI Connext® software is the critical nervous system for over 2,000 designs across Aerospace and Defense, MedTech, Automotive, and Robotics. Connext is the only real-time data streaming platform that can both control demanding physical systems and integrate them with cloud applications. RTI helps organizations develop, deploy, and scale intelligence and physical AI from edge to cloud, faster. RTI Runs a Smarter World™. Learn more at www.rti.com.

RTI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.title: Territory Manager (Manawatu-Whanganui)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Farmers with Halter are writing the playbook for a world-first farming system, they are paving a new way of managing their land and animals, and in doing so, are unlocking more productive and sustainable uses of the world's agricultural land along with driving optimal profitability outcomes.

We've more recently launched into the Beef Market! This is an opportunity to build a new market from the bottom up. The Beef industry has not had a disruptive and influential product in years and this is your chance to make a huge impact.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is based in the Manawatu-Whanganui region. Applicants must live within the region. Travel is required to meet with farmers daily.



WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR

 - Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You will be a high-performing value-based salesperson, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

 - Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

 - Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

 - Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

 - Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 


OUR BENEFITS

 - Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

 - We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

 - Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

 - Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.
   
   


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Product Lead, T:0 (Agentic) Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU’LL MAKE IMPACT

T:0 https://t0.ai is building an AI-native accounting platform that helps businesses close the books, reconcile, report, and operate with greater speed and confidence. You’ll own the product direction for T:0’s agentic finance experience, turning real customer pain into a clear roadmap and shipped outcomes.

 - Define how AI-native accounting can help businesses close the books, reconcile, report, and operate with greater speed and confidence.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers, creating a culture of ownership, product quality, customer focus, and continuous learning.

 - Lead product discovery and delivery across engineering, design, data, finance, compliance, and commercial teams.

 - Translate complex accounting and financial workflows into simple, trusted experiences, balancing AI innovation with deterministic controls, auditability, and accuracy.

 - Build from first principles in an early-stage environment, using customer insight, product data, and rapid iteration to shape a category that is still being defined.

 - Own product outcomes from discovery through delivery, using qualitative and quantitative signals to test assumptions and iterate quickly.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 8 + years experience leading product strategy and delivery for complex B2B, fintech, accounting, financial infrastructure, or AI products.

 - A track record of taking ambiguous problems from discovery through launch, with clear ownership of product outcomes.

 - Strong understanding of financial, accounting, or operational workflows and the customer problems they create.

 - Experience working closely with engineering and design to build and ship high-quality products.

 - Strong product judgment, with the ability to balance customer value, technical constraints, business priorities, risk, and regulatory considerations.

 - Clear, direct communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across functions.

 - Comfort using qualitative and quantitative signals to make decisions, test assumptions, and iterate quickly.

Preferred

 - Experience building AI-native products, intelligent workflows, automation, or agentic systems.

 - Experience with accounting software, financial operations, enterprise SaaS, or products serving finance teams.

 - Experience working in an early-stage or zero-to-one product environment.

 - Familiarity with the challenges of applying probabilistic AI to workflows that require accuracy, controls, and auditability.

 - Experience working in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry.


YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You're not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

 - You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

 - You ask "why" before jumping to "how."


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

T:0's mission is to make finance run itself. We're building an AI-native accounting platform that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so founders can stop managing their finances and start using them to run the business. The hard part isn't adding AI to accounting. It's making AI you can trust with the books. We use AI to understand how a business works, then run the actual accounting on strict, checkable rules, and no black box deciding the numbers. That's why customers pick us over both the legacy tools they've outgrown and the AI wrappers they don't trust. And bookkeeping is just the start: we're building toward a full financial operating system for how companies account, plan, and operate. 

The team is small, elite, and builder-focused, led by operators with a track record of shipping AI products at scale. We sit inside Airwallex, which means startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure, distribution, and capital behind us. You'll work directly from real customer pain, own outcomes end to end, and ship fast.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Director IT - Organizational Change Management & Business Enablement
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

This role is required to be onsite at our El Segundo, CA headquarters.

The Director of Organizational Change Management (OCM) and Business Enablement is a strategic leader responsible for driving enterprise-wide transformation by aligning people, processes, and technology. This role ensures that the human side of change is proactively managed to accelerate adoption, minimize resistance, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic foresight, operational execution, and deep expertise in change leadership, organizational design, and business enablement

What Your Impact Will Be:

Organizational Change Leadership

• Develop and execute enterprise-wide OCM strategies that support business and technology transformations.
• Lead stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, readiness planning, and resistance management.
• Embed OCM into agile delivery models and transformation roadmaps to ensure alignment with business goals.

Business Enablement & Adoption

• Design and implement scalable enablement frameworks that integrate training, communications, and adoption strategies.
• Lead the development of role-based training programs and content creation tools to support enterprise solution rollouts.
• Drive post-integration enablement for enterprise tools, services, and support models.

Organizational Design & Process Optimization

• Partner with IT and business leaders to align organizational structures, spans and layers, governance, and communication flows.
• Facilitate current and future state assessments, gap analyses, and implementation plans to support process improvement initiatives.
• Use data-driven strategies to define IT organizational goals, identify performance gaps, and forecast future demand.

Leadership Engagement & Culture Building

• Facilitate IT Town Halls, Extended Leadership Workshops, and global culture-building events.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, presenting business cases and transformation strategies to the C-suite.
• Lead global change enablement, training, and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and execution.

Program Integration & Governance

• Align change and enablement strategies with program milestones and enterprise architecture.
• Define and track KPIs to measure adoption, engagement, and business readiness.
• Ensure seamless coordination between business and IT to translate technical changes into business impacts.

What We’re Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree; advanced degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in IT, business transformation, or change leadership.
• 10+ years leading OCM in large-scale, global business/IT transformations.
• Proven experience leading culture and change programs, including global leadership events and workshops.
• Demonstrated business and technology acumen with a track record of delivering results.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to influence at all levels.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

This role is an in-office role Monday-Thursday, and work from home on Fridays. We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, T:0 (Agentic Finance)
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll lead the creation of a new AI-native product for T:0 https://t0.ai, helping define how agentic finance can move beyond software and tooling into finance work itself.

You’ll take the product from 0 to 1, shaping the strategy, user experience, solution design, roadmap and delivery plan around real founder problems and customer needs.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial and customers to validate the opportunity, find product-market fit and scale what works.

You’ll stay close to developments in AI, machine learning, LLMs, target markets and the competitive landscape, using those insights to guide product strategy and make high-quality decisions.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 7+ years of overall professional experience.

 - Experience in product management, including building products from 0 to 1.

 - Demonstrated experience working in novel fields such as AI, machine learning or LLMs.

 - Experience defining product strategy, user requirements and commercial approaches that drive meaningful product growth.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey product strategy to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to structure complex problems using data and first-principles thinking.

 - Drive, grit and persistence to take ownership and move ideas from concept to reality in short periods of time.

 - Ability to work effectively across cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

Preferred

 - Previous experience as a startup founder or early joiner.

 - Bachelor’s degree or higher in a STEM discipline.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You’re excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

 - You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

 - You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

 - You’re not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

 - You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

 - You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team’s direction once a call is made.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

T:0's mission is to make finance run itself. We're building an AI-native accounting platform that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so founders can stop managing their finances and start using them to run the business. The hard part isn't adding AI to accounting. It's making AI you can trust with the books. We use AI to understand how a business works, then run the actual accounting on strict, checkable rules, and no black box deciding the numbers. That's why customers pick us over both the legacy tools they've outgrown and the AI wrappers they don't trust. And bookkeeping is just the start: we're building toward a full financial operating system for how companies account, plan, and operate. 

The team is small, elite, and builder-focused, led by operators with a track record of shipping AI products at scale. We sit inside Airwallex, which means startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure, distribution, and capital behind us. You'll work directly from real customer pain, own outcomes end to end, and ship fast.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Disease Area Insights
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Disease Area Insights, the Senior Director, Global Disease Area Insights role requires strategic thinking and expertise to provide broad-level critical contributions to disease area strategy, life-cycle planning and product and portfolio decisions. The individual in this role will lead the global team responsible for integrated market research and competitive intelligence to support the development and commercialization of the RevMed portfolio for a given disease area. The role will identify unmet needs and market gaps, assess the significance of emerging developments, and evaluate proposed commercial strategies and solutions to inform decisions and improve market impact. The ideal candidate will have experience working on pipeline and commercial-stage molecules in Oncology across multiple geographies, a strong ability to advise and influence senior leadership, strong problem-solving skills, a strategic mindset, and will exhibit curiosity, flexibility, and comfort with ambiguity.

This position would ideally be based at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA., however open to remote candidates who are willing to travel to our CA office on a regular basis.

Responsibilities include:

• Leads Market Research and Competitive Strategy team members to develop an integrated, continuously updated view of the external environment for a given disease area, inclusive of competitor pipelines, emerging science, clinical data, commercial activities, market developments, and stakeholder insights in support of current business needs and future opportunities across the portfolio of targeted oncology molecules.

• Initiates and facilitates market research to deepen understanding of market opportunity, unmet needs, stakeholder behaviors, and gaps or barriers in the marketplace. Pressure-tests assumptions about the nature and importance of these gaps and evaluates proposed commercial strategies, solutions, and approaches for their potential to influence behavior and improve market outcomes.

• Leads systematic, ongoing tracking and synthesis of competitive information across medical conferences, earnings calls and investor events, scientific publications, clinical and regulatory updates, and commercial activities, positioning, and messaging. Coordinates congress coverage and deliver timely alerts, integrated summaries, and implications tailored to stakeholder needs.

• Benchmarks competitor clinical data, messaging, positioning, commercial strategies and execution, business models, and capabilities. Anticipates potential competitive moves and assesses their implications for differentiation, disease area strategy, and commercial planning.

• Collaborates with key stakeholders to identify and prioritize intelligence and research needs, translate business questions into learning objectives, and generate insights through appropriate research, competitive intelligence, and analytical approaches.

• Communicates and aligns key internal stakeholders around market research and competitive intelligence objectives and outputs, distinguishing established evidence from assumptions and qualifying findings based on data quality, uncertainty, and limitations.

• Develops and presents actionable recommendations to key stakeholders and senior leadership, connecting findings to strategic choices, potential responses, and priorities for further investigation. Assesses the significance of new events and emerging signals and uses targeted research to test their likely impact where needed.

• Demonstrates the ability to quickly understand complex markets, disease states, competitive landscapes, and relevant market and managed care dynamics, including the factors that shape stakeholder decisions and treatment practices.

• Synthesizes and communicates insights across geographies to inform global clinical development plans and commercial strategies, identifying where differences in market conditions or stakeholder needs require tailored approaches.

• Aligns cross-functional input into research and competitive intelligence plans, facilitates interpretation of findings, and supports their application to business decisions and subsequent learning priorities.

• Collaborates closely with Global and Regional Insights and Analytics functions, including Data Analytics and Forecasting, to integrate evidence, coordinate priorities, and share insights and effective practices. Tailors support to regional needs and capabilities.

• Works closely with Global Commercial Development, regional commercial teams, Clinical Development, Portfolio Strategy, and Medical Affairs to support decisions across early development, launch preparation, and commercialization.

• Maintains an in-depth understanding of Revolution Medicines’ diverse product offerings, competitive positioning, and the broader market dynamics shaping the industry's future.

• Reinforces market research and competitive intelligence best practices, selecting data sources, vendors, and methodologies suited to the business question. Uses qualitative and quantitative approaches to diagnose gaps, test hypotheses, and evaluate the potential impact and feasibility of proposed solutions. Manages third parties and ensures research and intelligence activities follow applicable policies and ethical standards.

• Identifies and tracks key business drivers, changes in market behavior, and emerging opportunities or risks. Refines research and intelligence priorities as new evidence and business needs emerge.

• Leads and develops a team of direct reports, building market research, competitive intelligence, and strategic synthesis capabilities and ensuring delivery against prioritized business needs.

• Travel domestically and internationally as needed, typically up to 25–30%.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor's degree required (MBA preferred) with 12+ years of progressive experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or strategic consulting role with 8+ years of experience in a strategic analytics role.

• Deep expertise supporting pipeline and portfolio decision making and leading executional strategy for pipeline analytics and insights.

• Extensive primary research and secondary analytical skills required; ability to diagnose market gaps, pressure-test assumptions, assess emerging developments, and evaluate proposed commercial approaches, translating evidence into actionable recommendations.

• Experience conducting and strategically coordinating market research across geographies, including regions outside the U.S.

• Experience leading comprehensive competitive intelligence activities across scientific, clinical, corporate, and commercial sources, with the ability to synthesize evolving information into timely strategic implications and recommendations.

• Track record of being a highly effective team player, and adaptive to meet the needs of a growing business.

• Strong problem solver with experience selecting fit-for-purpose research designs and analytical approaches to evaluate business questions and proposed solutions and building quality research and intelligence vendor partnerships.

• Demonstrated ability to influence executive management and cross functional business partners.

• Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.

• Ability to represent Revolution Medicines well with internal and external stakeholders, including strong interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, with a tolerance for ambiguity, and a passion for helping cancer patients.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with targeted Oncolytics.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and influence decision-making at the executive level.

• Experience working with Global teams.

#LI-JW1 #LI-Onsite

Our base pay salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We will only collect, process and use any personal data that you provide to us in accordance with our CCPA Notice and Privacy Policy. For additional information, please contact privacy@revmed.com.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Field Marketing, South Central
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a Senior Channel Field Marketing Manager to own co-marketing strategy and execution with Horizon3's channel partners in the South Central region. You will drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through high-signal field programs, working alongside Horizon3's Partner Business Managers to build account coverage, accelerate deals in market, and hold every program to a CPO and ROI threshold.

You will be the senior marketing partner to Horizon3's VAR, reseller, alliance, and distribution partners in the region, and to the Partner Business Managers who cover them. You own the co-marketing motion end to end: which partners get investment, joint program design, MDF management, execution, follow-up, and pipeline attribution.

Channel is a critical growth lever for Horizon3, and partner-driven pipeline needs an owner who understands both the field motion and the partner ecosystem. If you have spent your career running co-marketing programs with one eye on the partner relationship and the other on pipeline ROI, this role was built for you.



Please note: The ideal person for this role will reside in the state of Texas.



This role will be responsible for…..



Channel Co-Marketing Strategy and Planning

 - Own the South Central channel field marketing strategy, covering the region's partners and partner events, and a co-marketing portfolio built to generate net-new partner-sourced pipeline and accelerate partner-influenced deals already in motion.

 - Decide where co-marketing investment goes. Prioritize partners and programs by pipeline opportunity, not by who asks for budget.

 - Own the channel marketing calendar, aligned to partner priorities, regional sales plays, and company campaign themes, so partner programs ladder up to integrated demand gen motions.

 -  Define and enforce pipeline ROI standards as the gate for all channel field investment. Every program needs a pipeline hypothesis going in and a pipeline outcome coming out.



Partner Programs and MDF

 - Design and execute joint field programs with VARs, resellers, alliance partners, and distributors: co-hosted events, partner-led roundtables, joint conference activations, roadshows, and CISO-focused experiences.

 - Own MDF end to end: allocation strategy, partner alignment, execution oversight, budget tracking, and attribution reporting. MDF is an investment with an expected return, not a partner benefit to be dispersed.

 - Build repeatable co-marketing playbooks that scale across partners without rebuilding each program from scratch.

 -  Coordinate SDR, Partner Business Manager, and partner seller follow-up for every program, with defined SLAs.



Partner and Sales Alignment

 - Serve as the senior marketing counterpart to the region's Partner Business Managers and partner marketing contacts, and run joint planning and business reviews with priority partners.

 - Work with regional field marketers so partner programs and direct programs cover the same accounts without colliding.

 - Partner with partner marketing and product marketing on joint messaging and proof points.



Pipeline Accountability and Reporting

 - Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline reporting: meetings booked, pipeline created, stage progression, and ROI by partner and by program.

 - Partner with marketing operations to keep partner attribution clean in Salesforce.

 - Report to field marketing and channel leadership on a regular cadence, with clear recommendations on which partners and programs to scale and which to cut.

 - Mentor Channel Field Marketing Managers and Specialists. This role has no direct reports.



What You’ll Bring

 - 6+ years of B2B channel or field marketing experience, with ownership of partner co-marketing programs and measurable pipeline contribution.

 - Proven track record building and executing co-marketing programs with VARs, resellers, alliance partners, or distributors, with the pipeline data to back it up.

 - Experience owning MDF budgets, including allocation decisions, partner alignment, and ROI reporting.

 - Strong understanding of the B2B technology channel ecosystem: how partners sell, what motivates them, and how to design programs that drive joint pipeline rather than just partner satisfaction.

 - Financial fluency: comfortable building CPO and ROI cases and recommending investment trade-offs to leadership.

 - Proficiency with Salesforce for pipeline tracking, partner attribution, and co-marketing performance reporting.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Partner Business Managers, channel sales, direct field marketing, demand gen, digital, ABM, and product marketing.

jobs.description:

 - Ability to work independently where you know how to multitask and prioritize effectively.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, T:0 (Agentic) Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

T:0 https://t0.ai is building an AI-native accounting platform that helps founders run their businesses without managing financial busywork. You'll shape product experiences that make complex financial workflows approachable, trustworthy, and useful across desktop, mobile web, and native app experiences.

 - Define and drive the product design vision for your area, from first sketch to shipped product, in partnership with Product and Engineering.

 - Translate complex financial workflows into approachable experiences by researching, understanding, and advocating for user needs throughout product development.

 - Lead end-to-end design across desktop, mobile web, and native app experiences, working closely with engineers through critical moments from exploration to launch.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and the design system team to deliver solutions that work as a coherent system, not just as individual screens.

 - Build deep domain knowledge, connect work across the team, and contribute to product strategy, roadmap, customer validation, and the design culture and principles of T:0.

You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience as a UX or product designer, with expertise across desktop web, mobile web, and native app experiences.

 - A strong portfolio demonstrating complex systems, multi-channel user journeys, and intricate object relationships—not just polished screens.

 - Proficiency in UX methods, including generative research, information architecture, interaction design, and user testing, with the ability to think in systems.

 - Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain design rationale to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - A track record of leading projects end to end in ambiguous environments.

 - Experience partnering with Product Managers to scope design requirements and create lean project plans that leave room for research, exploration, and testing—not just execution.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

 - You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Design at Airwallex sits close to the centre of our product, which is exactly what makes it a team for designers who are looking for impact, not just execution. You’ll work side by side with product and engineering from day one, shaping the system and challenging the brief to deliver the best outcomes for our customers, influencing what gets built and how it comes together.

The access our designers have to senior leadership is real. The problems are complex, the standards are high, and the impact is visible at global scale. Airwallex is growing fast, and design is expected to keep pace. This is a genuinely exciting stage to be doing work that matters.

If you want real influence, ambitious work, and the chance to grow fast alongside smart, driven builders, this is the place to do it.

T:0's mission is to make finance run itself. We're building an AI-native accounting platform that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so founders can stop managing their finances and start using them to run the business. The hard part isn't adding AI to accounting. It's making AI you can trust with the books. We use AI to understand how a business works, then run the actual accounting on strict, checkable rules, and no black box deciding the numbers. That's why customers pick us over both the legacy tools they've outgrown and the AI wrappers they don't trust. And bookkeeping is just the start: we're building toward a full financial operating system for how companies account, plan, and operate. The team is small, elite, and builder-focused, led by operators with a track record of shipping AI products at scale. We sit inside Airwallex, which means startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure, distribution, and capital behind us. You'll work directly from real customer pain, own outcomes end to end, and ship fast.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Supply Chain Planner to support short-term planning for server hardware deployment. In this role, you will help translate customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans, track hardware availability, and ensure the right equipment is available at the right location and time.

You will work extensively with Excel, planning systems, and operational data to reconcile information, identify supply and demand gaps, monitor inventory, and track deployment requirements. This is a hands-on position that requires strong supply chain knowledge, analytical skills, and a willingness to manage detailed manual processes to keep planning activities accurate and on schedule.

You will collaborate with regional capacity managers and cross-functional partners, independently manage day-to-day planning responsibilities, and follow open actions through resolution. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, solving operational challenges, and turning supply chain requirements into executable plans.

Responsibilities

• Support short-term supply chain planning for server hardware deployment, translating customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans.

• Partner with regional capacity managers and cross-functional teams to understand hardware requirements, priorities, quantities, and delivery timelines.

• Analyze demand and supply data to identify capacity gaps, inventory constraints, delivery risks, and potential mitigation actions.

• Create, update, and maintain demand entries in planning systems, ensuring accuracy across quantities, locations, and required delivery dates.

• Leverage Microsoft Excel to reconcile datasets, validate planning information, track changes, analyze capacity, and prepare operational reports.

• Monitor hardware inventory, supply availability, costs, lead times, and deployment schedules to support planning decisions.

• Perform detailed manual tracking and maintain accurate records of planning inputs, open actions, risks, and delivery progress.

• Follow up with partner teams to resolve discrepancies, address planning gaps, and ensure requirements progress from initial planning through execution.

• Independently manage daily planning activities while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines.

Qualifications

• 5–7 years of experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, capacity planning, inventory planning, or related operations.

• Strong understanding of supply chain fundamentals, logistics, inventory management, and demand and supply planning processes.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets.

• Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, updating, and validating demand or supply plans within planning systems.

• Experience analyzing supply and demand gaps, tracking inventory, monitoring lead times, and managing deployment schedules.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies, assess risks, and maintain accurate planning data.

• Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work rather than focusing primarily on project coordination or oversight.

• Strong communication and follow-through skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple teams.

• Ability to work a consistent Pacific Time (PST) schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting hardware supply chain operations, server deployment, data center infrastructure, or technology logistics.

• Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and hardware inventory management.

• Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and data visualization tools.

• Experience working with enterprise resource planning (ERP), supply chain management, or demand planning systems.

You’ll work from our SF office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 5+ years of product management experience spanning product design, product planning, go-to-market, and solution architecture.

 - Experience taking products from ideation through delivery at global scale.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Forecasting
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting directly to the Executive Director, Global Forecasting, the Senior Director, Global Forecasting role requires strategic thinking and expertise to provide critical contributions to disease area strategy, life-cycle planning and product and portfolio decisions.  The Senior Director, Global Forecasting will act a strategic thought partner cross-functionally. They will develop, refine, and communicate key strategic and revenue forecast assumptions and analyses to inform and support portfolio investment and lifecycle strategy decisions across the organization.  This role will work directly with other Global and Regional Forecasting leads to ensure consistency in forecast approach, assumptions, and analyses.  The ideal candidate will have experience working on pipeline molecules in Oncology, strong problem-solving skills, a strategic mindset, and will exhibit curiosity, flexibility, and be comfortable with ambiguity.  The role will address increasingly complex interactions among products and indications within and across tumor types, translating forecast scenarios into actionable insights for long-range planning, supply planning, and go/no-go decisions.

This position would ideally be based at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA., however open to remote candidates who are willing to travel to our CA office on a regular basis.

Responsibilities include:

• Leading a team of forecasters responsible for developing and maintaining global forecast models for a given tumor type and integrating these forecasts to assess interactions across products, indications, and the broader portfolio. Specific activities include:

• Ensuring alignment to Global forecasting standards and governance processes; partnering with global and regional forecasting leads to establish and maintain a shared framework for methodologies, core assumptions, scenario definitions, and forecast review, with consistency where relevant and flexibility for justified market differences.

• Developing and maintaining patient-based forecasts and complex scenarios within indications and across the portfolio as multiple products and indications enter the same tumor type. Assessing treatment sequencing, overlapping eligible populations, combinations, launch timing, and substitution or complementary use to quantify incremental portfolio opportunity and avoid double counting patients and demand.

• Communicating and aligning key internal stakeholders around key forecast assumptions.

• Understanding complex markets, disease states, competitive landscapes, and relevant market and managed care dynamics and using this knowledge to develop strategic forecasts and plans.

• Synthesizing and communicating the similarities, differences, and considerations necessary to inform Global clinical development plans.

• Conducting rigorous opportunity assessments, sensitivity analyses, and risk quantification to clarify key uncertainties, interdependencies, and decision thresholds for portfolio prioritization, investment, and go/no-go decisions. Partnering with the Portfolio Strategy team to develop processes and systems.

• Partnering across the forecasting team and with Finance, Supply Chain, and cross-functional teams to translate patient, treatment duration, and utilization assumptions into revenue and demand scenarios for long-range plans, budgets, supply and capacity planning, and launch readiness; communicating forecast ranges, risks, and changes to inform timely decisions.

• Partnering closely with other Insights and Analytics functions (Disease Area Insights, Data Analytics) to inform the forecast.

• Working closely with Global Commercial Development, Clinical Development, Portfolio Strategy, Finance, and Medical Affairs to support early-stage decision making.

• Working closely with the Regions to ensure consistency; develops and communicates understanding of differences in forecasts. Documenting and reconciling material differences in assumptions, methods, and outputs, with clear rationale reflecting local evidence and market conditions, and ensuring their implications are understood in global and regional planning.

• Providing forecasting expertise, tools, and hands-on analytical support to regional and local teams as needed, adapting support to local capabilities and priorities. Helping teams apply the shared framework to local forecasting needs, build capabilities, and share insights and effective practices across markets.

• Maintaining an in-depth understanding of Revolution Medicines’ diverse product offerings, competitive positioning, and the broader market dynamics shaping the industry's future.

• Collaborating with vendor partners to manage various deliverables and analyses.

• Travel domestically and internationally as needed, typically up to 25–30%.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor's degree required (MBA preferred) with 12+ years of progressive experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or strategic consulting role with 8+ years of experience in a related forecasting role.

• Experience developing long-range patient-based oncology forecasts and complex scenarios that capture interactions among multiple products and indications within the same tumor type and across a portfolio.

• Experience translating forecast uncertainty and portfolio scenarios into insights supporting long-range planning, supply planning, investment prioritization, and go/no-go decisions.

• Experience developing and supporting early-stage forecasting efforts; comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty and rapidly evolving information and priorities.

• Experience working with global, regional, and local teams to establish shared forecasting approaches, explain material differences, and provide practical analytical support tailored to local needs and capabilities.

• Track record of being a collaborative team player, and adaptive to meet the needs of a growing business.

• Strong problem solver with experience leveraging a variety of research and analytical vendors, study designs, and building quality research vendor partnerships.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior management and key business partners.

• Proven experience in a smaller, rapidly growing, company.

• Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.

• Ability to represent Revolution Medicines well: strong interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, with a tolerance for ambiguity, and a passion for helping cancer patients.

Preferred Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in patient-based forecasting with focus in Oncology.

• Experience with targeted Oncolytics.

• Experience managing teams.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and influence decision-making at the executive level.
