jobs.title: Data Center Controls Technician, AWS Controls Engineering
jobs.description:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
Perform point-to-point checkouts, first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of BMS/EPMS code and hardware.
Provision servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and networks; test communication with third-party devices.
Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings, applying closed-loop controls and field sensor scaling.
Supervise low-voltage contractors per AWS requirements.
Provide commissioning and systems-level testing; create red-lined drawings and documentation.
Follow change management processes for work requests and methods of procedures.
Participate in factory witness tests and perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
Monitor ticketing systems, prioritize tasks, and manage service agreements (vendor scheduling, QA, invoice review).
Enforce on-site safety methodology.

Physical Requirements Lift and move up to 50 lbs; use ladders, platforms, and OSHA-standard PPE including safety harnesses.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic qualifications:
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 1+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 3+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 1+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications:
- Associate's degree in related field
- Experience using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment.

jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

jobs.title: Principal OEM Business Manager, eero Supply Chain
jobs.description:
eero, an Amazon company, builds the Wi-Fi and networking systems that homes and businesses rely on every day. We're hiring a Principal OEM Business Manager to own the commercial relationship between eero and a portfolio of its Tier 1 contract manufacturing partners.
You'll own the commercial relationship, from start to finish, with an assigned set of eero's Tier 1 EMS/ODM partners in the US and Asia. That means negotiating multi-year master agreements, leading RFQs for new programs, and managing contract manufacturing spend across your partner portfolio. You'll negotiate directly with those partners' executive teams, set the commercial terms for how eero builds its products with them, and hold them to their commitments on cost, quality, delivery, and flexibility
You'll work with eero Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Legal, and procurement teams. Together you'll shape eero's long-term manufacturing footprint.

Key job responsibilities
Commercial strategy and negotiation
•	For your assigned Tier 1 EMS/ODM partners, negotiate all commercial aspects of eero's relationship: Master Supply Agreements and Statements of Work, multi-year pricing, manufacturing value-add (MVA) and margin structures, NRE, tooling and IP ownership, payment terms, liability, warranty and epidemic failure, excess and obsolescence (E&O) liability, capacity commitments, and exit and transition terms.
•	Lead competitive RFQs for new programs and re-sourcing events in your portfolio. Own the full process: strategy, partner shortlist, should-cost targets, award recommendation, and signed contract.
•	Build and defend should-cost and total landed cost models (BOM, MVA, freight, duty and tariff, FX, inventory carrying cost)
•	Deliver year-over-year structural cost reductions, and own the contract manufacturing cost roadmap for your partner portfolio against annual operating plan targets.

Partner strategy and executive relationships
•	Define and run eero's multi-year contract manufacturing strategy. This includes the partner portfolio, share allocation, and geographic footprint diversification (for example, China+1, Southeast Asia, Mexico, US).
•	Own eero's executive relationships with leadership (CEO, GM, VP) at your assigned partners. Run executive business reviews, resolve escalations at the senior level, and act as eero's senior commercial voice with those partners.
•	Run partner governance and scorecards for your partners, using a common framework across eero's Tier 1 portfolio. Scorecards cover cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, flexibility, and business continuity. Use commercial levers to drive performance.

Risk, flexibility, and financial accountability
•	Structure agreements that protect eero from demand volatility: upside flexibility, downside liability caps, lead-time commitments, and buffer, VMI, or hub arrangements.
•	Own the commercial resolution of E&O, purchase price variance (PPV), NRE, and partner claims.
•	Contribute to tariff, trade compliance, and geopolitical risk, including country-of-origin strategy and supply continuity planning.

Leadership and mechanisms
•	Set the operating mechanisms the OEM and supply chain team runs on: monthly business reviews, pricing cadence, quarterly business reviews, and contract lifecycle management.
•	Raise the commercial bar across eero Operations through coaching, templates, and negotiation playbooks.
•	Travel 1-2 weeks per quarter to partner sites in Asia and North America.

A day in the life
You might start your morning preparing a strategic proposal for a major partner negotiation, then shift to a cross-functional working session where you align product, engineering, and business teams on a new market opportunity. After lunch, you could be leading a business review with senior leadership, presenting data-driven insights and recommendations. Later, you'll connect with a mentee to discuss their career development before closing out with a call to an external partner's executive team to advance a deal that's been months in the making.

Basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 7+ years of professional or military experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners
- Experience working with, presenting to and influencing senior executives up to VP level
- 10+ years of experience in OEM/EMS business management, strategic sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management in hardware or electronics manufacturing
- Experience leading RFQ or sourcing events for new hardware programs, from requirements through award and contract execution
- Established executive-level relationships with leadership teams at Tier 1 EMS/ODM providers in both the US and Asia
- Experience building should-cost and teardown models and MVA cost structures
- Experience leading CM transitions, dual-sourcing, or manufacturing footprint moves across countries
- 10+ years of multi-million dollar contract negotiation experience

Preferred qualifications:
- MBA
- 7+ years Experience in networking, consumer electronics, or connected-device hardware (for example, Wi-Fi routers, mesh systems, broadband CPE)

Job Purpose and Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work.  We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our Pharmacy Managers play a critical role in cultivating a culture of excellence in their respective pharmacy by acting as a role model for all, demonstrating genuine care, and setting the bar for their pharmacy team.

As a Pharmacy Manager, you will lead and develop a pharmacy team that provides exceptional patient care by promoting best practices and leading through change while identifying and addressing performance opportunities. Pharmacy Managers support novel program awareness, onboard newly hired pharmacy team members, and recognize colleagues for their success. The Pharmacy Manager consistently exhibits best practices when working the bench, including quarterbacking the team, providing patients with meaningful counseling, and abiding by all legal and regulatory guidelines, amongst other required activities.

The Pharmacy Manager is responsible for direct and effective management of their pharmacy team, including but not limited to:

• Living our purpose by helping to manage and improve patient health through safe and appropriate dispensing, counseling, and immunizing practices
• Overseeing the pharmacy team during bench shifts, including strengthening pharmacy performance measures through effective coaching and consistent follow-up of pharmacy team members
• Supporting safe and accurate prescription fulfillment by following—and directing the pharmacy team to follow—pharmacy workflow procedures and utilizing the safety guardrails at every workstation
• Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care, and coaching the pharmacy team to do the same: demonstrating compassionate care, collaborating with the patient’s total healthcare team, and proactively resolving insurance and/or medication issues
• Proactively offering and delivering immunizations to keep patients healthy; identifying, engaging, and supporting Pharmacy Technicians to learn to immunize
• Supporting the effective management of pharmacy inventory by following—and coaching the pharmacy team to follow—all inventory best practices, with a special focus on protecting cold chain products for our patients and our business
• Conducting new Technician and Pharmacist onboarding for the store and district, including training on CVS workflow, and ensuring all trainees are on-track for timely completion of required training and/or licensure
• Ensuring pharmacy operations are fully compliant with state Board of Pharmacy regulations at all times; escalating issues or concerns to the Rx DL for additional support if/as needed
• Partnering with the Store Manager to maintain a healthy talent pipeline of cross-trained colleagues willing to work in the pharmacy, and ensuring that cross-trained colleagues are on-track for timely completion of all required training for licensure

• Establishing a culture of safety, empowerment, and inclusion so the pharmacy team feels valued; building psychological safety by opening the door for feedback and taking relevant action
• Maintaining relevant clinical and technical skills for the job as the industry evolves (including but not limited to company-required trainings and CMEs); actively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge to better support patients

jobs.title: Claim Field Specialist (Central Florida)
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

The Claim Field Specialist acts as the primary resource for groups and providers, within a specific geographic location, to establish, oversee, and maintain a proactive claim education program focused on assisting providers with claim denials, claim education, and claim resolution.

This person analyzes claim denials to track and trend potential opportunities, in order to assist in training and education of participating and non-participating providers.  Additionally, they will assist in creating bulletins, newsletters, and claim trainings to improve provider claims issues, as well as billing practices, while collaborating with internal and/or external departments to identify claim training and education opportunities. This person will develop, implement, support, and promote provider training strategies, tactics, policies, and programs that drive provider satisfaction specific to claim submission and payments.

The Claim Field Specialist works with the grievance and appeal department to trend provider claim disputes and appeals that could be prevented with additional provider claim education. They also work with the provider engagement team to collaborate on provider education when additional detailed claim education is needed.

The Claim Field Specialist meets regularly, both in person and virtually, with assigned providers to conduct trainings and educations, review claim trends, and ensure understanding of Aetna Medicaid claim and billing policies and procedures. This person is expected to spend 70% of their time meeting with providers in-person, as well as conducting occasional telephonic or virtual provider meetings as needed.

The Claim Field Specialist responds to assigned provider claim questions or inquires, and if necessary, ensures prompt resolution to provider issues with appropriate enterprise business teams. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in medical billing and coding, specifically related to claims processing and root cause analysis.
• 2+ years of experience with provider engagement and/or relations.

Meet the Team

Cisco’s Corporate Development/Chief Strategy Office is a best-in-class, high-impact group responsible for Cisco’s M&A and investment strategy. We act as the link between cutting-edge startup innovation and Cisco’s vast product ecosystem. We aren’t just identifying the "next big thing"—we are actively driving post-investment value to ensure that the technologies we bet on integrate successfully into Cisco’s security, routing, and cloud solutions. We are a small, high-fidelity team where every member operates with independence and speed.

Impact

You will serve as the primary driver for realized value after an investment is made. Your mission is to facilitate technical and business integration, acting as the connective tissue between startup founders/CEOs and Cisco’s internal product and executive leadership.

• Drive Technical and Strategic Integration: Partner with Cisco product and engineering teams to identify teamwork opportunities and accelerate the integration of innovative startup technologies across Cisco’s Security, Networking, Routing, and Cloud portfolios.
• Facilitate Executive Engagement: Lead strategic discussions and technical roundtables with senior executives, including CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and startup leaders, to validate market opportunities and technology alignment.
• Enable Go-to-Market Growth: Leverage Cisco’s global sales organization, channel ecosystem, and go-to-market programs to accelerate portfolio company growth and create mutual business value.
• Lead Portfolio Strategy: Continuously assess portfolio company progress, identify growth opportunities, and align startups with the most relevant Cisco business units to maximize strategic outcomes.
• Provide Executive Transparency and Mentorship: Operate as a trusted advisor with exposure to Cisco’s senior leadership and executive teams, helping shape investment strategy and portfolio company success.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors +8 years of related experience or Masters +6 years of related experience or PhD 3+ years of related experience.
• Experience with an Engineering or Computer Science foundation, including the ability to evaluate full-stack architectures, AI technologies, and emerging startup innovations, and assess their technical capabilities, scalability, and strategic fit within Cisco’s ecosystem.
• Experience in business development, strategic partnerships, sales, channels, and go-to-market initiatives, collaborating across sales, marketing, and partner organizations.
• Experience working with executive partners and leading sophisticated business relationships.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in product management, venture capital, startup ecosystems, or entrepreneurship.
• Professionals with experience in corporate VC, venture capital value-creation teams, or best-in-class startup leadership roles.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The Cisco Strategy Office is dedicated to innovation as a path to growth and sustainability of market leadership. It plays an important role in fueling the strategy of innovation for growth. This includes a broad approach with multiple strategies such as acquisitions and investments. You will be extremely forward-thinking with a professional and approachable demeanor in all interactions; possess outstanding communication skills with all levels of staff, executives, customers, vendors; and good judgment.

• Calendar Management: Handles VP's calendar by prioritizing schedules and meetings. You may decide who gets on the principal’s calendar, which meetings are attended, and who can attend in their place.

• Special Projects: Provides analytical support to assist executives on special projects. Research issues, analyzes problems, compiles data, and prepares reports.

You have experience providing support at the VP level. You take initiative, can handle a full desk with ease and thrive in a lively environment. You have high-energy with a passion for thinking bigger and broader than the role itself. You have outstanding attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information. You enjoy a collaborative environment, are committed to improvement, solve problems and make decisions.

• 4+ years’ experience in administrative environment. A minimum of 2 years of experience supporting a principal who was at the director level or above.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to connect with all levels of Executive/Senior staff and clients.

• Past work experience in the high-tech industry is desired, prior Cisco experience preferred.
• Associates degree

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.

• Asset Reporting: Assist in the management of the real estate asset portfolio by collecting and compiling necessary documentation for transactions (lease administration, disposals, acquisitions).
• Financial Reporting: Contribute to financial reporting by compiling data related to Capital Expenditures (CapEx), operating costs, and portfolio valuation for executive summaries.
• Data Analysis: Perform data analysis on portfolio performance, occupancy rates, and benchmark metrics to identify areas for optimization and cost efficiency.

2. Knowledge to be Acquired by the Student

The intern will gain valuable, practical knowledge in:

• Corporate Real Estate Strategy: Understanding the link between a company's strategic goals (business plan) and its physical footprint (Master Planning).
• Asset Lifecycle Management: Exposure to the full lifecycle of real estate assets, from strategic planning and investment to operational management and disposal.
• Data Governance in RE: Best practices for structuring, managing, and securing complex real estate data for reporting and decision-making.
• Financial Acumen in Real Estate: Basic principles of real estate finance, including CapEx justification, portfolio valuation concepts, and cost reporting structures within a large corporation.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Operational/Business Units.
• Transnational collaboration: Experience working with teams across different countries: Spain, Portugal, France, Germany and UK.

3. Internship Project/Area Focus

This internship will be integrated within the Real Estate function, focusing on:

• Real Estate Transactions: Assisting the transaction team by preparing initial data packages for leasing activities (analysis and negotiation), acquisitions, and disposals, and supporting the market analysis research.
• Real Estate Master Plan Development: Assisting in the long-term rolling plan for site development and consolidation.
• Portfolio Data Integrity Program: Direct involvement in the projects to standardize and digitize the global real estate database.
• Financial Performance Tracking: Supporting the team in quarterly/annual financial reviews for property management and capital investment projects.

4. Tools to be Used

The student will utilize industry-standard and proprietary Airbus software tools, including:

• Data Analysis/Reporting: Google sheets (Advanced proficiency required for modeling and reporting), Google slides (for presentations).
• Database/GIS/BIM: Exposure to GIS (Geographic Information Systems) and/or BIM (Building Information Modeling) platforms used by Airbus for spatial data management. Familiarity with a specific tool (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, ArcGIS) is a plus.
• Enterprise Software: Potential exposure to internal dedicated Real Estate Management Systems

Required skills #AirbusDiversity

As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

• Master’s degree in: Architecture (candidates with a strong focus on spatial planning and construction are highly encouraged).
• Language Proficiency:Native Spanish. (Helpful for local site interaction, though English is primary.)Level C1 English (Fluent working proficiency required for international team communication).Level B2 French will be valuable
• General knowledge in: Real Estate Asset Management, CAD/BIM Software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit), and Spatial Planning Methodologies.
• Skills valued:Proactivity and a strong passion for strategic planning, real estate asset optimization, and future workplace design.Excellent visual communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into impactful visual storytelling and executive-level presentations. Commitment and a high sense of responsibility toward deadlines and data accuracy.Analytical and problem-solving skills (especially in translating business needs into physical space requirements).Team spirit and great collaboration skills.Ability to thrive in complex, international environments, demonstrating strong cultural awareness.

This profile strongly targets an architect who understands that Real Estate involves more than just design—it requires strategic thinking, data literacy, and business alignment. Does this reflect the level of detail you were looking for?

Job Description:

Are you an aviation compliance specialist, training operations professional, or military aviation veteran looking for an autonomous, high-impact role with a global aerospace pioneer? Airbus Helicopters, Inc. (AHNA) is seeking a Training Center Compliance Manager to lead regulatory governance across our FAA Part 142 and Transport Canada training programs in Grand Prairie, TX.

In this role, you won’t just check boxes—you will act as the operational anchor for our flight training operations, partnering directly with the FAA, TSA, and internal flight teams to maintain the certifications that keep our flight simulation devices and training curricula compliant and flight-ready.

Your working environment:

A suburb just outside the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area is home to Airbus Helicopters U.S. regional headquarters, where we have more than 1,000 employees. Check out one of the seven professional sports teams that also call Dallas home - you may even see a special, custom Airbus helicopter dedicated to the Dallas Cowboys flying during home games.

How we care for you:

• Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
• Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
• Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
• Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

Your Challenges:

• Serve as the focal point and Designated Training Center Manager (TCM) for AHNA’s FAA Part 142 Training Certificate, responsible for ensuring adherence to all FAA Part 142 requirements – this includes but is not limited to initial qualification and recurring approvals/updates of procedures, courseware, instructors, etc.
• Serve as the focal point for internal and external audits and develop action plans to ensure compliance.
• Monitor for updates and ensure company policies and Training Center manual/procedures are kept up-to-date in accordance with Airbus and applicable Regulatory requirements and develop/implement/monitor risk mitigation plans
• Responsible for interface with our simulation partner(s) to ensure compliance with Part-142 facility and satellite facility requirements, to include AHNA Simulator Quality Management System (SQMS).
• Manage annual FTSP/TSA requirements and ensure completion of all required customer security clearance items (TSA /FTSP clearances and student visas regulations as required).
• Ensure completeness of training records in accordance with company/regulatory requirements (i.e. Airbus, FAA, Transport Canada, TSA)
• Support our simulation partner(s) and Instructor staff in overseeing/coordinating initial and recurring evaluations of instructors and flight simulation training devices.
• Oversee instructor currency requirements and perform scheduled and random audits to ensure training records and skills matrices are in compliance and up to date.
• Establish and maintain structure and process for revision control in accordance with company/regulatory requirements
• In coordination with AHNA’s Person Responsible for Technical Training (PRT), serve as a co-focal point for AHNA’s Transport Canada ATO Certificate and ensure compliance with all applicable Transport Canada ATO requirements for maintenance courseware and instructor approvals and currency/revisions/audits

Your Boarding Pass:

• Must have a Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field from an accredited university. Relevant military or work experience combined with formal training may be substituted
• Seven (7) or more years’ work experience in aviation operations and/or Part 142 regulatory compliance
• Seven (7) or more years’ experience/working knowledge of the U.S. Federal Aviation Regulations relevant to aviation training (FAR Parts 61, 135, 141, 142)
• Four (4) or more year’s work experience conducting/managing audits and/or compliance
• Proficiency in Google Suite

Preferred Education/Skills:

• Master’s degree in a relevant field from an accredited university.
• Pilot examiner or Part 135 check airman experience
• Twelve (12) years experience managing an approved aviation training program in the U.S. or Canada (e.g. Part 141 and/or Part 142).
• Experience/working knowledge of Transport Canada Aviation Regulations (CAR’s) and training / licensing requirements
• FAA and/or Transport Canada mechanic’s license
• Project Management Professional Certificate is a plus

Travel Required:

• 10% Domestic and International

Citizenship:

• Authorized to Work in the US

Physical Requirements:

• Onsite in Grand Prairie, TX 100% when not on travel
• Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings. Daily
• Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily
• Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily
• Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools such as hydraulic lifts. Daily
• Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
• Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
• Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools. Daily
• Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Daily
• Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Several times per week
• Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Daily
• Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice. At Least Once a Month
• Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Daily
• Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site
• Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

Job Description:

Electrical System Installation Design Engineering. Design and Validate Electrical harnesses and Equipment installation with associated Design Principles from Architecture to Detailed Design phases up to Manufacturing support and In-service activities under the relevant regulation, installation processes/methods/tools and procedures. #MYCYM.

An Electrical System Engineer has to deal with a lot of interfaces and departments, so good social skills will be appreciated. The main tasks are:

- Processes and tools applicable to electrical design are in a continuing evolution so an open mind person willing to face new challenges is required.
- Electrical installations are usually in the critical path for the aircrafts development and manufacturing due to the complexity of systems integration, so person who apply to this position should be a dynamic person able to adpat the continues changes that appear during the different design and manufanting phases, and even with the aircraft in service

REQUIREMENTS:

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

• Educated in an Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree or a related discipline.
• At least 3-5 years of experience in Engineering, in a Design/Airframe Department.
• Knowledge in Electrical and/ or Electromechanical design, including CATIA. V5 knowledge (desirable CATIA V6/3DX).
• High adaptability to work on new topics, new business and in a network mode.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

In order to support E-Aircraft Systems, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Master Thesis Student on Physics-aware surrogate modelling and validation (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Airbus X-Labs department as a Master student (d/f/m)!

• Location: Taufkirchen / Ottobrunn
• Start: 01.01.2027
• Duration: 6 Months

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

• Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
• Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
• International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
• Work with modern/diversified technologies.
• Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Thesis detailed description

For this thesis, you will join the design and simulation engineering team to work on advanced physics-aware surrogate modeling for megawatt-class cryogenic components, supporting next-generation electric aircraft propulsion research (such as the CryoProp demonstrator). System-level evaluations rely on 0D/1D lumped-parameter physical networks in MATLAB/Simscape; however, standard baseline models often diverge from dynamic test-bench telemetry during transient current steps and gaseous helium (GHe) coolant flow/pressure variations due to complex unmodeled physical interactions (e.g., dynamic contact resistance, thermal inertia, cryostat heat inleak).

To overcome the labor-intensive manual parameter tuning and the numerical instability (solver chattering, step-size collapse) of unconstrained black-box machine learning models, your focus will be on developing and validating a physics-aware surrogate model. Furthermore, you will deploy sparse symbolic regression to distill the learned neural dynamics into explicit, human-readable analytical equations that can be integrated back into baseline 1D Simscape model libraries.

This thesis is planned to begin in the early 2027 for an ideal duration of 6 months (start date can be adjusted). Your work will directly support the development of robust, virtual integration tools and advance model-based engineering and experimental validation strategies for future electric aircraft propulsion systems.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Depending on the exact timing and scope of the thesis, the tasks include:

• Literature review and familiarization with Port-Hamiltonian Systems (PHS), continuous-depth Neural ODEs, symbolic regression frameworks (SINDy, PySR).

• Analysis of experimental test-rig telemetry to identify unmodeled transient physical dynamics across varying current steps and GHe coolant conditions (T,P,m,IDC).
• Formulation and training of an AI surrogate using the appropriately identified methods
• Model compilation and export as an acausal model coupled natively into Simscape to be a part of a larger system model
• Numerical validation and co-simulation benchmarking to show good performance in a system model
• Symbolic distillation of the learned dissipation matrix into closed-form, interpretable 1D constitutive equations for physical inspection and loss breakdown.
• Packaging a reproducible, documented modeling toolset and presenting the technical methodology and simulation results to the engineering team.

Desired skills and qualifications

You are looking for a  Master Thesis in Germany, in Aerospace engineering or similar, and you have the following competences:

• Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Aerospace engineering or an equivalent field of study.
• First practical experience in the field of AI surrogate modelling.
• First experience with handling large experimental datasets and model validation.
• Proven competence with 0D/1D Simulation (Python, Simulink / Simscape)
• Knowledge of industry regulatory environment is a plus
• Comfortable working in English

Behavioural qualities essential to the exercise of the profession:

• Have a spirit of initiative and innovation,
• Be rigorous and reliable in your work,
• Be autonomous and curious in your approach,
• Be critical / self-critical,
• Be open-minded and see beyond the limits,
• Maintain good interpersonal skills and team spirit.
• Be pragmatic in finding solutions, adapted to the current stage of development

jobs.title: Manager HR Technology / Automation & AI Transformation (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Zur Unterstützung der Abteilung Reward Operations sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen

Manager HR Technology / Automation & AI Transformation (m/w/d)

Reward Operations Germany (HRPG) ist mit rund 150 Mitarbeitenden Teil der internationalen Airbus Reward Operations Organisation (HRP) und verantwortlich für die Bereiche Personaladministration, Zeitwirtschaft und Entgeltabrechnung.

In der Rolle als HR Technology / Automation & AI Transformation Manager (m/w/d) agierst du als strategischer und technischer Motor für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozess- und Systemlandschaft. In dieser übergreifenden Schnittstellenfunktion verbindest Du strategische HR-Initiativen mit modernster Technologie, intelligenter Automatisierung und Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI).

Du nutzt dein fundiertes Domänen- und Systemwissen (SAP HCM / S/4HANA & Workday) mit moderner Technologie-Expertise (z.B. Agentic AI, LLM-Workflows, Process Automation). Du optimierst nicht nur die Effizienz im operativen Tagesgeschäft, sondern treibst die Transformation unserer Organisation hin zu unserem zukünftigen Service-Modell im nationalen wie internationalen Umfeld aktiv voran.

Dein Standort

Unser Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Landeshauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind in einer Stunde zu erreichen und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitaktivitäten.

Unsere Benefits für dich

• Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
• Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
• Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten
• Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Technologische Strategie & Roadmapping: Identifikation, Konzeption und Implementierung zukunftsfähiger HR-Tech-Lösungen zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung übergreifender HR-Prozesse. Du identifizierst, konzipierst und implementierst innovative Lösungen (z. B. KI-Agenten, LLM-gestützte Workflows, Process Automation) unter Berücksichtigung von Datenschutz, Wirtschaftlichkeit und regulatorischen Vorgaben.
• Change & Transformationsmanagement: Begleitung der fachlichen und organisatorischen Veränderungen im Transformationsprozess mit klarem Fokus auf Know-How, Ways of Working und Stakeholder-Einbindung von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung.
• Prozessoptimierung: Durchführung von End-to-End-Analysen gesamtheitlicher Prozessketten (Payroll, Time, Personaladministration) zur nachhaltigen Steigerung der Effizienz, Reduzierung von Fehlerquellen und Vorbereitung auf zukünftige Service-Modelle.
• Schnittstellen & Stakeholder Management: Partnerschaft mit internen und externen Stakeholdern sowie funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Du agierst als Brücke zwischen Reward Operations, IT-Bereichen und den internationalen Centers of Excellence (CoEs) für Digitalisierung, SAP und Workday.
• Netzwerk & Steuerung: Fachliche Koordination von HR-Tech-Netzwerken sowie enge divisions- und länderübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit Fachexperten und operativen Einheiten.

Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen

• Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung in der HR-IT oder HR-Transformation.
• Technology & HR Transformation: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung KI-gestützter HR-Transformationsinitiativen, in der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung von HR-Prozessen sowie im Einsatz moderner KI-basierter HR-Technologien. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung übergreifender Transformationsprogramme sowie in der fachlichen Führung von Projektteams.
• Tech-Expertise: Solide Kenntnisse und Praxis im Einsatz von Agentic AI, LLM-Integrationen, Prozessautomatisierung (z. B. RPA) und aktuellen HR-Tech-Trends. Starke Kombination aus strategischem Weitblick, analytischem Denken und praktischer Umsetzungsstärke.
• System- & Prozesserfahrung: Starke Methodik in der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung komplexer HR-Abläufe. Fundiertes Know-how in den Fachprozessen der Entgeltabrechnung (PY), Zeitwirtschaft (PT) und Personaladministration (PA) sowie praktische Erfahrung mit SAP (HCM / S/4HANA) und Workday.
• Globales Set-up & Einstellung: Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Initiativen im internationalen Umfeld – kombiniert mit einem klaren Transformations-Mindset und einer pragmatischen Anpacker-Mentalität („Hands-on“).
• Schnittstellen- & Stakeholder-Kompetenz: Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationskompetenz an der Schnittstelle zwischen HR, IT und Business. Hohes Verhandlungsgeschick und exzellentes Stakeholder Management in einem dynamischen, mehrsprachigen Umfeld.
• Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französisch- und/oder Spanischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Job Description:

Airbus Commercial  is looking for an HR AI Solutions and Governance Specialist to join our HR Digital team in Herndon, Virginia.

As an HR AI Solutions and Governance Specialist for Airbus in North America, you will drive the advancement of next-generation HR automation and technology. In this technical position, you will play a critical role in designing and governing state-of-the-art AI solutions that transform our human resources operations. Key responsibilities include overseeing the end-to-end architecture of HR agent workflows, implementing robust AI model governance frameworks, and upholding ethical standards and compliance across all HR AI initiatives. Working alongside global and regional teams across HR, Digital, Audit, and Legal, you will connect overarching HR strategies with technical execution to drive enterprise innovation. Additionally, you will safeguard data integrity and ethical compliance throughout automated processes, leveraging modern AI tools to optimize compliance operations.

Meet the Team:

Working in our Human Resources department, it’s our mission to help support Airbus’ greatest assets: our team members. Our team works cross-departmentally as well as with our global counterparts to ensure we are making a positive impact on all aspects of our employee experience.

Your Working Environment:

The Washington, D.C. metro area is home to multiple Airbus offices: In our nation’s capital you will find the Airbus Experience Center, a collection of interactive, multimedia exhibitions highlighting the extensive role the company plays in the aviation, aerospace and defense industries in the U.S. and around the world. The D.C. area is also home to our regional corporate headquarters – located adjacent to Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) - it makes flying in a breeze!

How We Care for You:

• Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
• Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
• Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
• Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

Your Challenges:

• Design and implement complex HR agent workflows for tasks such as policy retrieval (RAG), onboarding triage, and automated compliance reporting.
• Drive automation initiatives across all HR functions in North America, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and effectiveness through AI.
• Develop advanced prompt architectures and orchestrate tool-calling with key HR systems like Workday and various Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
• Implement initiatives to audit AI models for bias and ensure compliance with regulatory standards, including EEOC guidelines and the EU AI Act.
• Establish and enforce stringent data privacy protocols for worker data, safeguarding Personal Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI).
• Define and implement comprehensive model governance guardrails, overseeing the entire lifecycle of AI solutions in HR.
• Design and implement dedicated AI agents aimed at automating complex regulatory reporting and compliance operations.
• Implement robust governance, monitoring, and validation frameworks for automated HR reporting models and agentic decision workflows.
• Secure underlying data foundations for compliance operations, including data tagging, data catalogues, line-of-sight auditing, and data governance.

Your Boarding Pass:

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or another quantitative-focused field, or an equivalent combination of industry-related professional experience and education.
• A minimum of 4 years of professional experience in a technical role, preferably within data science, machine learning, or a related field.
• A minimum of 4 years of experience in statistical analysis and classical machine learning (ML).
• A minimum of 2 years of experience focused on model governance, AI ethics, and data privacy.
• At least 2 years of development experience with Generative AI (GenAI), including the design of agentic workflows and prompt engineering.
• Experience with cloud platforms like Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS including services related to AI and machine learning (e.g., Vertex AI, AutoML, and AI Infrastructure) and data engineering (e.g., S3, Data Factory, BigQuery).

Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities:

jobs.title: Controls Technician, AWS DC Acquisition & Construction - VAR
jobs.description:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export control regulations, and applicants must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by applicable law, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences.  Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications:
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 1+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 3+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, AI & Data, Global Corporate Communications
jobs.description:
Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Last-Mile Issues and Issues Campaigns
jobs.description:
Amazon’s last-mile delivery network touches millions of customers every day — and with that scale comes real scrutiny. Legislation, regulatory shifts, and coordinated advocacy campaigns can move fast, and the stories they generate don’t wait for anyone. This role puts you at the center of how Amazon identifies, understands, and responds to the issues that matter most to its last-mile delivery operations.

As Communications Manager, Last-Mile Issues and Campaigns, you'll own the communications strategy for a portfolio that touches aspects of Amazon's last-mile delivery model. Last-mile delivery touches regulation, safety, and public trust, and this role sits at the center of how we communicate across all of it. You'll lead strategic narrative development and scenario planning that keeps the team ahead of legislative shifts, emerging campaigns, and related issues. You'll coordinate across relevant business lines and communications teams, partnering with Policy Comms, Field Comms, and others, to bring the right expertise to bear at the right moment and ensure Amazon speaks with one clear, strategic voice. You'll draft the statements, talking points, and briefing documents that represent Amazon externally, and you'll manage the feedback and approval cycles that come with them. You'll spend as much time seeding stories and shaping narratives as you do managing the reactive moments that come with the portfolio.

You're a high-judgment communicator who doesn't flinch when things get complicated. You can hold multiple fast-moving situations at once without losing your footing, but what sets you apart is your ability to spot the issue before it breaks and start building the strategy, not just the response. You think clearly under pressure, write precisely on deadline, and know how to bring the right people together at the right moment. You're comfortable as an on-the-record spokesperson, and you know how to work with reporters to shape a story before it spirals. You think like a strategist, connecting dots across policy, operations, and reputation to protect and advance the business. You don't wait to be told there's a problem. You've already mapped the landscape, built the plan, and brought the right people to the table.

This is a strong independent contributor role that reports into the Core Operations Communications team within the Global Operations and Workplace Reputation team.

Key job responsibilities
Manage complex, fast-moving, and unexpected communications challenges with high judgment and professionalism.

Be precise under tight deadlines and prioritize and manage multiple situations simultaneously.

Effectively represent Amazon as an on-the-record spokesperson.

Work with reporters to correct and clarify breaking news stories.

Write, develop, and manage approvals of external communications materials dealing with sensitive and timely topics.

Participate in multi-stakeholder emergency response meetings to provide insight and guidance from an external communications point-of-view.

A day in the life
You might start your morning scanning media coverage and legislative trackers to flag any new developments that could affect Amazon’s last-mile operations — then pull together a quick brief for a leader heading into a sensitive meeting. By midday, you could be on a call with legal and public policy partners to assess the communications implications of a pending bill or regulatory action, working through the messaging framework and drafting an initial statement. In the afternoon, you may shift to handling a reactive media inquiry on a breaking story, coordinating approvals in real time while staying in close contact with the reporter to manage the narrative. You’ll close out by updating scenario plans for upcoming legislative milestones and checking in with issues managers across the team to make sure nothing’s falling through the cracks.

About the team
We’re a team of strategic communicators responsible for telling the story of how Amazon gets people their packages — from the first mile to the last. We work across organizational boundaries to develop integrated communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. We use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. We value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.

On the issues side of the team, we move fast and we move together. When a legislative campaign or regulatory challenge emerges, we’re the ones coordinating the response — aligning messaging across legal, policy, and business partners and making sure Amazon’s voice is clear, consistent, and credible. We’re building for the long term — investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as Amazon grows. If you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other’s growth, this is the team for you.

- 7+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience
- Bachelor's degree

- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, Internet Edge Services, Internet Edge Services
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Internet Edge Services (IES) organization at Amazon Web Services (AWS) is at the forefront of optimizing global internet connectivity for our customers through innovative software solutions. We are on a bold mission to reimagine how the internet's edge operates at planetary scale — building the Border Network of the future: software-defined, running on commodity hardware, and programmable at every layer. This kind of platform unlocks capabilities that simply weren't possible before.

We're seeking a talented Software Development Manager to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll be lead the team responsible for building, enhancing, and operating Catographer — the intelligent control plane that will power Amazon's software-defined network at the internet edge. Catographer will act as the brain of the network, continuously ingesting real-time signals such as routing information to determine how traffic should flow across Amazon's global border network. It translates those decisions into directives for the underlying network controllers, enabling fast and reliable traffic management at massive scale. By replacing legacy routing approaches with a modern, horizontally scalable platform built in Rust, Catographer improves network reliability, reduces the blast radius of failures, and unlocks advanced traffic engineering capabilities — all while handling network state changes in milliseconds. This is a unique opportunity to work on a foundational platform for how traffic enters and exits Amazon's network.

In this role, you will lead a team of software development engineers to understand requirements and extend platforms that support software-defined networks (SDN). You are joining a high performing team interacting closely with other engineering teams across USA and Australia.

Key job responsibilities
Lead an established high performing team to identify opportunities and deliver software defined traffic engineering solutions for AWS's internet edge networks leveraging your software background.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing indistinguishable from perfect global network at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

You’ll experience and contribute to an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Production Electrical Engineer (Night Shift) has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join the MRTT FAL Production Team, specifically driving aircraft electrical conversion, system installations, and functional testing activities. Working in a highly dynamic, multidisciplinary shopfloor environment interfacing with Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Planning, and Subcontractors, the jobholder will lead operations within an assigned aircraft zone to secure zero-outstanding-work deliveries.

Shift schedule details: This position is permanently based on the Night Shift. Please note that during the initial onboarding period (first 2 to 3 months), the selected candidate will follow a rotating training schedule alternating 2 weeks on morning shift and 2 weeks on night shift before transitioning permanently to night shift.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

• Lead and coordinate the shopfloor multifunctional team (internal blue collars, technicians, and subcontracted workforces) across aircraft zones to secure milestone delivery and eliminate pending work.
• Manage operational resources and workload-capacity, ensuring optimal allocation of manpower, tooling, technical competencies, and industrial means for conversion activities.
• Oversee electrical conversion, system installation, and functional tests, resolving daily technical roadblocks and liaising with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality to ensure process compliance.
• Enforce strict adherence to operational standards, actively upholding and auditing Health & Safety, FOD prevention, Quality, DIM, and 5S/Housekeeping procedures across the designated zone.
• Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives, implementing Lean methodologies and digitalization tools to reduce cycle times and optimize conversion costs.
• Ensure customer satisfaction (Voice of Customer) and cross-zone synchronization, driving proactive communication and alignment across production lines to meet overall program milestones.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

• Education: Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree or a related discipline.
• Experience: At least 3 years in Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or Planning & Production Control within an industrial or aerospace environment.
• Soft skills: Strong leadership and conflict management skills, high autonomy, collaborative mindset, and adaptability to a night-shift shopfloor rhythm.
• Languages: Advanced level in Spanish & English (both written and spoken).
• Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of aircraft electrical/system assembly and testing processes, alongside continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, cost reduction, process digitalization).
• Valuable / Nice to have: Prior experience in A330 MRTT conversion or heavy aircraft modification/MRO; experience managing direct shopfloor teams and subcontracted labor; knowledge of EASA Part 21 / Part 145 regulations; familiarity with tools such as SIPLA, CATIA, DEMAT, or Bar Chart.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Health Physicist / Deputy Radiation Safety Officer serves as a key technical leader within the Radiation Safety organization, supporting the Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) in maintaining regulatory compliance, protecting workers from radiological hazards, and supporting radiopharmaceutical manufacturing operations. This role provides technical oversight for radiation protection activities, contamination control, radiological work planning, dosimetry, event investigations, and regulatory compliance programs. The position serves as a technical subject matter expert and is expected to independently evaluate complex radiological issues, develop defensible technical positions, and support interactions with regulatory agencies, including the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC).

Location: Indianapolis, IndianaThis role is based in Indianapolis, Indiana.
#LI-Onsite

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Radiation Safety Program, ensuring strong standards of radiological protection.
• Partner with the Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) and Radiation Safety Committee to maintain compliance with NRC regulations, license commitments, and internal procedures.
• Develop and maintain radiation safety programs covering contamination control, dosimetry, radiological work controls, and exposure monitoring.
• Lead and support radiological assessments, including contamination investigations, airborne radioactivity evaluations, dose assessments, and event reconstruction.
• Provide expert technical support during radiological events, investigations, recovery activities, and regulatory reporting evaluations.
• Develop high-quality technical basis documents, regulatory position papers, and NRC response packages, supporting inspections, audits, and licensing activities.
• Evaluate operations against ALARA principles and regulatory requirements, identifying opportunities to strengthen radiation protection practices.
• Support Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities, including investigations and effectiveness reviews.
• Develop and review Radiological Work Permits (RWPs) and conduct hazard assessments to recommend appropriate engineering and administrative controls.
• Strengthen radiation safety capability through training and mentoring, while supporting radioactive material accountability, waste management, instrumentation, and contamination control programs.

• Bachelor's degree in health physics, Nuclear Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or related scientific discipline.
• 7-10 years of health physics, radiation protection, nuclear operations, or related experience, or 5+ years of significant radiopharmaceutical manufacturing experience.
• Working knowledge of NRC regulations and radiation protection principles.
• Experience in radiological assessments, contamination control, radioactive material handling, and radiation detection instrumentation.

Desirable Requirement:

• Certified Health Physicist (CHP) or progress toward certification. Experience supporting NRC-licensed radiopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.
• Experience with internal dosimetry, contamination investigations, regulatory compliance programs, and technical report preparation.
