jobs.title: Manager - R&D
jobs.description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Why Campbell’s…

• Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
• Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
• Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
• If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
• Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
• Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

How You Will Make History Here…

The successful candidate in this role will lead the development of new and improved Ready to Serve (RTS) Soup product designs that meet well-defined business propositions via consumer testing, while managing a small team of product development scientists. This individual will combine hands-on technical expertise in formulation, experimentation, and scale-up with people leadership to deliver innovation, renovation, cost, and quality initiatives from concept through commercialization.

The individual in this role will work independently, must possess an excellent knowledge base of technical principles and experimentation, and must demonstrate creative problem-solving and strong project leadership skills.

What You Will Do…

• Independently develop and manage technical timelines and activities for multiple product development projects and ensure the coordination and execution of projects led by the team.
• Work with Marketing, CCID, and Commercialization Planning to define key milestones and specific R&D activities and timing.
• Lead product development projects from concept to commercialization based on product design criteria and consumer insights, ensuring projects deliver on time, in full, and with technical rigor.
• Work with Process R&D and Engineering to define ingredient handling and blending equipment requirements.
• Lead trials in pilot plant and manufacturing locations to assess feasibility and define finished product specifications that meet consumers’ expectations.
• Support interactions with internal and external manufacturing facilities and suppliers to enable project success.
• Proactively apply scientific knowledge and/or technical skills to business issues and opportunities.
• Identify and define technical design requirements, evaluate research results, and incorporate consumer test results into the formulation of prototypes.
• Develop prototypes that deliver against business objectives, including cost and nutritional targets.
• Perform and direct analysis, testing, and experiments to develop and/or improve products and processes.
• Identify and communicate potential product constraints or risks and problem-solve for solutions.
• Lead the preparation of and provide sound technical guidance, proposals, and recommendations.
• Manage, develop, and engage direct reports, including product development scientists, contractors, and/or co-ops.
• Set clear priorities, delegate work appropriately, and provide coaching, training, and feedback to support the growth and career development of team members.
• Ensure the team is employing scientific rigor and discipline in the development and commercialization process and motivate the team to take ownership and deliver results.
• Partner with the Senior Manager to align resources and prioritize RTS Soup needs across critical interfacing teams, including PDM, Ingredient, and Optiva.
• Work with Marketing and Consumer Insights to identify and build concepts against new products and/or platforms.
• Demonstrate an innovative mindset, command of the innovation process, thought leadership, business strategy, and creative problem-solving.
• Lead awareness of industry developments and pursue ingredient, product, or technology advances for application to new and innovative product initiatives.
• Manage and prioritize projects for self and the team, balancing multiple project initiatives simultaneously and remaining flexible to changing directions and rapid timelines.
• Identify critical path items and risks, troubleshoot issues, remove barriers, and effectively communicate and elevate these to both the business team and management.
• Provide critical thinking and technical product leadership on project direction and drive alignment with key project stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
• Manage and motivate direct reports to exhibit strong drive and ownership while maintaining personal technical contributions on key projects.
• Work closely with Purchasing on ingredient supply and costing and support key product supplier relationships.
• Work closely with PR&D, Engineering, and Operations to identify, define, and commission new ingredient handling and/or blending equipment.
• Leverage internal and external expertise in resolving technical challenges.
• Work with co-packers, as needed, using effective communication skills and the ability to quickly adapt CSC formulas to their equipment and systems.

Who You Will Work With…

This position is on the Soup & Broth R&D team supporting the RTS Soup portfolio and will report directly to the Senior Manager, R&D, Meals & Beverages, Ready to Serve.

This position requires partnering with Marketing, CCID, Supply Chain, Quality, Packaging, Engineering, Purchasing, Sensory, Regulatory, Operations, Process R&D, Commercialization Planning, internal and external manufacturing facilities, suppliers, and co-packers throughout the development and commercialization process.

What You Bring to the Table… (Must Haves)

• Minimum BS in Food Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 6+ years of experience in food product development and/or food manufacturing.
• Proficient technical R&D expertise in product design, processing technologies, scale-up, and manufacturing.

It Would Be Great if You Have… (Nice to Haves)

• MS in Food Science or a related field.
• Experience developing and commercializing high- and low-acid products.
• Prior experience leading, coaching, or directly managing scientists, technologists, contractors, and/or co-ops.
• Understanding of the cost and sensory performance drivers of product design, along with knowledge of financials and business acumen, including P&Ls and ingredient costing.
• Strong influencing, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with cross-functional teams and multiple levels of management.
• Comfortable driving decisions, with the ability to delegate tasks to direct reports, contractors, and/or co-ops as appropriate and provide training and feedback as necessary.
• Strong project management, organizational, and documentation skills, with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Ability to deal with ambiguity, multitask, adapt to change, and persevere on projects with less definition in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to balance multiple project initiatives simultaneously and remain flexible to changing directions and rapid timelines.
• Ability to provide creative problem-solving, critical thinking, technical product leadership, and strong project leadership.
• Ability to work independently and apply scientific rigor and discipline throughout the product development and commercialization process.

Working Conditions

• Hybrid working environment from Camden based office, with ~20-30% expected travel to manufacturing locations.

• A significant portion of the job is in the thermal production environment; thus, the work exposes the employee to heat and hot food products, coolers, and freezers requiring the use of personal protective equipment.
• Ability to walk/stand up at times for up to ¾ of the workday.
• Physical ability to handle weights of up to approximately forty pounds.
• Handle allergens including dairy, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, wheat, eggs and other food ingredients, chemicals, and allergens while wearing appropriate PPE.
• Willingness and ability to taste and evaluate a wide range of food products and ingredients.

Compensation and Benefits:

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$118,600-$163,100

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.

jobs.title: Category Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description :

Job title: Category Strategy Manager

Contract: permanent

Location: London

About the Function

Sales is where our brands meet the real world.

This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter.

It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.

About the role

To support the development and execution of category strategies internally and externally that drive sustainable growth and commercial performance across Global Travel.

The role is responsible for translating category, customer, shopper, consumer, and market insights into actionable recommendations that support commercial decision-making and execution across global travel markets. Working closely with the Revenue Growth Management team and cross-functional stakeholders, the Category Strategy Manager helps adapt global category strategies to specific Global Travel market needs while identifying growth opportunities and tracking category performance.

Key Accountabilities

·  Category Strategy Execution: Support the adaptation and implementation of category strategies across Global Travel, ensuring global strategic priorities are translated into actionable recommendations that reflect local market dynamics and customer needs.

·  Market Insights & Category Analysis: Develop and maintain a strong understanding of category, consumer, shopper, customer, and competitive trends. Analyse data from multiple sources to identify growth opportunities, performance drivers, risks, and emerging market developments.

·  Commercial Planning Support: Partner with commercial, customer, marketing, and revenue growth management teams to ensure category insights are integrated into commercial planning, customer strategies, and execution plans.

·  Category Performance Tracking: Monitor category performance against strategic objectives, providing regular analysis and recommendations to support decision-making and continuous improvement. Identify performance gaps and opportunities to optimise commercial outcomes.

·  Global & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with regional and global category teams to provide market feedback, performance insights, and local perspectives that support the ongoing refinement of category strategies. Build strong relationships across functions to ensure alignment and successful execution.

Key Competencies

·  Category & Commercial Insight

·  Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving

·  Stakeholder Management & Communication

Experience/skills required

Qualifications

·  Bachelor's degree in applicable or related discipline.

·  Strong understanding of category management, commercial planning, consumer insights, or customer strategy.

·  Proficiency in data analysis and insight-generation tools.

Experience

·  Experience in Category Management, Category Strategy, Customer Marketing, Commercial Strategy, Insights, Sales, Marketing, or a related commercial function.

·  Experience analysing market, consumer, shopper, customer, and performance data to generate actionable insights.

·  Experience supporting commercial planning processes and translating insights into business recommendations.

·  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with multiple sources of data and information.

·  Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders within a matrix environment.

·  Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced commercial setting.

·  Strong written, verbal, presentation, and storytelling skills.

Working with Us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

jobs.title: Strikeforce Internship
jobs.description:
Job Description:

About the team

DXC Strikeforce carries out penetration tests, red team operations and other offensive security assessments for DXC's clients. The team also builds its own internal tools. Less time spent on preparation and administration means more time for the assessments themselves.

About the internship

You join the team's internal engineering work and help automate the supporting tasks around security assessments. You design and build automations that consultants start themselves from the team's internal platform. The automations hand their results back for review. The platform is a real product that the team uses every day, and a team member mentors you throughout the internship.

Responsibilities

• Work with the consultants to find out which recurring supporting tasks take the most time and which ones can be automated.
• Design and develop new modules for the team's internal web platform for assessment management and reporting.
• Automate the creation, configuration and removal of short-lived test environments in the team's lab.
• Build security testing tools into automated, repeatable workflows, and collect and structure their output.
• Build features that help consultants review and prioritise results, including AI-assisted analysis.
• Develop securely: access control, safe handling of secrets and confidential data, logging and automated tests.
• Measure the results of your work, such as the time it saves and the quality of its output.
• Document your designs and your work, and present them to the team.
• Work in short iterations with regular demos and code reviews, and report on your progress.

What you will learn

• How a professional offensive security team prepares and runs its assessments.
• How to develop and automate on an internal platform that is used in production, with your code reviewed by experienced engineers.
• How to use AI responsibly in a security context.
• How to work with confidential data under clear rules of engagement.

Your profile

Required

• You are a final-year student in applied computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering or a related field.
• You have programming experience and are comfortable reading, writing and debugging code.
• You know your way around Linux and networking basics.
• You have used version control.
• You are strongly interested in offensive security and automation.
• You speak and write English well.

Nice to have

• Experience with automating infrastructure or deployments.
• Experience with web application development.
• Experience with virtualisation or cloud platforms.
• CTFs, security labs or personal security projects.
• Experience with AI or large language models in your own projects.
• Knowledge of Dutch & English.

Personal qualities

• You work independently and in a structured way, and you ask for help when you need it.
• You are curious and like to dig into how things work.
• You document your work so others can continue it.
• You are discreet and act ethically. You handle confidential information with care.

What we offer

• A mentor in the team and regular feedback.
• A real assignment with impact: the team will use your work on client engagements.
• Access to the team's lab environment and tooling.
• A close look at the daily work of an offensive security team.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Every day at FIS, innovators, problem solvers and changemakers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, unlock your next chapter with FIS.

Role location: Gurugram - (Hybrid Work Model)

About the role

As a Corporate Counsel – Senior, you will support corporate secretarial, governance and regulatory compliance activities for FIS legal entities in India. You will manage statutory obligations, Board and shareholder processes, corporate records and regulatory filings under the Companies Act, 2013 and related corporate laws. You will also provide practical legal and governance guidance to the India Legal team and key business stakeholders.

Your key responsibilities

• Manage end-to-end corporate secretarial compliance for FIS entities in India, including statutory registers, corporate records, compliance calendars and Ministry of Corporate Affairs and Registrar of Companies filings.
• Coordinate Board, Committee and shareholder meetings, including notices, agendas, resolutions, meeting materials, minutes, statutory approvals and post-meeting actions.
• Support corporate actions involving directors, key managerial personnel, auditors, authorised signatories, registered offices, shareholding, capital structure and related-party approvals.
• Review financial statements, Board reports, corporate disclosures and annual reporting documents from a corporate-law and governance perspective, while coordinating with Finance, auditors and external advisers.
• Monitor regulatory developments, identify compliance risks and provide practical legal and governance advice to Legal, Compliance, Finance, Tax, Human Resources, Procurement and business teams.

What you bring

Required qualifications

• Qualified Company Secretary and current membership with the Institute of Company Secretaries of India.
• Bachelor of Laws degree or an equivalent law qualification.
• Relevant experience in corporate secretarial, corporate governance and legal compliance, preferably within a large multinational or professionally managed organisation.
• Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, related rules, applicable Secretarial Standards and corporate governance requirements.
• Practical experience managing Board, Committee and shareholder meetings, statutory records, corporate actions and Ministry of Corporate Affairs and Registrar of Companies filings.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting multiple legal entities and managing parallel statutory deadlines.
• Experience reviewing commercial or vendor contracts and supporting corporate restructuring or legal-entity rationalisation projects.
• Experience working with directors, senior leaders, auditors, external consultants and cross-functional teams.

The impact you’ll make

As a Corporate Counsel – Senior, you will help ensure that FIS entities in India meet their legal, statutory and governance responsibilities accurately and on time. Your attention to detail and ownership will strengthen corporate records, support informed decision-making and provide a reliable audit trail. You will also help the business respond effectively to changing regulatory requirements and governance priorities.

The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Payments Platform to lead the delivery of new capabilities and changes across our Payments-as-a-Service platform supporting acquiring and issuing customers. The role will manage initiatives across card-present and card-not-present transaction processing, coordinating multiple product and technology teams from initiation through production delivery. You will work closely with customers, product, engineering, testing and operations teams to ensure changes are delivered effectively with clear ownership, governance and stakeholder communication.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead end-to-end delivery of new payment capabilities, platform enhancements and customer-driven changes.
• Manage projects across acquiring and issuing transaction processing, including card-present and card-not-present channels.
• Coordinate delivery across Connex switching, ePay, DigiPay, Data Navigator reporting, IST MAS and CLR clearing components.
• Develop and manage delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resources and implementation timelines.
• Coordinate across customers, product teams, engineering, testing, operations and other stakeholders to drive delivery.
• Manage scope, risks, issues, dependencies and blockers, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.
• Drive customer change controls from initiation and estimation through planning, approval, implementation and closure.
• Coordinate testing, implementation planning, production readiness and post-implementation activities.
• Ensure clear ownership and timely closure of actions across multiple teams.
• Provide concise delivery status, risks and key decisions to customers and senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Strong Project Management experience in payments, cards, banking or payment-processing platforms.
• Good understanding of acquiring and issuing transaction processing, including authorisation, clearing and settlement.
• Strong understanding of card-present and card-not-present payment flows and the end-to-end transaction lifecycle.
• Experience delivering new payment functionality, customer integrations and complex technology changes.
• Experience working with payment switches and transaction-processing platforms; Connex experience is highly desirable.
• Experience managing delivery across multiple systems, teams, customers and external dependencies.
• Strong knowledge of change control, release management, RAID management and delivery governance.
• Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business teams.
• Proven ability to drive ownership, accountability, prioritisation and timely delivery.
• Strong team player with a proactive, structured and outcome-focused approach.
• Desirable: Experience using AI tools in project delivery for planning, risk and dependency management, status reporting, meeting/action tracking and project documentation.
• Applicants must have full, unrestricted working rights in Australia. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

We offer:

• Internal career growth opportunities

• Opportunities to innovate in fintech

• Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere

• Professional and personal development

• Resources to contribute to your community

jobs.title: Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Apprenticeship, Cheltenham 2027 Intake
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

This is a unique opportunity to complete a Health, Safety and Environmental Apprenticeship for a global Aerospace company, applying the technical skills learned in a practical environment supported by a team of experienced environment, health and safety professionals.

Job Description

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives.  Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

With over 1,700 employees, GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham is one of the largest sites outside the USA and a major contributor to the local economy.

Our heritage dates back to 1940 yet our technology is cutting-edge. Located in the heart of Gloucestershire, the Power Distribution & Controls (PD&C) site focuses on the design, development and manufacture of state-of-the-art aircraft power distribution and avionics systems for the global aviation industry. Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. The scale and complexity of engineering projects offer our employees unique opportunities to work on major international projects, developing critical aircraft systems that will be relied on by many people for decades to come.

At GE Aerospace we strive to be an employer of choice by offering internships, apprenticeships, mentoring and staff development programmes that create a workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential.

Innovation, a commitment to engineering excellence and leadership development places GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham as a pioneering force in building the future of flight.

Role description

As part of this role, you’ll undertake and complete the Safety, Health and Environment Technician Apprenticeship at Level 3 through our provider High Ridge.

Overview of the scheme

This qualification is designed for the aspiring professional wishing to move into Health and Safety and Environmental Management. The successful apprentice will be eligible to apply for Technician Level membership of IOSH and as such this standard sits at the same level as the NEBOSH Certificate or NVQ Level 3

• The duration of the training is 24 months and the whole programme is online delivery with a combination of online sessions and 1-2-1 sessions with a tutor

• End-Point Assessment (EPA): Knowledge test, Project Report and Presentation, Professional Discussion

• Additional training to take place to develop knowledge, skills, and behaviours in accordance with this Apprenticeship standard

Qualifications that you'll gain:

• Level 3 Safety, Health and Environment Technician apprenticeship standard

Key responsibilities:

• Assist in the development, management, implementation and monitoring of the Safety, Health and Environmental Management System

• Learn to identify hazards and evaluate risk

• Support and assist in the implementation of SHE inspections and closing out of issues identified

• Assist with the investigation of accidents, incidents, dangerous occurrences, near misses and other incidents as directed

• Undertake monitoring, analysis of and reporting of SHE KPI’s

• Prepare and maintain records relating to safety, health and environmental matters that comply with legal and workplace requirements and are accessible to those who are authorised to use them

• Assist with managing and maintaining relationships with external stakeholders such as local authorities

• Research SHE issues and best practices

• Review updates of health and safety regulations

• Recognise where decisions have a financial cost and assisting to develop a budget

• Recognise situations where the activity will benefit from contributions and expertise of other internal departments such as HR, Finance, IT or Occupational Health

Qualifications/Requirements

Please ensure you have achieved, or are predicted, the minimum grades below, as these are set by our academic provider. Failure to meet these grades could mean you are not eligible to join the programme.

Essential:

• 5 GCSE’s (or equivalent), including Maths and English, at grades C/4 or above. Evidence of certificates must be provided.

Desired:

• 3 A-levels (or equivalent) at grades C or above (or equivalent)

• Confidence with Microsoft Office

• Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills

• An ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Interest in pursuing a career in Environment, Sustainability, Health and Safety

• Commitment to personal and professional development

• Self-motivation with effective time management skills and ability to meet deadlines, including the ability to prioritise and work methodically and accurately.

• A safety-first attitude.

Total Reward

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.

As a new joiner to GE we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs:

• Performance based annual bonus

• Non-contributory Pension

• Life Assurance

• Group income protection

• Private medical cover

• Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages include a video interview and assessment centre. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process.

If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team via Apprenticeship.Queries@geaerospace.com.

Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Please note our applications will close on Sunday 22nd November but may close earlier dependant on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Applicants will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and if successful at stage one, will be invited to video interview. All candidates will be contacted by end of December latest to confirm if their application is being progressed to assessment Centre, which are currently planned for January 2027.

Security Clearance

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

Right to Work

Applications from job seekers who require sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. However, under the applicable UK immigration rules as may be in place from time to time, it may be that candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be appointed to a post if a suitably qualified, experienced and skilled candidate who does not require sponsorship is available to take up the post. Further, under immigration rules, sponsorship is not available for all posts. For further information please visit the UK Visas and Immigration website.

Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward.

jobs.title: LCE Systems NPI Turbomachinery Integrator
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Large Combat Engines (LCE) is at the nexus of advancing the state of the art for future military air superiority technology while also providing unwavering reliable propulsion systems to support today’s war fighters. The LCE Systems New Product Introduction (NPI) Turbomachinery Integrator leads cross-organization integration efforts for all turbomachinery design Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) on advanced F110 platforms. As part of the NPI Systems subsection, this role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with the Edison Works organization on tomorrow’s next gen military propulsion products while leveraging the success and legacy of today’s F110 engines.  LCE is a vibrant and growing organization supporting fielded engines for the US Air Force, US Navy, Foreign Militaries, and NPI offerings for Turkish Aerospace and Edison Works.

In this position, you will work across engineering, program management, supply chain, test, quality, and customer teams to solve complex technical problems within a Flight Deck framework. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who brings strong technical judgement, operates with a high level of autonomy, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

• Act as the primary point of contact with the Edison Works organization for the turbomachinery in support of Next Gen Products programs.
• Develop and execute qualification plans with the Edison Works organization that satisfy the certification requirements of the products.
• Conduct component and product integration. All activities that span multiple turbomachinery components and products and are concerned with how to integrate for maximum performance and operability. Manages flow down of product and systems requirements, specifications from the Edison Works team to the LCE team. Drives validation and verification activities for the overall product/system, including system level testing. Manages interface between components and execution organizations. Manages the overall product configuration and configuration control system.
• Execute required action plans needed to resolve system-level issues.
• Execute the design, analysis, or evaluation of assigned projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirements.
• Provide technical leadership to personnel supporting the assigned project.
• Document technical data generated by the assigned project consistent with engineering policies and procedures.
• Provide timely communications on significant issues or developments.
• Participate on teams assigned to address organizational initiatives and generic issues.
• Participate as a presenter or reviewer in technical and program reviews.
• Uses judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of operational/product management, manufacturing, technology or engineering. Takes new perspective on existing solutions. Uses technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions.
• Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus. Developing persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or aeronautical engineering (or a similar discipline focused on mechanical or aerothermal design) from an accredited college or university.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in an engineering position.
• Due to the nature of the duties of this position, this role requires the individual to obtain and maintain US Government Security Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S. citizenship

Desired Characteristics

• Mechanical design or systems engineering experience on turbomachinery related component and/or subsystem.
• Familiarity with F110-GE-129 propulsion system and specifications.
• Active DoD Security Clearance at the Secret level or higher.
• Recognized as approachable, collaborative and inclusive.
• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
• Established project management skills.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
• Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
• Passion for lean and continuous improvement.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

jobs.title: Working Student – Thermal Systems Design / CFD Analysis (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As a CFD Thermal Systems Design Working Student, you will support the development of advanced thermal systems through computational analysis and simulation. Your work will focus on predicting thermal and fluid flow behavior in heat exchangers and secondary air systems, validating experimental data, and supporting design optimization. You'll work with industry-standard CFD tools and collaborate with engineers to turn complex simulations into actionable design insights.

Job Description

Start: January 2027 or later |  Duration: min. 6 months  |  Working hours: 20 h/week

Key Responsibilities

• Support the Munich Thermal Systems Design team in CFD simulations and thermal system development
• Set up, run, and analyze CFD simulations for test rigs and secondary air system features
• Compare simulation and experimental results to improve model accuracy and support design decisions
• Create and maintain 3D CAD models and computational meshes for thermal and flow analysis
• Analyze simulation data, document findings, and share results with the team
• Use AI and data analysis tools to accelerate insight generation and pattern recognition

Required Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a BSc (3rd year or above) or MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
• Strong interest in aerospace engineering, heat transfer, thermal systems, and CFD
• Knowledge of CFD methods and experience through coursework or projects, ideally with ANSYS Fluent or CFX
• Experience with 3D CAD tools, ideally Siemens NX
• Understanding of mesh generation and its impact on simulation quality
• Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with ANSYS Fluent, CFX, or similar CFD tools
• Knowledge of Python, Bash, MATLAB, or similar tools for automation and post-processing
• Familiarity with turbulence models, HPC environments, or CFD validation with test data
• Basic knowledge of AI/ML for simulation data analysis

Why Join Us

• Gain hands-on experience in aerospace CFD and thermal systems
• Work on real engineering challenges with experienced thermal engineers
• Access advanced simulation tools, HPC resources, and AI technologies
• Build a strong technical foundation in an international environment

Apply now and take the first step towards an exciting career in aerospace engineering!

Learn more about our Garching team and the innovative work they’re doing here: https://invent.ge/garching

jobs.title: Auto Damage Trainee (Field)
jobs.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Please note: This is not a remote role; you will be required to work in the territory listed on the job posting.

Your Impact at GEICO

As a Field Auto Damage Trainee, you’ll provide reassurance and solutions that make a difference in our customers' lives when they need us the most after an accident. You will inspect and assess vehicle damage, estimate vehicle repair costs, negotiate equitable settlements, and partner with body shops, rental companies, and parts providers.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

Compensation & Incentives:

• Starting Salary: $27.98 per hour / $56,375 annually
• Benefits: Health and wellness benefits starting Day 1 (medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts and more). Accrue Paid Time Off immediately, plus 13 paid holidays annually (8 fixed, 5 floating). 401(k) with up to 6% match, vested immediately. GEICO Strive, upfront tuition assistance program (up to $5,250 annually).
• Professional Growth: Licensing and continuing education at no cost, including hundreds of eLearning courses to enhance your skills. GEICO’s industry-leading paid trainee program includes 3 weeks of required hands-on experience at our Ashburn, VA training facility. In addition, 2 weeks in a field training center (NY, TX, CA), with mentors to help you learn and grow.
• Field Territory: GEICO Fleet vehicle assigned and responsible for the Richmond, VA area.

How You’ll Make a Difference

• Customer Interaction: Consult with involved parties, review insurance contracts, inspect vehicles, write estimates, and manage rental cars.
• Problem Resolution: Resolve customer concerns, ensuring a positive experience.

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Controls Engineer specializing in industrial automation and manufacturing controls to support the design, implementation, launch, and ongoing support of automated manufacturing systems. This position will focus heavily on machining operations and controls systems, requiring strong experience with Siemens automation technologies, including TIA Portal. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record supporting manufacturing equipment, troubleshooting complex controls issues, and leading automation projects through implementation and launch. This role requires extensive travel to manufacturing facilities during critical project execution and launch phases.

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, commission, and support automation and controls systems for manufacturing operations.

• Support machining manufacturing processes and associated automation equipment.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement robust corrective actions for production issues.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, maintenance, and engineering teams.

• Support equipment launches and process improvements at manufacturing sites.

• Coordinate controls-related activities with suppliers, machine builders, and system integrators.

• Maintain controls documentation, standards, and backups.

• Support production monitoring, data collection, material call, and plant floor control systems.

• Lead controls activities during project planning, implementation, startup, and launch.

Your Skills and Abilities (Required Qualifications)

• Experience programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial PLC-based control systems.
• Experience with industrial automation platforms, with preference for Siemens technologies such as TIA Portal and/or Step 7.
• Experience supporting industrial automation systems in a manufacturing or production environment.
• Experience integrating PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, drives, robotics, and machine control systems.
• Demonstrated success diagnosing and resolving issues with automated manufacturing equipment and processes.
• Strong problem-solving, root cause analysis, and troubleshooting skills in fast-paced production environments.
• Ability to travel extensively to support manufacturing operations, equipment installations, commissioning activities, and new product launches.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience supporting CNC machining equipment and machining environments.
• Deep expertise with Siemens PLCs, TIA Portal, and Step 7.

• Experience with new equipment installations and launch activities.

• Knowledge of production monitoring, MES, and plant floor information systems.

• Experience working with machine builders, automation integrators, and suppliers.

Are you curious about power systems and looking to start your career in one of the most exciting areas of the energy transition?

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Global Commercial Risk Leader plays a pivotal role in the strategic direction and success of the Wind business globally.
This role requires a dynamic individual who can provide effective governance of a complex business which will deliver between up to $10B of annual order intake across New Units, Services and Aftermarket.
Recognised as a subject matter expert, you will oversee and ensure compliance to GE Vernova risk processes, bringing assertive leadership, ensuring that risk is thoroughly evaluated and that commercial deals enable successful and profitable execution.
This role requires capable leadership, exceptional commercial acumen and the ability to lead teams spanning the North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific regions.  The role demands high energy given the need to work proactively to identify risks, ensure the effectiveness of processes and strive for continuous improvement.

Job Description

Essential Behaviours

The Global Commercial Risk Leader will:

• Create the agenda – proactively identifying and mitigating key risks to ensure the business remains ahead of emerging threats.
• Make the complex simple – analysing issues and making recommendations.
• Bring a point of view – add value where it matters through commercial judgement.
• Drive organizational change – digitizing and standardizing processes and mobilizing people to achieve measurable results.
• Raise the quality of global processes and governance.
• Exercise high-level judgment and courage to challenge business assumptions in executive forums, acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on complex, cross-functional risk decisions.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Provide leadership vision and deliver on priorities for the global Commercial Risk team. [~6 FTE].
• Play a key role in the global Commercial Operations Leadership team, working closely with Regional Commercial Directors to proactively address issues and develop strategies to deliver on business objectives and targets.
• Act as a strategic commercial partner to the business, identifying high-impact risk trends before they manifest into deal issues, and proactively influence commercial strategies to maximize margin and minimize risk exposure.
• Act as domain and subject matter export for Contracting, Commercial and Technical Risk in the GE Vernova Wind business, a complex business spanning New Units, Services and Aftermarket.
• Provide contracting and risk underwriting advice across a range of Product and Service offerings (New Units, Services, Re-Powering, Aftermarket) as well as execution scopes (Equipment, Logistics, Installation) and Contracting types (Turbine Supply Agreements, Full Service Agreements, Transactional).
• Develop, maintain, and execute a robust risk review and delegation of authority process (R – table) globally to ensure consistency and transparency to risk.
• Mature and transform risk infrastructure, process and tools to deliver year-over-year productivity and enhanced quality of the global risk function.
• Work across the business segment cross-functionally to ensure all stakeholders are aligned to risk and underwriting, whilst driving process improvements.
• Work with the Global Projects and Services organisations in the implementation of an end-to-end process of lessons learned in which key issues are identified, screened, subject to detailed problem-solving and then addressed with appropriate countermeasures.
• Validate risk and reward balance, considering factors such as terms and conditions, technical risks, fulfilment capacity, margin and security of payment.
• Provide leadership and guidance to the Insurance Risk Manager to mitigate risk exposure by identifying risk profiles from insurance obligations and/or contractual injury/damage exposure in contracts for the supply of equipment and contracts for the provision of maintenance services.
• Establish a robust framework for deal and risk review, lead risk review meetings, and contribute to approval escalation meetings.
• Establish connections across the GE Vernova business and implement proactive assessments of risk anticipating and in response to changes in the business environment whilst learning and applying best practices.
• Review and approve risk modules. Maintain an overview of global deal approval status to ensure deals remain on track.
• Maintain a robust process for New Country Entry, ensuring that deals are reviewed comprehensively, and we are ready to execute considering Legal and Tax risks, Product compliance, Grid compliance, Project and Service delivery and other factors. T
• rack, aggregate and perform analytics of global deal risk and provide insights on areas for improvement.
• Develop tools towards leaner negotiations on terms and conditions, while maintaining the desired risk profile.
• Lead initiatives within the sales/commercial organization to drive process rigor and simplification within the overall risk management process. Work with a clear focus in supporting the Commercial team to achieve its business plan.

Required Experience and Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree from accredited university with extensive (equivalent to 15+/- years) commercial/sales experience with capital equipment sales/commercial operations in the energy sector, or equivalent knowledge/experience
• Strong people leader skill managing a large a diverse team of different cultures and time zone, particular experience working with colleagues outside the US
• Strong oral, written, and presentation skills
• Ability to handle fast-paced demanding dynamic commercial role with multiple deals in process at different times
• Strong interpersonal leadership skills, influencing skills, ambition, and self-confidence
• Strong risk and underwriting experience
• Track record of leading cross-functional transformation initiatives, with demonstrated success in improving operational metrics (e.g., risk scoring, deal cycle time, or process compliance) within a matrixed environment
• Strong contractual/legal understanding of large energy project equipment contracting including Services and After-market
• Broad energy markets, energy construction/logistics, and energy project financing understanding

Desired Experience and Qualifications

• MBA or Masters Degree or JD from accredited university
• Direct Commercial Operations or Risk leadership of wind equipment
• Demonstrated international contracting experience Demonstrated continuous improvement competencies

In this mission-critical role, you will build a resilient and scalable supply chain for specialized high-temperature electrochemical components, metal and ceramic materials, and balance-of-plant systems. You will lead the transition from development-stage procurement to a high-volume, cost-competitive manufacturing supply chain, ensuring we meet our decarbonization targets and commercial deployment goals. This role will have exciting opportunities to help define and develop sustainable solutions to the biggest challenges in the ongoing Energy Transition and sustainable fuels, which is the core of GE Vernova business.
GE Vernova’s Advanced Research center is the central innovation engine for GE Vernova’s portfolio of energy businesses, which will be unified under one banner called GE Vernova. The research organization is made up of 400+ researchers representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline. Collectively, they are driving major research programs and initiatives to decarbonize power, accelerate renewables, and promote electrification and the creation of a 21st century grid fit to power a zero-carbon energy future.

jobs.title: Stage - Ingénieur Matériaux ou Ingénieur Chimie F/H
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie, organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification. Fort de plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en travaillant à sa décarbonation, avec plus de 70 000 employés répartis dans plus de 100 pays. Le segment Electrification de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et systèmes de réseau avancés, permettant la transmission et la distribution d'énergie depuis le point de génération jusqu'au point de consommation, et soutient une transition énergétique décarbonisée et sécurisée.

Les transformateurs de puissance jouent un rôle essentiel dans la transmission de l’énergie électrique. De tels équipements sont remplis de liquides isolants, principalement issus de produits pétroliers, mais aussi de produits biosourcés, recyclés ou encore biodégradables.

Job Description

Présentation du poste

Le stage s’effectuera dans le centre de recherche du site industriel de Villeurbanne (HVTRC), et plus particulièrement au laboratoire matériaux et éco-conception.

Missions

Dans le cadre de l’extension des activités du laboratoire matériaux et éco-conception, le sujet de stage proposé porte sur le développement de nouveaux moyens d’essais pour caractériser les huiles isolantes utilisées dans les transformateurs. Pour rappel, de nombreux transformateurs sont remplis d’un liquide (huile) qui assure à la fois une fonction d’isolant électrique et de fluide caloporteur. Un bon état de l’isolation liquide assure un bon fonctionnement du transformateur et il est donc important de pouvoir la caractériser.

Plus particulièrement, l’objectif du/de la stagiaire sera de réaliser des études de compatibilité entre les liquides isolants et d’autres matériaux solides (élastomères, peinture, cellulose, …) en contact avec le liquide.  L’influence de différents paramètres tels que le type d’huile (biosourcée, biodégradable, recyclée, …), le ratio liquide/solide et la température seront étudiés. L’évaluation sera effectuée à travers différentes analyses physico-chimiques : résistivité/tan delta, acidité, tension interfaciale, DSC, teneur en humidité, IR …

Le stage pourra se découper en 4 axes :

- Bibliographie sur les essais de compatibilité existants

- Mise en place de l’essai / choix des matériaux/ plan d’expérience avec les différents paramètres à étudier

- Réalisation des essais et des mesures

- Evaluation des résultats et recommandations

Formation

Ecole d’Ingénieur ou Université avec une formation à dominante Matériaux, Physico-chimie ou Chimie

Connaissances requises

•Langues : Français et anglais parlé et écrit

•Savoir-faire : curiosité, esprit d’innovation, adaptabilité, autonomie et esprit d’équipe

Date de début du stage et durée

Pour 6 mois à partir de Mars/Avril 2027

jobs.title: Stagiaire - Ingénieur R&D F/H
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie, organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification. Fort de plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en travaillant à sa décarbonation, avec plus de 70 000 employés répartis dans plus de 100 pays. Le segment Electrification de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et systèmes de réseau avancés, permettant la transmission et la distribution d'énergie depuis le point de génération jusqu'au point de consommation, et soutient une transition énergétique décarbonisée et sécurisée.

Sur son site industriel situé à Villeurbanne (France), conçoit, teste et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés aux opérateurs de réseaux et industriels  nationaux et internationaux.

Job Description

Stagiaire - Simulation de la migration de molécules polaires dans un mélange gazeux sous champ électrique constant - Application appareillages HVDC.

Le stage comportera deux étapes principales. La première consistera à réaliser une recherche

bibliographique sur les phénomènes électrostatiques susceptibles de favoriser la migration des

molécules polaires, c'est-à-dire le C4F7N et/ou le H2O (présent sous forme de traces résiduelles

d'humidité), au sein du mélange gazeux g3 (mélange a base de C4F7N/CO2/02) sous pression, en

s'appuyant notamment sur le champ électrique macroscopique imposé par la géométrie de

l'appareillage et le champ résultant crée par les dipôles. La seconde consistera a développer un

premier modèle de simulation, limité dans un premier temps aux effets électrostatiques, afin

d'estimer l'ampleur de ces phénomènes dans une configuration représentative d'un appareillage

haute tension a courant continu (HVDC). La modélisation sera menee dans un premier temps en

géométrie 1D, puis étendue à une géométrie 2D axisymétrique. La personne effectuera son stage au LAPLACE a Toulouse et sera rattachée a la société GE Vernova.

Contacts et encadrement :

Olivier EICHWALD, LAPLACE

Raphael AMIOT

Contexte :

Afin d'améliorer la compatibilité environnementale des appareillages haute tension, le gaz SF6,

actuellement très répandu mais possédant un potentiel de réchauffement planétaire très élevé, est

progressivement remplace par des mélanges gazeux alternatifs. Le mélange g3, combinant du C4F7N (fluoronitrile) avec du CO2 et de I'O2, constitue l'une des alternatives les plus prometteuses pour les applications d'isolation et de coupure en haute tension.

Le developpement des reseaux a courant continu (HVDC) conduit au deploiement d'appareillages

fonctionnant sous tension continue. Or, contrairement au régime alternatif, l'application prolongée

d'un champ électrique continu peut favoriser des phénomenes de transport et de migration des

espèces moléculaires polaires présentes dans le mélange gazeux. Les molecules polaires C4F7N et H2O (dont la présence est liée à des traces résiduelles d'humidité) pourraient ainsi être soumises à une force de dérive sous champ continu rentrant en compétition avec les phénomènes de diffusion.

La migration resultante pourrait, a terme, engendrer une modification locale de la concentration de

C4F7N ou de H2O au sein du volume de gaz, notamment dans les zones de champ électrique intense (points triples, surfaces d'isolateurs, voisinage des électrodes). Une diminution locale de la

concentration de C4F7N se traduirait par un affaiblissement local du pouvoir diélectrique du mélange, pouvant potentiellement favoriser l'apparition d'une décharge et conduire a un amorçage diélectrique prématuré de l'appareillage.

À noter une spécificité propre au régime continu : le champ électrique macroscopique imposé par la géométrie de l'appareillage diffère entre l'état initial a vide (« zéro load »), ou les isolants solides ne sont pas chargés, et le régime établi en pleine charge (« high load »), ou la charge des isolants solides, dépendante de la cartographie thermique de l'appareillage, modifie la répartition du champ. Cette évolution du champ macroscopique constitue une donnée d'entrée essentielle pour l'étude de la migration des espèces polaires.

Sujet :
Dans un premier temps, le stage se concentre sur les phenomenes electrostatiques, laissant les aspects

électromagnétiques ainsi que les effets de diffusion comme pistes d'approfondissement ultérieures.

Le stage se deroulera au laboratoire LAPLACE en plusieurs etapes :

Partie 1 - Recherche bibliographique et analyse physique

. Étude du champ electrique macroscopique impose par la geometrie de l'appareillage en

regime continu, et de son evolution entre l'etat « zero load » et l'etat « high load > en fonction

de la charge des isolants solides et de la cartographie thermique

· Recherche bibliographique sur les mécanismes d'interaction des molécules polaires (C4F7N,

H20) avec le champ electrique, notamment le moment dipolaire induit et le champ resultant

créé par les dipôles

. Collecte des données physico-chimiques du C4F7N et du g3 (moment dipolaire, grandeurs

thermodynamiques)

. Identification, a titre exploratoire, du role potentiel du champ magnetique induit par le

courant dans le conducteur et par le déplacement des charges, ainsi que des phénomènes de

diffusion, en vue d'un approfondissement ulterieur

Partie 2 - Developpement et exploitation d'un outil de simulation

. Développement d'un premier modèle électrostatique, limité aux effets électrostatiques,

couplant le champ macroscopique impose par l'appareillage et le champ resultant induit par

les dipôles polaires

. Modélisation menée dans un premier temps en géométrie 1D, puis étendue à une géométrie

2D axisymėtrique

. Application du modele à une configuration representative d'un appareillage HVDC

. Premiere estimation de l'impact du deplacement des especes polaires sur la rigidité

diélectrique locale du gaz

Compétences attendues :

• Appétences pour la programmation informatique et les outils mathématiques de résolution d'équations différentielles (électromagnétique et/ou mécanique des fluides)
• Culture scientifique en électromagnétisme et/ou physico-chimie moléculaire et/ou génie électrique et/ou physique générale
• Être curieux et motive par le sujet
• Savoir présenter ses résultats et posséder de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles

Lieu du stage :

LAPLACE UMR 5213, CNRS, Toulouse INP, Universite de Toulouse, Bat 3R2, 118 rte de Narbonne, 31650

Toulouse.

Creating an inclusive work environment is very important to us. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we encourage and inspire others to grow and achieve success. Join GE Vernova where you can achieve your goals in an environment where you feel a sense of belonging.

Supported by the Company’s purpose, The Energy to Change the World, GE Vernova technology helps deliver a more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy future. Grid Solutions, a GE Vernova business, serves customers globally with over 20,000 employees. We provide power utilities and industries worldwide with equipment, systems, and services to bring power reliably and efficiently from generation to end consumers. By enabling the safe and reliable connection of renewable and distributed energy resources to the grid, we are helping accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and carbon-neutral future.

jobs.title: Termeléstámogató mérnök – EDM
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Szívesen alakítanád, hogyan készülnek az energetikai iparág kulcsfontosságú alkatrészei? Nálunk olyan gyártási megoldásokat fejleszthetsz, amelyek biztonságosabbá, ergonomikusabbá és hatékonyabbá teszik a munkát. Ötleteidet nemzetközi csapatokkal együtt valósíthatod meg.

Te felelsz majd az EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining, szikraforgácsolás) területének gyártási folyamataiért. Olyan feltételeket teremtesz, amelyek mellett a termelés biztonságos, jó minőségű, időben teljesül és hatékony.

Job Description

Fő feladatok

• Meghatározod és felügyeled az EDM gyártási folyamatokat, a szerszámokat és a berendezéseket.
• Vezeted az új termékek és technológiák bevezetését (NPI, azaz új termék bevezetési projektek) az ötlettől a gyártásindításig. Támogatod a prototípus-készítést, a tesztelést, a validálást és az anyagminták biztosítását.
• Fejlesztesz és beállíttatsz ergonomikus készülékeket, valamint emelésmentes („no-lift") megoldásokat a nehéz munkadarabokhoz.
• Elemzed a meglévő folyamatokat, és Lean és Kaizen (folyamatos fejlesztési) kezdeményezésekkel növeled a hatékonyságot és csökkented a költségeket.
• Elkészíted a technológiai és munkautasításokat, és gondoskodsz róla, hogy a tervek megfeleljenek a műszaki, minőségi és szabályozási követelményeknek.
• Együttműködsz a gyártási és minőségügyi csapatokkal, valamint az amerikai mérnöki kollégákkal.
• Leállíthatod a gyártást, ha minőségi kockázat vagy sérülésveszély merül fel.

Kit keresünk

Olyan gépészeti gyártási tapasztalattal rendelkező mérnököt, aki szeret problémákat megoldani, és nyitott a nemzetközi együttműködésre.

Elvárásaink:

• Gépészmérnöki, gyártástechnológiai mérnöki vagy hasonló műszaki felsőfokú végzettség
• Gépipari területen szerzett tapasztalat.
• Társalgási szintű angol és magyar nyelvtudás.
• Biztonságtudatos szemlélet (EHS, azaz egészség, környezetvédelem és munkabiztonság).
• Word, Excel és AutoCAD (vagy hasonló program) használata.

A kiválasztás során előnyként értékeljük:

• Erőművi vagy energetikai ismeretek.
• Lean, Kaizen vagy Six Sigma gyakorlat, valamint NPI vagy készüléktervezési tapasztalat.
• Nemzetközi való együttműködés.

A GE Vernova Gas Power üzletágának százhalombattai telephelye 2005-ben indult el és jelenleg 55 kollégát foglalkoztat. A gyár olyan precíziós hűtőfurat-megmunkálási technológiákkal rendelkezik, amelyek hatékonyabbá teszik a turbinamotorok működését, elősegítve a költségmegtakarítást, a működési időtartam növelését és a károsanyag-kibocsátás csökkentését. Kollégáink számára jó munkakörülményeket, családias környezetet, folyamatos szakmai kihívásokat és stabil munkalehetőséget biztosítunk.

jobs.title: Commercial Bank AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Summary:

The AI Product Manager sets product strategy and drives the planning, prioritization, and delivery of AI and data-enabled products that advance Commercial Banking’s AI transformation agenda. This role owns the product strategy and plan for one or more priority AI domains across the commercial client lifecycle (e.g., client service, credit, capital markets, treasury management, and sales) end-to-end – from opportunity assessment and problem definition through business case, build, governance, launch, and measured adoption – partnering closely with engineering, data science, segment risk, compliance, the Commercial Digital product team, and the central Enterprise Data & AI Strategy and Technology Innovation functions. The AI Product Manager is accountable for translating Commercial Banking’s highest-value opportunities into a clear product vision and an executable roadmap, integrated with existing digital channels, that delivers measurable value to customers and colleagues.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Define and own the product strategy for assigned Commercial Banking domains (e.g., client service, credit, capital markets, treasury management, and sales): a clear point of view on where AI creates differentiated value for clients and colleagues, which problems to solve first, and what not to pursue.
• Shape a multi-year product vision grounded in client and colleague needs, market and competitive insight, and emerging AI capabilities, and translate it into outcome-based goals (e.g., OKRs) and a prioritized roadmap.
• Assess build, buy, partner, and enterprise-platform reuse options, recommending trade-offs that balance value, speed to market, risk, and cost, and revisit the strategy as results, technology, and business priorities evolve.
• Own end-to-end accountability for the broader product plan, stakeholder messaging, and investment case for assigned AI initiatives – not just the backlog or delivery schedule.
• Build and defend the business case (cost, benefit, PPNR/revenue impact, and risk) required to secure and sustain funding through Huntington’s AI governance and prioritization process.
• Serve as the credible, single point of accountability that segment leaders, technology partners, and executive sponsors can turn to for status, trade-offs, and outcomes.
• Lead with user value: define the colleague or client benefit and the problem to be solved before selecting a capability, model, or vendor.

• Use design thinking and direct engagement with relationship managers, service teams, and customers to validate needs, pain points, and workflow context before scoping solutions.

• Translate validated needs into clear product requirements and acceptance criteria for cross-functional delivery teams.
• Maintain one integrated view across initiatives, segments, data readiness, cross-functional dependencies, and adoption.

• Partner across Commercial, Regional Banking, Payments, Wealth, Insurance, Ops, Risk, and Technology Innovation to align priorities, sequencing, and shared data foundations.

• Maintain a current, transparent roadmap and dependency map that leadership can use to make sequencing and resourcing decisions.

• Partner closely with the Commercial Digital product team to integrate AI capabilities into existing client- and colleague-facing digital channels and platforms, rather than building standalone experiences.
• Align AI product roadmaps with Commercial Digital roadmaps and release plans, jointly planning dependencies, sequencing, and shared capacity so AI features ship as part of the broader digital experience.
• Establish shared intake, prioritization, design standards, and success metrics with Commercial Digital product owners to deliver consistent client and colleague experiences and avoid duplicative investment.
• Define success before launch: establish baselines, target metrics, business outcomes, and attribution methodology in partnership with Finance and Analytics before development begins.

• Ensure measurement goes beyond usage counts to tie adoption to real business outcomes – revenue, banker productivity, customer experience, and risk/quality.

• Report progress against the defined baseline and value case throughout the product lifecycle, adjusting scope when tracking falls short of plan.
• Build within workflows and channels: design and deliver capabilities that meet colleagues and clients where they already work and bank, including existing CRM, servicing, and digital channels, rather than requiring new tools or habits.

• Partner with HR, segment leaders, and change management to build role-specific training, manager reinforcement, and adoption reporting for each launch.

• Continuously gather adoption and quality feedback post-launch and iterate on the product to close usage and value gaps.
• Move from roadmap to execution: convert prioritized concepts into resourced, sequenced delivery plans with clear owners, milestones, and go-live dates.

• Serve as product manager for one or more cross-functional pods (engineers, data scientists, analysts), prioritizing the backlog and ensuring iterative, quality delivery each sprint/quarter.

• Navigate Huntington’s AI governance lifecycle (business value definition, solution assessment, governance/risk review, contracting, and implementation) to keep initiatives on track and in compliance.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, or a related field
• 7+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of AI, machine learning, or data-driven products from concept through launch.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working in an Agile/Scrum delivery model as a product owner or product manager for a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and analysts.

• Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and vision, building and managing a product roadmap, writing business requirements, and defining measurable success criteria (KPIs, OKRs, or equivalent).
• Experience in commercial banking, corporate banking, or another regulated financial services environment, including familiarity with credit, treasury, or relationship-management workflows.

• Experience with generative AI/agentic AI products, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, including Financial Services Cloud), and enterprise data platforms.

• Experience integrating AI or data-driven capabilities into existing digital banking channels and platforms in partnership with digital product, design, and engineering teams
• Familiarity with model risk management, AI governance, and regulatory considerations (e.g., fair lending, data privacy) within banking.
• Track record partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance to move AI initiatives through formal governance and funding approval processes.
• Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting business cases, roadmaps, and value narratives to senior leadership and steering committees.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. ·         Perform blood collections by venipuncture and capillary techniques for all age groups

·         Collect specimens for drug screens, paternity tests, alcohol tests etc.

·         Perform data entry of patient information in an accurate and timely manner

·         Process billing information and collect payments when required

·         Prepare all collected specimens for testing and analysis

·         Maintain patient and specimen information logs

·         Provide superior customer service to all patients

·         Administrative and clerical duties as necessary

·         Travel to additional sites when needed

·         High school diploma or equivalent

·         3 months or more experience as a phlebotomist

Preferred Qualifications:

·         Phlebotomy certification or completed training program

·         In lieu of work experience, a Phlebotomy certification or completed training program must come from an accredited agency

·         Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service

·         Strong communication skills; both written and verbal

·         Ability to work independently or in a team environment

·         Comfortable working under minimal supervision

·         Reliable transportation and clean driving record if applicable

·         Flexibility to work overtime as needed
